# 全部已保存评测代码（按内容去重）

代码仅作为审计材料展示。各历史版本是否进入统计，由冻结清单和尝试索引确定。

## accept_frozen.py

保存的项目源代码/历史快照；具体执行身份须结合调用清单和运行日志核对。

SHA-256：`fa66eb138add64317b927092a9f642db20b73fe3ee48fb18e7e8d06b933b3d0b`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,concurrent.futures,hashlib
from verify_recorder import verify
from run_formal import manifest_check,FROZEN,ROOT,JAVA,ASSETS
fid=manifest_check()
def run(name,observe,port):
    out=ROOT/'results'/(name+'.csv')
    cmd=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g','-Dmindustry.eval.manualDuo=true','-Dmindustry.eval.earlyGraphite=true',f'-Dmindustry.eval.formalRecorder={str(observe).lower()}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.freezeId={fid}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourceRoot={FROZEN}/src',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourcePath={FROZEN}/src/Pilot.java',f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={port}','-cp',f'{FROZEN}/classes:{FROZEN}/server.jar','Pilot','stainedMountains',str(FROZEN/'layouts/balanced-A.csv'),str(out),'5400','0']
    with (ROOT/'logs'/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ASSETS,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert p.returncode==0,(name,p.returncode)
    if observe:verify(out)
    return name
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
    print(list(pool.map(lambda x:run(*x),[('frozen-on',True,43110),('frozen-off',False,43111),('frozen-repeat',True,43112)])),flush=True)
prefix=ROOT/'results'
hashes={}
for suffix in ['', '.events.csv','.batches.csv','.windows.csv','.stages.csv']:
    a=(prefix/('frozen-on.csv'+suffix)).read_bytes();b=(prefix/('frozen-repeat.csv'+suffix)).read_bytes()
    assert a==b,'Repeat mismatch '+suffix
    hashes[suffix or 'main']=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()
assert (prefix/'frozen-on.csv').read_bytes()==(prefix/'frozen-off.csv').read_bytes(),'Observer changed game'
verify(prefix/'frozen-G3-siege.csv')
result=dict(passed=True,freeze_id=fid,native_global_rng_seed_once=True,observer_on_off_main_byte_identical=True,repeat_all_four_logs_byte_identical=True,hashes=hashes,formal_samples_added=0)
(prefix/'frozen-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
````

## accept_v2.py

保存的项目源代码/历史快照；具体执行身份须结合调用清单和运行日志核对。

SHA-256：`6badedb68ac9c120e4e35285d6ea918672e8464025d7eb46c50fbb468ac479b4`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
import concurrent.futures,json,subprocess,gzip,hashlib
from run_formal import ROOT,FROZEN,JAVA,ASSETS,manifest_check
from verify_recorder import verify
fid=manifest_check()
def read(path):return path.read_bytes() if path.exists() else gzip.open(str(path)+'.gz','rb').read()
jobs=[]
for family,mp,layout,group,seed,stage in [('A','stainedMountains','balanced-A','G0',0,0),('B-regression','windsweptIslands','balanced-B','G3',1002,1)]:
    for variant,observe in [('on',True),('repeat',True),('off',False)]:jobs.append((family,variant,observe,mp,layout,group,seed,stage))
def run(index,job):
    family,variant,observe,mp,layout,group,seed,stage=job
    path=ROOT/'results'/f'v2-{family}-{variant}.csv'
    cmd=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g','-Dmindustry.eval.manualDuo=true','-Dmindustry.eval.earlyGraphite=true',f'-Dmindustry.eval.formalRecorder={str(observe).lower()}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.freezeId={fid}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourceRoot={FROZEN}/src',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourcePath={FROZEN}/src/Pilot.java',f'-Dmindustry.eval.group={group}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={46400+index}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.stageOrdinal={stage}']
    if family=='B-regression':
        cmd += ['-Dmindustry.eval.runId=S-A-balanced-G3-a00-s1002',f'-Dmindustry.eval.carryIn={ROOT}/formal-rejected-v1/S-A-balanced-G3-a00-s1002/A-attempt1.csv.carry.csv']
    cmd+=['-cp',f'{FROZEN}/classes:{FROZEN}/server.jar','Pilot',mp,str(FROZEN/'layouts'/(layout+'.csv')),str(path),'5400',str(seed)]
    with (ROOT/'logs'/f'v2-{family}-{variant}.log').open('w') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ASSETS,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert r.returncode==0,(family,variant,r.returncode)
    if observe:verify(path)
    print('completed',family,variant,flush=True)
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    futures=[pool.submit(run,i,j) for i,j in enumerate(jobs)]
    for f in futures:f.result()
hashes={}
for family in ['A','B-regression']:
    base=ROOT/'results'/f'v2-{family}-on.csv'
    for suffix in ['','.events.csv','.batches.csv','.windows.csv','.stages.csv']:
        a=read(Path(str(base)+suffix));assert a==read(ROOT/'results'/f'v2-{family}-repeat.csv{suffix}'),(family,'repeat',suffix)
        hashes[family+suffix]=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()
    assert read(base)==read(ROOT/'results'/f'v2-{family}-off.csv'),(family,'observer effect')
old=ROOT/'formal-rejected-v1/S-A-balanced-G3-a00-s1002/B-attempt1.csv'
old_battle=b''.join(line for line in read(old).splitlines(keepends=True) if b',carry_out,' not in line)
assert old_battle==read(ROOT/'results/v2-B-regression-on.csv'),'Recorder correction changed battle log'
events=read(ROOT/'results/v2-B-regression-on.csv.events.csv').decode()
assert 'order_native_resume' in events,'Regression did not exercise same-tick native resume'
result=dict(passed=True,freeze_id=fid,observer_on_off_main_byte_identical=True,repeat_all_four_logs_byte_identical=True,native_same_tick_resume_exercised=True,recorder_correction_battle_log_unchanged_excluding_original_postgame_carry=True,hashes=hashes,formal_samples_added=0)
(ROOT/'results/frozen-acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
````

## add_deferred_cause_hooks.py

历史源码补丁或记录器生成辅助；最终有效代码以冻结JAR及清单为准。

SHA-256：`6fc6890e7a9dc41ec333f306a5d7053ccbd6f72d797aaf97252c4742a20f72a6`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/core/src/mindustry')
def save(rel,suffix='before-deferred-cause'):
 p=root/rel;s=p.read_text();b=Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/patches')/(p.name+'.'+suffix)
 if not b.exists():b.write_text(s)
 return p,s
p,s=save('core/EvaluationTrace.java');s=s.replace('        default void waveBegin(int wave){}','''        default Object captureCause(Team direct){return null;}
        default void causeBegin(Object token){}
        default void causeEnd(Object token){}
        default void waveBegin(int wave){}''')
s=s.replace('    private EvaluationTrace(){}','''    public static Runnable wrap(Runnable task){return wrap(task,null);}
    public static Runnable wrap(Runnable task,Team direct){
        Sink observer=sink;if(observer==null)return task;
        Object token=observer.captureCause(direct);if(token==null)return task;
        return () -> {
            if(sink!=observer){task.run();return;}
            observer.causeBegin(token);
            try{task.run();}finally{observer.causeEnd(token);}
        };
    }
    private EvaluationTrace(){}''');p.write_text(s)
def call_wrap(s,dynamic_bounds=None):
 positions=[];start=0
 while True:
  i=s.find('Time.run(',start)
  if i<0:break
  a=i+len('Time.run(');depth=1;j=a;comma=None
  while depth:
   c=s[j]
   if c=='(':depth+=1
   elif c==')':depth-=1
   elif c==',' and depth==1 and comma is None:comma=j
   j+=1
  if comma is None:raise ValueError('No delay/task split')
  task=s[comma+1:j-1].strip();source=',ignoreTeam' if dynamic_bounds and dynamic_bounds[0]<=i<dynamic_bounds[1] else ''
  positions.append((comma+1,j-1,' mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.wrap('+task+source+')'));start=j
 for a,b,replacement in reversed(positions):s=s[:a]+replacement+s[b:]
 return s
p,s=save('entities/Damage.java');start=s.index('public static void dynamicExplosion(float x, float y, float flammability, float explosiveness, float power, float radius, boolean damage, boolean fire, @Nullable Team ignoreTeam, Effect explosionFx, float baseShake)');end=s.index('public static void createIncend',start);p.write_text(call_wrap(s,(start,end)))
p,s=save('world/blocks/power/PowerGenerator.java');p.write_text(call_wrap(s))
p,s=save('entities/bullet/BulletType.java');signature='public void hitTile(Bullet b, Building build, float x, float y, float initialHealth, boolean direct)';i=s.index(signature);a=s.index('{',i);depth=1;j=a+1
while depth:
 if s[j]=='{':depth+=1
 elif s[j]=='}':depth-=1
 j+=1
body=s[a+1:j-1];s=s[:a+1]+'\n        var evaluationObserver=mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink;\n        if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.bulletBegin(b);\n        try{'+body+'\n        }finally{if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.bulletEnd(b);}\n    '+s[j-1:];p.write_text(s)
print('Added observation-only cause propagation through native delayed tasks')
````

## add_energy_fire_hooks.py

历史源码补丁或记录器生成辅助；最终有效代码以冻结JAR及清单为准。

SHA-256：`f38b816aa882010e43b35d0ad1fccdc7c65c7a8180cf647b63b31dc3176c58de`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/core/src/mindustry')
def edit(rel,fn):
 p=root/rel;s=p.read_text();backup=Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/patches')/(p.name+'.before-energy-fire')
 if not backup.exists():backup.write_text(s)
 p.write_text(fn(s))
def wrap(s,signature,begin,end):
 i=s.index(signature);a=s.index('{',i);depth=1;j=a+1
 while depth:
  if s[j]=='{':depth+=1
  elif s[j]=='}':depth-=1
  j+=1
 body=s[a+1:j-1]
 return s[:a+1]+'\n'+begin+'\n        try{'+body+'\n        }finally{'+end+'}\n    '+s[j-1:]
edit('core/EvaluationTrace.java',lambda s:s.replace('        default void waveBegin(int wave){}','''        default void powerUsage(Building build, float requested, float received){}
        default void fireCreated(Fire fire){}
        default void fireIgnited(Bullet bullet, Fire fire){}
        default void fireBegin(Fire fire){}
        default void fireEnd(Fire fire){}
        default void bulletBegin(Bullet bullet){}
        default void bulletEnd(Bullet bullet){}
        default void waveBegin(int wave){}'''))
edit('entities/comp/BuildingComp.java',lambda s:s.replace('        updateConsumption();\n\n        if(enabled', '''        updateConsumption();
        var evaluationObserver=mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink;
        if(evaluationObserver!=null && power!=null && block.consPower!=null && !block.consPower.buffered && shouldConsumePower){
            float requested=block.consPower.requestedPower(self()) * delta();
            evaluationObserver.powerUsage(self(),requested,requested * power.status);
        }

        if(enabled'''))
edit('entities/Fires.java',lambda s:s.replace('            fire.time = 0f;\n        }\n    }', '            fire.time = 0f;\n        }\n        if(mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink!=null)mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink.fireCreated(fire);\n    }'))
edit('entities/bullet/BulletType.java',lambda s:s.replace('            Fires.create(build.tile);', '            Fires.create(build.tile);\n            if(mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink!=null)mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink.fireIgnited(b,Fires.get(build.tile));'))
edit('entities/bullet/FireBulletType.java',lambda s:s.replace('            Fires.create(b.tileOn());','            Fires.create(b.tileOn());\n            if(mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink!=null)mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink.fireIgnited(b,Fires.get(b.tileOn()));'))
edit('entities/comp/FireComp.java',lambda s:wrap(s,'public void update()', '        var evaluationObserver=mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink;\n        if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.fireBegin(this.<Fire>self());', 'if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.fireEnd(this.<Fire>self());'))
edit('entities/bullet/BulletType.java',lambda s:wrap(s,'public void hit(Bullet b, float x, float y, boolean createFrags)', '        var evaluationObserver=mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.sink;\n        if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.bulletBegin(b);', 'if(evaluationObserver!=null)evaluationObserver.bulletEnd(b);'))
print('Added exact native-frame power usage and persistent fire/bullet cause observers; pending build')
````

## add_trace_hooks.py

Optional read-only observer. Null by default; must never call simulation mutators.

SHA-256：`e59fe734811a5e010ff0945e66f25b42dee2b216886ab7ccedd5607945d1171c`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/core/src/mindustry')
trace='''package mindustry.core;

import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.type.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.modules.*;

/** Optional read-only observer. Null by default; must never call simulation mutators. */
public final class EvaluationTrace{
    public static Sink sink;
    public interface Sink{
        default void stock(ItemModule module, int item, int before, int after){}
        default void produce(Team team, int producer, Item item, int amount){}
        default void construction(Building site, Block target, Item item, int amount){}
        default void healing(Building source, int target, float amount){}
        default void waveBegin(int wave){}
        default void waveEnd(int wave){}
        default void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup group, float x, float y, int base, int adjusted){}
        default void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup group, Unit unit){}
    }
    public static void stock(ItemModule m,int i,int before,int after){if(sink!=null && before!=after)sink.stock(m,i,before,after);}
    public static void produce(Team t,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(sink!=null)sink.produce(t,producer,item,amount);}
    public static void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(sink!=null && amount>0)sink.construction(site,target,item,amount);}
    public static void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(sink!=null && amount>0)sink.healing(source,target,amount);}
    private EvaluationTrace(){}
}
'''
(root/'core/EvaluationTrace.java').write_text(trace)
def edit(rel,old,new):
 p=root/rel;s=p.read_text()
 if old not in s:raise ValueError((rel,old))
 backup=Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/patches')/(p.name+'.before-trace')
 if not backup.exists():backup.write_text(s)
 p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
f='world/modules/ItemModule.java'
edit(f,'import mindustry.type.*;','import mindustry.type.*;\nimport mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace;')
edit(f,'items[index] --;','int previous=items[index];\n                items[index] --;\n                EvaluationTrace.stock(this,index,previous,items[index]);')
edit(f,'total += (amount - items[item.id]);\n        items[item.id] = amount;', 'int previous=items[item.id];\n        total += (amount - previous);\n        items[item.id] = amount;\n        EvaluationTrace.stock(this,item.id,previous,amount);')
edit(f,'items[item] += amount;\n        total += amount;', 'int previous=items[item];\n        items[item] += amount;\n        total += amount;\n        EvaluationTrace.stock(this,item,previous,items[item]);')
edit(f,'items[item.id] -= amount;\n        total -= amount;', 'int previous=items[item.id];\n        items[item.id] -= amount;\n        total -= amount;\n        EvaluationTrace.stock(this,item.id,previous,items[item.id]);')
edit(f,'public void clear(){\n        Arrays.fill(items, 0);\n        total = 0;\n    }','''public void clear(){
        int[] previous=EvaluationTrace.sink==null?null:items.clone();
        Arrays.fill(items,0);total=0;
        if(previous!=null)for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++)EvaluationTrace.stock(this,i,previous[i],0);
    }''')
edit(f,'total = other.total;\n        takeRotation', 'int[] previous=EvaluationTrace.sink==null?null:items.clone();\n        total = other.total;\n        takeRotation')
edit(f,'System.arraycopy(other.items, 0, items, 0, items.length);', 'System.arraycopy(other.items, 0, items, 0, items.length);\n        if(previous!=null)for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++)EvaluationTrace.stock(this,i,previous[i],items[i]);')
edit('world/blocks/production/Drill.java','offload(dominantItem);','offload(dominantItem);\n                    mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.produce(team,id,dominantItem,1);')
edit('world/blocks/production/GenericCrafter.java','offload(output.item);','offload(output.item);\n                        mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.produce(team,id,output.item,1);')
edit('entities/comp/MinerComp.java','//add item to inventory before it is transferred','mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.produce(team(),id,item,1);\n                    //add item to inventory before it is transferred')
edit('entities/comp/MinerComp.java','}else if(acceptsItem(item)){','}else if(acceptsItem(item)){\n                    mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.produce(team(),id,item,1);')
edit('world/blocks/ConstructBlock.java','core.items.remove(current.requirements[i].item, itemsLeft[i]);','core.items.remove(current.requirements[i].item, itemsLeft[i]);\n                                mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.construction(this,current,current.requirements[i].item,itemsLeft[i]);')
edit('world/blocks/ConstructBlock.java','inventory.remove(current.requirements[i].item, maxUse);','inventory.remove(current.requirements[i].item, maxUse);\n                        mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.construction(this,current,current.requirements[i].item,maxUse);')
edit('world/blocks/defense/MendProjector.java','other.heal(other.maxHealth()', 'float beforeHealth=other.health;\n                    other.heal(other.maxHealth()')
edit('world/blocks/defense/MendProjector.java','other.recentlyHealed();','mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.healing(this,other.id,other.health-beforeHealth);\n                    other.recentlyHealed();')
edit('world/blocks/units/RepairTurret.java','target.heal(repairSpeed * strength * edelta() * multiplier);','float beforeHealth=target.health;\n                    target.heal(repairSpeed * strength * edelta() * multiplier);\n                    mindustry.core.EvaluationTrace.healing(this,target.id,target.health-beforeHealth);')
print('Added optional observer hooks; not yet built or validated')
````

## analyze_calibration.py

C独立统计、支付、帧质量和S/C方向校准。

## analyze_formal.py

从已接受S原始记录计算运行等权与配对统计。

SHA-256：`f04a6a7d5e159efc67e3d7999ccbcdc5cef9764e69c299958082292f382d9a9b`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Derived evidence only: route-equal statistics, paired seeds, and explicit missing inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,gzip,json,math,hashlib
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'report'
MILESTONES=['salvo_static','salvo_combat','army_formed','rts_attack','first_enemy_core','late_lock']
METRICS=['rmct_seconds','sim_seconds','empty_turret_seconds','threat_turret_seconds','missing_item_seconds','missing_liquid_seconds','power_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds','zero_efficiency_seconds','efficiency_loss_seconds','repair_effective_hp','repair_energy','grid_satisfaction','expand_seconds','defense_seconds','rebuild_seconds']

def read(path):
    path=Path(path)
    with (path.open() if path.exists() else gzip.open(str(path)+'.gz','rt')) as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))

def write(name,rows):
    if not rows:return
    fields=list(dict.fromkeys(k for r in rows for k in r))
    with (OUT/name).open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)

def numeric(v):
    try:return float(v)
    except (ValueError,TypeError):return None

def mean(values):
    values=[v for v in values if v is not None]
    return sum(values)/len(values) if values else None

def wilson(k,n):
    if not n:return [None,None]
    z=1.959963984540054;p=k/n;den=1+z*z/n
    c=(p+z*z/(2*n))/den;r=z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/den
    return [max(0,c-r),min(1,c+r)]

def paired(a,b,sign=1):
    # a-b, same seed; bootstrapping seed pairs, never individual waves.
    ids=sorted(set(a)&set(b));delta=[sign*(a[i]-b[i]) for i in ids if a[i] is not None and b[i] is not None]
    if not delta:return dict(pairs=0,mean_difference=None,ci_low=None,ci_high=None)
    x=np.array(delta,dtype=float);rng=np.random.default_rng(6021103)
    boot=x[rng.integers(0,len(x),size=(2000,len(x)))].mean(axis=1)
    lo,hi=np.quantile(boot,[.025,.975])
    return dict(pairs=len(x),mean_difference=float(x.mean()),ci_low=float(lo),ci_high=float(hi))

def key(job):return job['track'],job['chain'],job['policy'],job['group'],float(job['alpha'])
def labels(k):return dict(zip(['track','chain','policy','group','alpha'],k))

def collect():
    routes=[];invalid=[]
    for f in sorted((ROOT/'formal').glob('*/route.json')):
        r=json.loads(f.read_text());r['route_file']=str(f)
        (routes if r['valid'] else invalid).append(r)
    return routes,invalid

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);routes,invalid=collect();(OUT/'analysis_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'valid_route_files':[r['route_file'] for r in routes],'invalid_route_files':[r['route_file'] for r in invalid]},indent=2)+'\n');by=defaultdict(list);stages=defaultdict(list)
    for r in routes:
        by[key(r)].append(r)
        for s in r['stages']:stages[key(r)+(s['stage'],)].append((r,s))
    rates=[];stage_rows=[];tier_rows=[];milestone_rows=[];paired_rows=[];operations=[];route_milestones={}
    for k,rs in by.items():
        n=len(rs);wins=sum(r['complete'] for r in rs);lo,hi=wilson(wins,n)
        rates.append({**labels(k),'valid_routes':n,'complete_routes':wins,'completion_rate':wins/n,'wilson_low':lo,'wilson_high':hi,'core_loss_route_rate':sum(any(s['summary']['core_lost']=='true' for s in r['stages']) for r in rs)/n})
        for r in rs:
            elapsed=0;times={m:None for m in MILESTONES}
            for s in r['stages']:
                v=s['summary']
                for m in times:
                    if times[m] is None and v.get(m+'_seconds','')!='':times[m]=elapsed+float(v[m+'_seconds'])
                elapsed+=float(v['sim_seconds'])
            route_milestones[r['run_id']]=times
        for m in MILESTONES:
            vals=[route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in rs];achieved=[v for v in vals if v is not None];lo,hi=wilson(len(achieved),n)
            milestone_rows.append({**labels(k),'milestone':m,'valid_routes':n,'achieved':len(achieved),'attainment_rate':len(achieved)/n,'wilson_low':lo,'wilson_high':hi,'actual_achiever_mean_seconds':mean(achieved),'truncated_3L_mean_seconds':mean([v if v is not None else 16200 for v in vals]),'truncated_routes':n-len(achieved)})
    route_operations=[];paired_route_operations=[];route_op_values={}
    for k,rs in by.items():
        values={}
        for r in rs:
            v={category:sum(float(s['summary'][category+'_seconds']) for s in r['stages']) for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']}
            v['observed_seconds']=sum(float(s['summary']['sim_seconds']) for s in r['stages']);v['construction_seconds']=sum(v[category] for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild'])
            values[r['seed']]=v
        route_op_values[k]=values
        row={**labels(k),'valid_routes':len(rs),'exposure':'sum of observed stages; route failures remain in denominator','observed_route_seconds_mean':mean([v['observed_seconds'] for v in values.values()])}
        for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']:
            row[category+'_absolute_seconds_mean']=mean([v[category] for v in values.values()])
            row[category+'_construction_fraction_mean']=mean([v[category]/v['construction_seconds'] for v in values.values() if v['construction_seconds']>0])
            row[category+'_seconds_per_observed_hour_mean']=mean([3600*v[category]/v['observed_seconds'] for v in values.values() if v['observed_seconds']>0])
        route_operations.append(row)
    for k,values in route_op_values.items():
        if k[3]=='G0':continue
        baseline=route_op_values.get(k[:3]+('G0',k[4]),{})
        for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']:
            for scope in ['absolute_seconds','seconds_per_observed_hour']:
                def extract(v):return v[category] if scope=='absolute_seconds' else 3600*v[category]/v['observed_seconds']
                paired_route_operations.append({**labels(k),'category':category,'scope':scope,**paired({seed:extract(v) for seed,v in baseline.items() if v['observed_seconds']>0},{seed:extract(v) for seed,v in values.items() if v['observed_seconds']>0})})
    write('route_operations.csv',route_operations);write('paired_route_operations.csv',paired_route_operations)
    for ks,pairs in stages.items():
````

SHA-256：`f92508b5bef36fa5616f97de1ddaa20923fe63d137753910dde39555bb75028d`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/src/FormalRecorder.java')
s=p.read_text()
new=r'''
 final HashMap<Long,ArrayList<Unit>> enemyGrid=new HashMap<>();
 static long cellKey(int x,int y){return ((long)x<<32)^(y&0xffffffffL);}
 void indexEnemies(){enemyGrid.clear();for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team!=Team.sharded && u.team!=Team.derelict && !u.dead && u.isAdded())enemyGrid.computeIfAbsent(cellKey((int)Math.floor(u.x/128),(int)Math.floor(u.y/128)),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(u);}
 Ammo ammo(ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild b){
  ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo out=new Ammo();Turret.AmmoEntry chosen=b.ammo.size>0?b.ammo.peek():null;
  if(chosen!=null && chosen.amount<t.ammoPerShot)for(int i=0;i<b.ammo.size;i++)if(b.ammo.get(i).amount>=t.ammoPerShot){chosen=b.ammo.get(i);break;}
  if(chosen instanceof ItemTurret.ItemEntry entry){out.item=entry.item;out.type=entry.type();out.ready=entry.amount>=t.ammoPerShot && b.potentialEfficiency>0;}
  else{
   out.item=Items.copper;out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(Items.copper);
   if(out.type==null)for(Item item:content.items())if(t.ammoTypes.get(item)!=null){out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(item);break;}
  }
  return out;
 }
 boolean threat(Building b,Turret t,BulletType bullet){
  float range=t.range+(bullet==null?0:bullet.rangeChange);int minX=(int)Math.floor((b.x-range-80)/128),maxX=(int)Math.floor((b.x+range+80)/128),minY=(int)Math.floor((b.y-range-80)/128),maxY=(int)Math.floor((b.y+range+80)/128);
  for(int cx=minX;cx<=maxX;cx++)for(int cy=minY;cy<=maxY;cy++){
   ArrayList<Unit> bucket=enemyGrid.get(cellKey(cx,cy));if(bucket==null)continue;
   for(Unit u:bucket)if((u.isGrounded()?t.targetGround:t.targetAir) && t.unitFilter.get(u) && (bullet==null || bullet.targetMissiles || !(u instanceof TimedKillc)) && u.within(b,range+u.hitSize/2f))return true;
  }
  if(t.targetGround && t.targetBlocks && (bullet==null || bullet.targetBlocks))for(Building other:buildings.values())if(other.team!=Team.sharded && other.team!=Team.derelict && !other.dead && other.block.targetable && other.within(b,range))return true;
  return false;
 }
 void nominalRecipe(Building b,ItemStack[] recipe,double secondsPerCycle,Window w){if(secondsPerCycle>0)for(ItemStack stack:recipe)w.demand[stack.item.id]+=stack.amount/secondsPerCycle/60.0;}
 void facility(Building b,Window w)throws Exception{
  boolean isFacility=b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill;
  if(!isFacility)return;
  if(sleepField.getBoolean(b))w.sleeping+=1.0/60;
  boolean gate=false,blocked=false;
  double cycleTicks=0;ItemStack[] recipe=null;
  if(b instanceof GenericCrafter.GenericCrafterBuild crafter){
   GenericCrafter t=(GenericCrafter)b.block;boolean room=true;
   if(t.outputItems!=null)for(ItemStack output:t.outputItems)if(b.items.get(output.item)+output.amount>t.itemCapacity)room=false;
   if(t.outputLiquids!=null && !t.ignoreLiquidFullness){boolean allFull=true;for(LiquidStack output:t.outputLiquids){boolean full=b.liquids.get(output.liquid)>=t.liquidCapacity-0.001f;if(full && !t.dumpExtraLiquid)room=false;if(!full)allFull=false;}if(allFull)room=false;}
   blocked=b.enabled && !room;gate=b.enabled && room && b.productionValid();cycleTicks=t.craftTime*EvaluationParameters.cycle(b);
  }else if(b instanceof UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory){
   UnitFactory t=(UnitFactory)b.block;
   if(factory.currentPlan>=0 && factory.currentPlan<t.plans.size){var plan=t.plans.get(factory.currentPlan);boolean cap=mindustry.entities.Units.canCreate(b.team,plan.unit);blocked=b.enabled && (factory.payload!=null || !cap);gate=b.enabled && factory.payload==null && cap && b.team.activateUnitFactories();recipe=plan.requirements;cycleTicks=plan.time/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);}
  }else if(b instanceof Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor){
   Reconstructor t=(Reconstructor)b.block;gate=reconstructor.shouldConsume();blocked=b.enabled && reconstructor.payload!=null && !gate;cycleTicks=t.constructTime/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);
  }else if(b instanceof Drill.DrillBuild drill){Drill t=(Drill)b.block;blocked=b.enabled && b.items.total()>=t.itemCapacity;gate=b.enabled && drill.dominantItem!=null && drill.dominantItems>0 && !blocked;}
  if(blocked)w.blocked+=1.0/60;
  if(!gate)return;
  w.wantSeconds+=1.0/60;
  boolean lacksItem=false,lacksLiquid=false;
  for(Consume consumer:b.block.nonOptionalConsumers){
   ItemStack[] ingredients=consumer instanceof ConsumeItems ci?ci.items:consumer instanceof ConsumeItemDynamic ci?ci.items.get(b):null;
   if(ingredients!=null){float multiplier=consumer.multiplier.get(b);for(ItemStack ingredient:ingredients){int required=Math.round(ingredient.amount*multiplier);if(b.items.get(ingredient.item)<required)lacksItem=true;if(recipe==null && cycleTicks>0)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=required*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;}}
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquid liquid && b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquids liquids)for(LiquidStack liquid:liquids.liquids)if(b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
  }
  if(recipe!=null && cycleTicks>0)for(ItemStack ingredient:recipe)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=ingredient.amount*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;
  if(lacksItem)w.missingItems+=1.0/60;if(lacksLiquid)w.missingLiquid+=1.0/60;
  if(b.block.consPower!=null && !b.block.consPower.buffered)w.powerLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.power.status)))/60.0;
  if(b.efficiency<=1e-7)w.zeroEfficiency+=1.0/60;w.efficiencyLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.efficiency)))/60.0;
 }
 void step()throws Exception{
  syncCores();for(var core:Team.sharded.cores()){Account a=accounts.get(core.items);for(int i=0;i<a.balance.length;i++)if(a.balance[i]!=core.items.get(i))invalid("missed_stock_mutation;core="+core.pos()+";item="+i);}
  if(TimeDeltaInvalid())invalid("non_fixed_delta_or_cheat");
  indexEnemies();Window w=window((tick()-1)/18000);int salvoReady=0,salvoThreat=0;
  Iterator<Building> iterator=buildings.values().iterator();
  while(iterator.hasNext()){
   Building b=iterator.next();if(b.tile.build!=b || b.dead){iterator.remove();continue;}if(b.team!=Team.sharded)continue;
   if(!Float.isFinite(b.efficiency))invalid("nonfinite_efficiency;site="+b.pos());
   if(b instanceof ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild turret){
    ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo a=ammo(turret);boolean danger=b.enabled && threat(b,t,a.type);
    if(danger){w.threatSeconds+=1.0/60;if(!a.ready)w.emptySeconds+=1.0/60;
     if(a.type!=null){double cycles=t.reload+(!t.reloadWhileCharging?t.shoot.firstShotDelay:0);double shots=t.consumeAmmoOnce?1:t.shoot.shots;w.demand[a.item.id]+=shots*t.ammoPerShot/a.type.ammoMultiplier*a.type.reloadMultiplier*b.timeScale()/cycles;}
    }
    if(b.block==Blocks.salvo && b.enabled && a.ready){salvoReady++;if(danger)salvoThreat++;}
   }
   facility(b,w);
   if(b.power!=null && b.block.consPower!=null && !b.block.consPower.buffered && consumePowerField.getBoolean(b)){
    double requested=b.block.consPower.requestedPower(b)*b.timeScale(),received=requested*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.power.status));w.powerNeed+=requested;w.powerReceived+=received;if(repair(b.block))w.repairEnergy+=received;
   }
  }
  if(salvoReady>=3){
   if(salvoStreak>=10800)threatRingSum-=threatRing[ringIndex];threatRing[ringIndex]=salvoThreat;threatRingSum+=salvoThreat;ringIndex=(ringIndex+1)%10800;salvoStreak++;
   if(salvoStreak>=10800){milestone("salvo_static");if(threatRingSum>=5400)milestone("salvo_combat");}
  }else{salvoStreak=ringIndex=threatRingSum=0;}
  if(initialEnemyCores>0){int count=0;double hp=0;for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=Pilot.bot.unit() && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && AttackSupport.contains(u)){count++;hp+=u.health;}if(count>=8 && hp>=2000)milestone("army_formed");if(Team.crux.cores().size<initialEnemyCores)milestone("first_enemy_core");if(Team.crux.cores().isEmpty())milestone("all_enemy_cores");}
  for(int[] calls:workCalls.values()){int total=calls[0]+calls[1]+calls[2];if(total>0)for(int i=0;i<3;i++)w.operation[i]+=calls[i]/(double)total/60;}
  workCalls.clear();
  for(Batch b:batches)if(b.end<0){for(var e:b.units.entrySet())if(!b.terminated.contains(e.getKey()) && (e.getValue().dead || !e.getValue().isAdded())){b.terminated.add(e.getKey());emit("batch_unit_terminated","batch="+b.ordinal+";id="+e.getKey()+";dead="+e.getValue().dead);}if(b.sealed && b.terminated.size()==b.units.size()){b.end=tick();emit("batch_clear","ordinal="+b.ordinal);}}
 }
 boolean TimeDeltaInvalid(){return Math.abs(arc.util.Time.delta-1f)>1e-7 || state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().fillItems;}
 // OUTPUT_IMPLEMENTATION_FOLLOWS
'''
s=s.replace(' // OBSERVATION_AND_OUTPUT_IMPLEMENTATION_FOLLOWS',new)
p.write_text(s)
````

````python
new=r'''
 static final String META="run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds";
 static final String[] WINDOW_COLUMNS={"scope","item","facility","window","start_seconds","end_seconds","duration_seconds","supply","full_demand","construction_paid","flow_gap","net_shortage_core","opening_core_stock","due_unpaid_end","rebuild_paid","rebuild_equivalent","repair_material_paid","threat_turret_seconds","empty_turret_seconds","empty_fraction","want_facility_seconds","missing_item_seconds","missing_liquid_seconds","power_loss_seconds","zero_efficiency_seconds","efficiency_loss_seconds","blocked_seconds","sleep_seconds","repair_effective_hp","repair_energy","grid_requested_energy","grid_received_energy","grid_satisfaction","expand_seconds","defense_seconds","rebuild_seconds","expand_fraction","defense_fraction","rebuild_fraction"};
 void header(PrintWriter writer,String columns){writer.println("seq,"+META+","+columns);}
 void row(PrintWriter writer,int number,String... values){writer.println(number+","+fields()+","+tick()+","+(tick()/60.0)+","+String.join(",",values));}
 Map<String,String> windowBase(int index,double end,double duration,String scope){Map<String,String> r=new HashMap<>();r.put("scope",scope);r.put("window",String.valueOf(index));r.put("start_seconds",String.valueOf(index*300));r.put("end_seconds",String.valueOf(end));r.put("duration_seconds",String.valueOf(duration));return r;}
 void put(Map<String,String> row,String key,double value){row.put(key,Double.toString(value));}
 void windowRow(int number,Map<String,String> r){String[] values=new String[WINDOW_COLUMNS.length];for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++)values[i]=r.getOrDefault(WINDOW_COLUMNS[i],"");row(windowOut,number,values);}
 static double weight(Item i){return i==Items.copper?0.5:i==Items.lead?0.7:i==Items.graphite || i==Items.titanium?1:i==Items.silicon?0.8:0;}
 double[] totals(){double[] t=new double[17];for(Window w:windows.values()){
  t[0]+=w.threatSeconds;t[1]+=w.emptySeconds;t[2]+=w.wantSeconds;t[3]+=w.missingItems;t[4]+=w.missingLiquid;t[5]+=w.powerLoss;t[6]+=w.zeroEfficiency;t[7]+=w.efficiencyLoss;t[8]+=w.blocked;t[9]+=w.sleeping;t[10]+=w.repairHP;t[11]+=w.repairEnergy;t[12]+=w.powerNeed;t[13]+=w.powerReceived;for(int k=0;k<3;k++)t[14+k]+=w.operation[k];
 }return t;}
 String milestoneSeconds(String name){Integer value=milestones.get(name);return value==null?"":Double.toString(value/60.0);}
 void finish(boolean won,boolean ended)throws Exception{
  terminalTick=clock.getAsInt();initializing=false;
  if(!damageStack.isEmpty())invalid("unclosed_damage_context");
  if(won && initialEnemyCores==0 && lateStart>=0 && lateDestroyed==0){boolean clear=true;for(Batch b:batches)if(b.ordinal>=26 && b.ordinal<=29 && b.end<0)clear=false;if(clear && batches.size()==29)milestone("late_lock");}

  if(initialEnemyCores==0 && won && (actualNativeWinner!=Team.sharded.id || batches.size()!=29 || batches.stream().anyMatch(b->b.end<0)))invalid("survival_win_without_all_batches_clear");
  if(initialEnemyCores>0 && won && Team.crux.cores().size>initialEnemyCores-1)invalid("siege_win_without_first_core");
  Window last=window(tick()/18000);if(!last.opened)opening(last);last.dueAtEnd=due();
  for(Window w:windows.values())if(w.dueAtEnd==null)w.dueAtEnd=due();
  header(batchOut,"batch,native_wave,spawn_step,terminal_step,duration_seconds,cleared,censored,actual_units,terminated_units,tier");int bn=0,cleared=0;double rmct=0;
  for(Batch b:batches){int end=b.end<0?tick():b.end;double duration=(end-b.start)/60.0;rmct+=duration;if(b.end>=0)cleared++;
   row(batchOut,++bn,String.valueOf(b.ordinal),String.valueOf(b.wave),String.valueOf(b.start),String.valueOf(end),String.valueOf(duration),String.valueOf(b.end>=0),String.valueOf(b.end<0),String.valueOf(b.units.size()),String.valueOf(b.terminated.size()),b.ordinal<=10?"early":b.ordinal<=20?"mid":"late");
  }
  header(windowOut,String.join(",",WINDOW_COLUMNS));int wn=0;
  for(var entry:windows.entrySet()){
   int index=entry.getKey();Window w=entry.getValue();double end=Math.min(tick()/60.0,(index+1)*300.0),duration=Math.max(0,end-index*300.0);Map<String,String> global=windowBase(index,end,duration,"window");
   put(global,"threat_turret_seconds",w.threatSeconds);put(global,"empty_turret_seconds",w.emptySeconds);if(w.threatSeconds>0)put(global,"empty_fraction",w.emptySeconds/w.threatSeconds);
   put(global,"want_facility_seconds",w.wantSeconds);put(global,"missing_item_seconds",w.missingItems);put(global,"missing_liquid_seconds",w.missingLiquid);put(global,"power_loss_seconds",w.powerLoss);put(global,"zero_efficiency_seconds",w.zeroEfficiency);put(global,"efficiency_loss_seconds",w.efficiencyLoss);put(global,"blocked_seconds",w.blocked);put(global,"sleep_seconds",w.sleeping);put(global,"repair_effective_hp",w.repairHP);put(global,"repair_energy",w.repairEnergy);put(global,"grid_requested_energy",w.powerNeed);put(global,"grid_received_energy",w.powerReceived);if(w.powerNeed>0)put(global,"grid_satisfaction",w.powerReceived/w.powerNeed);
   double work=w.operation[0]+w.operation[1]+w.operation[2],eq=0;String[] cats={"expand","defense","rebuild"};for(int k=0;k<3;k++){put(global,cats[k]+"_seconds",w.operation[k]);if(work>0)put(global,cats[k]+"_fraction",w.operation[k]/work);}
   for(Item item:content.items())eq+=w.rebuild[item.id]*weight(item);put(global,"rebuild_equivalent",eq);windowRow(++wn,global);

   }

  }
  double[] t=totals();header(stageOut,"valid,won,terminal_reason,batch_count,cleared_batches,censored_batches,rmct_seconds,clear_fraction,core_lost,enemy_cores_initial,enemy_cores_remaining,buildings_destroyed,enemy_caused_destroyed,late_buildings_destroyed,salvo_static_seconds,salvo_combat_seconds,army_formed_seconds,rts_attack_seconds,first_enemy_core_seconds,late_lock_seconds,threat_turret_seconds,empty_turret_seconds,empty_fraction,want_facility_seconds,missing_item_seconds,missing_liquid_seconds,power_loss_seconds,zero_efficiency_seconds,efficiency_loss_seconds,blocked_seconds,sleep_seconds,repair_effective_hp,repair_energy,grid_requested_energy,grid_received_energy,grid_satisfaction,expand_seconds,defense_seconds,rebuild_seconds,aux_stage_under_60min");
  String reason=coreLost?"core_lost":won?(initialEnemyCores>0?"first_enemy_core":"native_victory"):ended?"native_defeat":"time_limit";
  ArrayList<String> values=new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(String.valueOf(valid),String.valueOf(won),reason,String.valueOf(batches.size()),String.valueOf(cleared),String.valueOf(batches.size()-cleared),batches.isEmpty()?"":String.valueOf(rmct/batches.size()),batches.isEmpty()?"":String.valueOf(cleared/(double)batches.size()),String.valueOf(coreLost),String.valueOf(initialEnemyCores),String.valueOf(Team.crux.cores().size),String.valueOf(destructionTotal),String.valueOf(enemyDestructionTotal),String.valueOf(lateDestroyed),milestoneSeconds("salvo_static"),milestoneSeconds("salvo_combat"),milestoneSeconds("army_formed"),milestoneSeconds("rts_attack"),milestoneSeconds("first_enemy_core"),milestoneSeconds("late_lock"),String.valueOf(t[0]),String.valueOf(t[1]),t[0]>0?String.valueOf(t[1]/t[0]):""));
  for(int i=2;i<14;i++)values.add(String.valueOf(t[i]));values.add(t[12]>0?String.valueOf(t[13]/t[12]):"");for(int i=14;i<17;i++)values.add(String.valueOf(t[i]));values.add(String.valueOf(won && tick()<=3600*60));row(stageOut,1,values.toArray(new String[0]));

 }
````

## frozen/S-v1/src/AuditRecorder.java

较早的审计记录器/观察不变性检查；是否正式使用以冻结清单为准。

SHA-256：`70e66e61d659241f4ba5c41a0605222e9b9d9b31e63a4b7725a134697332e0a1`；同内容路径数：1513。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
import mindustry.core.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.type.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.modules.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Search instrumentation acceptance only: not the complete Q1-Q5 recorder. */
public final class AuditRecorder implements EvaluationTrace.Sink,AutoCloseable{
 final PrintWriter journal,batches,windows,validation;
 final IntSupplier clock;
 long sequence;int terminalTick=-1;int activeWave=-1;boolean valid=true;
 final IdentityHashMap<ItemModule,Ledger> ledgers=new IdentityHashMap<>();
 final ArrayList<Batch> batchList=new ArrayList<>();
 final TreeMap<Integer,Win> winList=new TreeMap<>();
 static class Ledger{int core;int[] balance;Ledger(int c,ItemModule m){core=c;balance=new int[m.length()];for(int i=0;i<balance.length;i++)balance[i]=m.get(i);}}
 static class Batch{int ordinal,nativeWave,start,end=-1;boolean sealed;final LinkedHashMap<Integer,Unit> units=new LinkedHashMap<>();final HashSet<Integer> terminated=new HashSet<>();}
 static class Win{final long[] supply=new long[content.items().size],construction=new long[content.items().size];double healing;}
 AuditRecorder(String path,IntSupplier clock)throws Exception{
  this.clock=clock;journal=new PrintWriter(path+".audit-events.csv");batches=new PrintWriter(path+".audit-batches.csv");windows=new PrintWriter(path+".audit-windows.csv");validation=new PrintWriter(path+".audit-validation.json");
  journal.println("seq,step,sim_seconds,event,detail");
  emit("recorder_scope","SEARCH_ONLY;complete_Q1_Q5=false;stock_ledger=true;supply=true;construction=true;batches=true;repair_hp=true");syncCores();EvaluationTrace.sink=this;
 }
 int tick(){return terminalTick>=0?terminalTick:clock.getAsInt()+1;}
 void emit(String kind,String detail){journal.println(++sequence+","+tick()+","+(tick()/60.0)+","+kind+","+detail.replace(',',';'));}
 void invalid(String why){valid=false;emit("invalid",why);}
 void syncCores(){for(var core:Team.sharded.cores())if(!ledgers.containsKey(core.items)){
  var l=new Ledger(core.pos(),core.items);ledgers.put(core.items,l);
  for(int i=0;i<l.balance.length;i++)emit("stock_open","core="+l.core+";item="+content.item(i).name+";balance="+l.balance[i]);
 }}
 public void stock(ItemModule module,int item,int before,int after){
  Ledger l=ledgers.get(module);if(l==null)return;
  if(l.balance[item]!=before)invalid("ledger_discontinuity;core="+l.core+";item="+item+";expected="+l.balance[item]+";before="+before);
  if(after<0)invalid("negative_inventory;core="+l.core+";item="+item);
  emit("stock","core="+l.core+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);l.balance[item]=after;
 }
 Win window(){return winList.computeIfAbsent(tick()/18000,k->new Win());}
 public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(team==Team.sharded){window().supply[item.id]+=amount;emit("production","producer="+producer+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount);}}
 public void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(site.team==Team.sharded){window().construction[item.id]+=amount;emit("construction_spend","site="+site.pos()+";block="+target.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount);}}
 public void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(source.team==Team.sharded){window().healing+=amount;emit("repair_hp","source="+source.pos()+";target="+target+";amount="+amount);}}
 public void waveBegin(int wave){Batch b=new Batch();b.ordinal=batchList.size()+1;b.nativeWave=wave;b.start=tick();batchList.add(b);activeWave=wave;emit("batch_begin","ordinal="+b.ordinal+";native_wave="+wave);}
 Batch current(){return batchList.get(batchList.size()-1);}
 public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup group,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){emit("spawn_plan","batch="+current().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(group,true)+";type="+group.type.name+";x="+x+";y="+y+";base="+base+";adjusted="+adjusted+";boss="+(group.effect==mindustry.content.StatusEffects.boss));}
 public void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup group,Unit unit){if(unit.team!=Team.sharded){current().units.put(unit.id,unit);emit("batch_unit","batch="+current().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(group,true)+";id="+unit.id+";type="+unit.type.name);}}
 public void waveEnd(int wave){current().sealed=true;emit("batch_seal","ordinal="+current().ordinal+";actual_units="+current().units.size());activeWave=-1;}
 void step(){
  syncCores();
  for(var core:Team.sharded.cores()){
   Ledger l=ledgers.get(core.items);for(int i=0;i<l.balance.length;i++)if(l.balance[i]!=core.items.get(i))invalid("missed_stock_mutation;core="+core.pos()+";item="+i);
  }
  for(Batch b:batchList)if(b.end<0){
   for(var entry:b.units.entrySet())if(!b.terminated.contains(entry.getKey()) && (entry.getValue().dead || !entry.getValue().isAdded())){b.terminated.add(entry.getKey());emit("batch_unit_terminated","batch="+b.ordinal+";id="+entry.getKey()+";dead="+entry.getValue().dead);}
   if(b.sealed && b.terminated.size()==b.units.size()){b.end=tick();emit("batch_clear","ordinal="+b.ordinal);}
  }
 }
 public void close(){
  terminalTick=clock.getAsInt();
  EvaluationTrace.sink=null;
  batches.println("batch,native_wave,start_step,end_step,duration_seconds,cleared,censored,actual_units,terminated_units");
  for(Batch b:batchList){int end=b.end<0?tick():b.end;batches.println(b.ordinal+","+b.nativeWave+","+b.start+","+end+","+((end-b.start)/60.0)+","+(b.end>=0)+","+(b.end<0)+","+b.units.size()+","+b.terminated.size());}
  windows.println("window,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,item,supply,construction_spend,repair_effective_hp,scope");
  for(int wi=0;wi<=tick()/18000;wi++){
   Win w=winList.computeIfAbsent(wi,k->new Win());double end=Math.min(tick()/60.0,(wi+1)*300.0),duration=end-wi*300.0;
   if(duration<=0)continue;
   for(Item item:content.items())windows.println(wi+","+(wi*300)+","+end+","+duration+","+item.name+","+w.supply[item.id]+","+w.construction[item.id]+","+w.healing+",SEARCH_partial_recorder");
  }
  emit("recorder_end","ledger_valid="+valid+";complete_Q1_Q5=false");
  validation.println("{\"scope\":\"SEARCH_only\",\"ledger_valid\":"+valid+",\"complete_Q1_Q5\":false,\"journal_rows\":"+sequence+",\"batch_count\":"+batchList.size()+"}");
  journal.close();batches.close();windows.close();validation.close();
 }
}
````

## audit_derived_results.py

Independent checks of real derived tables and facility/material reconciliation.

SHA-256：`e7c4ed715cd8b26a3525dae423a1196b5aee7b4a4a8e56d34bcf2966cdcd7c12`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Independent checks of real derived tables and facility/material reconciliation."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,json,math,struct
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(p):
    with Path(p).open() as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def near(a,b):return math.isclose(float(a),float(b),abs_tol=3e-6,rel_tol=2e-9)
def main():
    snapshot=json.loads((ROOT/'report/analysis_manifest.json').read_text());routes=[json.loads(Path(p).read_text()) for p in snapshot['valid_route_files']];assert all(r['valid'] for r in routes)
    rates=read(ROOT/'report/route_completion.csv');groups=defaultdict(list);stages=defaultdict(list)
    for r in routes:
        k=(r['track'],r['chain'],r['policy'],r['group'],float(r['alpha']));groups[k].append(r)
        for s in r['stages']:stages[k+(s['stage'],)].append(s)
    def key(row):return row['track'],row['chain'],row['policy'],row['group'],float(row['alpha'])
    for row in rates:
        rs=groups[key(row)];assert len({r['seed'] for r in rs})==len(rs),'Duplicate independent seed'
        assert int(row['valid_routes'])==len(rs)
        assert int(row['complete_routes'])==sum(r['complete'] for r in rs)
        assert near(row['completion_rate'],sum(r['complete'] for r in rs)/len(rs))
    for row in read(ROOT/'report/stage_summary_statistics.csv'):
        ss=stages[key(row)+(row['stage'],)];assert int(row['reached'])==len(ss)
        rmct=[float(s['summary']['rmct_seconds']) for s in ss if s['summary']['rmct_seconds']!='']
        assert (row['rmct_seconds_mean']=='')==(not bool(rmct))
        if rmct:assert near(row['rmct_seconds_mean'],sum(rmct)/len(rmct)),'RMCT not equal per run'
    for row in read(ROOT/'report/pressure.csv'):
        rs=[r for r in groups.get(key(row),[]) if r['seed']<1020]
        assert int(row['valid_routes'])==len(rs)<=20,'Pressure alpha0 double counted main seeds'
    checked=0;spawn_rows=0;spawn_paths=set()
    def f32(value):return struct.unpack('f',struct.pack('f',value))[0]
    weights={'copper':.5,'lead':.7,'graphite':1,'titanium':1,'silicon':.8}
    for r in routes:
        for s in r['stages']:
            path=Path(s['path']+'.spawns.csv')
            if path not in spawn_paths:
                spawn_paths.add(path)
                assert path.exists() or int(s['summary']['batch_count'])==0,'Missing native spawn audit table'
                if path.exists():
                    for spawn in read(path):
                        native=int(spawn['base']);adjusted=int(spawn['adjusted'])
                        expected=native if native==0 or spawn['boss']=='true' else math.floor(f32(native*f32(1+f32(r['alpha'])))+.5)
                        assert adjusted==expected,'Pressure not applied after native rounding or boss/zero altered'
                        assert int(spawn['actual'])==adjusted,'Spawn point requested/actual mismatch'
                        spawn_rows+=1
            ws=read(s['path']+'.windows.csv');by_window=defaultdict(list)
            for w in ws:by_window[w['window']].append(w)
            for wrows in by_window.values():
                global_row=next(w for w in wrows if w['scope']=='window')
                equivalent=sum(float(w['rebuild_paid'])*weights.get(w['item'],0) for w in wrows if w['scope']=='item')
                assert near(equivalent,global_row['rebuild_equivalent']),'Rebuild weighted costs do not reconcile'
                for w in wrows:
                    if w['scope']=='item':
                        supplied=sum(float(z['supply']) for z in wrows if z['scope']=='facility_supply' and z['item']==w['item'])
                        assert near(supplied,w['supply']),'Facility supply does not reconcile with total production'
                for col in ['want_facility_seconds','missing_item_seconds','missing_liquid_seconds','power_loss_seconds','zero_efficiency_seconds','efficiency_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds','sleep_seconds']:
                    assert near(sum(float(z[col]) for z in wrows if z['scope']=='facility'),global_row[col]),'Facility downtime does not reconcile: '+col
                for col in ['grid_requested_energy','grid_received_energy']:
                    assert near(sum(float(z[col]) for z in wrows if z['scope']=='facility_energy'),global_row[col]),'Facility electricity does not reconcile'
                checked+=1
    result=dict(passed=True,formal_routes=len(routes),formal_stages=sum(len(r['stages']) for r in routes),windows_reconciled=checked,unique_native_spawn_point_rows=spawn_rows,checks=['unique independent seeds','route success numerator/denominator','equal-run RMCT','20-seed pressure subset without alpha0 duplication','native rounded pressure formula with Java float precision','boss/zero preservation and actual per-point spawns','facility supply totals','downtime totals','energy totals','actual rebuild item weights'])
    (ROOT/'report/derived-data-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(result))
if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

## audit_execution_matrix.py

Audit exact planned cells and persisted C evidence, separately from game admission.

SHA-256：`dc1702a3798b05d03d4ad797f0e3e925225f075153e2c2c479f8268b53f35e16`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Audit exact planned cells and persisted C evidence, separately from game admission."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv, hashlib, json, math

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def digest(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def read(path):
    with Path(path).open() as source:
        return list(csv.DictReader(source))


def close(a, b):
    return math.isclose(float(a), float(b), rel_tol=2e-7, abs_tol=3e-6)


def main():
    # Importing the planners performs no simulation, mutation or admission.
    from run_formal import planned
    from run_calibration import plan
    from verify_realtime import verify_costs

    cells, jobs = planned()
    s_plan = {r['run_id']: r for r in jobs}
    c_plan = {r['run_id']: r for r in plan()}
    snapshot = json.loads((ROOT / 'report/analysis_manifest.json').read_text())
    s_paths = snapshot['valid_route_files'] + snapshot['invalid_route_files']
    assert len(s_paths) == len(set(s_paths)), 'Duplicate S route in analysis snapshot'
    s_routes = [json.loads(Path(p).read_text()) for p in s_paths]
    c_summary = json.loads((ROOT / 'report/C-calibration.json').read_text())
    c_paths = [Path(p) for p in c_summary.get('snapshot_route_files', [])]
    assert len(c_paths) == c_summary['completed_route_cells'], 'C statistics need an exact immutable input snapshot'
    c_routes = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in c_paths]
    artifacts = {}
    freezes = {}
    for track, routes, expected, version in [('S', s_routes, s_plan, 'S-v2'),
                                              ('C', c_routes, c_plan, 'C-v1')]:
        ids = [r['run_id'] for r in routes]
        assert len(ids) == len(set(ids)), f'Duplicate {track} logical route'
        assert set(ids) <= expected.keys(), f'Unregistered {track} route'
        if routes:
            manifest = json.loads((ROOT / 'frozen' / version / 'manifest.json').read_text())
            freezes[track] = manifest
            for name, sha in manifest['files'].items():
                assert digest(ROOT / 'frozen' / version / name) == sha, (version, name)
            for name, sha in manifest.get('external_files', {}).items():
                assert digest(name) == sha, name
        for route in routes:
            registered = expected[route['run_id']]
            for field in ['track', 'chain', 'policy', 'group', 'alpha', 'seed']:
                assert route[field] == registered[field], (route['run_id'], field)
            assert route['freeze_id'] == freezes[track]['freeze_id']
            if not route['valid']:
                assert not route['complete']
                continue
            stages = route['stages']
            assert [s['stage'] for s in stages] == list('ABC')[:len(stages)]
            assert len(stages) <= 3
            assert all(s.get('won', s['summary']['won'] == 'true') for s in stages[:-1])
            assert route['complete'] == (len(stages) == 3 and all(s['summary']['won'] == 'true' for s in stages))
            for stage in stages:
                assert stage['summary']['valid'] == 'true'
                if track == 'S':
                    assert stage['accepted'] and stage['freeze_id'] == freezes['S']['freeze_id']
                    assert stage['attempt'] in [1, 2]
                    if stage['attempt'] == 2:
                        rejected = Path(stage['path'].replace('-attempt2.csv', '-attempt1.csv') + '.result.json')
                        assert not json.loads(rejected.read_text())['accepted']

    # An in-progress cohort has no missing-cell failure; exact missing IDs remain explicit.
    missing_s = sorted(s_plan.keys() - {r['run_id'] for r in s_routes})
    missing_c = sorted(c_plan.keys() - {r['run_id'] for r in c_routes})
    c_groups = defaultdict(list)
    c_stages = defaultdict(list)
    for path, route in zip(c_paths, c_routes):
        artifacts[str(path.relative_to(ROOT))] = digest(path)
        if not route['valid']:
            for attempt in [1, 2]:
                receipt = json.loads((path.parent / f'attempt{attempt}' / 'attempt-result.json').read_text())
                assert not receipt['accepted'] and receipt['seed'] == route['seed']
            continue
        native = route['native_route']
        assert route['accepted'] and native['valid'] and native['formal_sample']
        assert native['freeze_id'] == freezes['C']['freeze_id']
        assert native['run_id'] == route['run_id'] and native['stage_count'] == len(route['stages'])
        invocation_path = path.parent / f'attempt{route["attempt"]}' / 'invocation.json'
        invocation = json.loads(invocation_path.read_text())
        assert invocation['freeze_id'] == freezes['C']['freeze_id']
        assert invocation['entry_profile_files'] == freezes['C']['entry_profile_files']
        assert '-Dmindustry.eval.formalAccepted=true' in invocation['command']
        assert '-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationFps=30' in invocation['command']
        assert '-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationOrigin=ruinousShores' in invocation['command']
        artifacts[str(invocation_path.relative_to(ROOT))] = digest(invocation_path)
        costs_path = Path(route['output']) / 'campaign-costs.csv'
        costs = verify_costs(costs_path)
        assert costs == route['costs'], 'Persisted C payment evidence differs from accepted receipt'
        for row in read(costs_path):
            assert row['run_id'] == route['run_id']
        artifacts[str(costs_path.relative_to(ROOT))] = costs['sha256']
        c_groups[route['policy'], route['group']].append(route)
        for stage in route['stages']:
            summary = stage['summary']
            assert summary['route_id'] == route['run_id'] and summary['track'] == 'C'
            assert summary['policy'] == route['policy'] and summary['group'] == route['group']
            assert int(summary['seed']) == route['seed'] and summary['stage'] == stage['stage']
            checks = stage['artifact_check']
            assert checks['passed'] and close(checks['effective_seconds'], summary['sim_seconds'])
            assert int(summary['batch_count']) == checks['batches']
            for suffix, sha in checks['sha256'].items():
                raw = Path(stage['path'] + '.' + suffix + '.csv')
                assert digest(raw) == sha, f'Accepted C artifact changed: {raw}'
                artifacts[str(raw.relative_to(ROOT))] = sha
            batches = read(stage['path'] + '.batches.csv')
            durations = [float(b['duration_seconds']) for b in batches]
            assert len(batches) == int(summary['batch_count'])
            assert int(summary['cleared_batches']) == sum(b['cleared'] == 'true' for b in batches)
            assert int(summary['censored_batches']) == sum(b['censored'] == 'true' for b in batches)
            assert (summary['rmct_seconds'] == '') == (not durations)
            if durations:
                assert close(summary['rmct_seconds'], sum(durations) / len(durations))
            initial = Path(stage['path'] + '.initial.msav')
            profile = Path(stage['path'] + '.initial-profile')
            assert initial.is_file() and initial.stat().st_size > 0
            assert (profile / 'settings.bin').is_file() and any((profile / 'saves').glob('*.msav'))
            artifacts[str(initial.relative_to(ROOT))] = digest(initial)
            c_stages[route['policy'], route['group'], stage['stage']].append(summary)

    # Recalculate the published C estimands directly from accepted per-route artifacts.
    completion = read(ROOT / 'report/C_completion.csv')
    assert len(completion) == 8
    for row in completion:
        rs = c_groups[row['policy'], row['group']]
        assert int(row['valid_routes']) == len(rs)
        assert int(row['complete_routes']) == sum(r['complete'] for r in rs)
        if rs:
            assert close(row['completion_rate'], sum(r['complete'] for r in rs) / len(rs))
        else:
            assert row['completion_rate'] == ''
    for row in read(ROOT / 'report/C_stage_statistics.csv'):
        ss = c_stages[row['policy'], row['group'], row['stage']]
        assert int(row['reached']) == len(ss)
        assert int(row['won']) == sum(s['won'] == 'true' for s in ss)
        assert int(row['core_losses']) == sum(s['core_lost'] == 'true' for s in ss)
        values = [float(s['rmct_seconds']) for s in ss if s['rmct_seconds'] != '']
        assert int(row['rmct_contributing_runs']) == len(values)
        if values:
            assert close(row['rmct_seconds_mean'], sum(values) / len(values))
        else:
            assert row['rmct_seconds_mean'] == ''
    assert c_summary['completed_route_cells'] == len(c_routes)
    result = dict(passed=True, status='execution_complete' if not missing_s and not missing_c else 'in_progress',
                  complete_matrix=not missing_s and not missing_c,
                  S_requested_cells=len(cells), S_unique_planned=len(s_plan), S_snapshot_routes=len(s_routes),
                  C_planned=len(c_plan), C_handled=len(c_routes), C_valid=sum(r['valid'] for r in c_routes),
                  S_missing_ids=missing_s, C_missing_ids=missing_c,
                  independent_samples_are_unique_seeds_within_each_registered_cell=True,
                  C_byte_repeat_or_observer_invariance_proven=False,
                  checks=['exact registered identities, metadata and frozen files', 'sequential stages and actual route endpoints',
                          'C same-entry invocation receipts', 'C persisted measurement SHA256',
                          'C actual paid launch/research and source inventory reconciliation',
                          'C native stage snapshots', 'C batch counts and equal-run RMCT',
                          'C published completion/stage statistics'],
                  C_evidence_sha256=artifacts)
    output = ROOT / 'report/execution-matrix-audit.json'
    temporary = output.with_suffix('.json.tmp')
    temporary.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n');temporary.replace(output)
    print(json.dumps({k: result[k] for k in ['passed', 'status', 'S_snapshot_routes', 'C_handled', 'C_valid']}))
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
````

## audit_preparation_isolation.py

Verify a preparation-only fork did not modify frozen S or trained C files.

SHA-256：`99b917a7e1d9223af922ac07278382cb7bd3bbcd434a018b86c6a3caba9128b7`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Verify a preparation-only fork did not modify frozen S or trained C files."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, sys

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
baseline = json.loads((ROOT / "results/trained-code-unchanged-after-preparation3.json").read_text())
attempt = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 4
fork = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/driver-v5"


def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


for section in ("S_files", "trained_C_files"):
    for name, expected in baseline[section].items():
        path = ROOT / ("frozen/S-v2" if section == "S_files" else "") / name
        assert path.is_file(), path
        assert digest(path) == expected, (path, expected, digest(path))

result = {
    "formal_S_and_trained_C_unchanged": True,
    "formal_samples_added": 0,
    "S_files": baseline["S_files"],
    "trained_C_files": baseline["trained_C_files"],
    "preparation_fork": fork,
}
destination = ROOT / f"results/trained-code-unchanged-after-preparation{attempt}.json"
destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print(destination)
````

## audit_report_deliverables.py

Check the expanded requested report against saved sources and exact execution evidence.

SHA-256：`a947856974f1c6dc59ca91a7d2be36c1ff74dae7b8359f40098bcc86b24b0c7f`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Check the expanded requested report against saved sources and exact execution evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv, hashlib, json, math, re

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def audit(answer=None, require_final_alias=False):
    report=ROOT/'report'
    if answer is None:answer=json.loads((report/'答案汇总.json').read_text())
    required=['实验过程与全部尝试.md','全部尝试与失败流程索引.csv','G0固定策略操作手册.md',
              'G0固定布局逐项操作.csv','G0基准通关实例.csv','源码改动、数据来源与公式.md',
              '原生源码修改位置.csv','全部脚本索引.md','全部脚本与源码清单.csv',
              '全部脚本代码.md','项目耗时与成本核算.md','项目耗时与成本.json','方法与过程附录.json']
    assert all((report/name).is_file() and (report/name).stat().st_size>0 for name in required)
    metadata=json.loads((report/'方法与过程附录.json').read_text())
    def rows(name):
        with (report/name).open() as source:return list(csv.DictReader(source))
    code=rows('全部脚本与源码清单.csv');versions={r['sha256'] for r in code}
    assert len(code)==metadata['code']['saved_source_paths']
    assert len(versions)==metadata['code']['distinct_source_contents']
    # At final completion all source writers are finished. During execution the
    # extra Java snapshot files can still be in the process of being copied.
    checked=0
    for row in code:
        p=ROOT/row['path'];assert p.is_relative_to(ROOT) and p.is_file()
        if answer['final_report_complete'] or row['path'].startswith('frozen/'):
            assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==row['sha256'],row['path'];checked+=1
    book=(report/'全部脚本代码.md').read_text()
    for digest in versions:assert digest in book,'Code content not indexed in source book'
    orderbook=rows('G0固定布局逐项操作.csv')
    assert len(orderbook)==metadata['policy']['exact_order_rows']==1672
    for path in sorted((ROOT/'frozen/S-v2/layouts').glob('*.csv')):
        with path.open() as source:original=list(csv.DictReader(source))
        exported=[r for r in orderbook if r['layout_source']==str(path.relative_to(ROOT))]
        assert len(original)==len(exported)
        for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(original,exported),1):
            assert int(b['order'])==i
            for name in ['block','x','y','rotation','config']:assert a[name]==b[name]
    examples=rows('G0基准通关实例.csv')
    assert len(examples)==6
    for row in examples:
        route=json.loads((ROOT/'formal'/row['run_id']/'route.json').read_text())
        assert route['valid'] and route['complete'] and route['group']=='G0'
        stage=next(s for s in route['stages'] if s['stage']==row['stage'])
        assert math.isclose(float(row['stage_seconds']),float(stage['summary']['sim_seconds']),abs_tol=1e-7)
    history=rows('全部尝试与失败流程索引.csv')
    assert len(history)==metadata['history']['index_rows']
    assert [int(r['record_id']) for r in history]==list(range(1,len(history)+1))
    assert all((ROOT/r['source_artifact']).is_file() for r in history)
    accounting=json.loads((report/'项目耗时与成本.json').read_text())
    assert not metadata['tokens_and_monetary_costs_available']
    for field in ['input_tokens','cached_input_tokens','output_tokens','reasoning_tokens','all_model_tokens_total',
                  'model_cost','cloud_cost','storage_cost','network_cost','grand_total_monetary_cost']:
        assert accounting[field] is None,'Unknown usage or costs must not be represented by invented numbers'
    if accounting['runtime_observed_window']:
        runtime=accounting['runtime_observed_window']
        assert math.isclose(runtime['cpu_core_seconds'],runtime['cpu_stat']['usage_usec']/1e6)
        assert math.isclose(runtime['cpu_core_hours'],runtime['cpu_stat']['usage_usec']/3.6e9)
        assert not runtime['full_project_CPU_total']
    body=(report/'评测分析报告.md').read_text()
    for heading in ['Q1：','Q2：','Q3：','Q4：','Q5：','综合评价与适用范围',
                    '从头开始的实验过程与失败流程','最终选定的G0固定玩家策略操作手册',
                    '真实源码、自动玩家、数据来源与计算公式','全部已保存脚本与源码索引',
                    '项目从头开始的耗时、token与成本核算']:
        assert heading in body,heading
    targets=re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',body)
    for target in targets:
        if '://' not in target:assert (report/target.split('#')[0]).exists(),target
    if answer['final_report_complete']:
        matrix=json.loads((report/'execution-matrix-audit.json').read_text())
        assert matrix['passed'] and matrix['complete_matrix']
        assert answer['S']['snapshot_finished_routes']==4500 and answer['C']['completed_route_cells']==40
        assert '（执行中，非最终结论）' not in body
        assert not answer['protocol_conformance']['full_original_three_track_protocol_satisfied']
        assert len([r for r in history if r['scope']=='S_route_logical_summary'])==4500
        if require_final_alias:assert (report/'问题一_评测报告_最终版.md').read_text()==body
    result=dict(passed=True,final_execution=answer['final_report_complete'],source_paths=len(code),
                distinct_code_contents=len(versions),source_path_hashes_checked=checked,exact_blueprint_orders=len(orderbook),
                actual_G0_winning_example_stages=len(examples),attempt_evidence_rows=len(history),report_links_checked=len(targets),
                token_and_monetary_unknowns_explicit=True,nonformal_trials_not_added_to_formal_N=True,
                scope='Expanded report coverage, saved sources, exact blueprints, real G0 examples, cost honesty and final matrix gate; not a replacement for native gameplay audits')
    (report/'交付内容审计.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
    return result


if __name__=='__main__':
    answer=json.loads((ROOT/'report/答案汇总.json').read_text())
    print(json.dumps(audit(answer,require_final_alias=answer['final_report_complete'])))
````

````python
if finished:

    c_direction=table('C_vs_S_directions.csv')

    md += ['在本协议的两套固定自动玩家下，工业包的价值首先体现为真实资源供给和存活/通关机会，不能直接等同于所有战争里程碑都至少提前3分钟。主实验G1相对G2的完成率与置信区间、实际成军/首核配对数在正文逐项列出；按“每组30路线”的点阈值解释，两套策略也都未满足三项真实提前量全部≥3分钟，保守主判读则保留证据不足。','', '攻防包不是无条件收益：H只增强Duo/Salvo铜弹，冻结策略主要给Salvo喂石墨，而C同时提高建材。必须把实际弹种覆盖、建造时机、重建消耗与兵工厂转化一起看。G3也不能因同时开两包就被预设为最优，协同是否成立以完整增兵扫描和相应判据为准。','', '这说明Mindustry的工业、物流、供电、弹药和军事生产之间存在真实耦合：库存增长未必自动转成更早的实战防线与反攻，局部停机与操作负担可能抵消理论产速收益。具体是覆盖退出、瓶颈迁移还是转化断裂，需结合两链、两策略的实际覆盖、资源/停机与里程碑证据；未满足该诊断输入时不能宣布转化断裂。','', '可检验的后续设计方向是把工业提速与供电余量、物流补给及军事转化节奏一起做新一轮预注册比较，并将炮塔铜弹增伤与高成本分解验收。本项目没有在冻结后用这些建议重新优化某一组，也没有证明这些建议能保证通关。','', '综合评价限于本题提交、地图、参数、两套固定策略和日志可观察行为，不是对整款游戏所有内容的评分。原生C还存在研究、发射、核心/单位上限及帧时钟差异，G尺寸协议不适用；没有真人问卷，不能从自动化日志推导主观难度、乐趣或挫败感。','']
else:
    md += ['剩余矩阵与正式C尚未完成，全任务综合终论待实际实验和最终审计后生成。当前主实验事实和局部阈值结果保留，不把未执行的扫描、校准或候选解释填成最终结论。','']

for appendix in ['实验过程与全部尝试.md','G0固定策略操作手册.md','源码改动、数据来源与公式.md','全部脚本索引.md','项目耗时与成本核算.md']:
    content=(P/appendix).read_text()
    # Keep a single report title while retaining a navigable appendix hierarchy.

    md += [content,'']
body='\n'.join(md)+'\n'
(P/'评测分析报告.md').write_text(body)

data['report_artifact_audit']=report_audit

print(json.dumps({'status':data['status'],'snapshot_valid_routes':len(snapshot['valid_route_files']),'main_complete':data['S']['main_experiment_complete'],'C_completed':c.get('completed_route_cells',0),'final_report_complete':finished,'saved_code_versions':provenance['code']['distinct_source_contents'],'attempt_index_rows':provenance['history']['index_rows']},ensure_ascii=False))
````
