## cache_chain_B_A_prefixes.py

Protocol-authorized same-input stage-A reuse, with exact physical artifact provenance.

SHA-256：`c16b60098a9d5f21b102f7ec18cd5894656ffc68393a098351ff4a3b18d07549`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Protocol-authorized same-input stage-A reuse, with exact physical artifact provenance."""
from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;F=ROOT/'frozen/S-v2';OUT=ROOT/'formal'
def sha(path):return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def atomic(path,value):
    path.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);temporary=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp');temporary.write_text(json.dumps(value,indent=2)+'\n');temporary.replace(path)
manifest=json.loads((F/'manifest.json').read_text());proof=json.loads((ROOT/'results/chain-A-prefix-equivalence.json').read_text());cohort=json.loads((ROOT/'results/main-cohort-completion.json').read_text())
assert proof['passed'] and proof['freeze_id']==manifest['freeze_id']
for filename,digest in manifest['files'].items():assert sha(F/filename)==digest
plans=[]
for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
    for group in ['G0','G1','G2','G3']:
        for seed in range(1000,1020):
            source_id=f'S-A-{policy}-{group}-a00-s{seed}';consumer_id=f'S-B-{policy}-{group}-a00-s{seed}'
            source_route=OUT/source_id/'route.json';assert sha(source_route)==cohort['routes'][str(source_route)]
            route=json.loads(source_route.read_text());assert route['valid'] and route['freeze_id']==manifest['freeze_id']
            data=route['stages'][0];assert data['accepted'] and data['stage']=='A'
            original=Path(data['path']+'.result.json');assert json.loads(original.read_text())==data
            for filename,digest in data['uncompressed_sha256'].items():
                path=original.parent/filename
                if path.exists():actual=sha(path)
                else:
                    with gzip.open(str(path)+'.gz','rb') as f:
                        hasher=hashlib.sha256()
                        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):hasher.update(block)
                        actual=hasher.hexdigest()
                assert actual==digest,(source_id,filename)
            inputs=dict(freeze_id=manifest['freeze_id'],map='stainedMountains',map_seed=0,policy=policy,group=group,alpha=0,seed=seed,layout_sha256=manifest['files'][f'layouts/{policy}-A.csv'],incoming_carry=None,stage_limit=5400,unit_cap=8,clock='native fixed60')
            fingerprint=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(inputs,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
            result={**data,'reused_from':str(original),'source_run_id':source_id,'consumer_run_id':consumer_id,'reuse_input_sha256':fingerprint,'reuse_inputs':inputs,'reuse_equivalence_proof':str(ROOT/'results/chain-A-prefix-equivalence.json'),'new_physical_stage_execution':False}
            target=OUT/consumer_id/'A-attempt1.csv.result.json';assert not (target.parent/'route.json').exists()
            if target.exists():assert json.loads(target.read_text())==result
            else:assert not (target.parent/'A-attempt1.csv').exists()
            plans.append((target,result))
for path,result in plans:
    if not path.exists():atomic(path,result)
atomic(ROOT/'results/chain-B-A-prefix-cache.json',dict(passed=True,reused_stage_prefixes=len(plans),new_independent_samples_added=0,physical_source='accepted S-v2 main-chain A stages',scope='Chain B stage A only; all policies/groups retain same seed and exact inputs',proof=str(ROOT/'results/chain-A-prefix-equivalence.json'),consumer_results=[str(p) for p,_ in plans]))
print('Verified and registered',len(plans),'same-input native A prefixes; no new independent samples')
````

## src/realtime/AttackSupport.java

原生造兵、重构、集结与RTS指令；realtime版本仅适配原生帧的检查时机。

SHA-256：`a0d2d7e9442b9b24c8e227da9b8574e2023e1006afaaaabe86e317f0b4bea072`；同内容路径数：2。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import java.util.*;
import arc.math.geom.*;
import mindustry.content.*;
import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.input.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.type.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.blocks.units.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** C native realtime adapter of frozen S helper: same actions, once per crossed five-second clock interval. */
public class AttackSupport{
 static int lastCommandInterval=-1;static boolean activated,armyMilestone,attacked;static final boolean defensive=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.policy","balanced").equals("defensive");static HashSet<Integer> sent=new HashSet<>();
 static boolean contains(Unit unit){return unit.type==UnitTypes.dagger || unit.type==UnitTypes.mace || unit.type==UnitTypes.fortress || unit.type==UnitTypes.nova || unit.type==UnitTypes.pulsar || unit.type==UnitTypes.quasar;}
 static boolean control(){
  if(!state.rules.attackMode || Pilot.bot.dead())return false;
  var bot=Pilot.bot;var unit=bot.unit();var core=Team.sharded.core();
  ArrayList<Unit> army=new ArrayList<>();float hp=0;
  for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=unit && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && contains(u)){army.add(u);hp+=u.health;}
  if(!armyMilestone && army.size()>=8 && hp>=2000){armyMilestone=true;Pilot.event("army_formed","count="+army.size()+" hp="+hp);}
  if(Pilot.tick/300>lastCommandInterval && !army.isEmpty()){
   lastCommandInterval=Pilot.tick/300;
   Building target=null;for(var c:Team.crux.cores())if(target==null || c.dst2(core)<target.dst2(core))target=c;
   if((attacked || (army.size()>=8 && hp>=2000 && (!defensive || state.wave>=2))) && target!=null){
    int[] ids=army.stream().filter(u->!sent.contains(u.id)).mapToInt(u->u.id).toArray();
    if(ids.length>0){InputHandler.commandUnits(bot,ids,target,null,null,false,true);for(int id:ids)sent.add(id);if(Pilot.formalRecorder!=null)Pilot.formalRecorder.attack(bot.id,target.pos(),ids.length);Pilot.event("rts_attack","target="+target.pos()+" units="+ids.length);attacked=true;}
   }else{
    int[] ids=army.stream().mapToInt(u->u.id).toArray();InputHandler.commandUnits(bot,ids,null,null,new Vec2(core.x+70,core.y+95),false,true);
   }
  }
  UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory=null;Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor=null;
  for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){if(b.block==Blocks.groundFactory)factory=(UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild)b;if(b.block==Blocks.additiveReconstructor)reconstructor=(Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild)b;}
  boolean tutorialRequiresFlag=false;
  for(var objective:state.rules.objectives.all)for(String flag:objective.flagsAdded)if(flag.equals("unitsBuilt"))tutorialRequiresFlag=true;
  long livingDaggers=army.stream().filter(soldier->soldier.type==UnitTypes.dagger).count();
  if(defensive && activated && factory!=null && factory.rotation==0 && (state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt") || (!tutorialRequiresFlag && livingDaggers>=3))){
   InputHandler.rotateBlock(bot,factory,true);Pilot.event("factory_turn_to_upgrade","native_unitsBuilt_flag="+state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt")+" tutorial_requires_flag="+tutorialRequiresFlag);
  }
  boolean allBuilt=true;for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders)if(!o.wasBuilt){allBuilt=false;break;}
  if(factory==null || reconstructor==null || (!activated && !allBuilt))return false;
  if(!activated){
   for(Item desired:new Item[]{Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead}){
    int required=desired==Items.graphite?360:desired==Items.silicon?450:200;
    if(core.items.get(desired)<required){
     if(unit.stack.amount>0){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.deposit();return true;}
     Building source=null;for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b!=core && b.items!=null && (b.block==Blocks.graphitePress || b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter || b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill) && b.items.get(desired)>=1 && (source==null || b.dst2(unit)<source.dst2(unit)))source=b;
     unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;
     if(source!=null){Pilot.move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(source,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,required-core.items.get(desired)));}
     else if(desired==Items.lead)Pilot.mine(desired);
     else Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,40);
     return true;
    }
   }
   activated=true;factory.configureAny(0);Pilot.event("unit_production_start","core="+core.items);
  }
  // Recipe inputs are withdrawn and delivered through the same native player actions as construction logistics.
  Building[] targets={reconstructor,reconstructor,factory,factory};Item[] items={Items.silicon,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead};int[] buffers={80,80,20,20};
  for(int i=0;i<targets.length;i++){
   Building target=targets[i];Item desired=items[i];int missing=buffers[i]-target.items.get(desired);
   if(missing<=0)continue;
   if(unit.stack.amount>0 && unit.item()!=desired){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.deposit();return true;}
   if(unit.stack.amount>0){
    unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(target.x,target.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(target,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,target);return true;
   }
   if(core.items.get(desired)>0){
    unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(core,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,core,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,missing));return true;
   }
   Building source=null;for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b!=core && b!=factory && b!=reconstructor && b.items!=null && b.items.get(desired)>=1 && (source==null || b.dst2(unit)<source.dst2(unit)))source=b;
   if(source!=null){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(source,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,missing));return true;}
   if(desired==Items.lead){Pilot.mine(desired);return true;}
  }
  return false;
 }
}
````

## calibration-wave-smoke/driver-freeze/NativeCalibrationPolicy.java

同几何布局的合法科技前沿和一级兵种适配。

SHA-256：`26f7031b42bc3bed9425381462895fa0faeb5785ecf27ec40e37c6ee18e38302`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import java.util.*;import java.util.function.BiConsumer;import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.input.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.units.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Preregisterable native-campaign adapter: same geometry, legal research frontier and paid tier1 fallback. */
public class NativeCalibrationPolicy{
 final ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint;final BiConsumer<String,String> log;final IntSupplier clock;final HashSet<Integer> deferred=new HashSet<>();
 boolean tier1Activated,ownsCommandMode;final ArrayList<Pilot.Order> lockedOrders=new ArrayList<>();
 NativeCalibrationPolicy(ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint,BiConsumer<String,String> log,IntSupplier clock){this.blueprint=blueprint;this.log=log;this.clock=clock;}
 boolean currentSectorGate(Block block){
  if(block.techNode==null || block.unlockedHost())return false;
  for(var objective:block.techNode.objectives)if(objective instanceof Objectives.SectorComplete s && s.preset.sector==state.rules.sector && !objective.complete())return true;
  return false;
 }
 void refresh(){
  ArrayList<Pilot.Order> legal=new ArrayList<>(),locked=new ArrayList<>();
  for(Pilot.Order o:blueprint){
   if(o.block==Blocks.additiveReconstructor && currentSectorGate(o.block)){if(deferred.add(o.x<<16|o.y))log.accept("native_technology_defer","block="+o.block.name+";site="+o.x+":"+o.y+";reason=current_sector_capture_required");continue;}
   (o.block.unlockedHost()?legal:locked).add(o);
  }
  Pilot.orders.clear();Pilot.orders.addAll(legal);lockedOrders.clear();lockedOrders.addAll(locked);
 }
 boolean installed(Pilot.Order o){Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);return t!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block;}
 void act()throws Exception{
  Pilot.tick=clock.getAsInt();if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;refresh();
  if(ownsCommandMode && state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt")){control.input.commandMode=false;ownsCommandMode=false;log.accept("native_command_mode_released","native_unitsBuilt_goal_completed=true");}
  // Native ammunition and fuel actions take priority while an enemy threatens the base.
  if(mindustry.entities.Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,Team.sharded.core().x,Team.sharded.core().y,500,u->true)!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild t && t.totalAmmo<4){Pilot.act();return;}
  }
  for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders)if(o.block.unlockedHost() && !installed(o)){Pilot.act();return;}
  if(state.rules.attackMode && !Blocks.additiveReconstructor.unlockedHost() && produceLegalTier1()){AttackSupport.control();return;}
  // Fully affordable native technology has priority over saving for an unavailable earlier branch.
  ui.research.rebuildItems();
  for(Pilot.Order o:lockedOrders)if(!o.block.unlockedHost() && affordable(o.block)){NativeCampaignStage.research(o.block);return;}
  for(Pilot.Order o:lockedOrders)if(!o.block.unlockedHost()){NativeCampaignStage.research(o.block);return;}
  Pilot.act();
 }
 boolean affordable(mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent c){
  if(c.unlockedHost())return true;var n=c.techNode;if(n==null)return false;
  if(n.parent!=null && !n.parent.content.unlockedHost())return affordable(n.parent.content);
  for(var objective:n.objectives)if(!objective.complete())return false;
  for(int i=0;i<n.requirements.length;i++)if(ui.research.items.get(n.requirements[i].item)<n.requirements[i].amount-n.finishedRequirements[i].amount)return false;
  return true;
 }
 boolean produceLegalTier1(){
  UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.groundFactory)factory=(UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild)b;
  if(factory==null || !UnitTypes.dagger.unlockedHost())return false;
  if(!tier1Activated){
   for(var item:new Item[]{Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead}){int required=item==Items.graphite?360:item==Items.silicon?450:200;if(Team.sharded.core().items.get(item)<required)return NativeCampaignStage.gather(item);}
   factory.configureAny(0);tier1Activated=true;control.input.commandMode=true;ownsCommandMode=true;
   log.accept("native_command_mode_entered","local_player_input=true;objective_flags_not_written=true");
   log.accept("native_tier1_factory_activated","site="+factory.pos()+";unit=dagger;unlocked_reconstructor=false;all_materials_native");
  }
  var unit=Pilot.bot.unit();unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;
  for(var item:new Item[]{Items.silicon,Items.lead})if(factory.items.get(item)<20){
   if(unit.stack.amount>0 && unit.item()!=item){Pilot.deposit();return true;}
   if(unit.stack.amount==0){var core=Team.sharded.core();if(core.items.get(item)==0)return NativeCampaignStage.gather(item);Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(core,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(Pilot.bot,core,item,unit.type.itemCapacity);return true;}
   Pilot.move(factory.x,factory.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(factory,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(Pilot.bot,factory);return true;
  }
  return false;
 }
}
````

````java
/** Native SDL realtime calibration route. Development until C training/entry/admission are frozen. */
public class RealtimeCampaign{

 static Sector expected,origin;static RealtimeRecorder recorder;static NativeCalibrationPolicy actor;
 static boolean sourceLoaded,launchQueued,terminalPending,terminalWon,done,advanceSource;static String terminalReason;
 static double transitionSeconds,routeCompletedSeconds;static long bootWall;static ArrayList<String> stagePaths=new ArrayList<>();
 static final String[] mapsA={"stainedMountains","windsweptIslands","fungalPass"};

 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{

  if(debugMap!=null && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.formalAccepted"))throw new IllegalStateException("Development smoke cannot be a formal sample");
  if(!policy.equals("balanced") && !policy.equals("defensive"))throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown policy");
  System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.policy",policy);System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.seed",String.valueOf(seed));System.setProperty("mindustry.data.dir",profile);System.setProperty("nodiscord","true");System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.manualDuo","true");System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite","true");
  new File(output).mkdirs();routeId="C-A-"+policy+"-"+EvaluationParameters.group+"-s"+seed;bootWall=System.nanoTime();
  routeLog=new PrintWriter(output+"/campaign-costs.csv"){@Override public void println(String line){if(!line.isEmpty() && Character.isDigit(line.charAt(0))){int at=line.indexOf(',');if(at>=0)line=line.substring(0,at)+","+routeId+line.substring(at);}super.println(line);}};
  routeLog.println("seq,run_id,native_tick_seconds,effective_route_seconds,event,detail");NativeCampaignStage.journal=routeLog;
  Events.on(WorldLoadBeginEvent.class,e->Mathf.rand.setSeed(0));
  Events.on(ClientLoadEvent.class,e->{try{
   for(String option:new String[]{"backgroundpause","bloom","effects","drawlight","shadows","drawweather","animatedwater"})Core.settings.put(option,false);Core.settings.put("fpscap",60);Core.settings.put("skipcoreanimation",true);Core.settings.put("maxresources",true);
   NativeCampaignStage.spend=ui.research.view.getClass().getDeclaredMethod("spend",TechTree.TechNode.class);NativeCampaignStage.spend.setAccessible(true);
   expected=preset(maps[0]).sector;origin=debugMap==null || System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugNativeOrigin")!=null?preset(originName).sector:expected;
   control.setInput(new DesktopInput(){@Override public void update(){if(done || terminalPending || !state.isPlaying())return;try{
    Pilot.bot=Vars.player;if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;Pilot.bot.set(Pilot.bot.unit());

   }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}});
   Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->{

   }));
  }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}});

   if(state.rules.sector==expected && !expected.hasBase())removePreplaced();
   Core.app.post(()->{if(done)return;if(state.rules.sector==expected){if(recorder==null)try{activate();}catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}else if(state.rules.sector==origin){sourceLoaded=true;Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.orders.clear();note("native_origin_loaded","origin="+originName+";source_items="+origin.items());}});
  });

   int[] before=NativeCampaignStage.launchBalances.get(e.from);if(before==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing native source receipt opening");var after=e.from.items();var cost=e.loadout.requirements();var resources=universe.getLaunchResources();
   for(var item:content.items()){int paid=cost.get(item)+resources.get(item);if(before[item.id]-after.get(item)!=paid)throw new IllegalStateException("Native launch debit mismatch "+item);if(paid>0)note("native_launch_debit_receipt","source="+e.from.id+";item="+item.name+";before="+before[item.id]+";paid="+paid+";after="+after.get(item));}
  }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}});
  Events.on(SectorCaptureEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null && e.sector==expected && recorder.initialEnemyCores==0)requestTerminal(true,"native_sector_capture");});
  Events.on(ResearchEvent.class,e->{if(routeLog!=null)note("native_research_unlocked",e.content.name);});
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null)requestTerminal(e.winner==Team.sharded,e.winner==Team.sharded?"native_victory":"native_defeat");});
  Events.on(WaveEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null)Pilot.lastWaveTick=Pilot.tick;});
  Events.run(Trigger.beforeGameUpdate,()->{if(done)return;if(recorder!=null)recorder.beforePhysics();else if(sourceLoaded){advanceSource=true;NativeCampaignStage.effective=(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds+Time.delta/60)*60;}});
  Version.init();Vars.loadLogger();
  new SdlApplication(new DesktopLauncher(new String[0]){@Override public void update(){super.update();if(clientLoaded && !done)try{afterNativeFrame();}catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}},new SdlConfig(){{title="Mindustry realtime calibration "+routeId;width=480;height=360;disableAudio=true;vSyncEnabled=false;}});
 }
 static SectorPreset preset(String name){return content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,name);}
 static void removePreplaced(){ArrayList<Tile> removed=new ArrayList<>();for(var tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))removed.add(tile);for(var tile:removed){note("protocol_remove_without_refund",tile.block().name+"@"+tile.x+":"+tile.y);tile.remove();}}
 static void transition()throws Exception{
  if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;
  NativeCampaignStage.target=expected;NativeCampaignStage.targetName=expected.preset.name;NativeCampaignStage.origin=origin;NativeCampaignStage.originName=origin.preset.name;
  control.checkAutoUnlocks();

  var core=Team.sharded.core();if(core==null){finishRoute(false,"origin_core_lost");return;}
  if(core.items.get(Items.copper)<1000){NativeCampaignStage.gather(Items.copper);return;}
  if(core.items.get(Items.lead)<800){NativeCampaignStage.gather(Items.lead);return;}
  launchQueued=true;note("native_transition_launch","target="+expected.preset.name+";transition_effective_seconds="+transitionSeconds);NativeCampaignStage.launch();

 static void activate()throws Exception{
  if(done || recorder!=null || state.rules.sector!=expected)return;
  routeCompletedSeconds+=transitionSeconds;transitionSeconds=0;advanceSource=false;sourceLoaded=false;launchQueued=false;terminalPending=false;
  if(!net.active())net.host(Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.port",47100));if(!net.server() || !net.active())throw new IllegalStateException("Native realtime server did not host");
  Pilot.tick=0;Pilot.index=0;Pilot.seq=0;Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.mapName=maps[index];Pilot.lastWaveTick=0;
  ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint=new ArrayList<>();String file=debugMap==null?"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/frozen/S-v2/layouts/"+policy+"-"+stage()+".csv":System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugLayout","/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/campaign-groundZero-v2-layout.csv");
  var lines=java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(Path.of(file));for(String line:lines.subList(1,lines.size())){String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Pilot.Order o=new Pilot.Order();o.block=content.block(c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];blueprint.add(o);}

  Pilot.log=new PrintWriter(path+".actor.csv"){@Override public void println(String line){super.println(line);if(!line.isEmpty() && Character.isDigit(line.charAt(0)) && recorder!=null){String[] parts=line.split(",",4);if(parts.length==4)recorder.actorEvent(parts[2],parts[3]);}}};Pilot.log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");

  System.out.println("REALTIME_STAGE_STARTED "+stage()+" "+maps[index]+" seed="+seed+" headless="+headless+" nativeClock=true");
 }
 static void mapAcceptance(){
  TreeMap<String,Integer> ore=new TreeMap<>();int preplaced=0;for(var tile:world.tiles){if(tile.drop()!=null)ore.merge(tile.drop().name,1,Integer::sum);if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))preplaced++;}
  recorder.emit("native_map_acceptance","map="+maps[index]+";width="+world.width()+";height="+world.height()+";core="+Team.sharded.core().block.name+";unit_cap="+mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)+";unit_cap_variable="+state.rules.unitCapVariable+";build_cost_multiplier="+state.rules.buildCostMultiplier+";enemy_cores="+Team.crux.cores().size+";win_wave="+state.rules.winWave+";minerals="+ore+";player_duo_salvo="+preplaced);
  if(debugMap!=null)return;int width=index==0?300:index==1?400:150,height=index==0?300:index==1?400:250,enemies=index==2?2:0;
  if(world.width()!=width || world.height()!=height || state.rules.attackMode!=(enemies>0) || Team.crux.cores().size!=enemies)recorder.invalid("native_map_dimensions_or_mode");
  if(preplaced!=0 || state.rules.buildCostMultiplier!=1 || state.rules.defaultTeam!=Team.sharded)recorder.invalid("native_map_team_cost_or_preplaced");
  for(String required:new String[]{"copper","lead","coal","sand"})if(ore.getOrDefault(required,0)==0)recorder.invalid("native_map_missing_mineral_"+required);
  if(index<2 && (state.rules.winWave!=30 || !state.rules.waves || ore.getOrDefault("titanium",0)==0))recorder.invalid("native_survival_wave_rules_or_titanium");
 }
 static void requestTerminal(boolean won,String reason){if(!terminalPending || !won){terminalPending=true;terminalWon=won;terminalReason=reason;}}
 static void afterNativeFrame()throws Exception{
  if(recorder==null){if(advanceSource){transitionSeconds+=Time.delta/60;advanceSource=false;}if(transitionSeconds>=5400)finishRoute(false,"native_research_or_launch_gate_time_limit");return;}
  if(recorder.inFrame)recorder.afterPhysics();NativeCampaignStage.effective=(routeCompletedSeconds+recorder.seconds)*60;
  if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty())requestTerminal(false,"core_lost");
  else if(recorder.initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size<recorder.initialEnemyCores && !terminalPending)requestTerminal(true,"first_enemy_core");
  if(recorder.seconds>=limit && !terminalPending)requestTerminal(false,debugMap==null?"time_limit":"development_smoke_limit");
  if(recorder.frame>0 && recorder.frame%1800==0)System.out.println("REALTIME "+stage()+" sim="+recorder.seconds+" wall="+recorder.wall()+" wave="+state.wave+" valid="+recorder.valid);
  if(!terminalPending)return;
  String path=recorder.prefix;boolean won=terminalWon;String reason=terminalReason;boolean valid;
  recorder.finish(won,reason);valid=recorder.valid;SaveIO.write(new Fi(path+".final.msav"));if(Pilot.log!=null)Pilot.log.close();stagePaths.add(path);routeCompletedSeconds+=recorder.seconds;recorder=null;
  if(!valid){finishRoute(false,"technical_invalid_native_stage");return;}
  if(!won || index+1==maps.length){finishRoute(won,reason);return;}
  origin=expected;originName=origin.preset.name;expected=preset(maps[++index]).sector;terminalPending=false;sourceLoaded=true;launchQueued=false;transitionSeconds=0;
 }
 static void finishRoute(boolean complete,String reason)throws Exception{
  if(done)return;done=true;note("native_route_end","complete="+complete+";reason="+reason+";total_effective_seconds="+(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds));
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()!=null)control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();routeLog.close();
  java.nio.file.Files.writeString(Path.of(output+"/route.json"),"{\"run_id\":\""+routeId+"\",\"track\":\"C\",\"policy\":\""+policy+"\",\"group\":\""+EvaluationParameters.group+"\",\"seed\":"+seed+",\"complete\":"+complete+",\"reason\":\""+reason+"\",\"effective_seconds\":"+(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds)+",\"wall_seconds\":"+(System.nanoTime()-bootWall)/1e9+",\"formal_sample\":false,\"development_status\":\"NOT_FROZEN_NOT_ADMITTED\",\"stage_count\":"+stagePaths.size()+"}\n");
  System.out.println("REALTIME_ROUTE_END "+reason+" complete="+complete);Core.app.exit();
 }
 static void fail(Exception ex){ex.printStackTrace();try{finishRoute(false,"technical_exception_"+ex.getClass().getSimpleName());}catch(Exception other){other.printStackTrace();Core.app.exit();}}
}
````

## src/RealtimeRecorder.java

C原生可变帧记录、库存、波次、窗口和里程碑。

SHA-256：`60998735bc8d26ac7ff0866d84f5fe2721e367d6d05b57611f39e1ca29aac9cb`；同内容路径数：2。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.util.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.entities.bullet.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.game.EventType.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.storage.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.defense.*;import mindustry.world.modules.*;
import mindustry.world.blocks.units.*;
import java.io.*;import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Read-only native desktop calibration recorder. Variable native delta; never a fixed-loop substitute. */
public class RealtimeRecorder implements EvaluationTrace.Sink{
 final String prefix,routeId,runId,stage,policy,group;final int seed,initialEnemyCores;final long wallStart=System.nanoTime();
 final PrintWriter events,batchCsv,windowCsv,stageCsv,frames;boolean closed,valid=true,inFrame;long seq,frame;
 double seconds,frameEnd,frameDelta,staticStreak,combatIntegral;double firstNativeTick;int destroyed,lateDestroyed;boolean lateStarted;
 final IdentityHashMap<ItemModule,Account> accounts=new IdentityHashMap<>();final ArrayList<Batch> batches=new ArrayList<>();
 final TreeMap<Integer,Win> windows=new TreeMap<>();final LinkedHashMap<String,Double> milestones=new LinkedHashMap<>();
 final ArrayDeque<ThreatInterval> threatIntervals=new ArrayDeque<>();
 static class Account{int pos;int[] balance;Account(Building b){pos=b.pos();balance=new int[content.items().size];for(var i:content.items())balance[i.id]=b.items.get(i);}}
 static class Batch{int ordinal,wave;double start,end=-1;boolean sealed;long beginSeq,sealSeq,clearSeq;LinkedHashMap<Integer,Unit> units=new LinkedHashMap<>();HashSet<Integer> terminated=new HashSet<>();}
 static class Win{long[] supply=new long[content.items().size],construction=new long[content.items().size];double healing,requested,received,repairEnergy;}
 static class ThreatInterval{double start,end;int guns;ThreatInterval(double s,double e,int g){start=s;end=e;guns=g;}}
 interface Share{void add(Win w,double fraction);}
 public RealtimeRecorder(String prefix,String routeId,String stage,String policy,int seed)throws Exception{
  this.prefix=prefix;this.routeId=routeId;this.stage=stage;this.policy=policy;this.seed=seed;this.group=EvaluationParameters.group;runId=routeId+"-"+stage;initialEnemyCores=Team.crux.cores().size;firstNativeTick=state.tick;
  events=new PrintWriter(prefix+".events.csv");batchCsv=new PrintWriter(prefix+".batches.csv");windowCsv=new PrintWriter(prefix+".windows.csv");stageCsv=new PrintWriter(prefix+".stages.csv");frames=new PrintWriter(prefix+".frames.csv");
  events.println("seq,run_id,route_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,frame,sim_seconds,native_tick_seconds,wall_seconds,event,detail");
  frames.println("frame,sim_seconds,native_tick_seconds,wall_seconds,predicted_delta,actual_native_delta,graphics_delta,core_present,wave");
  syncCores();EvaluationTrace.sink=this;
  Events.on(BlockDestroyEvent.class,e->{if(!closed && e.tile.team()==Team.sharded){destroyed++;if(lateStarted)lateDestroyed++;emit("building_destroyed","site="+e.tile.pos()+";block="+e.tile.block().name);}});
  emit("native_calibration_open","headless="+headless+";fixed_override="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed")+";native_unit_cap="+mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)+";core="+Team.sharded.core().block.name+";initial_enemy_cores="+initialEnemyCores+";scope=calibration_not_full_S_Q3_Q4");
  if(headless || Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed") || !state.isCampaign())invalid("not_native_realtime_campaign");
 }
 double now(){return inFrame?frameEnd:seconds;}
 double wall(){return (System.nanoTime()-wallStart)/1e9;}
 void emit(String event,String detail){events.println(++seq+","+runId+","+routeId+",C,A,"+policy+","+group+",0,"+seed+","+stage+","+frame+","+now()+","+(state.tick-firstNativeTick)/60+","+wall()+","+event+",\""+detail.replace('"','\'').replace('\n',' ')+"\"");}
 void invalid(String reason){valid=false;emit("invalid",reason);}
 Win point(){return windows.computeIfAbsent((int)Math.floor(now()/300),k->new Win());}
 void split(Share callback){
  double start=seconds,end=inFrame?frameEnd:seconds;
  if(end<=start){callback.add(point(),1);return;}
  for(int k=(int)Math.floor(start/300);k<=(int)Math.floor(end/300);k++){double overlap=Math.max(0,Math.min(end,(k+1)*300.0)-Math.max(start,k*300.0));if(overlap>0)callback.add(windows.computeIfAbsent(k,j->new Win()),overlap/(end-start));}
 }
 void syncCores(){for(var core:Team.sharded.cores())if(!accounts.containsKey(core.items)){
  Account a=new Account(core);accounts.put(core.items,a);for(var item:content.items())emit("stock_open","core="+a.pos+";item="+item.name+";balance="+a.balance[item.id]);
 }}
 public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){Account a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a.balance[item]!=before || after<0)invalid("stock_discontinuity;item="+item+";expected="+a.balance[item]+";before="+before+";after="+after);a.balance[item]=after;emit("stock","core="+a.pos+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);}
 public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(team==Team.sharded)point().supply[item.id]+=amount;}
 public void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(site.team==Team.sharded){point().construction[item.id]+=amount;emit("construction_paid","site="+site.pos()+";block="+target.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount);}}
 public void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(source.team==Team.sharded)point().healing+=amount;}
 public void powerUsage(Building b,float requested,float received){if(b.team==Team.sharded)split((w,f)->{w.requested+=requested*f;w.received+=received*f;if(b.block instanceof MendProjector || b.block instanceof RepairTurret || b.block instanceof RegenProjector || b.block instanceof RepairTower)w.repairEnergy+=received*f;});}
 public void waveBegin(int wave){Batch b=new Batch();b.ordinal=batches.size()+1;b.wave=wave;b.start=now();batches.add(b);if(b.ordinal==26)lateStarted=true;emit("batch_begin","ordinal="+b.ordinal+";native_wave="+wave);b.beginSeq=seq;}
 Batch current(){return batches.get(batches.size()-1);}
 public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup g,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){emit("spawn_plan","batch="+current().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";type="+g.type.name+";x="+x+";y="+y+";base="+base+";adjusted="+adjusted+";boss="+(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss));}
 public void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup g,Unit u){if(u.team!=Team.sharded){current().units.put(u.id,u);emit("batch_unit","batch="+current().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";id="+u.id+";type="+u.type.name);}}
 public void waveEnd(int wave){current().sealed=true;emit("batch_seal","ordinal="+current().ordinal+";actual="+current().units.size());current().sealSeq=seq;}
 void mark(String name){if(!milestones.containsKey(name)){milestones.put(name,now());emit("milestone",name);}}
 void actorEvent(String type,String detail){if(initialEnemyCores>0 && type.equals("rts_attack"))mark("rts_attack");emit("actor_"+type,detail);}
 void beforePhysics(){
  float raw=Core.graphics.getDeltaTime()*60f;float predicted=!Float.isFinite(raw)?1:Mathf.clamp(raw,.0001f,maxDeltaClient);frameDelta=predicted;frameEnd=seconds+predicted/60.0;inFrame=true;frame++;
 }
 void afterPhysics(){
  if(!inFrame){invalid("physics_end_without_begin");return;}
  if(Math.abs(Time.delta-frameDelta)>1e-6)invalid("native_delta_prediction_mismatch;predicted="+frameDelta+";actual="+Time.delta);
  seconds=frameEnd;inFrame=false;syncCores();
  for(var core:Team.sharded.cores()){Account a=accounts.get(core.items);for(var item:content.items())if(a.balance[item.id]!=core.items.get(item))invalid("missed_core_stock_mutation;item="+item.name);}
  if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().fillItems)invalid("cheat_enabled");
  frames.println(frame+","+seconds+","+(state.tick-firstNativeTick)/60+","+wall()+","+frameDelta+","+Time.delta+","+Core.graphics.getDeltaTime()+","+!Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()+","+state.wave);
  for(Batch b:batches)if(b.end<0){for(var e:b.units.entrySet())if(!b.terminated.contains(e.getKey()) && (e.getValue().dead || !e.getValue().isAdded())){b.terminated.add(e.getKey());emit("batch_unit_terminated","batch="+b.ordinal+";id="+e.getKey());}if(b.sealed && b.terminated.size()==b.units.size()){b.end=seconds;emit("batch_clear","ordinal="+b.ordinal);b.clearSeq=seq;}}
  int ready=0,engaged=0;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.salvo && b.enabled && b instanceof ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild gun){
   Turret.AmmoEntry ammo=gun.ammo.size==0?null:gun.ammo.peek();if(ammo!=null && ammo.amount<((ItemTurret)gun.block).ammoPerShot)for(var a:gun.ammo)if(a.amount>=((ItemTurret)gun.block).ammoPerShot){ammo=a;break;}
   if(ammo==null || ammo.amount<((ItemTurret)gun.block).ammoPerShot || gun.potentialEfficiency<=0)continue;ready++;BulletType bullet=ammo.type();boolean threat=false;
   for(var u:Groups.unit)if(u.team!=Team.sharded && u.team!=Team.derelict && !u.dead && (u.isGrounded()?((Turret)gun.block).targetGround:((Turret)gun.block).targetAir) && ((Turret)gun.block).unitFilter.get(u) && (bullet.targetMissiles || !(u instanceof TimedKillc)) && u.within(gun,((Turret)gun.block).range+bullet.rangeChange+u.hitSize/2)){threat=true;break;}
   if(!threat && ((Turret)gun.block).targetGround && ((Turret)gun.block).targetBlocks && bullet.targetBlocks)for(var enemy:Groups.build)if(enemy.team!=Team.sharded && enemy.team!=Team.derelict && !enemy.dead && enemy.block.targetable && enemy.within(gun,((Turret)gun.block).range+bullet.rangeChange)){threat=true;break;}
   if(threat)engaged++;
  }
  double dt=frameDelta/60;
  if(ready>=3){staticStreak+=dt;threatIntervals.add(new ThreatInterval(seconds-dt,seconds,engaged));combatIntegral+=engaged*dt;double cut=seconds-180;
   while(!threatIntervals.isEmpty() && threatIntervals.peek().end<=cut){var old=threatIntervals.remove();combatIntegral-=(old.end-old.start)*old.guns;}
   if(!threatIntervals.isEmpty() && threatIntervals.peek().start<cut){var old=threatIntervals.peek();combatIntegral-=(cut-old.start)*old.guns;old.start=cut;}
   if(staticStreak>=180){mark("salvo_static");if(combatIntegral>=90)mark("salvo_combat");}
  }else{staticStreak=0;combatIntegral=0;threatIntervals.clear();}
  if(initialEnemyCores>0){int count=0;double hp=0;for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=Pilot.bot.unit() && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && AttackSupport.contains(u)){count++;hp+=u.health;}if(count>=8 && hp>=2000)mark("army_formed");if(Team.crux.cores().size<initialEnemyCores)mark("first_enemy_core");}
  if(frame%1800==0){events.flush();frames.flush();}
 }
 void finish(boolean won,String reason)throws Exception{
  if(closed)return;if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){won=false;reason="core_lost";}
  for(Batch b:batches)if(!b.sealed)invalid("unsealed_native_batch");
  if(won && initialEnemyCores==0 && (batches.size()!=29 || batches.stream().anyMatch(b->b.end<0)))invalid("native_survival_capture_without_all29clear");
  if(won && initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size>=initialEnemyCores)invalid("first_enemy_core_not_destroyed");
  if(won && initialEnemyCores==0 && lateStarted && lateDestroyed==0 && batches.size()==29 && batches.stream().allMatch(b->b.end>=0))mark("late_lock");
  batchCsv.println("seq,run_id,route_id,track,policy,group,seed,stage,batch,native_wave,spawn_seconds,terminal_seconds,duration_seconds,cleared,censored,actual_units,terminated_units,spawn_journal_seq,seal_journal_seq,clear_journal_seq");int i=0;double rmct=0;int clear=0;
  for(Batch b:batches){double end=b.end<0?seconds:b.end;rmct+=end-b.start;if(b.end>=0)clear++;batchCsv.println(++i+","+runId+","+routeId+",C,"+policy+","+group+","+seed+","+stage+","+b.ordinal+","+b.wave+","+b.start+","+end+","+(end-b.start)+","+(b.end>=0)+","+(b.end<0)+","+b.units.size()+","+b.terminated.size()+","+b.beginSeq+","+b.sealSeq+","+(b.clearSeq==0?"":b.clearSeq));}
  windowCsv.println("seq,run_id,route_id,track,policy,group,seed,stage,window,start_seconds,end_seconds,duration_seconds,item,actual_supply,actual_construction_paid,repair_effective_hp,grid_requested_energy,grid_received_energy,repair_received_energy,scope");int wi=0;
  for(var e:windows.entrySet()){int index=e.getKey();var w=e.getValue();double end=Math.min(seconds,(index+1)*300.0),duration=Math.max(0,end-index*300.0);String base=runId+","+routeId+",C,"+policy+","+group+","+seed+","+stage+","+index+","+(index*300.0)+","+end+","+duration;
   windowCsv.println(++wi+","+base+",,,,"+w.healing+","+w.requested+","+w.received+","+w.repairEnergy+",window");
   for(var item:content.items())windowCsv.println(++wi+","+base+","+item.name+","+w.supply[item.id]+","+w.construction[item.id]+",,,,,item");
  }
  emit("run_end","valid="+valid+";won="+won+";reason="+reason+";milestones="+milestones);
  stageCsv.println("seq,run_id,route_id,track,policy,group,seed,stage,sim_seconds,native_tick_seconds,wall_seconds,valid,won,terminal_reason,batch_count,cleared_batches,censored_batches,rmct_seconds,salvo_static_seconds,salvo_combat_seconds,army_formed_seconds,rts_attack_seconds,first_enemy_core_seconds,late_lock_seconds,buildings_destroyed,late_buildings_destroyed,core_lost,enemy_cores_initial,enemy_cores_remaining,scope,journal_end_seq");
  stageCsv.println("1,"+runId+","+routeId+",C,"+policy+","+group+","+seed+","+stage+","+seconds+","+(state.tick-firstNativeTick)/60+","+wall()+","+valid+","+won+","+reason+","+batches.size()+","+clear+","+(batches.size()-clear)+","+(batches.isEmpty()?"":rmct/batches.size())+","+time("salvo_static")+","+time("salvo_combat")+","+time("army_formed")+","+time("rts_attack")+","+time("first_enemy_core")+","+time("late_lock")+","+destroyed+","+lateDestroyed+","+Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()+","+initialEnemyCores+","+Team.crux.cores().size+",native_realtime_calibration,"+seq);
  closed=true;EvaluationTrace.sink=null;events.close();frames.close();batchCsv.close();windowCsv.close();stageCsv.close();
 }
 String time(String name){return milestones.containsKey(name)?String.valueOf(milestones.get(name)):"";}
}
````

## src/CampaignPreparation.java

Real desktop campaign preparation. It never assigns inventory, tech unlocks or objective flags.

SHA-256：`b0007e26f4c06feea614b3b4b8f589a10dca6a150df3debbc7718ae9f61d1525`；同内容路径数：2。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.sdl.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.util.*;
import mindustry.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.desktop.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.game.EventType.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.input.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.modules.*;
import java.io.*;import java.nio.file.*;import java.lang.reflect.*;import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Real desktop campaign preparation. It never assigns inventory, tech unlocks or objective flags. */
public class CampaignPreparation{
 static String root=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.preparationRoot","/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/campaign-preparation/attempt2");
 static boolean launched,captured,done;static long started,seq;static double effectiveTicks,lastSample;
 static PrintWriter journal,frames;static Method nativeSpend;static IdentityHashMap<ItemModule,int[]> accounts=new IdentityHashMap<>();
 static void event(String type,String details){journal.println(++seq+","+state.tick/60.0+","+effectiveTicks/60+","+type+",\""+details.replace('"','\'')+"\"");journal.flush();}
 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  new java.io.File(root).mkdirs();System.setProperty("mindustry.data.dir",root+"/profile");System.setProperty("nodiscord","true");System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.manualDuo","true");
  journal=new PrintWriter(root+"/groundZero-events.csv");journal.println("seq,native_tick_seconds,effective_sim_seconds,event,detail");
  frames=new PrintWriter(root+"/groundZero-frames.csv");frames.println("wall_seconds,native_tick_seconds,effective_sim_seconds,frames,delta,wave,orders,core_copper,core_lead,captured");
  Events.on(ClientLoadEvent.class,e->{
   for(String setting:new String[]{"backgroundpause","bloom","effects","drawlight","shadows","drawweather","animatedwater"})Core.settings.put(setting,false);
   Core.settings.put("skipcoreanimation",true);Core.settings.put("fpscap",60);Core.settings.put("crashreport",false);
   control.setInput(new DesktopInput(){@Override public void update(){if(launched && !done && state.isPlaying())try{act();}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}});
   try{nativeSpend=ui.research.view.getClass().getDeclaredMethod("spend",TechTree.TechNode.class);nativeSpend.setAccessible(true);}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}
   Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->control.playSector(Planets.serpulo.getStartSector())));
  });
  Events.on(SectorLaunchEvent.class,e->{try{
   launched=true;started=System.nanoTime();Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.mapName="groundZero";Pilot.log=new PrintWriter(root+"/groundZero-actor.csv");Pilot.log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");
   java.util.List<String> lines=java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(Path.of(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.preparationLayout","/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/campaign-groundZero-v2-layout.csv")));
   for(String line:lines.subList(1,lines.size())){String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Pilot.Order o=new Pilot.Order();o.block=content.block(c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];Pilot.orders.add(o);}
   for(var c:Team.sharded.cores()){int[] balances=new int[content.items().size];for(var item:content.items())balances[item.id]=c.items.get(item);accounts.put(c.items,balances);}
   EvaluationTrace.sink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){
    public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){int[] a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a[item]!=before || after<0)throw new IllegalStateException("Campaign inventory ledger invalid");event("stock","item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);a[item]=after;}
    public void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(site.team==Team.sharded)event("construction_paid","block="+target.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount);}
   };
   event("native_campaign_start","sector="+e.sector.id+";fixed="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed")+";headless="+headless+";inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items);
  }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}});
  Events.on(SectorCaptureEvent.class,e->{if(launched){captured=true;event("native_sector_captured","sector="+e.sector.id);}});
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{if(launched && e.winner!=Team.sharded)finish("native_defeat");});
  Events.on(ResearchEvent.class,e->{if(launched)event("native_research_unlocked",e.content.name);});
  Events.run(Trigger.afterGameUpdate,()->{if(!launched || done)return;effectiveTicks+=Time.delta;
   if(effectiveTicks/60-lastSample>=30){lastSample=effectiveTicks/60;var c=Team.sharded.core();frames.println((System.nanoTime()-started)/1e9+","+state.tick/60+","+effectiveTicks/60+","+state.updateId+","+Time.delta+","+state.wave+","+Pilot.index+","+(c==null?-1:c.items.get(Items.copper))+","+(c==null?-1:c.items.get(Items.lead))+","+captured);frames.flush();System.out.println("PREP effective="+lastSample+" native_tick="+state.tick/60+" wave="+state.wave+" order="+Pilot.index+" captured="+captured);}
   if(captured && Team.sharded.core()!=null && Team.sharded.core().items.get(Items.copper)>=3500 && Team.sharded.core().items.get(Items.lead)>=2500)finish("captured_and_stocked");
   if(effectiveTicks>=3600*60)finish("preparation_time_limit");
  });
  Version.init();Vars.loadLogger();new SdlApplication(new DesktopLauncher(new String[0]),new SdlConfig(){{title="Mindustry fresh campaign preparation";width=480;height=360;disableAudio=true;vSyncEnabled=false;}});
 }
 static void finish(String reason){if(done)return;done=true;try{
  event("preparation_end","reason="+reason+";captured="+captured+";inventory="+(Team.sharded.core()==null?"none":Team.sharded.core().items));
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()!=null)control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();journal.close();frames.close();if(Pilot.log!=null)Pilot.log.close();System.out.println("PREPARATION_END "+reason);Core.app.exit();
 }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}
 static void act()throws Exception{
  Pilot.tick++;if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;
  if(captured){
   var c=Team.sharded.core();var u=Pilot.bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();u.controlWeapons(false,false);
   if(u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){Pilot.deposit();return;}
   Pilot.mine(c.items.get(Items.copper)<3500?Items.copper:Items.lead);return;
  }
  for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders){Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block)continue;
   if(!o.block.unlockedHost()){if(research(o.block))return;}
   break;
  }
  boolean allBuilt=true;for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders){Tile tile=world.tile(o.x,o.y);if(tile==null || tile.team()!=Team.sharded || tile.block()!=o.block){allBuilt=false;break;}}
  if(allBuilt && state.stats.coreItemCount.get(Items.copper)<105){
   var u=Pilot.bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();Building inlet=world.build(131,55);u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=Items.copper){Pilot.deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){if(c.items.get(Items.copper)>0){Pilot.move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(Pilot.bot,c,Items.copper,u.type.itemCapacity);}else Pilot.mine(Items.copper);return;}
   Pilot.move(inlet.x,inlet.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(inlet,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(Pilot.bot,inlet);return;
  }
  Pilot.act();
 }
 static boolean research(mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent desired)throws Exception{
  if(desired.unlockedHost())return false;TechTree.TechNode n=desired.techNode;if(n==null)return true;
  if(n.parent!=null && !n.parent.content.unlockedHost())return research(n.parent.content);
  var u=Pilot.bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;
  for(var obj:n.objectives)if(!obj.complete()){
   mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent need=obj instanceof Objectives.Research r?r.content:obj instanceof Objectives.Produce p?p.content:null;
   if(need instanceof Item item && u.canMine(item)){if(u.stack.amount>0){Pilot.deposit();return true;}Pilot.mine(item);return true;}
   if(need!=null && !(need instanceof Item))return research(need);
   if(Pilot.tick%300==0)event("research_wait_objective","target="+desired.name+";objective="+obj);
   return true;
  }
  ui.research.rebuildItems();boolean canPay=true;Item shortage=null;
  for(int i=0;i<n.requirements.length;i++){var r=n.requirements[i];int remaining=r.amount-n.finishedRequirements[i].amount;if(ui.research.items.get(r.item)<remaining){canPay=false;shortage=r.item;break;}}
  if(canPay){String before=Team.sharded.core().items.toString();nativeSpend.invoke(ui.research.view,n);event("native_research_payment","target="+desired.name+";before="+before+";after="+Team.sharded.core().items+";unlocked="+desired.unlockedHost());return true;}
  if(u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity || (u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=shortage)){Pilot.deposit();return true;}
  if(u.canMine(shortage))Pilot.mine(shortage);
  else if(Pilot.tick%300==0)event("research_wait_supply","target="+desired.name+";item="+shortage.name);
  return true;
 }
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.sdl.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.scene.ui.*;import arc.util.*;
import mindustry.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.desktop.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.game.EventType.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.input.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.modules.*;import mindustry.ui.dialogs.*;
import java.io.*;import java.nio.file.Path;import java.lang.reflect.*;import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Native desktop preparation stage: pays through ResearchDialog and PlanetDialog launch callbacks. */
public class NativeCampaignStage{
 static String targetName,originName,layout,output,profile;static Sector target,origin;
 static final LinkedHashMap<String,Integer> goals=new LinkedHashMap<>();static String[] researchGoals;
 static boolean ready,launchQueued,captured,finished;static long started,seq;static double effective,lastSample;
 static PrintWriter journal,samples;static Method spend;static IdentityHashMap<ItemModule,Account> accounts=new IdentityHashMap<>();
 static final IdentityHashMap<Sector,int[]> launchBalances=new IdentityHashMap<>();
 static class Account{int sector,pos;int[] balances;Account(int s,int p,ItemModule m){sector=s;pos=p;balances=new int[content.items().size];for(var item:content.items())balances[item.id]=m.get(item);}}
 static void event(String kind,String detail){journal.println(++seq+","+state.tick/60+","+effective/60+","+kind+",\""+detail.replace('"','\'')+"\"");journal.flush();}
 static void syncCores(){if(state.rules.sector!=null)for(var c:Team.sharded.cores())if(!accounts.containsKey(c.items)){
  Account a=new Account(state.rules.sector.id,c.pos(),c.items);accounts.put(c.items,a);for(var item:content.items())event("stock_open","sector="+a.sector+";core="+a.pos+";item="+item.name+";balance="+a.balances[item.id]);
 }}
 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  targetName=args[0];originName=args[1];layout=args[2];profile=args[3];output=args[4];
  for(String part:(args.length>5?args[5]:"copper:3500,lead:2500").split(",")){String[] kv=part.split(":");goals.put(kv[0],Integer.parseInt(kv[1]));}
  researchGoals=args.length>6 && !args[6].isEmpty()?args[6].split(","):new String[0];
  new File(output).getParentFile().mkdirs();System.setProperty("mindustry.data.dir",profile);System.setProperty("nodiscord","true");System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.manualDuo","true");System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite","true");
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed"))throw new IllegalStateException("Desktop preparation must use native realtime clock");
  journal=new PrintWriter(output+".events.csv");journal.println("seq,native_tick_seconds,effective_sim_seconds,event,detail");samples=new PrintWriter(output+".frames.csv");samples.println("wall_seconds,native_tick_seconds,effective_sim_seconds,frames,delta,wave,order,captured,inventory");
  Events.on(WorldLoadBeginEvent.class,e->Mathf.rand.setSeed(0));
  Events.on(ClientLoadEvent.class,e->{
   target=((SectorPreset)content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,targetName)).sector;origin=((SectorPreset)content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,originName)).sector;
   for(String setting:new String[]{"backgroundpause","bloom","effects","drawlight","shadows","drawweather","animatedwater"})Core.settings.put(setting,false);
   Core.settings.put("skipcoreanimation",true);Core.settings.put("maxresources",true);Core.settings.put("fpscap",60);
   control.setInput(new DesktopInput(){@Override public void update(){if(ready && !finished && state.isPlaying())try{act();}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}});
   try{spend=ui.research.view.getClass().getDeclaredMethod("spend",TechTree.TechNode.class);spend.setAccessible(true);}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}
   EvaluationTrace.sink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){
    public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){Account a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a.balances[item]!=before || after<0)throw new IllegalStateException("Native campaign stock reconciliation failed");event("stock","sector="+a.sector+";core="+a.pos+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);a.balances[item]=after;}
    public void construction(Building b,Block block,Item item,int amount){if(b.team==Team.sharded)event("construction_paid","block="+block.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount);}
   };
   Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->{
    if(target.hasBase())control.playSector(target);
    else if(origin.hasBase())control.playSector(origin);
    else throw new IllegalStateException("No actual captured origin save: "+originName);
   }));
  });
  Events.on(WorldLoadEvent.class,e->Core.app.post(()->{syncCores();if(state.rules.sector==target)activate();else if(state.rules.sector==origin && !launchQueued){launchQueued=true;Core.app.post(()->{try{launch();}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}});}}));
  Events.on(SectorLaunchEvent.class,e->{if(e.sector==target)activate();});
  Events.on(SectorCaptureEvent.class,e->{if(e.sector==target){captured=true;event("native_sector_captured","sector="+target.id);}});
  Events.on(ResearchEvent.class,e->event("native_research_unlocked",e.content.name));
  Events.on(SectorLaunchLoadoutEvent.class,e->{
   event("native_launch_loadout","from="+e.from.id+";destination="+e.sector.id+";schematic="+e.loadout.requirements()+";resources="+universe.getLaunchResources());
   int[] before=launchBalances.get(e.from);if(before==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Launch origin missing actual opening inventory");var now=e.from.items();var cost=e.loadout.requirements();var resources=universe.getLaunchResources();
   for(var item:content.items()){int expected=cost.get(item)+resources.get(item),after=now.get(item);if(before[item.id]-after!=expected || after<0)throw new IllegalStateException("Native launch debit does not reconcile: "+item);if(expected>0)event("native_launch_debit_receipt","origin="+e.from.id+";item="+item.name+";before="+before[item.id]+";paid="+expected+";after="+after);}
  });
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{if(ready && e.winner!=Team.sharded)finish("native_defeat");});
  Events.run(Trigger.afterGameUpdate,()->{if(!ready || finished)return;effective+=Time.delta;
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().fillItems)throw new IllegalStateException("Native campaign cheat detected");
   syncCores();if(effective/60-lastSample>=30){lastSample=effective/60;String stock=Team.sharded.core()==null?"none":Team.sharded.core().items.toString();samples.println((System.nanoTime()-started)/1e9+","+state.tick/60+","+effective/60+","+state.updateId+","+Time.delta+","+state.wave+","+Pilot.index+","+captured+",\""+stock.replace('"','\'')+"\"");samples.flush();System.out.println("NATIVE_PREP "+targetName+" sim="+lastSample+" wave="+state.wave+" order="+Pilot.index+" captured="+captured);}
   if(effective>Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.preparationLimit",14400)*60L)finish("preparation_time_limit");
  });
  Version.init();Vars.loadLogger();new SdlApplication(new DesktopLauncher(new String[0]),new SdlConfig(){{title="Mindustry native prerequisite: "+targetName;width=480;height=360;disableAudio=true;vSyncEnabled=false;}});
 }
 static void launch()throws Exception{
  control.checkAutoUnlocks();if(!target.preset.unlockedHost())throw new IllegalStateException("Native prerequisites still lock "+targetName);
  event("native_launch_requested","origin="+originName+";target="+targetName+";origin_items="+origin.items());
  launchBalances.clear();for(var sector:Planets.serpulo.sectors)if(sector.hasBase()){var items=sector.items();int[] snapshot=new int[content.items().size];for(var item:content.items())snapshot[item.id]=items.get(item);launchBalances.put(sector,snapshot);}
  ui.planet.state.planet=Planets.serpulo;ui.planet.launchSector=origin;ui.planet.selected=target;ui.planet.mode=PlanetDialog.Mode.look;
  Method can=PlanetDialog.class.getDeclaredMethod("canPlaySector",Sector.class);can.setAccessible(true);if(!(Boolean)can.invoke(ui.planet,target))throw new IllegalStateException("Native planet dialog forbids launch");
  Method play=PlanetDialog.class.getDeclaredMethod("playSelected");play.setAccessible(true);play.invoke(ui.planet);
  Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->{
   try{
    if(!ui.planet.loadouts.isShown())throw new IllegalStateException("Native loadout dialog did not open");
    Field f=LaunchLoadoutDialog.class.getDeclaredField("valid");f.setAccessible(true);if(!(Boolean)f.get(ui.planet.loadouts))throw new IllegalStateException("Origin cannot afford native launch");
    TextButton button=ui.planet.loadouts.buttons.find(e->e instanceof TextButton b && b.getText().toString().equals(Core.bundle.get("launch.text")));
    if(button==null || button.isDisabled())throw new IllegalStateException("Native launch button unavailable");launchBalances.clear();for(var sector:Planets.serpulo.sectors)if(sector.hasBase()){var items=sector.items();int[] snapshot=new int[content.items().size];for(var item:content.items())snapshot[item.id]=items.get(item);launchBalances.put(sector,snapshot);}button.fireClick();
   }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}
  }));
 }
 static void activate(){if(ready)return;try{
  if(state.rules.sector!=target)return;ready=true;captured=target.isCaptured();started=System.nanoTime();Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.mapName=targetName;Pilot.log=new PrintWriter(output+".actor.csv");Pilot.log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");
  var lines=java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(Path.of(layout));for(String line:lines.subList(1,lines.size())){String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Pilot.Order o=new Pilot.Order();o.block=content.block(c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];Pilot.orders.add(o);}
  if(!net.active())net.host(Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.port",47090));if(!net.server())throw new IllegalStateException("Native desktop server failed to host");
  event("native_desktop_server_hosted","headless="+headless+";port="+Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.port",47090));
  syncCores();event("native_preparation_stage_start","target="+targetName+";sector="+target.id+";width="+world.width()+";height="+world.height()+";core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY()+";inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items+";captured="+captured);
 }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}
 static void act()throws Exception{
  Pilot.tick++;if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;
  if(mindustry.entities.Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,Team.sharded.core().x,Team.sharded.core().y,500,u->true)!=null){for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild t && t.totalAmmo<4){Pilot.act();return;}}
  for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders){Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block)continue;if(!o.block.unlockedHost()){research(o.block);return;}Pilot.act();return;}
  if(!captured){Pilot.act();return;}
  for(String name:researchGoals){mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent desired=content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.block,name);if(desired==null)desired=content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.unit,name);if(desired==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown native research goal "+name);if(!desired.unlockedHost()){research(desired);return;}}
  for(var goal:goals.entrySet()){Item item=content.item(goal.getKey());if(Team.sharded.core().items.get(item)<goal.getValue()){if(!gather(item))Pilot.act();return;}}
  finish("native_captured_researched_and_stocked");
 }
 static boolean gather(Item item){
  var u=Pilot.bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;
  if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()==item && !u.canMine(item)){Pilot.deposit();return true;}
  if(!u.canMine(item) && u.stack.amount>0 && resupplyProducer(item))return true;
  if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()!=item || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity || !u.canMine(item))){Pilot.deposit();return true;}
  if(u.canMine(item)){Pilot.mine(item);return true;}
  Building source=null;for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b!=Team.sharded.core() && b.items!=null && b.items.get(item)>0 && (source==null || b.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=b;
  if(source==null)return resupplyProducer(item);if(u.stack.amount>0){Pilot.deposit();return true;}Pilot.move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(Pilot.bot,source,item,u.type.itemCapacity);return true;
 }
 static boolean resupplyProducer(Item output){
  var u=Pilot.bot.unit();var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.GenericCrafter factory){
   boolean makes=factory.outputItem!=null && factory.outputItem.item==output;if(factory.outputItems!=null)for(var stack:factory.outputItems)if(stack.item==output)makes=true;if(!makes)continue;
   for(var consumer:b.block.consumers)if(consumer instanceof mindustry.world.consumers.ConsumeItems recipe)for(var ingredient:recipe.items){
    Item raw=ingredient.item;if(b.items.get(raw)>=ingredient.amount*4 || (u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=raw))continue;
    if(u.stack.amount>0){Pilot.move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(Pilot.bot,b);return true;}
    Building from=core.items.get(raw)>0?core:null;
    if(from==null)for(var mine:Groups.build)if(mine.team==Team.sharded && mine.block instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill && mine.items.get(raw)>0 && (from==null || mine.dst2(u)<from.dst2(u)))from=mine;
    if(from!=null){Pilot.move(from.x,from.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(from,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(Pilot.bot,from,raw,u.type.itemCapacity);return true;}
   }
  }
  return false;
 }
 static void research(mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent desired)throws Exception{
  if(desired.unlockedHost())return;var n=desired.techNode;if(n==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No native technology node "+desired.name);
  if(n.parent!=null && !n.parent.content.unlockedHost()){research(n.parent.content);return;}
  for(var obj:n.objectives)if(!obj.complete()){
   var need=obj instanceof Objectives.Research r?r.content:obj instanceof Objectives.Produce p?p.content:null;
   if(need instanceof Item item){if(!gather(item))Pilot.act();return;}
   if(need!=null){research(need);return;}
   if(Pilot.tick%300==0)event("native_research_wait_objective","target="+desired.name+";objective="+obj);Pilot.act();return;
  }
  ui.research.rebuildItems();Item shortage=null;for(int i=0;i<n.requirements.length;i++){var req=n.requirements[i];if(ui.research.items.get(req.item)<req.amount-n.finishedRequirements[i].amount){shortage=req.item;break;}}
  if(shortage!=null){if(!gather(shortage))Pilot.act();return;}
  IdentityHashMap<Sector,int[]> opening=new IdentityHashMap<>();int[] expected=new int[content.items().size];
  for(int i=0;i<n.requirements.length;i++)expected[n.requirements[i].item.id]=Math.max(0,n.requirements[i].amount-n.finishedRequirements[i].amount);
  for(var sector:Planets.serpulo.sectors)if(sector.hasBase()){var items=sector.items();int[] amounts=new int[content.items().size];for(var item:content.items())amounts[item.id]=items.get(item);opening.put(sector,amounts);}
  event("native_research_payment_begin","target="+desired.name+";required="+java.util.Arrays.toString(n.requirements));spend.invoke(ui.research.view,n);event("native_research_payment_end","target="+desired.name+";unlocked="+desired.unlockedHost());
  int[] paid=new int[content.items().size];for(var entry:opening.entrySet()){var after=entry.getKey().items();for(var item:content.items()){int before=entry.getValue()[item.id],remaining=after.get(item),amount=before-remaining;paid[item.id]+=amount;if(amount!=0)event("native_research_source_receipt","target="+desired.name+";sector="+entry.getKey().id+";item="+item.name+";before="+before+";paid="+amount+";after="+remaining);}}
  for(var item:content.items())if(paid[item.id]!=expected[item.id])throw new IllegalStateException("Native planet research debit failed reconciliation: "+desired.name+"/"+item.name);
 }
 static void finish(String reason){if(finished)return;finished=true;try{
  event("native_preparation_end","reason="+reason+";target="+targetName+";captured="+captured);
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()!=null)control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();
  java.nio.file.Files.writeString(Path.of(output+".result.json"),"{\"target\":\""+targetName+"\",\"captured\":"+captured+",\"reason\":\""+reason+"\",\"native_tick_seconds\":"+state.tick/60+",\"effective_seconds\":"+effective/60+",\"wall_seconds\":"+(System.nanoTime()-started)/1e9+",\"formal_sample\":false}\n");
  journal.close();samples.close();if(Pilot.log!=null)Pilot.log.close();Core.app.exit();
 }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}
}
````

## src/NativeCampaignCheckpoint.java

成对保存地图与全局战役元数据并独立读回校验。

SHA-256：`64eedbeb4e8a8a3cb0086481246356af39c828ebf36a8e7eaea16c125b8aaa0f`；同内容路径数：3。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import arc.files.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.io.*;import mindustry.type.*;
import java.nio.file.*;import java.security.*;import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Persist already earned native state, read it back, and commit a matched world/settings checkpoint. */
public class NativeCampaignCheckpoint{
 static String quote(String text){return "\""+text.replace("\\","\\\\").replace("\"","\\\"").replace("\n","\\n").replace("\r","\\r").replace("\t","\\t")+"\"";}
 static String hash(Path path)throws Exception{return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(path)));}
 public static Path save(String profile,String destination,Sector sector,double seconds)throws Exception{
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()==null || state.rules.sector!=sector)throw new IllegalStateException("No active native sector save");
  control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();
  Settings disk=new Settings();disk.setDataDirectory(new Fi(profile));disk.setJson(JsonIO.json);disk.load();
  SectorInfo saved=disk.getJson(sector.planet.name+"-s-"+sector.id+"-info",SectorInfo.class,SectorInfo::new);
  var core=state.rules.defaultTeam.core();
  if(core==null || !saved.hasCore || saved.wave!=state.wave || saved.waves!=state.rules.waves || saved.attack!=state.rules.attackMode)throw new IllegalStateException("Persisted native sector metadata differs from played state");
  for(var item:content.items())if(saved.items.get(item)!=core.items.get(item))throw new IllegalStateException("Persisted native inventory differs: "+item.name);
  for(var node:mindustry.content.TechTree.all){String key=node.content.name+"-unlocked";if(disk.getBool(key,false)!=Core.settings.getBool(key,false))throw new IllegalStateException("Persisted native research differs: "+key);}
  var meta=SaveIO.getMeta(control.saves.getCurrent().file);
  if(meta.wave!=saved.wave || meta.rules.waves!=saved.waves || meta.rules.attackMode!=saved.attack)throw new IllegalStateException("Native world/settings checkpoint generation differs");
  Path target=Path.of(destination),temporary=Path.of(destination+".writing");java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(temporary.resolve("saves"));
  java.nio.file.Files.copy(Path.of(profile,"settings.bin"),temporary.resolve("settings.bin"));
  try(var files=java.nio.file.Files.walk(Path.of(profile,"saves"))){for(Path file:(Iterable<Path>)files::iterator)if(java.nio.file.Files.isRegularFile(file) && file.toString().endsWith(".msav")){Path to=temporary.resolve("saves").resolve(Path.of(profile,"saves").relativize(file));java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(to.getParent());java.nio.file.Files.copy(file,to);}}
  StringBuilder hashes=new StringBuilder();try(var files=java.nio.file.Files.walk(temporary)){for(Path file:files.filter(java.nio.file.Files::isRegularFile).sorted().toList()){if(hashes.length()>0)hashes.append(',');hashes.append(quote(temporary.relativize(file).toString())).append(':').append(quote(hash(file)));}}
  String manifest="{\"target\":"+quote(sector.preset.name)+",\"formal_sample\":false,\"native_metadata_readback_passed\":true,\"captured\":"+sector.isCaptured()+",\"wave\":"+state.wave+",\"effective_seconds\":"+seconds+",\"native_tick_seconds\":"+state.tick/60+",\"inventory\":"+quote(core.items.toString())+",\"files\":{"+hashes+"}}\n";
  java.nio.file.Files.writeString(temporary.resolve("manifest.json"),manifest);java.nio.file.Files.move(temporary,target);
  Path pointer=target.getParent().resolve("latest.json.tmp");java.nio.file.Files.writeString(pointer,"{\"checkpoint\":"+quote(target.toAbsolutePath().toString())+"}\n");java.nio.file.Files.move(pointer,target.getParent().resolve("latest.json"),StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING,StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE);
  return target;
 }
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.sdl.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.scene.ui.*;import arc.util.*;
````
