````java
import java.io.*; import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Strategy search only. Native construction, mining and transfers; no formal inference from pilots. */
public class Pilot{
 static String mapName,layout,out; static int limit,seed,tick,index; static long seq;
 static int initialEnemyCores;static Player bot; static PrintWriter log; static ArrayList<Order> orders=new ArrayList<>();
 static int built,failed; static boolean won,ended; static final Vec2 movement=new Vec2();static float goalX,goalY,goalRadius;
 static class Order{Block block;int x,y,rotation;String config;boolean wasBuilt,critical;}
 static void event(String type,String detail){log.println(++seq+","+tick+","+type+","+detail.replace(',',';'));}
 public static void main(String[] args){
  mapName=args.length>0?args[0]:"stainedMountains";
  layout=args.length>1?args[1]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/pilot-layout.csv";
  out=args.length>2?args[2]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/pilot-01.csv";
  limit=args.length>3?Integer.parseInt(args[3]):5400;seed=args.length>4?Integer.parseInt(args[4]):0;
  System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.fixed","true");
  System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.seed",String.valueOf(seed));
  new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{run();System.exit(0);}catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});
 }
 static void run() throws Exception{
  Core.graphics=new MockGraphics(){@Override public float getDeltaTime(){return 1f/60f;}@Override public long getFrameId(){return tick;}};
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(out+".data"));
  headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(Vars.platform.getNet());Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();
  logicVars=new mindustry.logic.GlobalVars(){@Override public void update(){Player saved=Vars.player;Vars.player=null;try{super.update();}finally{Vars.player=saved;}}};
  content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();bases.load();
  log=new PrintWriter(out);log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");
  java.nio.file.Files.copy(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout),java.nio.file.Path.of(out+".layout.csv"));
  java.nio.file.Files.copy(java.nio.file.Path.of("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/src/Pilot.java"),java.nio.file.Path.of(out+".Pilot.java"));
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{won=e.winner==Team.sharded;ended=true;event("game_over",e.winner.name);});
  Events.on(WaveEvent.class,e->event("wave",String.valueOf(state.wave)));
  Events.on(BlockBuildEndEvent.class,e->{if(!e.breaking && e.team==Team.sharded){built++;event("constructed",e.tile.block().name+"@"+e.tile.x+":"+e.tile.y);}});
  Events.on(BlockDestroyEvent.class,e->{if(e.tile.team()==Team.sharded)event("destroyed",e.tile.block().name+"@"+e.tile.x+":"+e.tile.y);});
  Events.on(BuildDamageEvent.class,e->{if(e.build instanceof CoreBlock.CoreBuild)event("core_hit","source="+(e.source==null?"none":e.source.owner)+" health="+e.build.health);});
  logic.reset();Mathf.rand.setSeed(0);world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/"+mapName));
  System.out.println("LOADED "+mapName+" actual="+state.map.name()+" width="+world.width()+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  ArrayList<Tile> remove=new ArrayList<>();
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.isCenter() && t.team()==Team.sharded && (t.block()==Blocks.duo || t.block()==Blocks.salvo))remove.add(t);
  for(Tile t:remove){event("protocol_remove",t.block().name+"@"+t.x+":"+t.y);t.remove();}
  state.rules.infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().cheat=false;Team.sharded.rules().fillItems=false;
  state.rules.unitCapVariable=false;state.rules.unitCap=mapName.equals("stainedMountains")?8:16;
  state.rules.buildCostMultiplier=1;
  if(!state.rules.attackMode)state.rules.winWave=30;
  Mathf.rand.setSeed(seed);Time.setDeltaProvider(()->1f);Time.setInternalTime(0);mindustry.logic.GlobalVars.rand.setSeed(seed);logic.play();
  initialEnemyCores=Team.crux.cores().size;importCarry();
  System.out.println("PLAY core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  bot=Player.create();bot.name="evaluation-pilot";bot.team(Team.sharded);bot.add();Vars.player=bot;
  Team.sharded.core().requestSpawn(bot);
  net.host(40000+Math.floorMod(out.hashCode(),20000));
  if(!net.server() || !net.active())throw new IllegalStateException("Native server did not host");
  for(String line:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).size())){
   String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Order o=new Order();o.block=content.getByName(ContentType.block,c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];orders.add(o);
  }
  event("start",mapName+" seed="+seed+" inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  event("configuration","group="+EvaluationParameters.group+" alpha="+EvaluationParameters.alpha+" tick_substreams="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed")+" core_copper_bus="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus"));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".initial.msav"));
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.audit")){
   PrintWriter randomAudit=new PrintWriter(out+".rng-audit.txt");Rand previous=Mathf.rand;
   Mathf.rand=new Rand(previous.seed0,previous.seed1){@Override public long nextLong(){

 static void importCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryIn");if(path==null)return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(String row:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).size())){
   String[] fields=row.split(",");Item item=content.item(fields[0]);int amount=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);int beforeSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]),afterSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
   if(amount<0 || beforeSource-afterSource!=amount || Integer.parseInt(fields[4])!=seed || !fields[5].equals(EvaluationParameters.group))throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid inheritance receipt");
   int before=core.items.get(item),accepted=Math.min(amount,Math.max(0,core.storageCapacity-before));core.items.add(item,accepted);
   event("carry_in","item="+item.name+" exported="+amount+" before="+before+" accepted="+accepted+" overflow="+(amount-accepted)+" after="+core.items.get(item));
  }
 }
 static void exportCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryOut");if(path==null || !won || Team.sharded.core()==null)return;
  int[] caps=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0").equals("0")?new int[]{1000,1000,500,500,500,200}:new int[]{1500,1500,800,800,800,300};
  Item[] items={Items.copper,Items.lead,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.titanium,Items.metaglass};var core=Team.sharded.core();
  try(PrintWriter carry=new PrintWriter(path)){carry.println("item,amount,source_before,source_after,seed,group");
   for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++){Item item=items[i];int before=core.items.get(item),amount=Math.min(before,caps[i]);core.items.remove(item,amount);carry.println(item.name+","+amount+","+before+","+core.items.get(item)+","+seed+","+EvaluationParameters.group);event("carry_out","item="+item.name+" before="+before+" amount="+amount+" after="+core.items.get(item));}
  }
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){
   bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && c.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)==0){
    Building sink=null;for(Building bb:Groups.build)if(bb.team==Team.sharded && bb!=c && bb.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)>0 && (sink==null || bb.dst2(u)<sink.dst2(u)))sink=bb;
    if(sink!=null){move(sink.x,sink.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(sink,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,sink);}
    else{event("discard","item="+u.item().name+" amount="+u.stack.amount+" reason=no_accepting_storage");InputHandler.dropItem(bot,0);}
   }
   return u.stack.amount==0;
  }
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static int ammoPriority(mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){
  if(tb.block==Blocks.scatter)return Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,tb.x,tb.y,400,eu->eu.isFlying())!=null?3:0;
  return tb.block==Blocks.salvo?2:1;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead())return;
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  {
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite") || (commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count());
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && ((b.block==Blocks.duo && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.manualDuo")) || b.block==Blocks.scatter || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus") && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.duo?6:16)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || ammoPriority(tb)>ammoPriority(ammoTarget) || (ammoPriority(tb)==ammoPriority(ammoTarget) && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.scatter?Items.lead:ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper || ammoItem==Items.lead)mine(ammoItem);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty()){
     Object configuration;
     if(o.config.startsWith("point:")){String[] point=o.config.split(":");configuration=new Point2(Integer.parseInt(point[1]),Integer.parseInt(point[2]));}
     else configuration=content.item(o.config);
     if(!configuration.equals(t.build.config()))t.build.configureAny(configuration);
    }
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill || o.block==Blocks.salvo || o.block==Blocks.arc)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
````

## close_perimeter.py

布局规划/候选生成；不能仅凭脚本存在认定对应游戏尝试已执行。

SHA-256：`80b28bb2451bd42051604e152e088d9d4dd606d2ac81dcf44abd87c4e947d55e`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
# Executed in blueprint generator namespace: seal conveyor passages with native bridges.
wallring=set()
for layer in range(2):
 xa,xb,ya,yb=bx0-layer,bx1+layer,by0-layer,by1+layer
 wallring|={(xx,ya) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xx,yb) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xa,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}|{(xb,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}
convs={(o[1],o[2]):o for o in plans if o[0]=='conveyor'}
for center in sorted(wallring&convs.keys()):
 if center not in convs:continue
 rot=convs[center][3];dx,dy=[(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)][rot]
 run=[(center[0]+j*dx,center[1]+j*dy) for j in range(-2,3)]
 if not all(q in convs and convs[q][3]==rot for q in run):
  print('UNSEALED TURN',center);continue
 for q in run:
  plans.remove(convs.pop(q));reserved.remove(q)
 start,end=run[0],run[-1]
 add('bridge-conveyor',*start,config=f'point:{end[0]-start[0]}:{end[1]-start[1]}')
 add('bridge-conveyor',*end)
 for q in run[1:-1]:add('copper-wall',*q)
 print('SEALED',center,'bridge',start,end)
````

## collect_exclusions.py

Keep technical attempts, exhausted routes, and uniformly rejected versions distinct.

SHA-256：`0f644a3ab8679428c74048bc4133d392a6a037a774e06b70e91b12bb7062d7e0`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Keep technical attempts, exhausted routes, and uniformly rejected versions distinct."""
import csv,json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'report';OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def write(name,rows,fields):
    with (OUT/name).open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
attempts=[]
for path in sorted((ROOT/'formal').glob('*/*-attempt*.csv.result.json')):
    data=json.loads(path.read_text())
    if data.get('accepted'):continue
    route_file=path.parent/'route.json';route=json.loads(route_file.read_text()) if route_file.exists() else None
````

````python
"""Apply the document's numerical predicates; missing denominators are never treated as zero."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,json
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
REPORT=ROOT/'report'
def rows(name):
    p=REPORT/name
    if not p.exists():return []
    with p.open() as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def num(x):return None if x in [None,''] else float(x)
def verdict(status,reason,**evidence):return dict(status=status,reason=reason,evidence=evidence)
def main():
    rates={(r['policy'],r['group']):r for r in rows('route_completion.csv') if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0}
    stages={(r['policy'],r['group'],r['stage']):r for r in rows('stage_summary_statistics.csv') if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0}
    diffs={(r['policy'],r['group'],r['stage'],r['metric']):r for r in rows('paired_stage_differences.csv') if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0}
    def enough(policy,groups,stage=None):
        data=[(stages.get((policy,g,stage)) if stage else rates.get((policy,g))) for g in groups]
        return all(r and int(r['reached' if stage else 'valid_routes'])>=30 for r in data)
    results={}
    # Raw rebuild equivalents are summed per run before giving each run equal weight.
    rebuild=defaultdict(float)
    for r in rows('5分钟窗口日志.csv'):
        if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0 and r['scope']=='window':rebuild[(r['policy'],r['group'],r['stage'],r['seed'])]+=float(r['rebuild_equivalent'])
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        out={};eta={r['stage']:r for r in rows('industrial_eta.csv') if r['policy']==policy}
        if not enough(policy,['G0','G1']):out['industrial_gain_timing']=verdict('证据不足','G0/G1主实验每组尚不足30个有效路线种子')
        elif any(not eta.get(s) or num(eta[s]['eta']) is None for s in 'ABC'):
            out['industrial_gain_timing']=verdict('证据不足','存在无批次或未到达阶段，η不可计算，按题目禁止判定收益在中后期显现',eta=eta)
        elif not all(enough(policy,['G0','G1'],s) for s in 'ABC'):
            out['industrial_gain_timing']=verdict('证据不足','阶段到达样本不足，保留条件均值，不外推路线总体',eta=eta)
        else:
            values={s:float(eta[s]['eta']) for s in 'ABC'};passed=values['A']<=.05 and values['B']>.10 and values['C']>.15
            out['industrial_gain_timing']=verdict('成立' if passed else '不成立','按预注册η阈值判断；清敌删失敏感性另表报告',eta=values)
        if enough(policy,['G0','G1'],'A'):
            a=stages[policy,'G0','A'];b=stages[policy,'G1','A'];power=num(b['grid_satisfaction_mean'])
            if power is None:out['opening_industrial_penalty']=verdict('证据不足','前期电网请求功率分母为零')
            else:
                passed=power<.85 and float(b['core_loss_conditional_rate'])>float(a['core_loss_conditional_rate'])
                out['opening_industrial_penalty']=verdict('成立' if passed else '不成立','G1电网满足率<0.85且失守率高于G0',G1_power=power,G0_core_loss=float(a['core_loss_conditional_rate']),G1_core_loss=float(b['core_loss_conditional_rate']))
        else:out['opening_industrial_penalty']=verdict('证据不足','前期每组不足30个有效到达种子')
        # Building-versus-defense: only actual paired achievers, never the 3L surrogate difference.
        if enough(policy,['G1','G2']):
            pairs={}
            for group in ['G1','G2']:
                pair={}
                for path in (ROOT/'formal').glob(f'S-A-{policy}-{group}-a00-s*/route.json'):
                    r=json.loads(path.read_text())
                    if not r['valid']:continue
                    times={m:None for m in ['army_formed','first_enemy_core','salvo_combat']};elapsed=0
                    for s in r['stages']:
                        v=s['summary']
                        for m in times:
                            if times[m] is None and v.get(m+'_seconds','')!='':times[m]=elapsed+float(v[m+'_seconds'])
                        elapsed+=float(v['sim_seconds'])
                    pair[r['seed']]=times
                pairs[group]=pair
            advantages={}
            for m in ['army_formed','first_enemy_core','salvo_combat']:
                ds=[(pairs['G2'][s][m]-pairs['G1'][s][m])/60 for s in pairs['G1'].keys()&pairs['G2'].keys() if pairs['G1'][s][m] is not None and pairs['G2'][s][m] is not None]
                advantages[m]=dict(real_pairs=len(ds),G1_advance_minutes=sum(ds)/len(ds) if ds else None)
            if any(v['real_pairs']<30 for v in advantages.values()):out['construction_solves_war']=verdict('证据不足','保守地要求实际贡献配对达到30；题目原文的30是每组路线数，未单列达成者最低配对数。稀少达成者的条件均值不外推全路线，另列点阈值敏感性',advances=advantages)
            else:
                p1=float(rates[policy,'G1']['completion_rate']);p2=float(rates[policy,'G2']['completion_rate']);passed=all(v['G1_advance_minutes']>=3 for v in advantages.values()) and p1>=p2-.05
                out['construction_solves_war']=verdict('成立' if passed else '不成立','三项实际配对里程碑均提前至少3分钟，且G1完成率不低于G2减5个百分点',advances=advantages,G1_completion=p1,G2_completion=p2)
            p1=float(rates[policy,'G1']['completion_rate']);p2=float(rates[policy,'G2']['completion_rate'])
            point_inputs=all(v['G1_advance_minutes'] is not None for v in advantages.values())
            point_test=dict(per_group_30_route_minimum_met=True,actual_achiever_minimum_not_separately_specified_in_document=True,
                            actual_paired_contributing_counts={m:v['real_pairs'] for m,v in advantages.items()},
                            all_three_point_advances_at_least_3_minutes=all(v['G1_advance_minutes']>=3 for v in advantages.values()) if point_inputs else None,
                            completion_noninferiority_point_condition=p1>=p2-.05,
                            point_thresholds_met=(all(v['G1_advance_minutes']>=3 for v in advantages.values()) and p1>=p2-.05) if point_inputs else None,
                            interpretation='Post hoc rule-interpretation sensitivity: route sample size versus contributing-achiever sample size; conditional point estimates only, not a replacement for the conservative primary judgment')
            out['construction_solves_war']['evidence']['point_rule_sensitivity']=point_test
        else:out['construction_solves_war']=verdict('证据不足','G1/G2主实验每组尚不足30个有效路线种子')
        rescue={}
        for stage in 'ABC':
            for group in ['G1','G3']:
                k=stage+'-'+group
                if not enough(policy,['G0',group],stage):rescue[k]=verdict('证据不足','阶段有效到达种子不足30');continue
                a=stages[policy,'G0',stage];b=stages[policy,group,stage];ra=num(a['rebuild_seconds_mean']);ea=num(a['empty_turret_seconds_mean'])
                if ra in [None,0] or ea in [None,0]:rescue[k]=verdict('证据不足','G0的重建或缺弹时间为零，百分比降幅无定义');continue
                rr=float(b['rebuild_seconds_mean'])/ra-1;er=float(b['empty_turret_seconds_mean'])/ea-1
                rescue[k]=verdict('成立' if rr<=-.30 and er<=-.40 else '不成立','按绝对重建时间下降30%、缺弹时间下降40%判断；不同存活暴露时长另行解释',rebuild_change=rr,empty_change=er)
        out['benign_rescue_burden']=rescue
        harms={}
        for stage in 'ABC':
            parts=[];missing=[]
            if enough(policy,['G0','G2'],stage):
                eqs={g:[v for k,v in rebuild.items() if k[:3]==(policy,g,stage)] for g in ['G0','G2']}
                if all(eqs.values()):
                    eq0=sum(eqs['G0'])/len(eqs['G0']);eq2=sum(eqs['G2'])/len(eqs['G2']);t0=float(stages[policy,'G0',stage]['rebuild_seconds_mean']);t2=float(stages[policy,'G2',stage]['rebuild_seconds_mean']);parts.append(dict(test='G2_rebuild_cost_and_time',passed=eq2>eq0 and t2>t0,G0_equivalent=eq0,G2_equivalent=eq2,G0_seconds=t0,G2_seconds=t2))
                else:missing.append('rebuild equivalents')
            else:missing.append('G2/G0 stage sample size')
            if enough(policy,['G0','G1'],stage):
                for metric in ['power_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds']:
                    r=diffs.get((policy,'G1',stage,metric));upper=num(r['ci_high']) if r else None
                    if upper is None:missing.append(metric)
                    else:parts.append(dict(test='G1_increase_'+metric,passed=upper<0,G0_minus_G1_ci_low=num(r['ci_low']),G0_minus_G1_ci_high=upper,pairs=int(r['pairs'])))
            else:missing.append('G1/G0 stage sample size')
            harms[stage]=verdict('成立' if any(t['passed'] for t in parts) else '证据不足' if missing else '不成立','G2重建当量与时间同时增加，或G1缺电/堵塞的配对95%区间支持增加；未作多重检验校正',tests=parts,missing=missing)
        out['malign_rescue_burden']=harms
        boundaries=[r for r in rows('pressure_boundaries.csv') if r['policy']==policy];d={r['group']:r for r in boundaries}
        if any(g not in d or d[g]['all_21_cells_complete']!='True' for g in ['G1','G2','G3']):out['synergy']=verdict('证据不足','G1/G2/G3全21档、每档20个有效种子的扫描尚未完成')
        else:
            b={g:num(d[g]['continuous_boundary']) for g in ['G1','G2','G3']}
            if b['G3'] is None:out['synergy']=verdict('不成立','G3在α=0时即低于90%完成率，连续边界为空',boundaries=b)
            elif any(d[g]['boundary_is_lower_bound']=='True' for g in ['G1','G2']):out['synergy']=verdict('证据不足','对照组边界仅为测试上限的下界，无法作严格大于比较',boundaries=b)
            else:
                passed=all(b[g] is None or b['G3']>b[g] for g in ['G1','G2']);out['synergy']=verdict('成立' if passed else '不成立','比较连续可行区间；空边界代表无可行基准档；仅为经验完成率判据',boundaries=b)
````

````python
"""Observational failure context, computed after main-cohort completion without policy changes."""
import collections,csv,gzip,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def detail(text):return dict(z.split('=',1) for z in text.split(';') if '=' in z)
def mean(v):return sum(v)/len(v) if v else None
def write(name,rows):
    with (ROOT/'report'/name).open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(rows[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)

manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'results/main-cohort-completion.json').read_text());records=[]
for name,digest in manifest['routes'].items():
    p=Path(name);assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest
    route=json.loads(p.read_text());assert route['valid']
    for stage in route['stages']:
        summary=stage['summary'];source=Path(stage['path']+'.events.csv.gz');opener=gzip.open if source.exists() else open
        if not source.exists():source=Path(stage['path']+'.events.csv')
        units={};dead=set();destroyed=collections.Counter();native_waves={};last_core_event=None
        with opener(source,'rt') as f:
            for e in csv.DictReader(f):
                d=detail(e['detail'])
                if e['event']=='batch_begin':native_waves[int(d['ordinal'])]=int(d['native_wave'])
                elif e['event']=='batch_unit':units[int(d['id'])]=d['type']
                elif e['event']=='batch_unit_terminated':dead.add(int(d['id']))
                elif e['event']=='building_destroyed':
                    destroyed[d['block']]+=1
                    if d['block'].startswith('core-'):last_core_event=e
        alive=collections.Counter(t for uid,t in units.items() if uid not in dead)
        windows=list(csv.DictReader(open(stage['path']+'.windows.csv')))
        global_windows=[w for w in windows if w['scope']=='window'];last=global_windows[-1]
        requested=float(last['grid_requested_energy']);received=float(last['grid_received_energy'])
        records.append(dict(run_id=route['run_id'],policy=route['policy'],group=route['group'],seed=route['seed'],stage=stage['stage'],won=summary['won'],core_lost=summary['core_lost'],terminal_seconds=summary['sim_seconds'],generated_batches=summary['batch_count'],censored_batches=summary['censored_batches'],unresolved_wave_unit_types=json.dumps(dict(alive),sort_keys=True),destroyed_building_types=json.dumps(dict(destroyed),sort_keys=True),last_window_start=last['start_seconds'],last_window_duration=last['duration_seconds'],last_window_empty_turret_seconds=last['empty_turret_seconds'],last_window_threat_turret_seconds=last['threat_turret_seconds'],last_window_grid_satisfaction=received/requested if requested else None,core_destruction_event_seq=last_core_event['seq'] if last_core_event else None,source_events=str(source),interpretation='Concurrent context only; unresolved types and downtime do not independently prove the killer or causal mechanism'))
write('main_failure_context.csv',records)
summary=[]
for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
    for group in ['G0','G1','G2','G3']:
        rs=[r for r in records if r['policy']==policy and r['group']==group and r['stage']=='A'];failed=[r for r in rs if r['won']=='false'];types=collections.Counter()
        for r in failed:types.update(json.loads(r['unresolved_wave_unit_types']))
        summary.append(dict(policy=policy,group=group,A_routes=len(rs),A_failures=len(failed),A_core_losses=sum(r['core_lost']=='true' for r in rs),failed_A_terminal_seconds_mean=mean([float(r['terminal_seconds']) for r in failed]),failed_A_last_window_empty_turret_seconds_mean=mean([float(r['last_window_empty_turret_seconds']) for r in failed]),failed_A_last_window_grid_satisfaction_mean=mean([r['last_window_grid_satisfaction'] for r in failed if r['last_window_grid_satisfaction'] is not None]),unresolved_wave_units_total_by_type=json.dumps(dict(types),sort_keys=True),not_a_causal_attribution=True))
write('main_failure_summary.csv',summary)
print(json.dumps(dict(main_routes=len(manifest['routes']),observed_stages=len(records),A_failures=sum(r['A_failures'] for r in summary),B_or_C_failures=sum(r['won']=='false' for r in records if r['stage']!='A'))))
````

## finish_benchmark.py

Guarded continuation: wait genuine entry, freeze C, play all C cells, then finalize audited evidence.

SHA-256：`17d9b73a5125034b3d468125413a66478e1476ece769cc47a54c8b72afcbfe5e`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Guarded continuation: wait genuine entry, freeze C, play all C cells, then finalize audited evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def run(script,*args):subprocess.run(['python',script,*args],cwd=ROOT,check=True)
def wait_json(path,predicate,label):
    while True:
        if path.exists():
            value=json.loads(path.read_text())
            if predicate(value):return value
            if value.get('status')=='requires_diagnosis':raise RuntimeError(f'{label}: {value}')
        print('Waiting for actual validated work:',label,flush=True);time.sleep(30)
def main():
    wait_json(ROOT/'results/C-native-entry-and-training.json',lambda v:v.get('status')=='native_prerequisites_complete_training_recorded_freeze_pending','native prerequisite entry and both training logs')
    if not (ROOT/'frozen/C-v1/manifest.json').exists():run('freeze_calibration.py')
    run('run_calibration.py','--workers','8');run('analyze_calibration.py')
    wait_json(ROOT/'formal/progress.json',lambda v:v.get('finished')==4500,'all required S logical routes')
    # Avoid concurrent report writers; the milestone watcher exits after its final S refresh.
    wait_json(ROOT/'results/report-refresh-state.json',lambda v:4500 in v.get('completed_milestones',[]),'completed final S report refresh')
    for script in ['analyze_formal.py','audit_derived_results.py','summarize_windows.py','derive_verdicts.py','collect_exclusions.py','analyze_calibration.py','plot_formal.py','build_report.py']:run(script)
    result=json.loads((ROOT/'report/答案汇总.json').read_text());assert result['final_report_complete'] and result['C']['completed_route_cells']==40
    (ROOT/'results/benchmark-completed.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(completed=True,report='report/评测分析报告.md',machine='report/答案汇总.json',S_execution_cells=4500,C_execution_cells=40,technical_missing_reported=True),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('All required execution cells handled and final audited report written',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

````java
import java.util.*;
import arc.math.geom.*;
import mindustry.content.*;
import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.input.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.type.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.blocks.units.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Training siege policy: native factory/reconstructor, inventory transfers and RTS commands. */
public class AttackSupport{
 static boolean activated,armyMilestone,attacked;static final boolean defensive=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.policy","balanced").equals("defensive");static HashSet<Integer> sent=new HashSet<>();
 static boolean contains(Unit unit){return unit.type==UnitTypes.dagger || unit.type==UnitTypes.mace || unit.type==UnitTypes.fortress || unit.type==UnitTypes.nova || unit.type==UnitTypes.pulsar || unit.type==UnitTypes.quasar;}
 static boolean control(){
  if(!state.rules.attackMode || Pilot.bot.dead())return false;
  var bot=Pilot.bot;var unit=bot.unit();var core=Team.sharded.core();
  ArrayList<Unit> army=new ArrayList<>();float hp=0;
  for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=unit && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && contains(u)){army.add(u);hp+=u.health;}
  if(!armyMilestone && army.size()>=8 && hp>=2000){armyMilestone=true;Pilot.event("army_formed","count="+army.size()+" hp="+hp);}
  if(Pilot.tick%300==0 && !army.isEmpty()){
   Building target=null;for(var c:Team.crux.cores())if(target==null || c.dst2(core)<target.dst2(core))target=c;
   if((attacked || (army.size()>=8 && hp>=2000 && (!defensive || state.wave>=2))) && target!=null){
    int[] ids=army.stream().filter(u->!sent.contains(u.id)).mapToInt(u->u.id).toArray();
    if(ids.length>0){InputHandler.commandUnits(bot,ids,target,null,null,false,true);for(int id:ids)sent.add(id);if(Pilot.formalRecorder!=null)Pilot.formalRecorder.attack(bot.id,target.pos(),ids.length);Pilot.event("rts_attack","target="+target.pos()+" units="+ids.length);attacked=true;}
   }else{
    int[] ids=army.stream().mapToInt(u->u.id).toArray();InputHandler.commandUnits(bot,ids,null,null,new Vec2(core.x+70,core.y+95),false,true);
   }
  }
  UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory=null;Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor=null;
  for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){if(b.block==Blocks.groundFactory)factory=(UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild)b;if(b.block==Blocks.additiveReconstructor)reconstructor=(Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild)b;}
  boolean tutorialRequiresFlag=false;
  for(var objective:state.rules.objectives.all)for(String flag:objective.flagsAdded)if(flag.equals("unitsBuilt"))tutorialRequiresFlag=true;
  long livingDaggers=army.stream().filter(soldier->soldier.type==UnitTypes.dagger).count();
  if(defensive && activated && factory!=null && factory.rotation==0 && (state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt") || (!tutorialRequiresFlag && livingDaggers>=3))){
   InputHandler.rotateBlock(bot,factory,true);Pilot.event("factory_turn_to_upgrade","native_unitsBuilt_flag="+state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt")+" tutorial_requires_flag="+tutorialRequiresFlag);
  }
  boolean allBuilt=true;for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders)if(!o.wasBuilt){allBuilt=false;break;}
  if(factory==null || reconstructor==null || (!activated && !allBuilt))return false;
  if(!activated){
   for(Item desired:new Item[]{Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead}){
    int required=desired==Items.graphite?360:desired==Items.silicon?450:200;
    if(core.items.get(desired)<required){
     if(unit.stack.amount>0){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.deposit();return true;}
     Building source=null;for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b!=core && b.items!=null && (b.block==Blocks.graphitePress || b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter || b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill) && b.items.get(desired)>=1 && (source==null || b.dst2(unit)<source.dst2(unit)))source=b;
     unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;
     if(source!=null){Pilot.move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(source,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,required-core.items.get(desired)));}
     else if(desired==Items.lead)Pilot.mine(desired);
     else Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,40);
     return true;
    }
   }
   activated=true;factory.configureAny(0);Pilot.event("unit_production_start","core="+core.items);
  }
  // Recipe inputs are withdrawn and delivered through the same native player actions as construction logistics.
  Building[] targets={reconstructor,reconstructor,factory,factory};Item[] items={Items.silicon,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead};int[] buffers={80,80,20,20};
  for(int i=0;i<targets.length;i++){
   Building target=targets[i];Item desired=items[i];int missing=buffers[i]-target.items.get(desired);
   if(missing<=0)continue;
   if(unit.stack.amount>0 && unit.item()!=desired){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.deposit();return true;}
   if(unit.stack.amount>0){
    unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(target.x,target.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(target,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,target);return true;
   }
   if(core.items.get(desired)>0){
    unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(core,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,core,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,missing));return true;
   }
   Building source=null;for(Building b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b!=core && b!=factory && b!=reconstructor && b.items!=null && b.items.get(desired)>=1 && (source==null || b.dst2(unit)<source.dst2(unit)))source=b;
   if(source!=null){unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;Pilot.move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(source,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,desired,Math.min(unit.type.itemCapacity,missing));return true;}
   if(desired==Items.lead){Pilot.mine(desired);return true;}
  }
  return false;
 }
}
````

````java
 FormalRecorder(String path,IntSupplier clock)throws Exception{
  this.clock=clock;policy=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.policy","balanced");chain=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.chain","A");track=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.track","S");seed=Pilot.seed;
  int ordinal=Integer.parseInt(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0"));stage="ABC".substring(ordinal,ordinal+1);
  runId=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.runId",policy+"-"+chain+"-"+EvaluationParameters.group+"-a"+EvaluationParameters.alpha+"-s"+seed);
  initialEnemyCores=Team.crux.cores().size;
  journal=new PrintWriter(path+".events.csv");batchOut=new PrintWriter(path+".batches.csv");windowOut=new PrintWriter(path+".windows.csv");stageOut=new PrintWriter(path+".stages.csv");validation=new PrintWriter(path+".validity.json");
  journal.println("seq,run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds,event,detail");

 void runtimeAcceptance(){
  int width=0,height=0,enemies=0,cap=16;Block coreBlock=null;
  switch(Pilot.mapName){
   case "stainedMountains":width=height=300;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;cap=8;break;
   case "windsweptIslands":width=height=400;coreBlock=Blocks.coreFoundation;break;
   case "fungalPass":width=150;height=250;enemies=2;coreBlock=Blocks.coreFoundation;break;
   case "overgrowth":width=height=344;enemies=1;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;break;
   default:width=height=Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.generatedSize",-1);cap=8;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;
  }
  var core=Team.sharded.core();TreeMap<String,Integer> ores=new TreeMap<>();int presetTurrets=0;
  for(Tile tile:world.tiles){if(tile.drop()!=null)ores.merge(tile.drop().name,1,Integer::sum);if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))presetTurrets++;}
  if(world.width()!=width || world.height()!=height || core==null || core.block!=coreBlock || initialEnemyCores!=enemies || state.rules.attackMode!=(enemies>0))invalid("map_dimensions_core_or_mode");
  if(state.rules.unitCap!=cap || state.rules.unitCapVariable || state.rules.buildCostMultiplier!=1 || state.rules.defaultTeam!=Team.sharded || presetTurrets!=0)invalid("map_cap_cost_team_or_preplaced_turret");
  for(String required:new String[]{"copper","lead","coal","sand"})if(ores.getOrDefault(required,0)==0)invalid("map_missing_mineral_"+required);
  if((Pilot.mapName.equals("stainedMountains") || Pilot.mapName.equals("windsweptIslands")) && ores.getOrDefault("titanium",0)==0)invalid("map_missing_titanium");
  if(enemies==0 && (state.rules.winWave!=30 || !state.rules.waves))invalid("survival_wave_rules");
  if(formalRequested && (seed<1000 || freezeId.length()!=64 || Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed") || !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed")))invalid("formal_configuration_not_frozen");
  emit("map_acceptance","width="+world.width()+";height="+world.height()+";core="+(core==null?"none":core.block.name)+";enemy_cores="+initialEnemyCores+";cap="+state.rules.unitCap+";minerals="+ores+";preplaced_duo_salvo="+presetTurrets);
 }
 void placementFailed(Block block,int x,int y,String existing){String key=block.name+"@"+x+":"+y;placementAttempts.merge(key,1L,Long::sum);if(failedPlacements.add(key))emit("placement_failure_begin","order="+key+";existing="+existing);}

 int tick(){return initializing?0:terminalTick>=0?terminalTick:clock.getAsInt()+1;}

 }}
 void opening(Window w){if(w.opened)return;w.opened=true;Set<ItemModule> seen=Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());for(var c:Team.sharded.cores())if(seen.add(c.items))for(int i=0;i<w.opening.length;i++)w.opening[i]+=c.items.get(i);}

 public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){Account a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a.balance[item]!=before)invalid("ledger_discontinuity;item="+item+";expected="+a.balance[item]+";before="+before);if(after<0)invalid("negative_inventory;item="+item);emit("stock","core="+a.core+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);a.balance[item]=after;}

 static boolean enemy(Team t){return t!=null && t!=Team.derelict && t!=Team.sharded;}

 public void causeBegin(Object token){Team cause=(Team)token;damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(Integer.MIN_VALUE,cause,cause));}

 public void waveBegin(int wave){Batch b=new Batch();b.ordinal=batches.size()+1;b.wave=wave;b.start=tick();batches.add(b);if(b.ordinal==26)lateStart=tick();emit("batch_begin","ordinal="+b.ordinal+";native_wave="+wave);b.spawnSeq=seq;}
 Batch currentBatch(){return batches.get(batches.size()-1);}
 public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup g,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){emit("spawn_plan","batch="+currentBatch().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";type="+g.type.name+";x="+x+";y="+y+";base="+base+";adjusted="+adjusted+";boss="+(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss));}

 public void waveEnd(int wave){currentBatch().sealed=true;emit("batch_seal","ordinal="+currentBatch().ordinal+";actual="+currentBatch().units.size());currentBatch().sealSeq=seq;}
 void attack(int actor,int target,int units){Building b=world.build(target);if(initialEnemyCores>0 && b!=null && b.block instanceof CoreBlock && b.team!=Team.sharded && units>0)milestone("rts_attack");emit("rts_command","actor="+actor+";target="+target+";units="+units);}
 void milestone(String name){if(!milestones.containsKey(name)){milestones.put(name,tick());emit("milestone",name);}}

 final HashMap<Long,ArrayList<Unit>> enemyGrid=new HashMap<>();
 static long cellKey(int x,int y){return ((long)x<<32)^(y&0xffffffffL);}
 void indexEnemies(){enemyGrid.clear();for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team!=Team.sharded && u.team!=Team.derelict && !u.dead && u.isAdded())enemyGrid.computeIfAbsent(cellKey((int)Math.floor(u.x/128),(int)Math.floor(u.y/128)),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(u);}
 Ammo ammo(ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild b){
  ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo out=new Ammo();Turret.AmmoEntry chosen=b.ammo.size>0?b.ammo.peek():null;

  if(chosen instanceof ItemTurret.ItemEntry entry){out.item=entry.item;out.type=entry.type();out.ready=entry.amount>=t.ammoPerShot && b.potentialEfficiency>0;}

   if(out.type==null)for(Item item:content.items())if(t.ammoTypes.get(item)!=null){out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(item);break;}
  }

 boolean threat(Building b,Turret t,BulletType bullet){

  for(int cx=minX;cx<=maxX;cx++)for(int cy=minY;cy<=maxY;cy++){
   ArrayList<Unit> bucket=enemyGrid.get(cellKey(cx,cy));if(bucket==null)continue;
   for(Unit u:bucket)if((u.isGrounded()?t.targetGround:t.targetAir) && t.unitFilter.get(u) && (bullet==null || bullet.targetMissiles || !(u instanceof TimedKillc)) && u.within(b,range+u.hitSize/2f))return true;
  }

 void nominalRecipe(Building b,ItemStack[] recipe,double secondsPerCycle,Window w){if(secondsPerCycle>0)for(ItemStack stack:recipe)w.demand[stack.item.id]+=stack.amount/secondsPerCycle/60.0;}
 void facility(Building b,Window w)throws Exception{
  boolean isFacility=b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill;
  if(!isFacility)return;

  boolean gate=false,blocked=false;
  double cycleTicks=0;ItemStack[] recipe=null;

   GenericCrafter t=(GenericCrafter)b.block;boolean room=true;
   if(t.outputItems!=null)for(ItemStack output:t.outputItems)if(b.items.get(output.item)+output.amount>t.itemCapacity)room=false;
   if(t.outputLiquids!=null && !t.ignoreLiquidFullness){boolean allFull=true;for(LiquidStack output:t.outputLiquids){boolean full=b.liquids.get(output.liquid)>=t.liquidCapacity-0.001f;if(full && !t.dumpExtraLiquid)room=false;if(!full)allFull=false;}if(allFull)room=false;}
   blocked=b.enabled && !room;gate=b.enabled && room && b.productionValid();cycleTicks=t.craftTime*EvaluationParameters.cycle(b);
  }else if(b instanceof UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory){
   UnitFactory t=(UnitFactory)b.block;
   if(factory.currentPlan>=0 && factory.currentPlan<t.plans.size){var plan=t.plans.get(factory.currentPlan);boolean cap=mindustry.entities.Units.canCreate(b.team,plan.unit);blocked=b.enabled && (factory.payload!=null || !cap);gate=b.enabled && factory.payload==null && cap && b.team.activateUnitFactories();recipe=plan.requirements;cycleTicks=plan.time/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);}
  }else if(b instanceof Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor){
   Reconstructor t=(Reconstructor)b.block;gate=reconstructor.shouldConsume();blocked=b.enabled && reconstructor.payload!=null && !gate;cycleTicks=t.constructTime/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);
  }else if(b instanceof Drill.DrillBuild drill){Drill t=(Drill)b.block;blocked=b.enabled && b.items.total()>=t.itemCapacity;gate=b.enabled && drill.dominantItem!=null && drill.dominantItems>0 && !blocked;}
  if(blocked)w.blocked+=1.0/60;
  if(!gate)return;
  w.wantSeconds+=1.0/60;
  boolean lacksItem=false,lacksLiquid=false;
  for(Consume consumer:b.block.nonOptionalConsumers){
   ItemStack[] ingredients=consumer instanceof ConsumeItems ci?ci.items:consumer instanceof ConsumeItemDynamic ci?ci.items.get(b):null;
   if(ingredients!=null){float multiplier=consumer.multiplier.get(b);for(ItemStack ingredient:ingredients){int required=Math.round(ingredient.amount*multiplier);if(b.items.get(ingredient.item)<required)lacksItem=true;if(recipe==null && cycleTicks>0)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=required*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;}}
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquid liquid && b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquids liquids)for(LiquidStack liquid:liquids.liquids)if(b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
  }
  if(recipe!=null && cycleTicks>0)for(ItemStack ingredient:recipe)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=ingredient.amount*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;
  if(lacksItem)w.missingItems+=1.0/60;if(lacksLiquid)w.missingLiquid+=1.0/60;
  if(b.block.consPower!=null && !b.block.consPower.buffered)w.powerLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.power.status)))/60.0;

 }
 void step()throws Exception{

    }

   }

    double a=w.wantSeconds,mi=w.missingItems,ml=w.missingLiquid,pl=w.powerLoss,ze=w.zeroEfficiency,el=w.efficiencyLoss,bl=w.blocked,sl=w.sleeping;

   }

   if(salvoStreak>=10800)threatRingSum-=threatRing[ringIndex];threatRing[ringIndex]=salvoThreat;threatRingSum+=salvoThreat;ringIndex=(ringIndex+1)%10800;salvoStreak++;
   if(salvoStreak>=10800){milestone("salvo_static");if(threatRingSum>=5400)milestone("salvo_combat");}
  }else{salvoStreak=ringIndex=threatRingSum=0;}
````

## frozen/S-v1/src/Pilot.java

````java
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".initial.msav"));

    float ammo=0;int turrets=0;String drills="";
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){ammo+=tb.totalAmmo;turrets++;}
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db)drills+=db.tileX()+":"+db.tileY()+"="+db.dominantItem+"/"+db.dominantItems+" eff="+db.efficiency+" items="+db.items+" ";

    event("enemy_types",counts.toString());
    if(core!=null && core.power!=null)event("core_power","produced="+core.power.graph.getPowerProduced()+" needed="+core.power.graph.getPowerNeeded()+" stored="+core.power.graph.getBatteryStored());
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.arc || b.block==Blocks.mender || b.block==Blocks.battery))event("power_detail",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" status="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status)+" stored="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getBatteryStored())+" needed="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerNeeded())+" produced="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerProduced()));
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux && core!=null && eu.within(core,300))event("threat_detail",eu.type.name+" id="+eu.id+" health="+eu.health+" shield="+eu.shield+" x="+eu.x+" y="+eu.y);

   }
   if(!ended && initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size<=initialEnemyCores-1){ended=true;won=true;event("first_enemy_core","initial="+initialEnemyCores+" remaining="+Team.crux.cores().size);}
   if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){ended=true;won=false;}
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources)throw new IllegalStateException("cheat enabled");
  }
  event("end","won="+won+" ended="+ended+" wave="+state.wave+" built="+built+" failed="+failed+" index="+index);
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.tileX()>=35 && b.tileX()<=56 && b.tileY()>=65 && b.tileY()<=78)event("final_build",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" rotation="+b.rotation+" items="+b.items+(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb?" ammo="+tb.totalAmmo:""));
  if(recorder!=null)recorder.terminalTick=tick;if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.terminalTick=tick;
  exportCarry();
  if(recorder!=null)recorder.close();if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.finish(won,ended);
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".final.msav"));log.close();if(probe!=null)probe.close();
  System.out.println("END won="+won+" wave="+state.wave+" sim_seconds="+tick/60f+" wall_seconds="+(System.nanoTime()-start)/1e9);
 }
 static void importCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryIn");if(path==null)return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(String row:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).size())){
   String[] fields=row.split(",");Item item=content.item(fields[0]);int amount=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);int beforeSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]),afterSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
   if(amount<0 || beforeSource-afterSource!=amount || Integer.parseInt(fields[4])!=seed || !fields[5].equals(EvaluationParameters.group))throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid inheritance receipt");
   int before=core.items.get(item),accepted=Math.min(amount,Math.max(0,core.storageCapacity-before));core.items.add(item,accepted);
   event("carry_in","item="+item.name+" exported="+amount+" before="+before+" accepted="+accepted+" overflow="+(amount-accepted)+" after="+core.items.get(item));
  }
 }
 static void exportCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryOut");if(path==null || !won || Team.sharded.core()==null)return;
  int[] caps=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0").equals("0")?new int[]{1000,1000,500,500,500,200}:new int[]{1500,1500,800,800,800,300};
  Item[] items={Items.copper,Items.lead,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.titanium,Items.metaglass};var core=Team.sharded.core();
  try(PrintWriter carry=new PrintWriter(path)){carry.println("item,amount,source_before,source_after,seed,group");
   for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++){Item item=items[i];int before=core.items.get(item),amount=Math.min(before,caps[i]);core.items.remove(item,amount);carry.println(item.name+","+amount+","+before+","+core.items.get(item)+","+seed+","+EvaluationParameters.group);event("carry_out","item="+item.name+" before="+before+" amount="+amount+" after="+core.items.get(item));}
  }
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){
   bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && c.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)==0){
    Building sink=null;for(Building bb:Groups.build)if(bb.team==Team.sharded && bb!=c && bb.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)>0 && (sink==null || bb.dst2(u)<sink.dst2(u)))sink=bb;
    if(sink!=null){move(sink.x,sink.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(sink,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,sink);}
    else{event("discard","item="+u.item().name+" amount="+u.stack.amount+" reason=no_accepting_storage");InputHandler.dropItem(bot,0);}
   }
   return u.stack.amount==0;
  }
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static int ammoPriority(mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){
  if(tb.block==Blocks.scatter)return Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,tb.x,tb.y,400,eu->eu.isFlying())!=null?3:0;
  return tb.block==Blocks.salvo?2:1;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead())return;
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  if(!state.rules.attackMode && state.wave>=30 && tick-lastWaveTick>=180*60){
   Unit remaining=null;for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==state.rules.waveTeam && !eu.dead && eu.isAdded() && (remaining==null || eu.dst2(c)<remaining.dst2(c)))remaining=eu;
   if(remaining!=null){u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(remaining.x,remaining.y,u.range()-8);u.aim(remaining);u.lookAt(remaining);u.controlWeapons(true,true);return;}
  }
  if(AttackSupport.control())return;
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  {
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   if(state.rules.attackMode && c.items.get(Items.coal)>0)coalSource=c;
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress || nb.block==Blocks.multiPress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || (coalSource!=c && b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u))))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite") || (commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count());
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && ((b.block==Blocks.duo && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.manualDuo")) || b.block==Blocks.scatter || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus") && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.duo?6:16)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || ammoPriority(tb)>ammoPriority(ammoTarget) || (ammoPriority(tb)==ammoPriority(ammoTarget) && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.scatter?Items.lead:ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper || ammoItem==Items.lead)mine(ammoItem);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty()){
     Object configuration;
     if(o.config.startsWith("point:")){String[] point=o.config.split(":");configuration=new Point2(Integer.parseInt(point[1]),Integer.parseInt(point[2]));}
     else configuration=content.item(o.config);
     if(!configuration.equals(t.build.config()))t.build.configureAny(configuration);
    }
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill || o.block==Blocks.salvo || o.block==Blocks.arc)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);EvaluationTrace.order(u.id,o.x,o.y,o.block);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.placementFailed(o.block,o.x,o.y,t.block().name);
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.placementPossible(o.block,o.x,o.y);
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
}
````

````java
  final double[] operation=new double[3];

 static class Ammo{Item item;BulletType type;boolean ready;}
 FormalRecorder(String path,IntSupplier clock)throws Exception{
  this.clock=clock;policy=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.policy","balanced");chain=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.chain","A");track=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.track","S");seed=Pilot.seed;
  int ordinal=Integer.parseInt(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0"));stage="ABC".substring(ordinal,ordinal+1);
  runId=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.runId",policy+"-"+chain+"-"+EvaluationParameters.group+"-a"+EvaluationParameters.alpha+"-s"+seed);
  initialEnemyCores=Team.crux.cores().size;
  journal=new PrintWriter(path+".events.csv");batchOut=new PrintWriter(path+".batches.csv");windowOut=new PrintWriter(path+".windows.csv");stageOut=new PrintWriter(path+".stages.csv");validation=new PrintWriter(path+".validity.json");
  journal.println("seq,run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds,event,detail");
  sleepField=Building.class.getDeclaredField("sleeping");sleepField.setAccessible(true);consumePowerField=Building.class.getDeclaredField("shouldConsumePower");consumePowerField.setAccessible(true);
  for(Tile tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.build!=null)register(tile.build);
  syncCores();

  Events.on(BlockBuildEndEvent.class,e->{if(!closed && !e.breaking){if(e.tile.build!=null)register(e.tile.build);if(e.team==Team.sharded){Debt d=debts.remove(e.tile.pos());if(d!=null && Arrays.stream(d.remaining).sum()!=0)invalid("completed_order_has_unpaid_materials;site="+e.tile.pos());pendingEnemy.remove(e.tile.pos());emit("build_complete","site="+e.tile.pos()+";block="+e.tile.block().name);}}});
  Events.on(BlockDestroyEvent.class,e->{if(closed)return;Building b=e.tile.build;if(b==null)return;buildings.remove(e.tile.pos());if(b.team==Team.sharded){
   destructionTotal++;if(lateStart>=0)lateDestroyed++;Team root=damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root;boolean enemy=root!=null && root!=Team.derelict && root!=Team.sharded;
   if(enemy){enemyDestructionTotal++;pendingEnemy.add(e.tile.pos());}
   Debt d=debts.remove(e.tile.pos());if(d!=null)emit("order_cancel_destroyed","site="+e.tile.pos()+";unpaid="+Arrays.toString(d.remaining));

  }});

  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{if(!closed){actualNativeWinner=e.winner.id;emit("native_game_over","winner="+e.winner.id);}});
  emit("recorder_start","implementation_status=ACCEPTANCE_V2;freeze_id="+freezeId+";map="+Pilot.mapName+";map_seed=0;tick_substreams="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed"));
  EvaluationTrace.sink=this;
````
