````java
 }
 void runtimeAcceptance(){
  int width=0,height=0,enemies=0,cap=16;Block coreBlock=null;
  switch(Pilot.mapName){
   case "stainedMountains":width=height=300;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;cap=8;break;
   case "windsweptIslands":width=height=400;coreBlock=Blocks.coreFoundation;break;
   case "fungalPass":width=150;height=250;enemies=2;coreBlock=Blocks.coreFoundation;break;
   case "overgrowth":width=height=344;enemies=1;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;break;
   default:width=height=Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.generatedSize",-1);cap=8;coreBlock=Blocks.coreShard;
  }
  var core=Team.sharded.core();TreeMap<String,Integer> ores=new TreeMap<>();int presetTurrets=0;
  for(Tile tile:world.tiles){if(tile.drop()!=null)ores.merge(tile.drop().name,1,Integer::sum);if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))presetTurrets++;}
  if(world.width()!=width || world.height()!=height || core==null || core.block!=coreBlock || initialEnemyCores!=enemies || state.rules.attackMode!=(enemies>0))invalid("map_dimensions_core_or_mode");
  if(state.rules.unitCap!=cap || state.rules.unitCapVariable || state.rules.buildCostMultiplier!=1 || state.rules.defaultTeam!=Team.sharded || presetTurrets!=0)invalid("map_cap_cost_team_or_preplaced_turret");
  for(String required:new String[]{"copper","lead","coal","sand"})if(ores.getOrDefault(required,0)==0)invalid("map_missing_mineral_"+required);
  if((Pilot.mapName.equals("stainedMountains") || Pilot.mapName.equals("windsweptIslands")) && ores.getOrDefault("titanium",0)==0)invalid("map_missing_titanium");
  if(enemies==0 && (state.rules.winWave!=30 || !state.rules.waves))invalid("survival_wave_rules");
  if(formalRequested && (seed<1000 || freezeId.length()!=64 || Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed") || !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed")))invalid("formal_configuration_not_frozen");
  emit("map_acceptance","width="+world.width()+";height="+world.height()+";core="+(core==null?"none":core.block.name)+";enemy_cores="+initialEnemyCores+";cap="+state.rules.unitCap+";minerals="+ores+";preplaced_duo_salvo="+presetTurrets);
 }
 void placementFailed(Block block,int x,int y,String existing){String key=block.name+"@"+x+":"+y;placementAttempts.merge(key,1L,Long::sum);if(failedPlacements.add(key))emit("placement_failure_begin","order="+key+";existing="+existing);}
 void placementPossible(Block block,int x,int y){String key=block.name+"@"+x+":"+y;if(failedPlacements.remove(key))emit("placement_failure_end","order="+key+";attempts="+placementAttempts.get(key));}
 int tick(){return initializing?0:terminalTick>=0?terminalTick:clock.getAsInt()+1;}
 String fields(){return runId+","+track+","+chain+","+policy+","+EvaluationParameters.group+","+EvaluationParameters.alpha+","+seed+","+stage;}
 void emit(String type,String detail){journal.println(++seq+","+fields()+","+tick()+","+(tick()/60.0)+","+type+","+detail.replace(',',';').replace('\n',' '));}
 void invalid(String why){valid=false;emit("invalid",why);}
 void register(Building b){if(b.team==Team.sharded || b.team==Team.crux){buildings.put(b.pos(),b);producerBuildings.put(b.id,b);}}
 static Block target(Building b){return b instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild c && c.current!=null?c.current:b.block;}
 static boolean repair(Block b){return b instanceof MendProjector || b instanceof RegenProjector || b instanceof RepairTurret || b instanceof RepairTower;}
 static boolean defense(Block b){return b instanceof BaseTurret || b instanceof Wall || b instanceof UnitFactory || b instanceof Reconstructor || repair(b);}
 String category(int pos,Block b){return pendingEnemy.contains(pos)?"rebuild":defense(b)?"defense":"expand";}
 void syncCores(){for(var core:Team.sharded.cores())if(!accounts.containsKey(core.items)){
  var a=new Account(core.pos(),core.items);accounts.put(core.items,a);for(int i=0;i<a.balance.length;i++)emit("stock_open","core="+a.core+";item="+content.item(i).name+";balance="+a.balance[i]);
 }}
 void opening(Window w){if(w.opened)return;w.opened=true;Set<ItemModule> seen=Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());for(var c:Team.sharded.cores())if(seen.add(c.items))for(int i=0;i<w.opening.length;i++)w.opening[i]+=c.items.get(i);}
 Window window(int index){return windows.computeIfAbsent(index,k->new Window());}
 Window point(){return window(tick()/18000);}
 void afterInitialization(){opening(window(0));emit("stage_open","enemy_cores="+initialEnemyCores+";wave_timer="+state.rules.waveTimer+";waves="+state.rules.waves);initializing=false;}
 long[] due(){long[] total=new long[content.items().size];for(Debt d:debts.values())for(int i=0;i<total.length;i++)total[i]+=d.remaining[i];return total;}
 void beforeStep(){
  if((clock.getAsInt()+1)%18000==0){opening(window((clock.getAsInt()+1)/18000));window(clock.getAsInt()/18000).dueAtEnd=due();}
  else opening(window(clock.getAsInt()/18000));
 }
 public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){Account a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a.balance[item]!=before)invalid("ledger_discontinuity;item="+item+";expected="+a.balance[item]+";before="+before);if(after<0)invalid("negative_inventory;item="+item);emit("stock","core="+a.core+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);a.balance[item]=after;}
 public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(team==Team.sharded){Window w=point();w.supply[item.id]+=amount;Building b=producerBuildings.get(producer);String name=b==null?"unit_mining":b.block.name;w.supplyByFacility.computeIfAbsent(name,k->new long[content.items().size])[item.id]+=amount;}}
 public void order(int actor,int x,int y,Block block){int pos=Point2.pack(x,y);releasedTargets.put(pos,block);if(debts.containsKey(pos))return;Debt d=new Debt();d.target=block;d.category=category(pos,block);d.remaining=new long[content.items().size];for(ItemStack stack:block.requirements)d.remaining[stack.item.id]=EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,block,stack.amount);debts.put(pos,d);emit("order_due","actor="+actor+";site="+pos+";block="+block.name+";category="+d.category+";materials="+Arrays.toString(d.remaining));}
 public void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(site.team!=Team.sharded)return;Window w=point();w.construction[item.id]+=amount;String kind=operations.getOrDefault(site.pos(),category(site.pos(),target));if(kind.equals("rebuild"))w.rebuild[item.id]+=amount;Debt d=debts.get(site.pos());if(d==null)invalid("spend_without_released_order;site="+site.pos());else{d.remaining[item.id]-=amount;if(d.remaining[item.id]<0)invalid("order_overpaid;site="+site.pos()+";item="+item.id);}emit("construction_spend","site="+site.pos()+";block="+target.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount+";category="+kind);}
 public void work(Unit builder,Building site,Block target){if(builder.team!=Team.sharded)return;String kind=operations.getOrDefault(site.pos(),category(site.pos(),target));int index=kind.equals("expand")?0:kind.equals("defense")?1:2;workCalls.computeIfAbsent(builder.id,k->new int[3])[index]++;}
 public void consumed(Building b,Item item,int amount){if(b.team==Team.sharded && repair(b.block))point().repairItems[item.id]+=amount;}
 public void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(source.team==Team.sharded)point().repairHP+=amount;}
 public void damageBegin(Building b,Team source){Team root=enemy(source)?source:damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().root==null?source:damageStack.peek().root;damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(b.id,source,root));}
 public void damageEnd(Building b){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=b.id){invalid("damage_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 public void powerUsage(Building b,float requested,float received){
  if(b.team!=Team.sharded || requested<=0)return;Window w=window((tick()-1)/18000);w.powerNeed+=requested;w.powerReceived+=received;double[] energy=w.energyByFacility.computeIfAbsent(b.block.name,k->new double[2]);energy[0]+=requested;energy[1]+=received;if(repair(b.block))w.repairEnergy+=received;
 }
 Team bulletCause(Bullet b){return b.team==Team.derelict?bulletOrigins.get(b.id):b.team;}
 public void fireCreated(Fire f){if(f!=null && (!fireOrigins.containsKey(f.id) || fireOrigins.get(f.id)==null))fireOrigins.put(f.id,damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root);}
 public void fireIgnited(Bullet b,Fire f){if(f!=null && bulletCause(b)!=null)fireOrigins.put(f.id,bulletCause(b));}
 public void fireBegin(Fire f){Team cause=fireOrigins.get(f.id);damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(-2*f.id,cause,cause));}
 public void fireEnd(Fire f){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=-2*f.id){invalid("fire_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 public void bulletBegin(Bullet b){Team cause=damageStack.isEmpty()?bulletCause(b):damageStack.peek().root;if(cause==null)cause=bulletCause(b);damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(-2*b.id-1,b.team,cause));}
 public void bulletEnd(Bullet b){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=-2*b.id-1){invalid("bullet_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 static boolean enemy(Team t){return t!=null && t!=Team.derelict && t!=Team.sharded;}
 public Object captureCause(Team direct){Team current=damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root;return enemy(direct)?direct:current!=null?current:direct;}
 public void causeBegin(Object token){Team cause=(Team)token;damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(Integer.MIN_VALUE,cause,cause));}
 public void causeEnd(Object token){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=Integer.MIN_VALUE || damageStack.peek().root!=token){invalid("deferred_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 public void waveBegin(int wave){Batch b=new Batch();b.ordinal=batches.size()+1;b.wave=wave;b.start=tick();batches.add(b);if(b.ordinal==26)lateStart=tick();emit("batch_begin","ordinal="+b.ordinal+";native_wave="+wave);b.spawnSeq=seq;}
 Batch currentBatch(){return batches.get(batches.size()-1);}
 public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup g,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){emit("spawn_plan","batch="+currentBatch().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";type="+g.type.name+";x="+x+";y="+y+";base="+base+";adjusted="+adjusted+";boss="+(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss));}
 public void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup g,Unit u){if(u.team!=Team.sharded){currentBatch().units.put(u.id,u);emit("batch_unit","batch="+currentBatch().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";id="+u.id+";type="+u.type.name);}}
 public void waveEnd(int wave){currentBatch().sealed=true;emit("batch_seal","ordinal="+currentBatch().ordinal+";actual="+currentBatch().units.size());currentBatch().sealSeq=seq;}
 void attack(int actor,int target,int units){Building b=world.build(target);if(initialEnemyCores>0 && b!=null && b.block instanceof CoreBlock && b.team!=Team.sharded && units>0)milestone("rts_attack");emit("rts_command","actor="+actor+";target="+target+";units="+units);}
 void milestone(String name){if(!milestones.containsKey(name)){milestones.put(name,tick());emit("milestone",name);}}

 final HashMap<Long,ArrayList<Unit>> enemyGrid=new HashMap<>();
 static long cellKey(int x,int y){return ((long)x<<32)^(y&0xffffffffL);}
 void indexEnemies(){enemyGrid.clear();for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team!=Team.sharded && u.team!=Team.derelict && !u.dead && u.isAdded())enemyGrid.computeIfAbsent(cellKey((int)Math.floor(u.x/128),(int)Math.floor(u.y/128)),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(u);}
 Ammo ammo(ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild b){
  ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo out=new Ammo();Turret.AmmoEntry chosen=b.ammo.size>0?b.ammo.peek():null;
  if(chosen!=null && chosen.amount<t.ammoPerShot)for(int i=0;i<b.ammo.size;i++)if(b.ammo.get(i).amount>=t.ammoPerShot){chosen=b.ammo.get(i);break;}
  if(chosen instanceof ItemTurret.ItemEntry entry){out.item=entry.item;out.type=entry.type();out.ready=entry.amount>=t.ammoPerShot && b.potentialEfficiency>0;}
  else{
   out.item=Items.copper;out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(Items.copper);
   if(out.type==null)for(Item item:content.items())if(t.ammoTypes.get(item)!=null){out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(item);break;}
  }
  return out;
 }
 boolean threat(Building b,Turret t,BulletType bullet){
  float range=t.range+(bullet==null?0:bullet.rangeChange);int minX=(int)Math.floor((b.x-range-80)/128),maxX=(int)Math.floor((b.x+range+80)/128),minY=(int)Math.floor((b.y-range-80)/128),maxY=(int)Math.floor((b.y+range+80)/128);
  for(int cx=minX;cx<=maxX;cx++)for(int cy=minY;cy<=maxY;cy++){
   ArrayList<Unit> bucket=enemyGrid.get(cellKey(cx,cy));if(bucket==null)continue;
   for(Unit u:bucket)if((u.isGrounded()?t.targetGround:t.targetAir) && t.unitFilter.get(u) && (bullet==null || bullet.targetMissiles || !(u instanceof TimedKillc)) && u.within(b,range+u.hitSize/2f))return true;
  }
  if(t.targetGround && t.targetBlocks && (bullet==null || bullet.targetBlocks))for(Building other:buildings.values())if(other.team!=Team.sharded && other.team!=Team.derelict && !other.dead && other.block.targetable && other.within(b,range))return true;
  return false;
 }
 void nominalRecipe(Building b,ItemStack[] recipe,double secondsPerCycle,Window w){if(secondsPerCycle>0)for(ItemStack stack:recipe)w.demand[stack.item.id]+=stack.amount/secondsPerCycle/60.0;}
 void facility(Building b,Window w)throws Exception{
  boolean isFacility=b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill;
  if(!isFacility)return;
  if(sleepField.getBoolean(b))w.sleeping+=1.0/60;
  boolean gate=false,blocked=false;
  double cycleTicks=0;ItemStack[] recipe=null;
  if(b instanceof GenericCrafter.GenericCrafterBuild crafter){
   GenericCrafter t=(GenericCrafter)b.block;boolean room=true;
   if(t.outputItems!=null)for(ItemStack output:t.outputItems)if(b.items.get(output.item)+output.amount>t.itemCapacity)room=false;
   if(t.outputLiquids!=null && !t.ignoreLiquidFullness){boolean allFull=true;for(LiquidStack output:t.outputLiquids){boolean full=b.liquids.get(output.liquid)>=t.liquidCapacity-0.001f;if(full && !t.dumpExtraLiquid)room=false;if(!full)allFull=false;}if(allFull)room=false;}
   blocked=b.enabled && !room;gate=b.enabled && room && b.productionValid();cycleTicks=t.craftTime*EvaluationParameters.cycle(b);
  }else if(b instanceof UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory){
   UnitFactory t=(UnitFactory)b.block;
   if(factory.currentPlan>=0 && factory.currentPlan<t.plans.size){var plan=t.plans.get(factory.currentPlan);boolean cap=mindustry.entities.Units.canCreate(b.team,plan.unit);blocked=b.enabled && (factory.payload!=null || !cap);gate=b.enabled && factory.payload==null && cap && b.team.activateUnitFactories();recipe=plan.requirements;cycleTicks=plan.time/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);}
  }else if(b instanceof Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor){
   Reconstructor t=(Reconstructor)b.block;gate=reconstructor.shouldConsume();blocked=b.enabled && reconstructor.payload!=null && !gate;cycleTicks=t.constructTime/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);
  }else if(b instanceof Drill.DrillBuild drill){Drill t=(Drill)b.block;blocked=b.enabled && b.items.total()>=t.itemCapacity;gate=b.enabled && drill.dominantItem!=null && drill.dominantItems>0 && !blocked;}
  if(blocked)w.blocked+=1.0/60;
  if(!gate)return;
  w.wantSeconds+=1.0/60;
  boolean lacksItem=false,lacksLiquid=false;
  for(Consume consumer:b.block.nonOptionalConsumers){
   ItemStack[] ingredients=consumer instanceof ConsumeItems ci?ci.items:consumer instanceof ConsumeItemDynamic ci?ci.items.get(b):null;
   if(ingredients!=null){float multiplier=consumer.multiplier.get(b);for(ItemStack ingredient:ingredients){int required=Math.round(ingredient.amount*multiplier);if(b.items.get(ingredient.item)<required)lacksItem=true;if(recipe==null && cycleTicks>0)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=required*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;}}
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquid liquid && b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquids liquids)for(LiquidStack liquid:liquids.liquids)if(b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
  }
  if(recipe!=null && cycleTicks>0)for(ItemStack ingredient:recipe)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=ingredient.amount*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;
  if(lacksItem)w.missingItems+=1.0/60;if(lacksLiquid)w.missingLiquid+=1.0/60;
  if(b.block.consPower!=null && !b.block.consPower.buffered)w.powerLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.power.status)))/60.0;
  if(b.efficiency<=1e-7)w.zeroEfficiency+=1.0/60;w.efficiencyLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.efficiency)))/60.0;
 }
 void step()throws Exception{
  syncCores();for(var core:Team.sharded.cores()){Account a=accounts.get(core.items);for(int i=0;i<a.balance.length;i++)if(a.balance[i]!=core.items.get(i))invalid("missed_stock_mutation;core="+core.pos()+";item="+i);}
  if(TimeDeltaInvalid())invalid("non_fixed_delta_or_cheat");
  if(Pilot.bot!=null && Pilot.bot.team()!=Team.sharded)invalid("agent_changed_team");
  indexEnemies();Window w=window((tick()-1)/18000);int salvoReady=0,salvoThreat=0;
  Iterator<Building> iterator=buildings.values().iterator();
  while(iterator.hasNext()){
   Building b=iterator.next();if(b.tile.build!=b || b.dead){iterator.remove();continue;}if(b.team!=Team.sharded)continue;
   if(!Float.isFinite(b.efficiency))invalid("nonfinite_efficiency;site="+b.pos());
   if(b instanceof ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild turret){
    ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo a=ammo(turret);boolean danger=b.enabled && threat(b,t,a.type);
    if(danger){w.threatSeconds+=1.0/60;if(!a.ready)w.emptySeconds+=1.0/60;
     if(a.type!=null){double cycles=t.reload+(!t.reloadWhileCharging?t.shoot.firstShotDelay:0);double shots=t.consumeAmmoOnce?1:t.shoot.shots;w.demand[a.item.id]+=shots*t.ammoPerShot/a.type.ammoMultiplier*a.type.reloadMultiplier*b.timeScale()/cycles;}
    }
    if(b.block==Blocks.salvo && b.enabled && a.ready){salvoReady++;if(danger)salvoThreat++;}
   }
   if(b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill){
    double a=w.wantSeconds,mi=w.missingItems,ml=w.missingLiquid,pl=w.powerLoss,ze=w.zeroEfficiency,el=w.efficiencyLoss,bl=w.blocked,sl=w.sleeping;
    facility(b,w);double[] metric=w.facilityMetrics.computeIfAbsent(b.block.name,k->new double[8]);metric[0]+=w.wantSeconds-a;metric[1]+=w.missingItems-mi;metric[2]+=w.missingLiquid-ml;metric[3]+=w.powerLoss-pl;metric[4]+=w.zeroEfficiency-ze;metric[5]+=w.efficiencyLoss-el;metric[6]+=w.blocked-bl;metric[7]+=w.sleeping-sl;
   }

  }
  if(salvoReady>=3){
   if(salvoStreak>=10800)threatRingSum-=threatRing[ringIndex];threatRing[ringIndex]=salvoThreat;threatRingSum+=salvoThreat;ringIndex=(ringIndex+1)%10800;salvoStreak++;
   if(salvoStreak>=10800){milestone("salvo_static");if(threatRingSum>=5400)milestone("salvo_combat");}
  }else{salvoStreak=ringIndex=threatRingSum=0;}
  if(initialEnemyCores>0){int count=0;double hp=0;for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=Pilot.bot.unit() && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && AttackSupport.contains(u)){count++;hp+=u.health;}if(count>=8 && hp>=2000)milestone("army_formed");if(Team.crux.cores().size<initialEnemyCores)milestone("first_enemy_core");}
  for(int[] calls:workCalls.values()){int total=calls[0]+calls[1]+calls[2];if(total>0)for(int i=0;i<3;i++)w.operation[i]+=calls[i]/(double)total/60;}
  workCalls.clear();
  for(Batch b:batches)if(b.end<0){for(var e:b.units.entrySet())if(!b.terminated.contains(e.getKey()) && (e.getValue().dead || !e.getValue().isAdded())){b.terminated.add(e.getKey());emit("batch_unit_terminated","batch="+b.ordinal+";id="+e.getKey()+";dead="+e.getValue().dead);}if(b.sealed && b.terminated.size()==b.units.size()){b.end=tick();emit("batch_clear","ordinal="+b.ordinal);b.clearSeq=seq;}}
 }
 boolean TimeDeltaInvalid(){return Math.abs(arc.util.Time.delta-1f)>1e-7 || state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().fillItems;}

 static final String META="run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds";
 static final String[] WINDOW_COLUMNS={"journal_summary_seq","scope","item","facility","window","start_seconds","end_seconds","duration_seconds","supply","full_demand","construction_paid","flow_gap","net_shortage_core","opening_core_stock","due_unpaid_end","rebuild_paid","rebuild_equivalent","repair_material_paid","threat_turret_seconds","empty_turret_seconds","empty_fraction","want_facility_seconds","missing_item_seconds","missing_liquid_seconds","power_loss_seconds","zero_efficiency_seconds","efficiency_loss_seconds","blocked_seconds","sleep_seconds","repair_effective_hp","repair_energy","grid_requested_energy","grid_received_energy","grid_satisfaction","expand_seconds","defense_seconds","rebuild_seconds","expand_fraction","defense_fraction","rebuild_fraction"};
 void header(PrintWriter writer,String columns){writer.println("seq,"+META+","+columns);}
 void row(PrintWriter writer,int number,String... values){writer.println(number+","+fields()+","+tick()+","+(tick()/60.0)+","+String.join(",",values));}
 Map<String,String> windowBase(int index,double end,double duration,String scope){Map<String,String> r=new HashMap<>();r.put("journal_summary_seq",String.valueOf(windowReference));r.put("scope",scope);r.put("window",String.valueOf(index));r.put("start_seconds",String.valueOf(index*300));r.put("end_seconds",String.valueOf(end));r.put("duration_seconds",String.valueOf(duration));return r;}
 void put(Map<String,String> row,String key,double value){row.put(key,Double.toString(value));}
 void windowRow(int number,Map<String,String> r){String[] values=new String[WINDOW_COLUMNS.length];for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++)values[i]=r.getOrDefault(WINDOW_COLUMNS[i],"");row(windowOut,number,values);}
 static double weight(Item i){return i==Items.copper?0.5:i==Items.lead?0.7:i==Items.graphite || i==Items.titanium?1:i==Items.silicon?0.8:0;}
 double[] totals(){double[] t=new double[17];for(Window w:windows.values()){
  t[0]+=w.threatSeconds;t[1]+=w.emptySeconds;t[2]+=w.wantSeconds;t[3]+=w.missingItems;t[4]+=w.missingLiquid;t[5]+=w.powerLoss;t[6]+=w.zeroEfficiency;t[7]+=w.efficiencyLoss;t[8]+=w.blocked;t[9]+=w.sleeping;t[10]+=w.repairHP;t[11]+=w.repairEnergy;t[12]+=w.powerNeed;t[13]+=w.powerReceived;for(int k=0;k<3;k++)t[14+k]+=w.operation[k];
 }return t;}

  terminalTick=clock.getAsInt();initializing=false;

  if(initialEnemyCores>0 && won && Team.crux.cores().size>initialEnemyCores-1)invalid("siege_win_without_first_core");

  for(Batch b:batches){int end=b.end<0?tick():b.end;double duration=(end-b.start)/60.0;rmct+=duration;if(b.end>=0)cleared++;
   row(batchOut,++bn,String.valueOf(b.ordinal),String.valueOf(b.wave),String.valueOf(b.start),String.valueOf(end),String.valueOf(duration),String.valueOf(b.end>=0),String.valueOf(b.end<0),String.valueOf(b.units.size()),String.valueOf(b.terminated.size()),b.ordinal<=10?"early":b.ordinal<=20?"mid":"late",String.valueOf(b.spawnSeq),String.valueOf(b.sealSeq),b.clearSeq==0?"":String.valueOf(b.clearSeq));
  }

   put(global,"threat_turret_seconds",w.threatSeconds);put(global,"empty_turret_seconds",w.emptySeconds);if(w.threatSeconds>0)put(global,"empty_fraction",w.emptySeconds/w.threatSeconds);
   put(global,"want_facility_seconds",w.wantSeconds);put(global,"missing_item_seconds",w.missingItems);put(global,"missing_liquid_seconds",w.missingLiquid);put(global,"power_loss_seconds",w.powerLoss);put(global,"zero_efficiency_seconds",w.zeroEfficiency);put(global,"efficiency_loss_seconds",w.efficiencyLoss);put(global,"blocked_seconds",w.blocked);put(global,"sleep_seconds",w.sleeping);put(global,"repair_effective_hp",w.repairHP);put(global,"repair_energy",w.repairEnergy);put(global,"grid_requested_energy",w.powerNeed);put(global,"grid_received_energy",w.powerReceived);if(w.powerNeed>0)put(global,"grid_satisfaction",w.powerReceived/w.powerNeed);

    put(r,"supply",w.supply[i]);put(r,"full_demand",demand);put(r,"construction_paid",w.construction[i]);put(r,"flow_gap",Math.max(0,demand-w.supply[i]));put(r,"net_shortage_core",Math.max(0,demand-w.supply[i]-w.opening[i]));put(r,"opening_core_stock",w.opening[i]);put(r,"due_unpaid_end",w.dueAtEnd[i]);put(r,"rebuild_paid",w.rebuild[i]);put(r,"repair_material_paid",w.repairItems[i]);windowRow(++wn,r);
   }
   for(var fs:w.supplyByFacility.entrySet())for(Item item:content.items())if(fs.getValue()[item.id]!=0){Map<String,String> r=windowBase(index,end,duration,"facility_supply");r.put("facility",fs.getKey());r.put("item",item.name);put(r,"supply",fs.getValue()[item.id]);windowRow(++wn,r);}

   }
   for(var en:w.energyByFacility.entrySet()){Map<String,String> r=windowBase(index,end,duration,"facility_energy");r.put("facility",en.getKey());put(r,"grid_requested_energy",en.getValue()[0]);put(r,"grid_received_energy",en.getValue()[1]);windowRow(++wn,r);}
   emit("window_summary","window="+index+";duration="+duration+";supply="+Arrays.toString(w.supply)+";nominal_material_demand="+Arrays.toString(w.demand)+";construction="+Arrays.toString(w.construction)+";operation_seconds="+Arrays.toString(w.operation)+";threat_seconds="+w.threatSeconds+";empty_seconds="+w.emptySeconds+";repair_hp="+w.repairHP+";repair_energy="+w.repairEnergy);
  }
  for(var failure:placementAttempts.entrySet())emit("placement_failure_summary","order="+failure.getKey()+";attempts="+failure.getValue()+";still_blocked="+failedPlacements.contains(failure.getKey()));
  double[] t=totals();header(stageOut,"valid,won,terminal_reason,batch_count,cleared_batches,censored_batches,rmct_seconds,clear_fraction,core_lost,enemy_cores_initial,enemy_cores_remaining,buildings_destroyed,enemy_caused_destroyed,late_buildings_destroyed,salvo_static_seconds,salvo_combat_seconds,army_formed_seconds,rts_attack_seconds,first_enemy_core_seconds,late_lock_seconds,threat_turret_seconds,empty_turret_seconds,empty_fraction,want_facility_seconds,missing_item_seconds,missing_liquid_seconds,power_loss_seconds,zero_efficiency_seconds,efficiency_loss_seconds,blocked_seconds,sleep_seconds,repair_effective_hp,repair_energy,grid_requested_energy,grid_received_energy,grid_satisfaction,expand_seconds,defense_seconds,rebuild_seconds,aux_stage_under_60min,journal_end_seq");
  String reason=coreLost?"core_lost":won?(initialEnemyCores>0?"first_enemy_core":"native_victory"):ended?"native_defeat":"time_limit";
  ArrayList<String> values=new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(String.valueOf(valid),String.valueOf(won),reason,String.valueOf(batches.size()),String.valueOf(cleared),String.valueOf(batches.size()-cleared),batches.isEmpty()?"":String.valueOf(rmct/batches.size()),batches.isEmpty()?"":String.valueOf(cleared/(double)batches.size()),String.valueOf(coreLost),String.valueOf(initialEnemyCores),String.valueOf(Team.crux.cores().size),String.valueOf(destructionTotal),String.valueOf(enemyDestructionTotal),String.valueOf(lateDestroyed),milestoneSeconds("salvo_static"),milestoneSeconds("salvo_combat"),milestoneSeconds("army_formed"),milestoneSeconds("rts_attack"),milestoneSeconds("first_enemy_core"),milestoneSeconds("late_lock"),String.valueOf(t[0]),String.valueOf(t[1]),t[0]>0?String.valueOf(t[1]/t[0]):""));
  for(int i=2;i<14;i++)values.add(String.valueOf(t[i]));values.add(t[12]>0?String.valueOf(t[13]/t[12]):"");for(int i=14;i<17;i++)values.add(String.valueOf(t[i]));values.add(String.valueOf(won && tick()<=3600*60));values.add(String.valueOf(seq+1));row(stageOut,1,values.toArray(new String[0]));

  closed=true;EvaluationTrace.sink=null;journal.close();batchOut.close();windowOut.close();stageOut.close();validation.close();
 }
````

## freeze_calibration.py

Freeze a genuinely earned C entry only after native prerequisites/training and cold validation.

SHA-256：`7ae339eedd8a22d8e63ff06641bb22ebca2a5d8863a32d10693c4d18e4a8e91d`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Freeze a genuinely earned C entry only after native prerequisites/training and cold validation."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,json,shutil,subprocess
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;DEST=ROOT/'frozen/C-v1'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def main():
    ready=json.loads((ROOT/'results/C-native-entry-and-training.json').read_text());assert ready['status']=='native_prerequisites_complete_training_recorded_freeze_pending'
    entry=Path(ready['entry_checkpoint']);original=json.loads((entry/'manifest.json').read_text());assert original['native_result']['target']=='ruinousShores' and original['native_result']['captured'] and original['native_result']['reason']=='native_captured_researched_and_stocked'
    for name,digest in original['profile_files'].items():assert sha(entry/name)==digest,name
    for training in ready['training']:
        assert training['route']['valid'] and training['route']['formal_sample'] is False
        proof=json.loads(Path(training['artifact_checks']).read_text());assert proof['stage']['passed'] and proof['costs']['passed']
    assert len(ready['training'])==2
    # Preparation retries may use a separate courier fork. The trained C helper
    # must still match the archived V5b source/classes, never that preparation fork.
    trained_helper=json.loads((ROOT/'campaign-preparation/driver-v5b/manifest.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in trained_helper['files'].items():
        if name.startswith('classes/'):path=ROOT/'native-campaign-v5-classes'/Path(name).name
        elif name.endswith('.java'):path=ROOT/'src'/name
        else:continue
        assert sha(path)==digest,'C helper differs from native training: '+name
    validation=ROOT/'results/C-native-entry-profile-validation.json'
    command=['/workspace/toolchains/jdk-17.0.17+10/bin/java','-Xmx1g','-cp',f'{ROOT}/diagnostic-classes:{ROOT}/frozen/S-v2/server.jar','ValidateNativeProfile',str(entry),str(validation),'ruinousShores']
    subprocess.run(command,cwd='/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/core/assets',check=True);entry_check=json.loads(validation.read_text());assert entry_check['passed']
    assert entry_check['active_player_constructions']==0,'Do not carry G0 construction progress into different C parameter groups'
    sectors={r['preset']:int(r['sector']) for r in csv.DictReader(open(ROOT/'results/native-sector-dimensions.csv')) if r['preset']}
    for name in ['stainedMountains','windsweptIslands','fungalPass','overgrowth']:assert not (entry/'saves'/f'sector-serpulo-{sectors[name]}.msav').exists(),f'Entry precleared a measurement map: {name}'
    s=json.loads((ROOT/'frozen/S-v2/manifest.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in s['files'].items():assert sha(ROOT/'frozen/S-v2'/name)==digest
    shared_code=json.loads((ROOT/'results/server-desktop-shared-game-code.json').read_text())
    assert shared_code['passed'] and shared_code['server_jar_sha256']==s['files']['server.jar']
    assert shared_code['desktop_jar_sha256']==sha(Path('/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/desktop/build/libs/Mindustry.jar'))
    assert not DEST.exists(),'Never overwrite an existing frozen C version'
    temporary=DEST.with_name('C-v1.writing');temporary.mkdir()
    shutil.copytree(ROOT/'frozen/S-v2/classes',temporary/'classes');shutil.copytree(ROOT/'native-campaign-v5-classes',temporary/'classes',dirs_exist_ok=True);shutil.copytree(ROOT/'realtime-calibration-v6-classes',temporary/'classes',dirs_exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2('/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/desktop/build/libs/Mindustry.jar',temporary/'desktop.jar')
    shutil.copytree(entry,temporary/'entry-profile');(temporary/'src').mkdir();(temporary/'layouts').mkdir()
    sources=['RealtimeCampaign.java','RealtimeRecorder.java','NativeCalibrationPolicy.java','NativeCAdmission.java','NativeCampaignStage.java','NativeCampaignCheckpoint.java','PreparationHailAmmo.java']
    for name in sources:shutil.copy2(ROOT/'src'/name,temporary/'src'/name)
    shutil.copy2(ROOT/'src/realtime/AttackSupport.java',temporary/'src/AttackSupport.java')
    external={}
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        for stage in 'ABC':
            path=ROOT/'frozen/S-v2/layouts'/f'{policy}-{stage}.csv';shutil.copy2(path,temporary/'layouts'/path.name);external[str(path)]=sha(path)
    protocol=(ROOT/'C_ENTRY_PROTOCOL.md').read_text().replace('C 原生战役校准实施草案（尚未冻结、无正式 C 样本）','C 原生战役校准实施约定（C-v1冻结版，正式样本待执行）',1)
    protocol+='\n\n冻结时实际入口为原生已通关并备料的Ruinous Shores；两套原生A阶段非正式训练及冷读取入口校验已完成。具体入口哈希、源文件、30FPS及外部布局路径由本目录manifest.json绑定。C未获得S式逐字节确定性证明，作为单独统计校准报告。\n'
    (temporary/'PROTOCOL.md').write_text(protocol);(temporary/'proofs').mkdir()
````

## frozen/S-v1/untracked-native/EvaluationParameters.java

玩家队伍专用参数分派，含主组、拆分、消融、X和α。

SHA-256：`424b8dd585623d576c77702b8edfc25d27399cbf58992f9749737068986b22dc`；同内容路径数：2。完整别名见CSV。

````java
package mindustry.core;

import mindustry.content.*;
import mindustry.entities.bullet.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Opt-in evaluation overrides. Shared content, research and buildTime remain untouched. */
public final class EvaluationParameters{
    public static final String group = System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.group", "G0");
    public static final float alpha = Float.parseFloat(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.alpha", "0"));
    private static boolean m,t,g,s,p,h,c,x;
    static{
        switch(group){
            case "G0": break;
            case "G1": m=t=g=s=p=true; break;
            case "G2": h=c=true; break;
            case "G3": m=t=g=s=p=h=c=true; break;
            case "G2H": h=true; break;
            case "G2C": c=true; break;
            case "G1X": m=t=g=s=p=x=true; break;
            case "G3X": m=t=g=s=p=h=c=x=true; break;
            case "I_only_M": m=true; break;
            case "I_only_T": t=true; break;
            case "I_only_G": g=true; break;
            case "I_only_S": s=true; break;
            case "I_only_P": p=true; break;
            case "I_without_M": t=g=s=p=true; break;
            case "I_without_T": m=g=s=p=true; break;
            case "I_without_G": m=t=s=p=true; break;
            case "I_without_S": m=t=g=p=true; break;
            case "I_without_P": m=t=g=s=true; break;
            case "I_SP": s=p=true; break;
            default: throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown evaluation group: " + group);
        }
        if(!Float.isFinite(alpha) || alpha<0 || alpha>2)throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid alpha");
    }
    private static boolean player(Building b){return b.team == state.rules.defaultTeam;}
    public static float mining(Building b){
        return player(b) && ((m && (b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill || b.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill)) || (x && b.block==Blocks.laserDrill)) ? 0.8f : 1f;
    }
    public static float conveyor(Building b){return player(b) && t && (b.block==Blocks.conveyor || b.block==Blocks.titaniumConveyor) ? 1.25f : 1f;}
    public static float cycle(Building b){
        return player(b) && ((g && b.block==Blocks.graphitePress) || (s && b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter) || (x && b.block==Blocks.multiPress)) ? 0.8f : 1f;
    }
    public static float power(Building b){
        return player(b) && ((p && b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter) || (x && (b.block==Blocks.laserDrill || b.block==Blocks.multiPress))) ? 1.2f : 1f;
    }
    public static float bullet(Building b, BulletType type){
        return player(b) && h && (b.block==Blocks.duo || b.block==Blocks.salvo) && ((ItemTurret)b.block).ammoTypes.get(Items.copper)==type ? type.damage*1.2f : -1f;
    }
    public static int cost(Team team, Block block, int amount){
        return team==state.rules.defaultTeam && c && (block==Blocks.duo || block==Blocks.salvo) ? Math.round(amount*1.2f) : amount;
    }
    /** Additive pressure: alpha=0 is native; applied after native campaign rounding. */
    public static int waveCount(int nativeCount, boolean boss){
        return nativeCount==0 || boss ? nativeCount : Math.round(nativeCount*(1f+alpha));
    }
    private EvaluationParameters(){}
}
````

## frozen/S-v1/untracked-native/EvaluationTrace.java

原生引擎调用的可选观测接口及因果上下文传递。

SHA-256：`435e9694b9c9735c66f51f5894c66e428daea8a1fa36dd578e45c67e66cd38c7`；同内容路径数：2。完整别名见CSV。

````java
package mindustry.core;

import mindustry.gen.*;
import mindustry.type.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import mindustry.world.modules.*;

/** Optional read-only observer. Null by default; must never call simulation mutators. */
public final class EvaluationTrace{
    public static Sink sink;
    public interface Sink{
        default void stock(ItemModule module, int item, int before, int after){}
        default void produce(Team team, int producer, Item item, int amount){}
        default void construction(Building site, Block target, Item item, int amount){}
        default void healing(Building source, int target, float amount){}
        default void work(Unit builder, Building site, Block target){}
        default void order(int actor, int x, int y, Block target){}
        default void consumed(Building build, Item item, int amount){}
        default void damageBegin(Building build, Team source){}
        default void damageEnd(Building build){}
        default void powerUsage(Building build, float requested, float received){}
        default void fireCreated(Fire fire){}
        default void fireIgnited(Bullet bullet, Fire fire){}
        default void fireBegin(Fire fire){}
        default void fireEnd(Fire fire){}
        default void bulletBegin(Bullet bullet){}
        default void bulletEnd(Bullet bullet){}
        default Object captureCause(Team direct){return null;}
        default void causeBegin(Object token){}
        default void causeEnd(Object token){}
        default void waveBegin(int wave){}
        default void waveEnd(int wave){}
        default void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup group, float x, float y, int base, int adjusted){}
        default void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup group, Unit unit){}
    }
    public static void stock(ItemModule m,int i,int before,int after){if(sink!=null && before!=after)sink.stock(m,i,before,after);}
    public static void produce(Team t,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(sink!=null)sink.produce(t,producer,item,amount);}
    public static void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(sink!=null && amount>0)sink.construction(site,target,item,amount);}
    public static void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(sink!=null && amount>0)sink.healing(source,target,amount);}
    public static void work(Unit builder,Building site,Block target){if(sink!=null)sink.work(builder,site,target);}
    public static void order(int actor,int x,int y,Block target){if(sink!=null)sink.order(actor,x,y,target);}
    public static void consumed(Building build,Item item,int amount){if(sink!=null && amount>0)sink.consumed(build,item,amount);}
    public static Runnable wrap(Runnable task){return wrap(task,null);}
    public static Runnable wrap(Runnable task,Team direct){
        Sink observer=sink;if(observer==null)return task;
        Object token=observer.captureCause(direct);if(token==null)return task;
        return () -> {
            if(sink!=observer){task.run();return;}
            observer.causeBegin(token);
            try{task.run();}finally{observer.causeEnd(token);}
        };
    }
    private EvaluationTrace(){}
}
````

````python
 return list(reversed(path))
````

## package_deliverables.py

所有执行写入结束且审计通过后打包，并验证包内逐文件哈希。

SHA-256：`037a52b0df5e2b38acef232ee19ea0a54428d129c0881d04cf162c1403cf8e7f`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Package completed, audited evidence; refuses an unfinished experimental matrix."""
from pathlib import Path
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,tarfile,csv,os
import time
from runtime_quiescence import inspect
from verify_evidence_archive import verify as verify_archive
from audit_report_deliverables import audit as audit_report_deliverables

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

def digest(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open('rb') as f:
        for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def main():
    package_started=time.perf_counter();package_cpu_started=time.process_time()
    answer=json.loads((ROOT/'report/答案汇总.json').read_text())
    assert answer['final_report_complete'],'The final report is not complete'
    assert answer['S']['snapshot_finished_routes']==4500 and answer['C']['completed_route_cells']==40
    assert audit_report_deliverables(answer,require_final_alias=True)['passed']
    assert json.loads((ROOT/'report/derived-data-audit.json').read_text())['passed']
    matrix=json.loads((ROOT/'report/execution-matrix-audit.json').read_text())
    assert matrix['passed'] and matrix['complete_matrix'] and matrix['S_snapshot_routes']==4500 and matrix['C_handled']==40
    assert json.loads((ROOT/'results/benchmark-completed.json').read_text())['completed']
    state=ROOT/'results/runtime-supervisor-state.json'
    if state.exists():
        runtime=inspect();assert runtime['quiescent'],'Wait for all execution writers and any verified recovery to finish before hashing delivery files: '+str(runtime)
    assert not (ROOT/'deliverables/Mindustry-评测完整证据.tar.gz').exists(),'Never overwrite an already completed evidence archive'
    for version in ['S-v2','C-v1']:
        manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'frozen'/version/'manifest.json').read_text())
        for name,sha in manifest['files'].items():assert digest(ROOT/'frozen'/version/name)==sha,(version,name)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',(ROOT/'report/评测分析报告.md').read_text()):
        if '://' not in target:assert (ROOT/'report'/target.split('#')[0]).exists(),target
    guide=ROOT/'report/交付与复现说明.md'
    guide.write_text('''# 交付与复现说明

先阅读 `评测分析报告.md`，机器答案为 `答案汇总.json`。三张主CSV是 `批次日志.csv`、`5分钟窗口日志.csv`、`阶段汇总日志.csv`；原生校准以 `C_` 开头单列。训练、技术失败尝试与整体拒收的S-v1均不进入有效样本分母。

包内保留冻结JAR/class/布局/源码补丁、实际入口战役档、正式原始日志、阶段快照与支付凭证。`formal-rejected-v1/` 为明确拒收的历史证据，不是另一批正式样本。`delivery_manifest.json` 给出全部交付文件的SHA-256。压缩包旁另有其整体SHA-256。

现有日志中的绝对路径以 `/workspace/mindustry-evaluation` 为根；完整审计建议在相同位置解包。原始事件不做改写。源码为报告中的固定提交；`reproduce-environment.sh` 用于已有源码工作区的版本核对与构建，不会自动下载仓库或应用补丁。离线审计可直接使用包内冻结JAR。源码重建时，先将干净的Anuken/Mindustry检出到报告提交，在其根目录应用 `frozen/S-v2/source.patch`，再将 `frozen/S-v2/untracked-native/` 内两份Java文件复制至 `core/src/mindustry/core/`。Arc、Rhino、Steamworks4j的相邻仓库及其精确提交见该脚本；先安装所列JDK、Gradle依赖和桌面运行库。补丁和新增源码已在干净提交上实际核对，见 `results/source-reconstruction-validation.json`。不得把重建的产物覆盖原冻结目录；重新验收应在独立目录进行。

仅重算派生统计时，在评测目录依次运行：

```bash
python analyze_formal.py
python audit_derived_results.py
python summarize_windows.py
python derive_verdicts.py
python collect_exclusions.py
python analyze_calibration.py
python plot_formal.py
python build_report.py
```

Python统计依赖为NumPy和Matplotlib。真实重跑使用JDK17；`run_formal.py --workers 4` 会核对冻结文件并仅补未完成S路线，`run_calibration.py --workers 8` 会从冻结合法战役入口复制独立存档。已经完成的路线不会被覆盖。新的重复性实验应写到独立诊断目录，不能删除正式结果来增加N。

下载后可先用 `sha256sum -c Mindustry-评测完整证据.tar.gz.sha256` 核对压缩包，再运行 `python verify_evidence_archive.py Mindustry-评测完整证据.tar.gz` 流式核对包内所有文件与嵌入清单，不会解压或执行游戏。

固定步长重复及观察开关验收脚本为 `accept_v2.py`，正式胜利种子的独立交叉校验为 `repeat_formal_acceptance.py`；它们写入诊断结果，不增加独立种子数。运行之前保留包内原验收文件。C需原生SDL客户端、Xorg、软件OpenGL与可用服务器端口；不得用固定步长服务器替代原生实时校准。G按已批准决定为协议不适用。

没有真人问卷，报告不推断主观挫败感。技术缺失、阶段未到达、零批次与未达成里程碑分别保留；完整执行不意味着每一判据都有足够证据。
''')
    selected=set()
    retained_checkpoints=set()
    recovery=ROOT/'results/C-preparation-continuations.json'
    if recovery.exists():
        checkpoint=Path(json.loads(recovery.read_text())['checkpoint']);assert checkpoint.is_relative_to(ROOT)
        retained_checkpoints.add(checkpoint)
    preparation_retry=ROOT/'results/C-ruinous-preparation-retry.json'
    if preparation_retry.exists():
        evidence=json.loads(preparation_retry.read_text())
        for diagnostic in [evidence.get('diagnostic_checkpoint'),evidence.get('second_diagnostic_checkpoint')]:
            if not diagnostic:continue
            checkpoint=Path(diagnostic)
            if not checkpoint.is_absolute():checkpoint=ROOT/checkpoint
            assert checkpoint.is_relative_to(ROOT);retained_checkpoints.add(checkpoint)
    evidence_directories=['report','frozen','formal','calibration','formal-rejected-v1','campaign-preparation','training','src','input','runtime-container','artifacts','candidates','logs']
    evidence_directories+=sorted(p.name for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and 'smoke' in p.name)
    for directory in evidence_directories:
        for path in (ROOT/directory).rglob('*'):
            if not path.is_file():continue
            if any(part in ['cache','previews','settings_backups'] for part in path.parts):continue
            # Periodic preparation checkpoint worlds duplicate the earned final
            # frozen entry; their manifests remain available for provenance.
            if '-checkpoints' in str(path) and path.name!='manifest.json' and path.name!='latest.json' and not any(path.is_relative_to(c) for c in retained_checkpoints):continue
            if '__pycache__' not in path.parts:selected.add(path)
    for pattern in ['*.py','*.sh','*.md','*.patch','campaign-*.csv']:
        selected.update(ROOT.glob(pattern))
    # The user requests all saved script versions, including prototype snapshots
    # outside the current src/frozen folders. The code catalogue binds each one.
    with (ROOT/'report/全部脚本与源码清单.csv').open() as source:
        for row in csv.DictReader(source):
            path=ROOT/row['path'];assert path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and digest(path)==row['sha256']
            selected.add(path)
    selected.discard(ROOT/'WORK_STATE.md')
    for pattern in ['*.json','*.csv','analysis-before-compaction.py.txt','v2-*.csv*','formal-winning-*.csv*','prefix-equivalence-B-A-seed0.csv*','container-runtime-A.csv*']:
        selected.update(p for p in (ROOT/'results').glob(pattern) if p.is_file())
    for pattern in ['pressure-accept-*.log','research-invariant-*.log','v2-*.log','formal-runner-v2*.log','native-preparation-*.log','C-training-*.log','finish-benchmark*.log','container-runtime-A.log','runtime-supervisor.log','native-prerequisite-container.log','native-ruinous-recovery-container.log']:
        selected.update((ROOT/'logs').glob(pattern))
    selected.discard(ROOT/'report/delivery_manifest.json')
    # Packaging's own stdout/stderr receive the final receipt after the archive
    # closes. Keep those live logs outside the immutable archived payload.
    late_logs=[]
    for descriptor in [1,2]:
        try:path=Path(os.readlink(f'/proc/self/fd/{descriptor}'))
        except OSError:continue
        if path.is_absolute() and path.is_relative_to(ROOT) and path in selected:
            selected.discard(path);late_logs.append(str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
    hashes={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):digest(p) for p in sorted(selected)}
    assert all(not p.is_symlink() for p in selected),'Evidence bundle must contain regular files, not external symlink targets'
    manifest=ROOT/'report/delivery_manifest.json'
    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(S_requested_cells=4660,S_unique_logical_routes=4500,C_requested_cells=40,G='protocol_not_applicable_user_authorized',reused_A_prefixes_are_not_new_independent_samples=True,late_writing_packaging_logs_excluded=sorted(set(late_logs)),files=hashes),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    selected.add(manifest)
    destination=ROOT/'deliverables';destination.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    output=destination/'Mindustry-评测完整证据.tar.gz';temporary=output.with_suffix('.gz.writing')
    with temporary.open('wb') as raw,gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=raw,mtime=0,compresslevel=6) as compressed,tarfile.open(fileobj=compressed,mode='w|') as archive:
        for path in sorted(selected):
            info=archive.gettarinfo(str(path),arcname='mindustry-evaluation/'+str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
            info.uid=info.gid=0;info.uname=info.gname='';info.mtime=0
            with path.open('rb') as source:archive.addfile(info,source)
    archive_audit=verify_archive(temporary)
    temporary.replace(output)
    sha=digest(output);(destination/(output.name+'.sha256')).write_text(sha+'  '+output.name+'\n')
    (ROOT/'results/delivery-archive-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(archive_audit,indent=2)+'\n')
    result=dict(complete=True,archive=str(output),bytes=output.stat().st_size,sha256=sha,files=len(selected),manifest=str(manifest),archive_payload_audit=archive_audit,
                packaging_wall_seconds=time.perf_counter()-package_started,packaging_process_cpu_seconds=time.process_time()-package_cpu_started,
                packaging_cost_scope='This packaging/verification process only; not full project CPU or token/billing cost')
    (ROOT/'results/delivery-completed.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

````python
    isolated=all(R.get(q,{}).get('block','') not in ['conveyor','titanium-conveyor','router','junction'] for q in neighbours)
    if isolated and free(cs|press):candidates.append(((ax-core[0])**2+(ay-core[1])**2,ax,ay,dx,dy))
 _,ax,ay,dx,dy=min(candidates)
 add('mechanical-drill',ax,ay,size=2);add('graphite-press',ax+dx,ay+dy,size=2)

 sites=[((ax-core[0])**2+(ay-core[1]-5)**2,ax,ay) for ax in range(core[0]-8,core[0]+9) for ay in range(core[1]-2,core[1]+11) if free({(ax,ay)})]
 _,ax,ay=min(sites);add('duo',ax,ay)
for _ in range(3):
 sites=[((ax-core[0])**2+(ay-core[1]-5)**2,ax,ay) for ax in range(core[0]-8,core[0]+9) for ay in range(core[1]-2,core[1]+11) if free({(ax,ay)})]
 _,ax,ay=min(sites);add('mender',ax,ay)
for ax in range(core[0]-7,core[0]+11,4):

path=p/('attack-layout.csv' if name=='fungalPass' else 'overgrowth-layout.csv')
````

````python
for _ in range(3):

    _,x,y=min(sites);add('combustion-generator',x,y,size=2)
for x in range(cx-9,cx+14,4):
    for y in range(cy-9,cy+16,4):
        if free({(x,y)}):add('power-node',x,y)
for _ in range(6):
    sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy-3)**2,x,y) for x in range(cx-12,cx+13) for y in range(cy-9,cy+15) if free({(x,y)})]
    _,x,y=min(sites);add('mender',x,y)
for layer in range(2):
    lo,hi,yl,yh=cx-10-layer,cx+12+layer,cy-7-layer,cy+16+layer
    wall={(x,yl) for x in range(lo,hi+1)}|{(x,yh) for x in range(lo,hi+1)}|{(lo,y) for y in range(yl,yh+1)}|{(hi,y) for y in range(yl,yh+1)}
    for x,y in sorted(wall):
        if free({(x,y)}):add('copper-wall',x,y)
# Six paid independent input/output modules; no field changes or resource grants.
for _ in range(6):
    options=[]
    for x,y in R:
        for dx,dy in [(2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)]:
            cs=cells(x,y,2)|cells(x+dx,y+dy,2)

    if not options:break

silicon_count=0
for _ in range(args.silicon):
    candidates=[]
    for x,y in R:

                cs=set().union(*(cells(*p,2) for p in [co,sm,sa,ge]))

for _ in range(args.silicon-silicon_count):
    sand_sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y) for x,y in R if free(cells(x,y,2)) and sum(R[z]['ore']=='sand' for z in cells(x,y,2))>=2 and all(R[z]['ore'] in ['', 'sand'] for z in cells(x,y,2))]
    coal_sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y) for x,y in R if free(cells(x,y,2)) and sum(R[z]['ore']=='coal' for z in cells(x,y,2))>=2]
    if not sand_sites or not coal_sites:break
    _,x,y=min(sand_sites);add('mechanical-drill',x,y,size=2)
    _,x,y=min(coal_sites);add('mechanical-drill',x,y,size=2)
    sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y) for x,y in R if free(cells(x,y,2))]
    _,x,y=min(sites);add('silicon-smelter',x,y,size=2);courier_silicon+=1
    node_sites=[((nx-x)**2+(ny-y)**2,nx,ny) for nx in range(x-2,x+4) for ny in range(y-2,y+4) if free({(nx,ny)})]
    if node_sites:_,nx,ny=min(node_sites);add('power-node',nx,ny)
for _ in range(2 if courier_silicon else 0):
    sites=[]
    for x,y in R:
        for dx,dy in [(2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)]:
            if free(cells(x,y,2)|cells(x+dx,y+dy,2)) and sum(R[z]['ore']=='coal' for z in cells(x,y,2))>=2:sites.append(((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y,dx,dy))
    if not sites:break
    _,x,y,dx,dy=min(sites);add('mechanical-drill',x,y,size=2);add('combustion-generator',x+dx,y+dy,size=2)
    steps=max(1,math.ceil(math.dist((x+dx,y+dy),(cx,cy))/3))
    for i in range(steps+1):
        px=round(cx+(x+dx-cx)*i/steps);py=round(cy+(y+dy-cy)*i/steps)
        ns_=[((nx-px)**2+(ny-py)**2,nx,ny) for nx in range(px-2,px+3) for ny in range(py-2,py+3) if free({(nx,ny)})]
        if ns_:_,nx,ny=min(ns_);add('power-node',nx,ny)
if args.kiln:
    candidates=[]
    for x,y in R:
        for dx,dy in [(2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)]:
            for sx,sy in [(2,0),(-2,0),(0,2),(0,-2)]:
                if (dx,dy)==(sx,sy):continue
                kiln=(x,y);lead=(x+dx,y+dy);sand=(x+sx,y+sy);cs=cells(*kiln,2)|cells(*lead,2)|cells(*sand,2)
                if not free(cs) or sum(R[z]['ore']=='lead' for z in cells(*lead,2))<3:continue
                if sum(R[z]['ore']=='sand' for z in cells(*sand,2))<2 or any(R[z]['ore'] not in ['', 'sand'] for z in cells(*sand,2)):continue
                candidates.append(((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,kiln,lead,sand))
    if candidates:
        _,kiln,lead,sand=min(candidates);add('mechanical-drill',*lead,size=2);add('mechanical-drill',*sand,size=2);add('kiln',*kiln,size=2)
    else:
        # Sparse native deposits: real raw materials are carried to this paid kiln.
        sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y) for x,y in R if free(cells(x,y,2))]
        _,x,y=min(sites);kiln=(x,y);add('kiln',x,y,size=2)
        sites=[((x-cx)**2+(y-cy)**2,x,y) for x,y in R if free(cells(x,y,2)) and sum(R[z]['ore']=='sand' for z in cells(x,y,2))>=2 and all(R[z]['ore'] in ['', 'sand'] for z in cells(x,y,2))]

    # Native power auto-links along a paid node chain; never assign power.status.
    steps=max(1,math.ceil(math.dist(kiln,(cx,cy))/3))
    for i in range(steps+1):
        px=round(cx+(kiln[0]-cx)*i/steps);py=round(cy+(kiln[1]-cy)*i/steps)
        sites=[((x-px)**2+(y-py)**2,x,y) for x in range(px-2,px+3) for y in range(py-2,py+3) if free({(x,y)})]
        if sites:_,x,y=min(sites);add('power-node',x,y)
with (P/f'campaign-{args.map}-layout.csv').open('w') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(['block','x','y','rotation','config']);w.writerows(plans)
print(args.map,'orders',len(plans),'core',cx,cy,'automatic_silicon_modules',silicon_count,'courier_fed_silicon',courier_silicon,'requested',args.silicon)
````

````python
import csv,collections,pathlib,json

name='stainedMountains'; core=(48,67)
R={ (int(r['x']),int(r['y'])):r for r in csv.DictReader(open(P/'results'/('tiles-'+name+'.csv'))) }
reserved={p for p,r in R.items() if r['block']!='air' and not r['block'].endswith('boulder')}
plans=[]; belt={}; drill_footprints=collections.defaultdict(list)
def footprint(x,y,size):return {(x+i,y+j) for i in range(-(size-1)//2 if size%2 else 0, (size+2)//2) for j in range(-(size-1)//2 if size%2 else 0,(size+2)//2)}
# only 1x1, 2x2 modules in the initial candidate.
def cells(x,y,size):return {(x+i,y+j) for i in range(size) for j in range(size)}
def free(cs):return all(p in R and p not in reserved and R[p]['liquid']=='false' for p in cs)

 plans.append((block,x,y,rot,config));reserved.update(cells(x,y,size))
def nbors(p):
 x,y=p
 for dx,dy in [(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]:yield x+dx,y+dy
# Mark all core tiles (the dump stores linked blocks too).
targets={q for p,r in R.items() if r['block']=='core-shard' for q in nbors(p) if q in R and R[q]['block']=='air'}
def path_out(cs,preview=False):
 sources={q for p in cs for q in nbors(p) if q not in cs and q not in reserved and q in R and R[q]['liquid']=='false'}
 queue=collections.deque(sorted(sources));prev={p:None for p in queue};end=None
 while queue:
  p=queue.popleft()
  if p in targets or p in belt:end=p;break
  for q in nbors(p):
   if q in prev or q not in R or q in cs:continue
   if q in reserved and q not in belt:continue
   if R[q]['liquid']=='true':continue
   prev[q]=p;queue.append(q)
 if end is None:raise ValueError('no output route')
 path=[]
 while end is not None:path.append(end);end=prev[end]
 path.reverse()
 if preview:return path
 for i,p in enumerate(path):
  if p in belt:continue
  q=path[i+1] if i+1<len(path) else min((q for q in nbors(p) if R.get(q,{}).get('block')=='core-shard'),key=lambda q:q)
  dx=q[0]-p[0];dy=q[1]-p[1];rot={(1,0):0,(0,1):1,(-1,0):2,(0,-1):3}[dx,dy]
  add('conveyor',*p,rot);belt[p]=rot
# mining patches nearest core, drill anchors scored by ore coverage.
reachable=set(targets);q=collections.deque(targets)
while q:
 p=q.popleft()
 for z in nbors(p):
  if z not in reachable and z in R and R[z]['liquid']=='false' and (z not in reserved or z in belt):reachable.add(z);q.append(z)
def drill(ore,kind='mechanical-drill'):
 candidates=[]
 for x,y in R:
  cs=cells(x,y,2)
  if not free(cs):continue
  n=sum(R[p]['ore']==ore for p in cs)
  if n>=3 and any(q in reachable for p in cs for q in nbors(p) if q not in cs):candidates.append((((x-core[0])**2+(y-core[1])**2)/n,x,y))
 for _,x,y in sorted(candidates):
  try:path_out(cells(x,y,2),preview=True)
  except ValueError:continue
  add(kind,x,y,size=2);drill_footprints[ore].append(cells(x,y,2));path_out(cells(x,y,2))

  return
 raise ValueError('no drill '+ore)
for _ in range(9):drill('copper')
copper_belts=set(belt);drill('lead')
# Choose a single preplanned straight router/duo bank with a native copper feed.
banks=[]
for x in range(core[0]-18,core[0]+19):
 for y in range(core[1]-10,core[1]+26):
  for dx,dy in [(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]:
   length=0
   for j in range(12):
    cx,cy=x+j*dx,y+j*dy
    if not free({(cx,cy),(cx-dy,cy+dx),(cx+dy,cy-dx)}):break
    length+=1
   if length>=8 and not any(q in cs for j in range(length) for q in nbors((x+j*dx,y+j*dy)) for cs in drill_footprints['lead']):banks.append((-length+0.1*((x-core[0]+10)**2+(y-core[1]-8)**2),x,y,dx,dy,length))
if not banks:raise ValueError('no defense bank')
_,x,y,dx,dy,length=min(banks)
bankcells={(x+j*dx+k*dy,y+j*dy-k*dx) for j in range(length) for k in [-1,0,1]}
endpoints={(x+j*dx,y+j*dy) for j in range(length)}
reserved.update(bankcells-endpoints)

while queue:

 if p in endpoints:end=p;break
 for q in nbors(p):
  if q in prev or not free({q}):continue
  prev[q]=p;queue.append(q)
if end is None:raise ValueError('no defense feed')
path=[]
while end is not None:path.append(end);end=prev[end]
path.reverse()
reserved.difference_update(bankcells)
# Split the existing copper conveyor to supply the bank, without free items/unloaders.
source=path[0]
for i,o in enumerate(plans):
 if o[1:3]==source and o[0]=='conveyor':plans[i]=('inverted-sorter',source[0],source[1],0,'copper');break
for i,p in enumerate(path[1:-1],1):
 q=path[i+1];rot={(1,0):0,(0,1):1,(-1,0):2,(0,-1):3}[q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]];add('conveyor',*p,rot)
for j in range(length):
 cx,cy=x+j*dx,y+j*dy
 add('router',cx,cy);add('duo',cx-dy,cy+dx);add('duo',cx+dy,cy-dx)
# Paid repair network. Fuel arrives only through the native player's inventory transfers.

for j in range(0,length,3):
 for side in [-1,1]:
  q=(x+j*dx+3*side*dy,y+j*dy-3*side*dx)
  if free({q}):add('mender',*q);repairnodes.append(q)
for ax in range(core[0]-6,core[0]+7,3):
 for ay in range(core[1]-6,core[1]+7,3):

  if free(cells(ax,ay,2)):add('combustion-generator',ax,ay,size=2);repairnodes.append((ax,ay))

for ax in range(core[0]-7,core[0]+12,4):
 for ay in range(core[1]-7,core[1]+15,4):
  if free({(ax,ay)}):add('power-node',ax,ay)
# Coal pickup depots are genuine drills; no conveyor drains their inventories.
for _ in range(int(os.environ.get('PILOT_COAL_DRILLS','4'))):
 candidates=[]
 for ax,ay in R:
  cs=cells(ax,ay,2)
  if free(cs) and sum(R[p]['ore']=='coal' for p in cs)>=3:
   candidates.append(((ax-core[0])**2+(ay-core[1])**2,ax,ay))
 _,ax,ay=min(candidates);add('mechanical-drill',ax,ay,size=2)
# Two paid wall perimeters around the core and the native ammunition bank.
bx0=min(core[0]-4,min(p[0] for p in bankcells)-2);bx1=max(core[0]+4,max(p[0] for p in bankcells)+2)
by0=min(core[1]-4,min(p[1] for p in bankcells)-2);by1=max(core[1]+4,max(p[1] for p in bankcells)+2)
wallplans=[]
for layer in range(2):
 xa,xb,ya,yb=bx0-layer,bx1+layer,by0-layer,by1+layer
 wallcells={(xx,ya) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xx,yb) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xa,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}|{(xb,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}
 for q in sorted(wallcells,key=lambda z:-(z[0]+z[1])):
  if free({q}):wallplans.append(('copper-wall',*q,0,''));reserved.add(q)
# Rebuild walls before replacing expensive turrets when they are breached.
plans=wallplans+plans

# Native conveyors cannot cross water; restrict modules to the core land component.
reachable=set(targets);q=collections.deque(targets)
while q:

 for z in nbors(p):
  if z not in reachable and z in R and R[z]['liquid']=='false' and (z not in reserved or z in belt):reachable.add(z);q.append(z)
# Fixed 2x2 module search over rotations/reflections; native placement is checked again by pilot.

for x,y in R:
 for ux,uy in [(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]:

   vx,vy=-uy*sign,ux*sign
   co=(x,y);sm=(x+2*ux,y+2*uy);sa=(sm[0]+2*vx,sm[1]+2*vy);ge=(x+2*vx,y+2*vy)

 if free(cs) and sum(R[p]['ore']=='coal' for p in cells(x,y,2))>=1 and any(q in reachable for p in cells(x+2,y,2) for q in nbors(p) if q not in cs):
  candidates.append(((x-core[0])**2+(y-core[1])**2,x,y))
````

````python
_,x,y,dx,dy,length=min(banks)

 p=queue.popleft()
 if p in endpoints:end=p;break
 for q in nbors(p):

  prev[q]=p;queue.append(q)
if end is None:raise ValueError('no defense feed')

while end is not None:path.append(end);end=prev[end]
path.reverse()
reserved.difference_update(bankcells)
# Split the existing copper conveyor to supply the bank, without free items/unloaders.
source=path[0]
for i,o in enumerate(plans):
 if o[1:3]==source and o[0]=='conveyor':plans[i]=('inverted-sorter',source[0],source[1],0,'copper');break
for i,p in enumerate(path[1:-1],1):
 q=path[i+1];rot={(1,0):0,(0,1):1,(-1,0):2,(0,-1):3}[q[0]-p[0],q[1]-p[1]];add('conveyor',*p,rot)
for j in range(length):
 cx,cy=x+j*dx,y+j*dy
 add('router',cx,cy);add('duo',cx-dy,cy+dx);add('duo',cx+dy,cy-dx)

repairnodes=[]
for j in range(0,length,3):
 for side in [-1,1]:
  q=(x+j*dx+3*side*dy,y+j*dy-3*side*dx)
  if free({q}):add('mender',*q);repairnodes.append(q)
for ax in range(core[0]-6,core[0]+7,3):
 for ay in range(core[1]-6,core[1]+7,3):
  if len([p for p in plans if p[0]=='combustion-generator'])>=int(os.environ.get('PILOT_GENERATORS','3')):break
  if free(cells(ax,ay,2)):add('combustion-generator',ax,ay,size=2);repairnodes.append((ax,ay))
# Power nodes use native auto-link, distributed over the bank/base at <=6 tile intervals.
for ax in range(core[0]-7,core[0]+12,4):
 for ay in range(core[1]-7,core[1]+15,4):
  if free({(ax,ay)}):add('power-node',ax,ay)
# Coal pickup depots are genuine drills; no conveyor drains their inventories.

 candidates=[]
 for ax,ay in R:

   candidates.append(((ax-core[0])**2+(ay-core[1])**2,ax,ay))
 _,ax,ay=min(candidates);add('mechanical-drill',ax,ay,size=2)
# Two paid wall perimeters around the core and the native ammunition bank.
bx0=min(core[0]-4,min(p[0] for p in bankcells)-2);bx1=max(core[0]+4,max(p[0] for p in bankcells)+2)
by0=min(core[1]-4,min(p[1] for p in bankcells)-2);by1=max(core[1]+4,max(p[1] for p in bankcells)+2)

for layer in range(2):
 xa,xb,ya,yb=bx0-layer,bx1+layer,by0-layer,by1+layer
 wallcells={(xx,ya) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xx,yb) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xa,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}|{(xb,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}
 for q in sorted(wallcells,key=lambda z:-(z[0]+z[1])):

 if free(cs) and sum(R[p]['ore']=='coal' for p in cells(x,y,2))>=1 and any(q in reachable for p in cells(x+2,y,2) for q in nbors(p) if q not in cs):
````

````python
 wallcells={(xx,ya) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xx,yb) for xx in range(xa,xb+1)}|{(xa,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}|{(xb,yy) for yy in range(ya,yb+1)}
````

````python
for _ in range(6):
 try:drill('copper')
 except ValueError:break
# Native conveyors cannot cross water; restrict modules to the core land component.
reachable=set(targets);q=collections.deque(targets)
while q:
 p=q.popleft()
 for z in nbors(p):
  if z not in reachable and z in R and R[z]['liquid']=='false' and (z not in reserved or z in belt):reachable.add(z);q.append(z)

candidates=[]
for x,y in R:

  for sign in [-1,1]:
   vx,vy=-uy*sign,ux*sign
````

## plan_preparation_sand_belts.py

Paid logistics extension for the captured preparation map, never a formal layout.

SHA-256：`d55d62e6eaf0d11ca1e60a32e2398bd704fbd3e99a65133391028fed6339460f`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Paid logistics extension for the captured preparation map, never a formal layout."""
import csv,collections
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open(ROOT/'campaign-crateredBattleground-layout.csv')))
terrain={(int(r['x']),int(r['y'])):r for r in csv.DictReader(open(ROOT/'results/tiles-crateredBattleground.csv'))}
large={'mechanical-drill','pneumatic-drill','graphite-press','combustion-generator','silicon-smelter','scatter','kiln'}
blocked=set();belts={};sand=[]
for row in rows:
    x,y=int(row['x']),int(row['y']);size=2 if row['block'] in large else 1
    footprint={(x+i,y+j) for i in range(size) for j in range(size)};blocked|=footprint
    if row['block']=='conveyor':belts[x,y]=int(row['rotation'])
    if row['block']=='mechanical-drill' and sum(terrain[p]['ore']=='sand' for p in footprint)>=2 and all(terrain[p]['ore'] in ['', 'sand'] for p in footprint):sand.append((x,y))
directions=[(1,0),(0,1),(-1,0),(0,-1)]
core={(x,y) for x in range(93,96) for y in range(54,57)}
def reaches_core(point):
    seen=set()
    while point in belts and point not in seen:
        seen.add(point);dx,dy=directions[belts[point]];point=point[0]+dx,point[1]+dy
    return point in core
rooted={p for p in belts if reaches_core(p)}
new=[]
def free(point):
    t=terrain.get(point)
    return t is not None and point not in blocked and t['solid']=='false' and t['liquid']=='false' and t['block']=='air'
for mx,my in sand:
    footprint={(mx+i,my+j) for i in range(2) for j in range(2)}
    starts=sorted({(x+dx,y+dy) for x,y in footprint for dx,dy in directions if (x+dx,y+dy) not in footprint and free((x+dx,y+dy))})
    queue=collections.deque(starts);parent={p:None for p in starts};found=None
    while queue and found is None:
        point=queue.popleft()
        for direction,(dx,dy) in enumerate(directions):
            nxt=point[0]+dx,point[1]+dy
            if nxt in rooted and belts[nxt]!=(direction+2)%4:found=(point,nxt);break
            if nxt not in parent and free(nxt):parent[nxt]=point;queue.append(nxt)
    if found is None:print('No terrain-safe paid belt route:',mx,my);continue
    point,target=found;path=[]
    while point is not None:path.append(point);point=parent[point]
    previous=target
    for point in path:
        direction=directions.index((previous[0]-point[0],previous[1]-point[1]))
        new.append(('conveyor',*point,direction,''));belts[point]=direction;rooted.add(point);blocked.add(point);previous=point
    print('Native sand mine',mx,my,'paid conveyor tiles',len(path),'joins existing core-bound network',target)
with (ROOT/'campaign-crateredBattleground-sand-logistics.csv').open('w') as f:
    w=csv.writer(f);w.writerow(['block','x','y','rotation','config']);w.writerows(new)
print('Total additional paid conveyors',len(new),'sand mines',len(sand))
````

````python
"""Nonformal third preparation layout: relocate paid generators onto actual coal drill outputs; add a paid buffer."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,json

with (R/'results/tiles-ruinousShores.csv').open() as f:tiles={(int(r['x']),int(r['y'])):r for r in csv.DictReader(f)}
generators={(222,109),(220,113),(222,114),(222,116)}

for row in old:
 if row['block']=='combustion-generator':continue
 if row['block']=='graphite-press' and (int(row['x']),int(row['y'])) in generators:row={**row,'block':'combustion-generator'}
 rows.append(row)

 used|={(int(r['x'])+dx,int(r['y'])+dy) for dx in range(size) for dy in range(size)}
# Preserve map buildings/core and every paid prior layout footprint.
used|={p for p,r in tiles.items() if r['block']!='air' and not r['block'].endswith('boulder')}
for _ in range(8):
 choices=[((x-212)**2+(y-106)**2,x,y) for x in range(200,224) for y in range(100,125) if (x,y) not in used and (x,y) in tiles and tiles[x,y]['liquid']=='false']
 _,x,y=min(choices);rows.append({'block':'battery','x':str(x),'y':str(y),'rotation':'0','config':''});used.add((x,y))
# Two paid repair sites for remote generators (not overlapping drills or belts).

 choices=[((x-gx)**2+(y-gy)**2,x,y) for x in range(gx-3,gx+4) for y in range(gy-3,gy+4) if (x,y) not in used and (x,y) in tiles and tiles[x,y]['liquid']=='false']
 _,x,y=min(choices);rows.append({'block':'mender','x':str(x),'y':str(y),'rotation':'0','config':''});used.add((x,y))

 if r['block'] in ['mechanical-drill','graphite-press','combustion-generator']:return 0
 if r['block'] in ['power-node','battery','mender']:return 1
 if r['block']=='copper-wall':return 3
````

## plan_ruinous_preparation_v5.py

Nonformal fourth Ruinous layout: sustain graphite, add an inner repaired line and powered close defense.

SHA-256：`51a2f9f41c8a8881d19d563ac57b9bfd57e587b5fbd48c73aa08d072b09dc381`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Nonformal fourth Ruinous layout: sustain graphite, add an inner repaired line and powered close defense."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
with (ROOT / "campaign-ruinousShores-v4-layout.csv").open() as source:
    original = list(csv.DictReader(source))
with (ROOT / "results/tiles-ruinousShores.csv").open() as source:
    tiles = {(int(row["x"]), int(row["y"])): row for row in csv.DictReader(source)}

# Attempt 3 had excess real power but only two graphite presses. Restore two of
# the paid coal modules to presses; replacement generators are paid below.
restored_presses = {(222, 109), (220, 113)}
rows = []
for row in original:
    position = (int(row["x"]), int(row["y"]))
    if row["block"] == "combustion-generator" and position in restored_presses:
        row = {**row, "block": "graphite-press"}
    rows.append(row)

size2 = {"mechanical-drill", "graphite-press", "combustion-generator", "scatter"}
used = set()
for row in rows:
    size = 2 if row["block"] in size2 else 1
    used |= {(int(row["x"]) + dx, int(row["y"]) + dy)
             for dx in range(size) for dy in range(size)}
used |= {position for position, tile in tiles.items()
         if tile["block"] != "air" and not tile["block"].endswith("boulder")}

added = set()


def add(block, x, y, size=1):
    footprint = {(x + dx, y + dy) for dx in range(size) for dy in range(size)}
    assert not footprint & used, (block, x, y, footprint & used)
    assert all(position in tiles and tiles[position]["liquid"] == "false" for position in footprint)
    rows.append({"block": block, "x": str(x), "y": str(y), "rotation": "0", "config": ""})
    used.update(footprint)
    added.add((block, x, y))


# Four replacement generators retain the measured power margin while four
# presses continuously create real graphite. Two nodes join them to the paid grid.
for x, y in [(224, 109), (224, 112), (224, 119), (224, 122)]:
    add("combustion-generator", x, y, 2)
for x, y in [(223, 111), (223, 122)]:
    add("power-node", x, y)

# These menders are inside the eventual firing line. They consume generated
# power and repair the second line through normal engine mechanics.
for x, y in [(203, 120), (207, 120), (211, 120), (215, 120)]:
    add("mender", x, y)

# Arc is already earned in the Bio checkpoint. These four paid, powered turrets
# cover the core's west/south approaches without creating ammunition.
for x, y in [(200, 113), (202, 113), (200, 117), (202, 117)]:
    add("arc", x, y)

# Attempt 3's direct attackers came from west and south. This paid inner line is
# closer to the existing menders than the outer line and intercepts projectiles.
inner_walls = {(203, y) for y in range(111, 120)}
inner_walls |= {(x, y) for y in (121, 122) for x in range(200, 218)}
for x, y in sorted(inner_walls, key=lambda p: (p[1], p[0])):
    add("copper-wall", x, y)


def rank(row):
    key = (row["block"], int(row["x"]), int(row["y"]))
    if row["block"] in {"mechanical-drill", "graphite-press", "combustion-generator"}:
        return 0
    if row["block"] in {"power-node", "battery", "mender"}:
        return 1
    if row["block"] != "copper-wall":
        return 2
    return 3 if (int(row["x"]), int(row["y"])) in inner_walls else 4


rows.sort(key=rank)
destination = ROOT / "campaign-ruinousShores-v5-layout.csv"
with destination.open("w", newline="") as target:
    writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=list(original[0]))
    writer.writeheader()
    writer.writerows(rows)
print(f"Preparation-only paid orders: {len(rows)}; presses="
      f"{sum(row['block'] == 'graphite-press' for row in rows)}; generators="
      f"{sum(row['block'] == 'combustion-generator' for row in rows)}; inner_walls={len(inner_walls)}")
````

## plot_formal.py

Export research figures from actual accepted route summaries only.

SHA-256：`cd0dc1284a745ae078dac4626c5b399843d38f41cef3305818ed0b6c90f00dca`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Export research figures from actual accepted route summaries only."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,csv,json
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR',str(ROOT/'plot-cache'))
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
P=ROOT/'report';OUT=P/'figures';OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
def read(name):
    p=P/name
    if not p.exists():return []
    with p.open() as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))
def save(fig,name):
    fig.savefig(OUT/(name+'.png'),dpi=180,bbox_inches='tight');fig.savefig(OUT/(name+'.pdf'),bbox_inches='tight');plt.close(fig)
groups=['G0','G1','G2','G3'];colors=dict(zip(groups,['#64748b','#0d9488','#c2410c','#6d28d9']))
rates=[r for r in read('route_completion.csv') if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0 and r['group'] in groups]
complete=len(rates)==8 and all(int(r['valid_routes'])>=30 for r in rates)
phase='Main experiment' if complete else 'Interim execution (unfinished routes omitted; no group inference)'
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(10,3.7),sharey=True)
for ax,policy in zip(axes,['balanced','defensive']):
    for i,g in enumerate(groups):
        matches=[r for r in rates if r['policy']==policy and r['group']==g]
        if not matches:continue
        r=matches[0];p=float(r['completion_rate']);lo=float(r['wilson_low']);hi=float(r['wilson_high'])
        ax.errorbar(i,p,yerr=[[max(0,p-lo)],[max(0,hi-p)]],fmt='o',capsize=5,color=colors[g],markersize=7)
        ax.text(i,min(1.07,hi+.06),f'n={r["valid_routes"]}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
    ax.set(xticks=range(4),xticklabels=groups,title=policy,ylim=(-.04,1.15));ax.axhline(.9,linestyle='--',color='#94a3b8',linewidth=1);ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Three-stage route completion (Wilson 95% CI)');fig.suptitle(phase,fontsize=11);fig.tight_layout();save(fig,'route_completion')
pressure=read('pressure.csv');fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,3.8),sharey=True)
for ax,policy in zip(axes,['balanced','defensive']):
    has_data=False
    for g in groups:
        rs=sorted([r for r in pressure if r['policy']==policy and r['group']==g and r['cell_complete']=='True'],key=lambda r:float(r['alpha']))
        if not rs:continue
        has_data=True
        x=np.array([float(r['alpha']) for r in rs]);y=np.array([float(r['completion_rate']) for r in rs]);lo=np.array([float(r['wilson_low']) for r in rs]);hi=np.array([float(r['wilson_high']) for r in rs])
        ax.plot(x,y,'o-',label=g,color=colors[g],markersize=3);ax.fill_between(x,lo,hi,color=colors[g],alpha=.10)
    ax.axhline(.9,color='#475569',linestyle='--',linewidth=1);ax.set(xlim=(-.03,2.03),ylim=(-.03,1.03),xlabel='Additive pressure alpha',title=policy);ax.grid(alpha=.2)
    if ax.lines and ax.get_legend_handles_labels()[0]:ax.legend(fontsize=8)
    if not has_data:ax.text(.5,.5,'No complete 20-seed cells yet',transform=ax.transAxes,ha='center',va='center',color='#475569')
axes[0].set_ylabel('Route completion; only complete 20-seed cells');fig.tight_layout();save(fig,'pressure_scan')
ops=[r for r in read('operations.csv') if r['track']=='S' and r['chain']=='A' and float(r['alpha'])==0 and r['group'] in groups]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(2,3,figsize=(12,6),sharey=False)
for j,policy in enumerate(['balanced','defensive']):
    for i,stage in enumerate('ABC'):
        ax=axes[j,i];bottom=np.zeros(4)
        for category,color in [('expand','#0d9488'),('defense','#6366f1'),('rebuild','#d97706')]:
            vals=[]
            for g in groups:
                r=next((r for r in ops if r['policy']==policy and r['stage']==stage and r['group']==g),None);vals.append(float(r[category+'_absolute_seconds_mean']) if r and r[category+'_absolute_seconds_mean'] else 0)
            ax.bar(groups,vals,bottom=bottom,color=color,label=category);bottom+=vals
        ax.set(title=f'{policy} / stage {stage}',ylabel='Mean actual construction seconds');ax.grid(axis='y',alpha=.2)
        for gi,g in enumerate(groups):
            r=next((r for r in ops if r['policy']==policy and r['stage']==stage and r['group']==g),None)
            ax.text(gi,bottom[gi],f'n={r["reached"] if r else 0}',ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=8)
axes[0,0].legend(fontsize=8);fig.suptitle('Observed stages only; inspect arrival and survival exposure before interpreting',fontsize=11);fig.tight_layout();save(fig,'construction_operations')
snapshot=json.loads((P/'analysis_manifest.json').read_text())
s_handled=len(snapshot['valid_route_files'])+len(snapshot['invalid_route_files'])==4500
c_summary=json.loads((P/'C-calibration.json').read_text()) if (P/'C-calibration.json').exists() else {'status':'not_started','completed_route_cells':0}
(OUT/'figure_metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps({'accepted_primary_group_rows':len(rates),'main_each_group_30_valid_routes':complete,'figures_are_final':s_handled and c_summary['completed_route_cells']==40,'S_execution_complete':s_handled,'data':'report CSV files derived from frozen/S-v2 accepted routes','intervals':'Wilson95%; no wave treated as an independent replicate','G':'protocol not applicable by user choice','C':{'status':c_summary['status'],'completed_route_cells':c_summary['completed_route_cells'],'not_pooled_with_S':True}},indent=2)+'\n')
print('Saved accepted-data figures to',OUT)
````
