## repeat_formal_acceptance.py

Cross-check an actual accepted winning seed; repeated runs add zero independent N.

SHA-256：`edff50d0fb2a461815276ab203519eef487cf5c35bd03f12c284257ba50005cc`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Cross-check an actual accepted winning seed; repeated runs add zero independent N."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,gzip,json,subprocess,hashlib
from verify_recorder import verify
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=ROOT/'formal/S-A-balanced-G2-a00-s1001/A-attempt1.csv'
inv=json.loads(Path(str(source)+'.invocation.json').read_text())
def read(p):return p.read_bytes() if p.exists() else gzip.open(str(p)+'.gz','rb').read()
hashes={}
for observe,name,port in [(True,'formal-winning-repeat',45200),(False,'formal-winning-observer-off',45201)]:
    out=ROOT/'results'/(name+'.csv');cmd=inv['command'].copy()
    cmd=[f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={port}' if v.startswith('-Dmindustry.eval.port=') else f'-Dmindustry.eval.carryOut={out}.carry.csv' if v.startswith('-Dmindustry.eval.carryOut=') else f'-Dmindustry.eval.formalRecorder={str(observe).lower()}' if v.startswith('-Dmindustry.eval.formalRecorder=') else str(out) if v==str(source) else v for v in cmd]
    with (ROOT/'logs'/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=inv['cwd'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    assert r.returncode==0,(name,r.returncode)
    suffixes=['','.events.csv','.batches.csv','.windows.csv','.stages.csv','.carry.csv'] if observe else ['','.carry.csv']
    if observe:verify(out)
    for suffix in suffixes:
        a=read(Path(str(source)+suffix));b=read(Path(str(out)+suffix))
        assert a==b,(name,'mismatch',suffix)
        hashes[(name+':'+suffix)]=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest()
result=dict(passed=True,source=str(source),actual_formal_winning_seed=1001,group='G2',observer_on_off_identical=True,repeated_all_csvs_and_source_debit_identical=True,additional_independent_samples=0,sha256=hashes)
````

## report_provenance.py

生成全部已保存代码、尝试、G0流程、公式和可核实成本附录。

SHA-256：`50208a447a5a89a45b588c34b8dffa348fc79c48a6098eab3b58c5799dc9aa84`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Generate saved-attempt history, executable source catalogue, fixed policy manual and honest cost scope."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import ast, csv, gzip, hashlib, json, os, re

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = ROOT / 'report'
LOCAL = ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')
CODE_SUFFIXES = {'.py', '.java', '.sh', '.patch'}


def sha(path):
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as source:
        for block in iter(lambda: source.read(1024 * 1024), b''):
            h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()


def load(path, default=None):
    p = ROOT / path
    return json.loads(p.read_text()) if p.exists() else default


def write_csv(name, rows, fields):
    with (OUT / name).open('w') as target:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(target, fieldnames=fields)
        writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(rows)


def table(headers, rows):
    def cell(value):
        return str(value).replace('|', '\\|').replace('\n', ' ')
    return '\n'.join(['| ' + ' | '.join(headers) + ' |', '|' + '|'.join('---' for _ in headers) + '|'] +
                     ['| ' + ' | '.join(cell(v) for v in row) + ' |' for row in rows])


def moment(timestamp):
    return datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp, timezone.utc).astimezone(LOCAL).isoformat()


def purpose(path, content):
    name = path.name
    known = {
        'Pilot.java': '固定布局自动玩家：原生采矿、物流、施工、补给和防守；S服务器启动与推进。',
        'AttackSupport.java': '原生造兵、重构、集结与RTS指令；realtime版本仅适配原生帧的检查时机。',
        'FormalRecorder.java': 'S只读事件、库存、波次、窗口、里程碑与有效性记录器。',
        'AuditRecorder.java': '较早的审计记录器/观察不变性检查；是否正式使用以冻结清单为准。',
        'EvaluationParameters.java': '玩家队伍专用参数分派，含主组、拆分、消融、X和α。',
        'EvaluationTrace.java': '原生引擎调用的可选观测接口及因果上下文传递。',
        'RealtimeCampaign.java': '真实SDL客户端原生战役、付费研究和发射、连续路线及原生时钟。',
        'RealtimeRecorder.java': 'C原生可变帧记录、库存、波次、窗口和里程碑。',
        'NativeCalibrationPolicy.java': '同几何布局的合法科技前沿和一级兵种适配。',
        'NativeCAdmission.java': '冻结C版本、入口档、种子、类加载来源和帧率准入核对。',
        'NativeCampaignStage.java': '非正式战役前置：真实通关、研究、发射和备料。',
        'NativeCampaignCheckpoint.java': '成对保存地图与全局战役元数据并独立读回校验。',
        'PreparationHailAmmo.java': '非正式准备的原生冰雹补弹；各历史版本按路径和哈希区分。',
        'run_formal.py': '执行S预注册矩阵、同种子技术重试、保存阶段与路线结果。',
        'run_calibration.py': '从冻结合法入口复制独立档，执行40条原生实时C路线。',
        'analyze_formal.py': '从已接受S原始记录计算运行等权与配对统计。',
        'analyze_calibration.py': 'C独立统计、支付、帧质量和S/C方向校准。',
        'derive_verdicts.py': '按数值阈值生成判定；明确保守样本解释和点阈值敏感性。',
        'build_report.py': '汇总实际证据生成报告；矩阵未齐时保留非最终标识。',
        'package_deliverables.py': '所有执行写入结束且审计通过后打包，并验证包内逐文件哈希。',
        'report_provenance.py': '生成全部已保存代码、尝试、G0流程、公式和可核实成本附录。',
    }
    if name in known:
        return known[name]
    if path.suffix == '.py':
        try:
            doc = ast.get_docstring(ast.parse(content))
            if doc:
                return doc.splitlines()[0]
        except SyntaxError:
            pass
    match = re.search(r'/\*\*(.*?)\*/', content, re.S)
    if match:
        return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', match.group(1).replace('*', '')).strip()
    if name.startswith(('plan_', 'generate_', 'close_', 'core_ammo_', 'lancer_')):
        return '布局规划/候选生成；不能仅凭脚本存在认定对应游戏尝试已执行。'
    if name.startswith(('add_', 'append_')):
        return '历史源码补丁或记录器生成辅助；最终有效代码以冻结JAR及清单为准。'
    return '保存的项目源代码/历史快照；具体执行身份须结合调用清单和运行日志核对。'


def code_catalogue():
    files = sorted(p for p in ROOT.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in CODE_SUFFIXES or p.name.endswith('.py.txt'))
                   and not any(part in ['__pycache__', 'cache', '.git', 'deliverables'] for part in p.relative_to(ROOT).parts))
    by_hash = defaultdict(list)
    for path in files:
        by_hash[sha(path)].append(path)
    records = []
    unique = []
    for digest, copies in sorted(by_hash.items(), key=lambda item: min(str(p.relative_to(ROOT)) for p in item[1])):
        # Prefer an actual frozen source, then root/src/runtime helpers, over per-run copies.
        def rank(p):
            rel = p.relative_to(ROOT)
            return (0 if rel.parts[0] == 'frozen' else 1 if len(rel.parts) == 1 or rel.parts[0] in ['src', 'runtime-container'] else 2,
                    len(rel.parts), str(rel))
        primary = min(copies, key=rank)
        content = primary.read_text(errors='replace')
        description = purpose(primary, content)
        label = 'frozen' if primary.relative_to(ROOT).parts[0] == 'frozen' else 'current_or_historical_saved_source'
        for path in copies:
            records.append(dict(path=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), sha256=digest, bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                                lines=len(content.splitlines()), primary_path=str(primary.relative_to(ROOT)),
                                identical_copies=len(copies), scope=label, purpose=description,
                                executable_presence_does_not_prove_execution=True))
        unique.append((primary, digest, copies, content, description))
    write_csv('全部脚本与源码清单.csv', records, ['path', 'sha256', 'bytes', 'lines', 'primary_path', 'identical_copies', 'scope', 'purpose', 'executable_presence_does_not_prove_execution'])
    index = ['# 全部已保存脚本与源码索引', '',
             f'发现{len(files)}个源文件路径、{len(unique)}种不同字节内容。逐运行保存的同内容副本按SHA-256去重展示，但CSV保留每一个路径。', '',
             '这是本项目保存的评测代码目录，不是整个Mindustry/Arc仓库源码目录。原生游戏的26处修改另列于源码附录；其余未修改原生代码由固定提交和构建JAR绑定。存在文件不表示该文件一定被执行；实际执行以尝试记录、invocation和原始日志为准。未保存或被覆盖且无快照的临时终端命令无法凭空还原。', '',
             table(['主要路径', '相同副本数', '行数', '用途'],
                   [[f'[{p.relative_to(ROOT)}](../{p.relative_to(ROOT)})', len(copies), len(content.splitlines()), desc]
                    for p, digest, copies, content, desc in unique]), '',
             '完整逐路径清单：[全部脚本与源码清单.csv](全部脚本与源码清单.csv)。逐字节代码汇编：[全部脚本代码.md](全部脚本代码.md)。']
    (OUT / '全部脚本索引.md').write_text('\n'.join(index) + '\n')
    with (OUT / '全部脚本代码.md').open('w') as target:
        target.write('# 全部已保存评测代码（按内容去重）\n\n代码仅作为审计材料展示。各历史版本是否进入统计，由冻结清单和尝试索引确定。\n\n')
        for p, digest, copies, content, desc in unique:
            lang = 'python' if p.name.endswith('.py.txt') else {'.py': 'python', '.java': 'java', '.sh': 'bash', '.patch': 'diff'}[p.suffix]
            fence = '`' * max(4, max((len(m.group()) + 1 for m in re.finditer(r'`{3,}', content)), default=4))
            target.write(f'## {p.relative_to(ROOT)}\n\n{desc}\n\nSHA-256：`{digest}`；同内容路径数：{len(copies)}。完整别名见CSV。\n\n{fence}{lang}\n{content}')
            if not content.endswith('\n'):
                target.write('\n')
            target.write(f'{fence}\n\n')
    return dict(saved_source_paths=len(files), distinct_source_contents=len(unique),
                catalogue='全部脚本与源码清单.csv', code_book='全部脚本代码.md', index='全部脚本索引.md')


def history():
    records = []
    fields = ['record_id', 'scope', 'formal_inclusion', 'policy', 'group', 'seed', 'chain', 'stage', 'map',
              'terminal_status', 'terminal_detail', 'effective_seconds', 'native_wave', 'wall_seconds',
              'wall_scope', 'physical_execution_key', 'reused_prefix', 'source_artifact', 'source_sha256_at_indexing', 'artifact_mtime_local']
    def add(path, **values):
        row = {key: '' for key in fields}
        row.update(record_id=len(records) + 1, source_artifact=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                   source_sha256_at_indexing=sha(path), artifact_mtime_local=moment(path.stat().st_mtime))
        row.update(values);records.append(row)
    suffixes = ('.events.csv', '.audit-events.csv', '.batches.csv', '.windows.csv', '.stages.csv', '.spawns.csv', '.carry.csv', '.layout.csv', '.probe.csv')
    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'results').glob('*.csv')):
        if path.name.endswith(suffixes):
            continue
        with path.open() as source:
            reader = csv.DictReader(source)
            if reader.fieldnames != ['seq', 'tick', 'event', 'detail']:
                add(path, scope='component_or_survey_data_not_full_game',formal_inclusion=False,
                    terminal_status='saved_component_or_survey_result',terminal_detail='Data file only; execution/pass scope must be verified against its companion proof/log, not inferred from existence')
                continue
            start = config = end = None
            for row in reader:
                if row['event'] == 'start':start = row
                elif row['event'] == 'configuration':config = row
                elif row['event'] == 'end':end = row
        d = end['detail'] if end else ''
        start_detail = start['detail'] if start else ''
        def value(text, name):
            match = re.search(r'(?:^|[ ;])' + name + r'=([^ ;]+)', text)
            return match.group(1) if match else ''
        wall = ''
        log = ROOT / 'logs' / (path.stem + '.log')
        if end and log.exists():
            matches = re.findall(r'END won=(true|false) wave=(\d+) sim_seconds=([\d.]+) wall_seconds=([\d.eE+-]+)', log.read_text(errors='replace'))
            if matches:
                won, wave, sim, elapsed = matches[-1]
                if won == value(d, 'won') and abs(float(sim) - float(end['tick']) / 60) < .1:
                    wall = float(elapsed)
        add(path, scope='nonformal_search_or_diagnostic', formal_inclusion=False,
            group=value(config['detail'], 'group') if config else '', seed=value(start_detail, 'seed'),
            map=start_detail.split(' ')[0] if start_detail else '',
            terminal_status='won' if value(d, 'won') == 'true' else 'not_won' if end else 'no_saved_end_record',
            terminal_detail=d, effective_seconds=float(end['tick']) / 60 if end else '', native_wave=value(d, 'wave'),
            wall_seconds=wall, wall_scope='matched native loop wall only, excludes initialization' if wall != '' else '',
            physical_execution_key=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
    for directory, scope in [('formal', 'S_v2_stage_attempt'), ('formal-rejected-v1', 'S_v1_uniformly_rejected_stage_attempt')]:
        for path in sorted((ROOT / directory).glob('*/*-attempt*.csv.result.json')):
            data = json.loads(path.read_text());summary = data.get('summary', {})
            reused = bool(data.get('reused_from'))
            add(path, scope=scope, formal_inclusion=directory == 'formal' and data.get('accepted', False),
                policy=summary.get('policy', ''), group=summary.get('group', ''), seed=summary.get('seed', ''), chain=summary.get('chain', ''),
                terminal_status='reused_prefix_reference' if reused else 'won' if data.get('accepted') and data.get('won') else 'valid_game_failure' if data.get('accepted') else 'technical_invalid_attempt',
                terminal_detail=data.get('technical_error', summary.get('terminal_reason', '')),
                effective_seconds=summary.get('sim_seconds', ''), wall_seconds='' if reused else data.get('wall_seconds', ''),
                wall_scope='runner stage attempt; not CPU; source reused wall excluded' if reused else 'runner stage attempt; not CPU',
                stage=data.get('stage', path.name[0]), physical_execution_key=data.get('path', str(path)),
                reused_prefix=reused)
        for path in sorted((ROOT / directory).glob('*/route.json')):
            data = json.loads(path.read_text())
            add(path, scope='S_route_logical_summary' if directory == 'formal' else 'S_v1_rejected_logical_route',
                formal_inclusion=directory == 'formal' and data['valid'], policy=data['policy'], group=data['group'],
                seed=data['seed'], chain=data['chain'], terminal_status='complete' if data['complete'] else 'not_complete',
                terminal_detail='Logical route summary, not another physical execution or wall-cost item')
        for path in sorted((ROOT/directory).glob('*/*-attempt*.csv.invocation.json')):
            receipt=Path(str(path).removesuffix('.invocation.json')+'.result.json')
            if not receipt.exists():
                add(path,scope=scope+'_without_saved_receipt',formal_inclusion=False,
                    terminal_status='in_progress_or_interrupted_no_saved_acceptance',
                    terminal_detail='Retained invocation without accepted end/result; not fabricated as a win or loss',
                    physical_execution_key=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).removesuffix('.invocation.json'))
    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'calibration').glob('*/attempt*/attempt-result.json')):
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        add(path, scope='C_formal_route_attempt', formal_inclusion=data['accepted'], policy=data['policy'],
            group=data['group'], seed=data['seed'], chain=data['chain'], terminal_status='complete' if data.get('complete') else 'valid_game_failure' if data['accepted'] else 'technical_invalid_attempt',
            terminal_detail=data.get('technical_error', data.get('native_route', {}).get('reason', '')),
            wall_seconds=data.get('wall_seconds', ''), wall_scope='entire route attempt; do not add its stages again',
            effective_seconds=data.get('native_route', {}).get('effective_seconds', ''), physical_execution_key=str(path.parent.relative_to(ROOT)))
    native_roots = [ROOT / 'training'] + sorted(p for p in ROOT.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and 'smoke' in p.name)
    for directory in native_roots:
        for path in sorted(directory.rglob('route.json')):
            data = json.loads(path.read_text())
            add(path, scope='C_nonformal_native_training_or_smoke', formal_inclusion=False,
                policy=data.get('policy', ''), group=data.get('group', ''), seed=data.get('seed', ''),
                terminal_status='complete' if data.get('complete') else 'not_complete', terminal_detail=data.get('reason', ''),
                effective_seconds=data.get('effective_seconds', ''), wall_seconds=data.get('wall_seconds', ''),
                wall_scope='native nonformal route wall; do not add its stages again', physical_execution_key=str(path.parent.relative_to(ROOT)))
    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'campaign-preparation').rglob('*.result.json')):
        if '-checkpoints' in str(path):continue
        data = json.loads(path.read_text())
        add(path, scope='C_nonformal_preparation_attempt', formal_inclusion=False, map=data.get('target', ''),
            terminal_status='captured_researched_stocked' if data.get('captured') and data.get('reason') == 'native_captured_researched_and_stocked' else 'not_completed',
            terminal_detail=data.get('reason', ''), effective_seconds=data.get('effective_seconds', ''), wall_seconds=data.get('wall_seconds', ''),
            wall_scope='native preparation attempt wall', physical_execution_key=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)))
    # Native preparation attempts without a result JSON still have indispensable
    # failure/interruption/first-generation evidence; retain their exact end events.
    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'campaign-preparation').rglob('*events.csv')):
        if '-checkpoints' in str(path):continue
        end = None;last = None
        with path.open() as source:
            reader = csv.DictReader(source)
            for row in reader:
                last = row
                if row.get('event') in ['native_preparation_end', 'preparation_end']:end = row
        if last:
            add(path, scope='C_preparation_event_evidence_not_additional_run', formal_inclusion=False,
                terminal_status='saved_end' if end else 'no_saved_end_record', terminal_detail=(end or last).get('detail', ''),
                effective_seconds=(end or last).get('effective_sim_seconds', ''),
                physical_execution_key=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).removesuffix('.events.csv'))
    for path in sorted((ROOT/'logs').glob('*')):
        if not path.is_file():continue
        text=path.read_text(errors='replace')
        status='saved_process_log'
        if 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in text:status='build_success'
        elif 'BUILD FAILED' in text:status='build_failed'
        elif re.search(r'(Traceback|Exception|\bERROR\b|AssertionError)',text):status='contains_error_text_review_context'
        add(path,scope='process_log_evidence_not_additional_run',formal_inclusion=False,
            terminal_status=status,terminal_detail='\n'.join(text.splitlines()[-8:])[-2000:])
    write_csv('全部尝试与失败流程索引.csv', records, fields)
    counts = Counter(r['scope'] for r in records)
    exploratory = [r for r in records if r['scope'] == 'nonformal_search_or_diagnostic']
    pilots = [r for r in exploratory if Path(r['source_artifact']).name.startswith('pilot-')]
    text = ['# 从头开始的实验过程与失败流程', '',

                ['通关训练与冻结', 'pilot-53属于早期stepSeed训练，不能直接当最终原生随机流基准。', '后续原生全局随机流下完成balanced/defensive链A种子0并冻结S-v2；正式seed1000–1029独立于训练。'],

def policy_manual():
    rows, summaries, segments = [], [], []
    for path in sorted((ROOT / 'frozen/S-v2/layouts').glob('*.csv')):
        policy, stage = path.stem.split('-', 1)
        with path.open() as source:orders = list(csv.DictReader(source))
        counts = Counter(o['block'] for o in orders)
        summaries.append([policy, stage, len(orders), '；'.join(f'{name}×{n}' for name, n in sorted(counts.items()))])
        begin = 1
        for i, order in enumerate(orders, 1):
            rows.append(dict(policy=policy, layout_stage=stage, order=i, block=order['block'], x=int(order['x']),
                             y=int(order['y']), rotation=int(order['rotation']), config=order['config'],
                             layout_source=str(path.relative_to(ROOT)), layout_sha256=sha(path),
                             is_blueprint_not_completed_build=True))
            if i == len(orders) or orders[i]['block'] != order['block']:
                segments.append([policy, stage, f'{begin}–{i}', order['block'],
                                 f"{orders[begin-1]['x']}:{orders[begin-1]['y']} → {order['x']}:{order['y']}"])
                begin = i + 1
    write_csv('G0固定布局逐项操作.csv', rows, ['policy', 'layout_stage', 'order', 'block', 'x', 'y', 'rotation', 'config', 'layout_source', 'layout_sha256', 'is_blueprint_not_completed_build'])
    text = '''# 最终选定的G0固定玩家策略操作手册

G0是本项目的原版数值基线，不是未修改发行版二进制的同义词。G0、G1、G2、G3使用相同版本的引擎适配、对应策略的相同布局与相同动作优先级；分组改变指定倍率，不能为某组另换布局。

项目保留两套题目要求的策略：balanced和defensive，分别报告。二者在训练种子0完成过链A，之后冻结。能找到一个通关种子不表示所有正式种子都能通关；正式失败必须进入完成率分母。

## 从服务器启动到路线结束

1. 校验`frozen/S-v2/manifest.json`内的JAR、class、源码、参数、地图和布局哈希，启动一个独立JVM。地图种子固定0，战斗种子使用预注册值。实际调用原生`world.loadMap`、`logic.play`、`net.host`，并检查服务器已真正host。每个并发进程有独立端口与数据目录。
2. 按批准协议移除玩家预置Duo/Salvo且不退款，强制关闭作弊/无限资源；S生存胜利波30，A上限8，后续上限16，建造材料倍率规则为1。G0各评测倍率均为1。保留原生地图初始物资，后续按凭证实扣实入继承，保存`.initial.msav`。
3. 原生核心调用`requestSpawn`产生玩家单位。新写的Pilot控制这名真实玩家，不另刷建设单位；按冻结CSV读入订单。坐标为原生tile锚点，旋转为原生0–3值，config按原生方块配置处理。
4. 每步先执行原生待处理任务、模拟时钟、同步寻路，再执行自动玩家动作，然后推进原生物理和`Logic.update`；1步=1tick=1/60模拟秒。不是按“资源公式”直接改库存或判定战斗胜利。
5. 动作循环按以下优先级执行。缺钱、缺料、炮毁、缺弹等会改变完成时间，但不改变预注册订单坐标；不是承诺第几分钟免费造出某建筑。
6. 生存阶段以原生胜利/失守结束；攻坚阶段以首个敌核被毁结束，第二个敌核只记录。全部核心丢失优先，随后原生胜负、首核目标、5400秒时限。失败不进入下一阶段。成功时先从源库存扣出，目标按容量接收，记录溢出；上限按A→B与B→C分别执行。

## 每步实际动作优先级

- 先检查核心和玩家是否存活；玩家本体在射程内有敌人时使用原生瞄准、武器控制。生存第30波后若超过180秒仍有敌军，原有策略会用玩家追击残敌。
- 若是攻坚，先运行AttackSupport：集结、指挥及工厂/重构厂真实物流。出击检查每300tick一次，未达门槛时原生RTS集结于核心附近。
- 随后优先为核心附近燃烧发电机取真实煤并运输；从已付费煤钻获取，攻坚时可优先用核心煤。之后处理弹药。Scatter在有飞行威胁时优先级最高，其次Salvo，再次Duo；Scatter喂铅、Salvo在正式开启earlyGraphite配置下喂石墨、Duo喂铜。所需物资从核心或实际工厂取货；核心没有铜/铅则真实采矿。
- 冰雹有威胁且空弹时，原冻结Pilot可从真实石墨压缩机取货。非正式战役准备后来使用的额外补弹优先级修补，不会悄悄覆盖这份冻结S玩家。
- 物流处理后，先恢复被毁的重要已建订单（修复、电力、关键采矿/加工与防线）；再选择冻结CSV中第一个未完成订单。按已存在的原生建筑检查完成和配置，不能只把订单索引当实际完工数。
- 在完整剩余材料不足时，先卸下/存回玩家所携物品，再采铜/铅或向真实生产设施取所需材料；有料后才提交原生`BuildPlan`，由原生施工进度和扣料完成。不会调用`setBlock`替代付费落成。放置失败只记失败并保留该坐标，不根据处理组临时改位置。
- 矿石选择限于单位可采、可接近的实际露天矿格，按距离选择；移动以单位速度执行。核心装不下时寻找能接收的真实建筑；确实无接收处才调用原生丢弃，并记录`discard`，不把丢弃当成收入。

## 三阶段与攻坚差别

主链A：stainedMountains(A，300×300，核心48:67) → windsweptIslands(B，400×400，核心116:104) → fungalPass(C，150×250，核心66:22)。备选链B：A → fungalPass → overgrowth；相同A前缀可引用，不构成独立重复。

两套A布局都计划493项，但顺序不同；B各279项；Fungal各34项；Overgrowth各30项。下表给出实际计划数量，完整坐标和相对顺序见CSV。计划里的Lancer/硅厂等不等于每次运行都实际建成，报告必须用实际施工/产出验证覆盖。

balanced在攻坚按布局建陆军工厂/重构厂，启动前收集真实石墨360、硅450、铅200；工厂配置Dagger，并将硅/石墨送入重构厂得到Mace。集结至少8个白名单单位、实际总HP≥2000后，向最近的敌核发原生RTS攻击指令，可在首批波次前完成首核目标，属于有效零批次阶段。

defensive保留工厂最初东向出口，先由原生目标要求的3个Dagger触发`unitsBuilt`，再原生旋转工厂进入重构路径；至少8单位且HP≥2000、并达到原生wave≥2后才首次出击。不直接写入目标标志。其他地图没有该教程目标时，以实际存活Dagger数作为策略里已有的对应判断。

后续重构厂硅/石墨目标缓冲各80，工厂硅/铅各20；全部来自真实库存和生产。成军白名单为dagger/mace/fortress/nova/pulsar/quasar，排除玩家代理本体，损血单位按当前HP计。

C实时校准是单独的合法战役适配：必须实际支付研究与发射费，原生发射Shard可能使B/C每兵种上限只有8；不能将S的“不扣研究、协议继承、B的Foundation核心及cap16”冒充完整原生战役。首访Fungal的重构厂需占领本关，合法适配暂缓该订单并先造Dagger，保留2000HP门槛；8个150HP Dagger仅1200HP，可能无法按冻结策略出击。不得免费解锁、改HP/上限或新增核心升级策略来强行通关。实际到达/执行须由正式C日志验证。

## 精确订单

所有坐标、旋转与配置见[G0固定布局逐项操作.csv](G0固定布局逐项操作.csv)；源文件是`frozen/S-v2/layouts/`的8张CSV，其SHA固定。下表是计划数量，随后为连续同方块订单段。每段仍以CSV逐项顺序为准，不按表中数量一次性生成建筑。
'''
    text += '\n' + table(['策略', '布局阶段', '订单数', '计划设施数量'], summaries) + '\n\n'
    text += table(['策略', '布局阶段', '订单序号（1起）', '方块', '首/末锚点'], segments) + '\n'
    examples=[]
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        candidates=[]
        for path in sorted((ROOT/'formal').glob(f'S-A-{policy}-G0-a00-s*/route.json')):
            route=json.loads(path.read_text())
            if route['valid'] and route['complete']:candidates.append(route)
        if not candidates:continue
        route=candidates[0];elapsed=0
        for stage in route['stages']:
            path=Path(stage['path']);finished_sites=set();constructed=0
            with (path.open() if path.exists() else gzip.open(str(path)+'.gz','rt')) as source:
                for record in csv.DictReader(source):
                    if record['event']=='constructed':constructed+=1;finished_sites.add(record['detail'])
            summary=stage['summary']
            examples.append(dict(policy=policy,run_id=route['run_id'],seed=route['seed'],stage=stage['stage'],
                                 won=summary['won'],stage_seconds=summary['sim_seconds'],route_seconds_at_end=elapsed+float(summary['sim_seconds']),
                                 actual_construction_end_events=constructed,distinct_completed_block_sites=len(finished_sites),
                                 salvo_combat_seconds=summary['salvo_combat_seconds'],army_formed_seconds=summary['army_formed_seconds'],
                                 first_enemy_core_seconds=summary['first_enemy_core_seconds'],batch_count=summary['batch_count'],
                                 source_artifact=stage['path'],source_freeze=route['freeze_id']))
            elapsed+=float(summary['sim_seconds'])
    write_csv('G0基准通关实例.csv',examples,['policy','run_id','seed','stage','won','stage_seconds','route_seconds_at_end','actual_construction_end_events','distinct_completed_block_sites','salvo_combat_seconds','army_formed_seconds','first_enemy_core_seconds','batch_count','source_artifact','source_freeze'])
    text+='\n## 同一冻结玩家实际完成三阶段的G0实例\n\n以下每策略取正式G0中一个已验收的通关实例，仅用于展示实际时间和已付费施工，不增加N，也不代替全部30种子的统计。不同坐标/方块曾完成数不是终点存活建筑数；施工结束事件数包含重建。\n\n'
    text+=table(['策略','正式seed','阶段','模拟秒','路线累计秒','施工完成事件','曾完成不同方块/坐标','实际批次'],[[r['policy'],r['seed'],r['stage'],f"{float(r['stage_seconds']):.2f}",f"{r['route_seconds_at_end']:.2f}",r['actual_construction_end_events'],r['distinct_completed_block_sites'],r['batch_count']] for r in examples])+'\n\n原始运行号、实际里程碑与冻结标识见[G0基准通关实例.csv](G0基准通关实例.csv)。\n'
    (OUT / 'G0固定策略操作手册.md').write_text(text)
    return dict(manual='G0固定策略操作手册.md', exact_order_file='G0固定布局逐项操作.csv',
                exact_order_rows=len(rows), plans_are_not_completed_builds=True)

    text = r'''# 真实源码、自动玩家、数据来源与计算公式

## 诚实说明执行方式

结果来自固定提交Mindustry及其Arc等依赖构建的真实JAR，在原生世界、`Logic.update`、物理、寻路、生产、库存、施工、波次与网络服务器中执行。S确实运行原生`net.host`，C确实使用SDL桌面原生战役并host服务器。不是另写一个简化游戏或用Python随机生成胜率、资源和伤亡。

同时，确实写了新代码，也直接修改了原生源码。原生代码中有26个已跟踪文件修改，新增`EvaluationParameters.java`和`EvaluationTrace.java`；新写的Java自动玩家、记录器与C战役驱动调用原生API，Python负责布局生成、JVM编排、数据验收、统计和报告。不能把这些都称为“原版自带脚本”。

G0只保证指定数值倍率为1，不能声称是完全未经修改的官方发行版：S还统一固定步长、同步求解、有序容器与模拟时钟；执行了批准的预置炮移除和协议继承/单位上限。源补丁、两份新增源文件、冻结JAR/class/布局/配置及命令都随证据保存。新代码的存在不意味着虚假游戏，但上述适配必须限定结果外推范围。

禁止物资和科技注入的约束针对玩家实际行动。S的地图起始物资以及题目规定的源扣除/目标入账继承单独记录；S不扣研究费本身就是题目S协议。C通过原生ResearchDialog与发射UI的付款方法真实扣除，保存源余额和逐项凭证。不能用S代替原生战役费用。

参数隔离验收与完整对局也必须区分。ParameterAcceptance/RecipeAcceptance使用原生Overgrowth物资、真实扣料和部件方法，但会关闭波次/胜负、选择性更新部件，并通过反射触发射击或直接推进原生施工；WavePressureAcceptance会直接设待验波号并调用原生spawnEnemies以核对数量。这些是人工控制的白盒验收，不是正常完整对局，增加的正式样本数为0。早期只读结构值检查也不能冒充真实吞吐实验；最终报告分别标明实际生产、结构阈值及未验证的范围。

S的JVM入口是本项目新写的`Pilot`，不是直接使用未修改官方ServerLauncher的默认命令。实际形式为`java [分组/seed/冻结属性] -cp frozen/S-v2/classes:frozen/S-v2/server.jar Pilot 地图 布局 输出 5400 seed`；Pilot初始化原生Vars/Logic/NetServer，调用真实net.host并按固定步推进原生方法。C入口是RealtimeCampaign，由其创建原生SDL DesktopLauncher并设置原生玩家输入；帧更新仍调用原生客户端逻辑。每次准确参数以该attempt的invocation.json为准，不以示例命令代替原记录。

正式S执行器最多并发4个独立JVM。正式C执行器计划最多并发8个独立SDL客户端，运行于同一容器的4核CPU配额下，每个客户端限制30FPS、480×360、软件渲染和单线程LLVM pipe；这会造成实际帧率和截帧比例随负载变化，不能假装每条路线稳定达到30FPS。C逐帧保存图形delta、原生实际delta、有效模拟秒与墙钟，最终报告按路线公开观察FPS、4-tick截帧比例及有效时间/墙钟比；若进程或记录验收失败，只允许同一seed再试一次并保留失败attempt。并发数是执行吞吐设置，不是额外样本量。

非正式准备期间曾通过JavaAgent在已捕获Cratered的自有存活进程中热替换补给优先级，源文件、事件和驱动快照保留；这是开发过程的一次真实控制器修改，不是从头重跑同一版本。它没有注入库存/科技/占领标志，正式S和冻结后C不做这种热修改。正式前的准备布局/物流可迭代，所有失败都保留；不能把准备迭代结果算成某处理组更优。

C未获得与S相同的逐字节重复和观察开关不变性证明；可变帧与记录开销对帧调度的影响也未被严格排除。因此“原生实时校准执行结束”不等于“题目全局确定性条款在C已全部通过”。C只作为单列的原生情境校准，不与S合并推断；G按已批准决定不适用。这是本项目完整交付中的符合性限制，不能隐去。

## 参数在哪改

调参前后比较使用同一冻结框架中的G0与G1/G2/G3等组，不能用不同开发版本的早期对局充当“调参前”。

所有分组由`frozen/S-v2/untracked-native/EvaluationParameters.java`读取JVM属性`mindustry.eval.group`与`mindustry.eval.alpha`。通过当前建筑/施工队伍与`state.rules.defaultTeam`比较，只改变玩家。倍率在实际阈值、位移、周期、请求功率、子弹创建或施工扣料处使用，不直接改全局共享方块定义来影响敌方。G0全1；G1=M/T/G/S/P；G2=H/C；G3全部；G2H/G2C、单项/去项、SP及X按该文件的switch展开，精确组表见`frozen/S-v2/parameters.json`。

| 项 | 原生调用位置 | 实际运算 | 验证范围 |
|---|---|---|---|
| M | Drill：getDrillTime(dominantItem)之后 | 含硬度最终阈值×0.8；机械铜650→520、煤700→560、气动钛550→440tick | 理论速率+25%不等于实际产量必涨25%，仍受矿格/预热/供水/堵塞影响 |
| T | Conveyor物品moved | 普通0.035→0.04375、钛0.0801→0.100125 | 物品位移×1.25，单位推力与显示不改 |
| G | GenericCrafter进度周期 | 石墨90→72tick | 实际周期×0.8；真实产出/耗料另计 |
| S | GenericCrafter进度周期 | 硅40→32tick | 同上 |
| P | ConsumePower请求 | 硅0.5→0.6/ tick | 独立提高请求功率，不免费增加供电 |
| H | Turret创建实际子弹 | 仅铜弹：Duo9→10.8、Salvo15→18 | 共享BulletType不变；石墨弹不受这项加成 |
| C | ConstructBlock剩余材料/扣料 | Math.round(原材料×1.2)：35→42；100/80/50→120/96/60 | 研究价与施工工作量不变；不跨组带入在建进度 |
| X | Drill/GenericCrafter/ConsumePower | 激光共享drillTime仍280；含硬度最终阈值×0.8，钛430→344（280→224只是无硬度示意）；功率1.10→1.32；多重周期30→24、功率1.80→2.16 | 只在X组与目标设施启用；未投入生产不能推断效果 |
| α | WaveSpawner原生数量取整之后 | 正数非boss：Java float运算下round(n×(1+α))；boss/0不改 | 每组每出生点的base/adjusted/actual逐项对账 |

共享研究、施工工作量及敌方隔离有独立原生验收。服务端与桌面共有3047个Mindustry类字节一致，但S/C标志、平台后端、原生时钟和战役情境不同；共同类一致不能证明两轨道行为等价。

## 追踪数据从哪里来

| 原生信息/事件 | 钩子/读取点 | 保存的数据 |
|---|---|---|
| 逐核心库存 | ItemModule修改入口 → EvaluationTrace.stock | stock_open、stock的before/delta/after，逐事件余额对账 |
| 实际生产 | Drill、GenericCrafter、MinerComp成功产出 → produce | 设施/单位、物品、实际数量；传输与入库不重复算产出 |
| 施工 | 原生BuildPlan/ConstructBlock、BuildBegin/End与BlockDestroy事件 | 到期订单、真实扣料、实际执行工作、放置失败、战损来源 |

| 建筑伤害与连锁 | BuildingComp、Damage、BulletType、Fires/FireComp、PowerGenerator的观测上下文 | 直接与根来源、火灾/爆炸延迟因果；未知来源不冒充敌方 |
| 炮塔缺弹与威胁 | 只读弹栈、启用/效率、敌对单位与建筑的原生类型/射程 | threat/empty炮塔·秒；不调用会换弹栈或重新选靶的接口 |
| 生产门控与停机 | 设施实际配方、输出空间、载荷/单位上限、consumer物品/液体、power.status、efficiency | 想生产、缺料/液、电力折损、零效率、效率损失、堵塞、睡眠 |
| 治疗/维修 | MendProjector、RepairTurret的heal前后，真实consumer耗材，原生功率积分 | 有效治疗HP、修复电能、实际物料消耗 |
| 里程碑与终点 | 每步末真实建筑/单位/敌核/原生GameOver状态 | 连续齐射窗口、成军、RTS攻击、首核、26–30波锁定 |
| C真实战役支付 | 原生研究付款/发射回调及实际sector余额 | 所有来源的before/paid/after；图纸消耗与搬运分别列出 |
| C时钟 | 实际Time.delta、graphics delta、state.tick与System.nanoTime | 实际有效时间、原生tick、墙钟、帧上限及截帧比例 |

S的`FormalRecorder`写`.events.csv`、`.batches.csv`、`.windows.csv`、`.stages.csv`及每出生点`.spawns.csv`；事件/主日志可能gzip压缩但未改内容。`verify_recorder.py`独立核验，Python分析只接收通过验收的route清单。C的RealtimeRecorder及verify_realtime另行执行，不冒充S完整Q3/Q4采样。

## 计算公式与精确口径

以下均为实际使用的公式，不把理论倍率当实测值。运行是独立种子的统计单位；一条路线的多波、多窗不是多个独立样本。

1. **时钟、窗口、终点。** S `t=k/60`秒，`Δt=1/60`。窗口`W_j=[300j,300(j+1))`，区间贡献按与窗口重叠的长度分配，点事件落入包含该时刻的窗；保留末尾短窗，边界点可以产生0秒窗但不求速率。C有效秒`Σ actual_Time.delta/60`，同时保存原生state.tick和墙钟，不能互换。
2. **批次时长和RMCT。** 第b批生成于`s_b`，封口且全部成员首次终止于`c_b`，阶段终止`T`；`d_b=c_b-s_b`（已清）或`d_b=T-s_b`（未清并删失）。`RMCT_r=(Σ_b d_b)/B_r`，组均值`Σ_r RMCT_r/N_有批次运行`；先运行内均值、再等权平均。零批次的RMCT为空，不填0。另列清除率`#已清/B`与early1–10/mid11–20/late21起分层。这里按题目实现的是终点截断平均，并不额外声称做了Kaplan–Meier无偏生存估计。
3. **完成、失守。** 路线完成率`p=完整三阶段成功数/N_有效路线`；阶段条件失守率`阶段失守数/实际到达数`，全路线失守口径分母为全部有效路线。未到达不当成该阶段的0时长或无失守观察。
4. **Wilson95%。** `z=1.959963984540054`，中心`(p+z²/(2N))/(1+z²/N)`，半宽`z*sqrt[p(1-p)/N+z²/(4N²)]/(1+z²/N)`，界限截于[0,1]；N=0留空。
5. **η。** `η_s=1-meanRMCT_G1,s/meanRMCT_G0,s`；任何一方没有实际批次则为空。前期≤5%、中期>10%、后期>15%三条件需同时满足且样本/输入合格；不能因零波通关宣称后期η很大。
6. **里程碑。** 路线时刻为此前完成阶段时长之和加本阶段首次真实达成时刻。未达成单独标3L=16200秒；双方都真实达成时才计算`Δ_i=(t_参考,i-t_处理,i)/60`分钟，正数为处理组提前。3L代入的差仅为另列敏感性。静态齐射需连续180秒至少3座启用且可发射；同一窗口的实战威胁齐射·秒≥90。成军要求至少8白名单单位、实际HP和≥2000。26–30锁定要求从26批起玩家建筑零损毁且26–29批均清并原生获胜。
7. **供给与需求。** `Supply_w,i=Σ实际钻头/工厂/单位采矿产出`。`Demand_w,i=加工门控满载配方需求+造兵门控满载需求+交战炮塔名义弹药需求+实际施工扣料`。S每tick的配方满载需求按`所需量×timeScale/实际周期tick`累加；造兵周期含原生unitBuildSpeed。炮塔每tick按`shot数×ammoPerShot/ammoMultiplier×reloadMultiplier×timeScale/(reload+适用的firstShotDelay)`累加；Salvo每模式4发逐发消耗，空仓记铜，不能装铜的炮塔只用原生可用最小item ID弹药倍率换算这项虚拟需求，不声称能实际喂铜。
8. **三种缺口。** 流量缺口`max(0,Demand-Supply)`；核心库存口径净短缺`max(0,Demand-Supply-窗口期初核心库存)`。到期未付是代理已释放订单的剩余材料余额；被毁未完成订单取消，新重建重新释放。欠料是余额，不跨窗口相加。阶段流量缺口累计是各窗口正缺口之和，不等于先跨窗相减再取正；核心净短缺不包含工厂/运输带/玩家携带缓冲，范围明确限定。
9. **缺弹与停机。** `Threat=Σ_b,t 1[启用且射程内有可打威胁]Δt`，`Empty=Σ1[Threat且不足以发射一次]Δt`，比例`Empty/Threat`（0分母为空）。在“想生产”门控内分别积分缺物品、缺液、`1-clamp(power.status,0,1)`、`1[efficiency≈0]`、`1-clamp(efficiency,0,1)`；可重叠，不求和当互斥停机原因。输出满与睡眠另列，不算缺料。
10. **修复与重建。** 有效修复`Σ max(0,HP_after-HP_before)`；修复电能来自原生请求/实际供电积分；修复材料来自真实消费差。重建物品当量`0.5Cu+0.7Pb+1Graphite+1Ti+0.8Si`，只加实际敌方战损重建扣料，不把所有摧毁一律归敌方。
11. **操作时间。** 开工处固定expand/defense/rebuild。每名真实施工单位每步最多贡献Δt；同一步多次施工按各类调用数分配Δt。`T_c=Σ分配到类别c的实际秒`，`f_c=T_c/(T_expand+T_defense+T_rebuild)`。另报每观察小时`3600T_c/T_observed`，不能把短命路线的少施工当救火改善。
12. **变化、配对和交互。** 比例变化`x_g/x_G0-1`（基线0无定义）；时间收益通常用`G0-g`。按共同seed形成差值，对seed配对重抽样2000次，NumPy默认生成器固定种子6021103，取2.5%和97.5%分位。完成率用处理减参考；交互`Y_ID-Y_I-Y_D+Y_0`，H×C与S×P同理。各表注明符号，未作多重检验校正；CI包含0不证明等效或可忽略。
13. **压力边界。** `p_g(α)=三阶段成功数/该档有效路线数`，每格指定20seed。`α*=max{α_j: 从0至α_j每个已测档p≥0.9}`；0档不通过则为空，测试上限通过则仅能报≥该上限。另报`max{α:p(α)≥0.9}`，不能用它替代连续边界。数量公式使用Java float32取整，Python银行家round不能直接替代。经验90%不等于总体成功概率至少90%。
14. **C费用。** 每笔`paid=source_before-source_after`；发射`paid=schematic_consumed+carried_resources`，搬运不算费用消耗；研究全部算实际消耗。共同准备历史只计一次，正式路线克隆后各自费用分列；不把失败早/未到达造成的少支出解释为效率提升。

第7章的阈值、每组路线数、实际到达/达成配对数均输出。本项目额外保守地对部分条件估计要求足够贡献配对，这不是题目另写的“30个成军成功配对”条款；机器答案明确给出这一解释和仅按每组30路线解释的点阈值敏感性，不能偷偷替换判据。

'''
    text += '\n' + table(['上游文件', '补丁起始行', '类别', '具体改动'], [[r['upstream_file'], r['patch_line'], r['kind'], r['modification']] for r in records]) + '\n'

                methods='源码改动、数据来源与公式.md', modifications='原生源码修改位置.csv',
                real_native_engine=True, new_player_recorder_and_statistics_code=True, untouched_official_binary=False)


def costs(records, execution_complete=False):
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    baseline_path = ROOT / 'results/project-accounting-origin.json'
    if baseline_path.exists():
        baseline = json.loads(baseline_path.read_text())
    else:
        logs = [p for p in (ROOT / 'logs').glob('*') if p.is_file()]
        earliest = min(logs, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
        baseline = dict(earliest_retained_log=str(earliest.relative_to(ROOT)),
                        earliest_retained_log_mtime_utc=datetime.fromtimestamp(earliest.stat().st_mtime, timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                        earliest_log_sha256_at_recording=sha(earliest),
                        exact_conversation_start_unavailable=True,
                        provenance='Retained task log filesystem timestamp; not a user-session start or active-labor measurement')
        baseline_path.write_text(json.dumps(baseline, indent=2) + '\n')
    beginning = datetime.fromisoformat(baseline['earliest_retained_log_mtime_utc'])
    runtime_origin = load('results/runtime-resource-origin.json', {})
    resource_path = ROOT / 'results/runtime-resource-snapshot.json'
    runtime = json.loads(resource_path.read_text()) if resource_path.exists() else None
    hostname = Path('/etc/hostname').read_text().strip()
    if runtime_origin and hostname == runtime_origin['container_hostname']:
        values = {}
        for line in Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat').read_text().splitlines():
            key, value = line.split();values[key] = int(value)
        runtime = dict(scope='Only this experiment Docker cgroup since its current creation; excludes earlier host execution and other tool/model work',
                       observed_at=now.astimezone(LOCAL).isoformat(), container_started_at=runtime_origin['started_at'],
                       container_hostname=hostname, cpu_stat=values, cpu_core_seconds=values['usage_usec'] / 1e6,
                       cpu_core_hours=values['usage_usec'] / 3.6e9,
                       memory_peak_bytes=int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak').read_text()),
                       cpu_max=Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max').read_text().strip(),
                       memory_max_bytes=int(Path('/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max').read_text()),
                       full_project_CPU_total=False, monetary_cost_not_inferred_from_resource_counters=True)
        resource_path.write_text(json.dumps(runtime, indent=2) + '\n')
    totals = defaultdict(lambda: dict(recorded_attempts=0, attempts_with_wall=0, recorded_wall_seconds=0.0))
    seen = set()
    for row in records:
        if not row['wall_scope'] or row['wall_seconds'] in ['', None] or row['reused_prefix'] is True:
            continue
        key = row['scope'], row['physical_execution_key']
        if key in seen:continue
        seen.add(key)
        wall = float(row['wall_seconds'])
        if wall < 0:continue
        item = totals[row['scope']];item['attempts_with_wall'] += 1;item['recorded_wall_seconds'] += wall
    for scope in totals:
        totals[scope]['recorded_attempts'] = sum(row['scope'] == scope for row in records)
    disk = defaultdict(lambda: dict(files=0, bytes=0))
    for directory in ['formal', 'formal-rejected-v1', 'results', 'campaign-preparation', 'training', 'frozen', 'logs']:
        for p in (ROOT / directory).rglob('*'):
            if p.is_file():disk[directory]['files'] += 1;disk[directory]['bytes'] += p.stat().st_size
    result = dict(as_of=now.astimezone(LOCAL).isoformat(),
                  exact_project_start=None, exact_total_active_work_seconds=None,
                  earliest_visible_log=baseline,
                  visible_elapsed_span_seconds=(now - beginning).total_seconds(),
                  visible_elapsed_includes_idle_pauses_and_parallel_work=True,
                  experiment_execution_complete=execution_complete,
                  full_project_costs_recoverable=False,
                  runtime_observed_window=runtime,
                  recorded_attempt_wall_by_scope=dict(totals),
                  summing_concurrent_wall_is_not_project_elapsed_or_CPU=True,
                  current_saved_data_by_directory=dict(disk),
                  input_tokens=None, cached_input_tokens=None, output_tokens=None, reasoning_tokens=None,
                  all_model_tokens_total=None, model_cost=None, cloud_cost=None, storage_cost=None, network_cost=None,
                  grand_total_monetary_cost=None, currency=None,
                  billing_status='Not available: no project-wide model usage/billing or cloud price invoice is exposed by the connected tools or saved project records',
                  token_numbers_not_estimated_from_words_or_tool_output_counts=True,
                  limitations=['Before-container CPU and earlier model/tool execution not metered here',
                               'File timestamp span is not exact session start, human labor or active simulation duration',
                               'Per-attempt wall clocks differ in scope, may overlap, and do not include every discarded/interrupted process',
                               'Current cgroup CPU does not include future archive compression; packaging adds a separately timed receipt',
                               'No monetary totals are inferred from absent rates or unexposed billing data'])
    (OUT / '项目耗时与成本.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    runtime_rows = []
    if runtime:
        runtime_rows = [['Docker启动', runtime['container_started_at']], ['该窗口累计CPU核时', f"{runtime['cpu_core_hours']:.4f}"],
                        ['内存峰值/字节（cgroup口径）', runtime['memory_peak_bytes']], ['CPU配额', runtime['cpu_max']],
                        ['内存上限/字节', runtime['memory_max_bytes']], ['资源读数截止', runtime['observed_at']]]
    md = ['# 项目从头开始的耗时、token与成本核算', '',
          f'核算截止：{result["as_of"]}（Asia/Shanghai）。本页如在完整实验结束前生成，只是中期核算。项目是否执行结束以主报告的最终完成标志为准。', '',
          '## 可以核实与不能核实的总量', '',
          table(['项目', '数值/结论', '口径'], [
              ['最早保留的本项目日志时间', moment(beginning.timestamp()), baseline['earliest_retained_log']],
              ['可见记录跨度/小时', f'{result["visible_elapsed_span_seconds"]/3600:.4f}', '从上述日志时间至本次截止，包含等待、进程中断与并发；不是纯模拟工时'],
              ['从用户第一次请求起的精确总时长', '无法核实', '当前工具没有完整会话起点/跨会话活动记录；不以文件mtime冒充精确起点'],
              ['全部有效/无效尝试的完整CPU总量', '无法核实', '只保存了部分墙钟和当前Docker窗口累计CPU，二者不能互换'],
              ['输入/缓存输入/输出/推理token', '全部未知（JSON为null）', '无全项目用量接口或账单；不从源码字数或终端original_token_count反推计费'],
              ['所有轮次、工具及可能的历史代理调用token总量', '无法核实', '不能以本轮可见上下文、单条工具输出或估计值替代完整token账单'],
              ['模型、云主机、存储、网络费用与总费用', '全部无法核实', '未取得实际账单、费率、币种和完整计量；不编造货币金额']]), '',
          '## 当前实验容器的可审计资源窗口', '',
          table(['指标', '值'], runtime_rows) if runtime_rows else '尚无匹配该容器的资源计量读数。', '',
          'CPU核秒=cpu.stat.usage_usec/10^6；核时再除3600。这是当前容器cgroup累积量，不包含之前在宿主环境运行的构建、失败探索、工具调用或LLM推理。内存峰值来自cgroup memory.peak，可含文件缓存，不是所有历史进程RSS之和。资源额度也不是计费金额。', '',
          '## 已保存尝试的墙钟（分口径，不互加成项目工时）', '',
          table(['类别', '有墙钟的物理记录数', '记录墙钟之和/小时', '该类索引行数'],
                [[scope, row['attempts_with_wall'], f'{row["recorded_wall_seconds"]/3600:.4f}', row['recorded_attempts']] for scope, row in sorted(totals.items())]), '',
          'S优先使用每个物理阶段attempt的执行器记录，复用A前缀不再次计墙钟；C按整条原生路线attempt计，不能再加其A/B/C子阶段。非正式主日志只在匹配的原生END日志与模拟终点一致时引用循环墙钟，且不含初始化。准备事件旁证不是另一场运行。失去结尾、未计时或被覆盖的尝试无法补造耗时。不同尝试并发，所以墙钟总和可以大于自然经过时间。', '',
          '## 当前保留数据规模', '', table(['目录', '文件数', '字节'], [[name, values['files'], values['bytes']] for name, values in sorted(disk.items())]), '',
          '上述文件数不是实验样本数；快照/副本/拒收结果与正式N分开。最终压缩包生成和逐文件验证的额外墙钟/进程CPU另记在results/delivery-completed.json，生成后才有实数。它仍不是全项目账单。', '',
          '后台推进是本地Java/Python代码执行，已保存模拟脚本不调用LLM API，容器也未开放外部网络；不是每一帧让模型生成一次结果。因此游戏tick、模拟小时、CPU核时都不能换算为模型token。模型用量发生在会话推理、代码生成与工具编排等层面，完整计量需要平台usage。', '',
          '取得实际账单后，按每个请求的实际模型/价格版本分别计算：非缓存输入token×输入单价 + 缓存输入token×缓存价 + 已计费输出token×输出价，再按计价单位归一化并求和。推理token如已含在输出计费内不得重复相加；工具费用与云资源计费另按实际账单。不能用某一个模型的当前价格给所有历史调用套算。', '',
          '如要得到全部token与货币开销，必须补充平台针对整个项目、所有会话/模型调用的实际usage导出和云账单；本项目现有证据无法回答的字段保持null，不填写推测数字。']
    (OUT / '项目耗时与成本核算.md').write_text('\n'.join(md) + '\n')
    return result


def generate(final=False):
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    attempts, past = history()
    policy = policy_manual()
    source = methods()
    catalogue = code_catalogue()
    accounting = costs(attempts, execution_complete=final)
    result = dict(final_execution=final, history=past, policy=policy, source=source,
                  code=catalogue, accounting_file='项目耗时与成本.json', accounting_as_of=accounting['as_of'],
                  tokens_and_monetary_costs_available=False)
    (OUT / '方法与过程附录.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
    return result


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(generate(), ensure_ascii=False))
````

## results/analysis-before-compaction.py.txt

保存的项目源代码/历史快照；具体执行身份须结合调用清单和运行日志核对。

SHA-256：`f45b191b41264054029386409517177cdf2fa778435d9c98a2f62b1ee5ecc852`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Derived evidence only: route-equal statistics, paired seeds, and explicit missing inputs."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,gzip,json,math,hashlib
import numpy as np
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT=ROOT/'report'
MILESTONES=['salvo_static','salvo_combat','army_formed','rts_attack','first_enemy_core','late_lock']
METRICS=['rmct_seconds','sim_seconds','empty_turret_seconds','threat_turret_seconds','missing_item_seconds','missing_liquid_seconds','power_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds','zero_efficiency_seconds','efficiency_loss_seconds','repair_effective_hp','repair_energy','grid_satisfaction','expand_seconds','defense_seconds','rebuild_seconds']

def read(path):
    path=Path(path)
    with (path.open() if path.exists() else gzip.open(str(path)+'.gz','rt')) as f:return list(csv.DictReader(f))

def write(name,rows):
    if not rows:return
    fields=list(dict.fromkeys(k for r in rows for k in r))
    with (OUT/name).open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)

def numeric(v):
    try:return float(v)
    except (ValueError,TypeError):return None

def mean(values):
    values=[v for v in values if v is not None]
    return sum(values)/len(values) if values else None

def wilson(k,n):
    if not n:return [None,None]
    z=1.959963984540054;p=k/n;den=1+z*z/n
    c=(p+z*z/(2*n))/den;r=z*math.sqrt(p*(1-p)/n+z*z/(4*n*n))/den
    return [max(0,c-r),min(1,c+r)]

def paired(a,b,sign=1):
    # a-b, same seed; bootstrapping seed pairs, never individual waves.
    ids=sorted(set(a)&set(b));delta=[sign*(a[i]-b[i]) for i in ids if a[i] is not None and b[i] is not None]
    if not delta:return dict(pairs=0,mean_difference=None,ci_low=None,ci_high=None)
    x=np.array(delta,dtype=float);rng=np.random.default_rng(6021103)
    boot=x[rng.integers(0,len(x),size=(2000,len(x)))].mean(axis=1)
    lo,hi=np.quantile(boot,[.025,.975])
    return dict(pairs=len(x),mean_difference=float(x.mean()),ci_low=float(lo),ci_high=float(hi))

def key(job):return job['track'],job['chain'],job['policy'],job['group'],float(job['alpha'])
def labels(k):return dict(zip(['track','chain','policy','group','alpha'],k))

def collect():
    routes=[];invalid=[]
    for f in sorted((ROOT/'formal').glob('*/route.json')):
        r=json.loads(f.read_text());r['route_file']=str(f)
        (routes if r['valid'] else invalid).append(r)
    return routes,invalid

def main():
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);routes,invalid=collect();(OUT/'analysis_manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'valid_route_files':[r['route_file'] for r in routes],'invalid_route_files':[r['route_file'] for r in invalid]},indent=2)+'\n');by=defaultdict(list);stages=defaultdict(list)
    for r in routes:
        by[key(r)].append(r)
        for s in r['stages']:stages[key(r)+(s['stage'],)].append((r,s))
    rates=[];stage_rows=[];tier_rows=[];milestone_rows=[];paired_rows=[];operations=[];route_milestones={}
    for k,rs in by.items():
        n=len(rs);wins=sum(r['complete'] for r in rs);lo,hi=wilson(wins,n)
        rates.append({**labels(k),'valid_routes':n,'complete_routes':wins,'completion_rate':wins/n,'wilson_low':lo,'wilson_high':hi,'core_loss_route_rate':sum(any(s['summary']['core_lost']=='true' for s in r['stages']) for r in rs)/n})
        for r in rs:
            elapsed=0;times={m:None for m in MILESTONES}
            for s in r['stages']:
                v=s['summary']
                for m in times:
                    if times[m] is None and v.get(m+'_seconds','')!='':times[m]=elapsed+float(v[m+'_seconds'])
                elapsed+=float(v['sim_seconds'])
            route_milestones[r['run_id']]=times
        for m in MILESTONES:
            vals=[route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in rs];achieved=[v for v in vals if v is not None];lo,hi=wilson(len(achieved),n)
            milestone_rows.append({**labels(k),'milestone':m,'valid_routes':n,'achieved':len(achieved),'attainment_rate':len(achieved)/n,'wilson_low':lo,'wilson_high':hi,'actual_achiever_mean_seconds':mean(achieved),'truncated_3L_mean_seconds':mean([v if v is not None else 16200 for v in vals]),'truncated_routes':n-len(achieved)})
    route_operations=[];paired_route_operations=[];route_op_values={}
    for k,rs in by.items():
        values={}
        for r in rs:
            v={category:sum(float(s['summary'][category+'_seconds']) for s in r['stages']) for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']}
            v['observed_seconds']=sum(float(s['summary']['sim_seconds']) for s in r['stages']);v['construction_seconds']=sum(v[category] for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild'])
            values[r['seed']]=v
        route_op_values[k]=values
        row={**labels(k),'valid_routes':len(rs),'exposure':'sum of observed stages; route failures remain in denominator','observed_route_seconds_mean':mean([v['observed_seconds'] for v in values.values()])}
        for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']:
            row[category+'_absolute_seconds_mean']=mean([v[category] for v in values.values()])
            row[category+'_construction_fraction_mean']=mean([v[category]/v['construction_seconds'] for v in values.values() if v['construction_seconds']>0])
            row[category+'_seconds_per_observed_hour_mean']=mean([3600*v[category]/v['observed_seconds'] for v in values.values() if v['observed_seconds']>0])
        route_operations.append(row)
    for k,values in route_op_values.items():
        if k[3]=='G0':continue
        baseline=route_op_values.get(k[:3]+('G0',k[4]),{})
        for category in ['expand','defense','rebuild']:
            for scope in ['absolute_seconds','seconds_per_observed_hour']:
                def extract(v):return v[category] if scope=='absolute_seconds' else 3600*v[category]/v['observed_seconds']
                paired_route_operations.append({**labels(k),'category':category,'scope':scope,**paired({seed:extract(v) for seed,v in baseline.items() if v['observed_seconds']>0},{seed:extract(v) for seed,v in values.items() if v['observed_seconds']>0})})
    write('route_operations.csv',route_operations);write('paired_route_operations.csv',paired_route_operations)
    for ks,pairs in stages.items():
        k=ks[:5];stage=ks[5];ss=[s['summary'] for r,s in pairs];row={**labels(k),'stage':stage,'reached':len(ss),'all_routes':len(by[k]),'won':sum(s['won']=='true' for s in ss),'core_lost':sum(s['core_lost']=='true' for s in ss),'zero_batch_runs':sum(int(s['batch_count'])==0 for s in ss),'censored_batches':sum(int(s['censored_batches']) for s in ss),'batches':sum(int(s['batch_count']) for s in ss)}
        row['core_loss_conditional_rate']=row['core_lost']/len(ss);row['core_loss_whole_route_rate']=row['core_lost']/len(by[k])
        row.update({m+'_mean':mean([numeric(s.get(m)) for s in ss]) for m in METRICS})
        row['rmct_contributing_runs']=sum(s['rmct_seconds']!='' for s in ss)
        row['clear_fraction_equal_run_mean']=mean([numeric(s['clear_fraction']) for s in ss])
        row['pooled_batch_clear_fraction']=(row['batches']-row['censored_batches'])/row['batches'] if row['batches'] else None
        row['all_clear_rmct_mean']=mean([numeric(s['rmct_seconds']) for s in ss if int(s['batch_count'])>0 and int(s['censored_batches'])==0])
        row['all_clear_runs']=sum(int(s['batch_count'])>0 and int(s['censored_batches'])==0 for s in ss)
        stage_rows.append(row)
        for tier in ['early','mid','late']:
            runmeans=[];run_clear=[];censored=total=0
            for r,s in pairs:
                bs=[b for b in read(s['path']+'.batches.csv') if b['tier']==tier]
                if bs:runmeans.append(mean([float(b['duration_seconds']) for b in bs]));run_clear.append(sum(b['cleared']=='true' for b in bs)/len(bs));total+=len(bs);censored+=sum(b['censored']=='true' for b in bs)
            tier_rows.append({**labels(k),'stage':stage,'tier':tier,'contributing_runs':len(runmeans),'batches':total,'censored_batches':censored,'rmct_seconds':mean(runmeans),'clear_fraction_equal_run_mean':mean(run_clear),'pooled_batch_clear_fraction':(total-censored)/total if total else None})
        op={**labels(k),'stage':stage,'reached':len(ss)}
        for c in ['expand','defense','rebuild']:
            op[c+'_absolute_seconds_mean']=mean([float(s[c+'_seconds']) for s in ss])
            op[c+'_fraction_mean']=mean([float(s[c+'_seconds'])/sum(float(s[x+'_seconds']) for x in ['expand','defense','rebuild']) for s in ss if sum(float(s[x+'_seconds']) for x in ['expand','defense','rebuild'])>0])
        operations.append(op)
        if k[3]!='G0':

                paired_rows.append({**labels(k),'stage':stage,'metric':metric,'direction':'G0 minus group; positive means smaller group value',**paired(a,b)})
            aa={r['seed']:numeric(s['summary'].get('rmct_seconds')) for r,s in bp if int(s['summary']['batch_count'])>0 and int(s['summary']['censored_batches'])==0}
            bb={r['seed']:numeric(s['summary'].get('rmct_seconds')) for r,s in pairs if int(s['summary']['batch_count'])>0 and int(s['summary']['censored_batches'])==0}
            paired_rows.append({**labels(k),'stage':stage,'metric':'rmct_all_clear_sensitivity','direction':'G0 minus group; only seeds with both stages fully cleared',**paired(aa,bb)})
    advances=[]
    for k,rs in by.items():
        if k[3]=='G0':continue
        baseline=by.get(k[:3]+('G0',k[4]),[])
        for m in MILESTONES:
            a={r['seed']:route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in baseline};b={r['seed']:route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in rs}
            real=paired({s:v/60 if v is not None else None for s,v in a.items()},{s:v/60 if v is not None else None for s,v in b.items()})
            truncated=paired({s:(v if v is not None else 16200)/60 for s,v in a.items()},{s:(v if v is not None else 16200)/60 for s,v in b.items()})
            advances.append({**labels(k),'milestone':m,**{'real_'+x:v for x,v in real.items()},**{'truncated_'+x:v for x,v in truncated.items()}})
    direct=[]
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        first=by.get(('S','A',policy,'G1',0.0),[]);second=by.get(('S','A',policy,'G2',0.0),[])
        direct.append(dict(policy=policy,metric='route_completion_G1_minus_G2',scope='all_valid_routes',G1_routes=len(first),G2_routes=len(second),**paired({r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in first},{r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in second})))
        for m in MILESTONES:
            a={r['seed']:route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in second};b={r['seed']:route_milestones[r['run_id']][m] for r in first}
            for scope in ['actual_both_achieved','truncated_3L_sensitivity']:
                aa={i:(v/60 if v is not None else 270 if scope=='truncated_3L_sensitivity' else None) for i,v in a.items()}
                bb={i:(v/60 if v is not None else 270 if scope=='truncated_3L_sensitivity' else None) for i,v in b.items()}
                direct.append(dict(policy=policy,metric=m+'_G1_advance_minutes',scope=scope,G1_routes=len(first),G2_routes=len(second),**paired(aa,bb)))
    write('construction_vs_defense.csv',direct)
    robustness=[]
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        for group in ['G0','G1','G2','G3']:
            first={r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in by.get(('S','A',policy,group,0.0),[]) if r['seed']<1020}
            alternate={r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in by.get(('S','B',policy,group,0.0),[]) if r['seed']<1020}
            robustness.append(dict(policy=policy,group=group,metric='chain_B_minus_A_completion',required_pairs=20,A_first20_valid=len(first),B_valid=len(alternate),**paired(alternate,first)))
            if group!='G0':
                control_a={r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in by.get(('S','A',policy,'G0',0.0),[]) if r['seed']<1020}
                control_b={r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in by.get(('S','B',policy,'G0',0.0),[]) if r['seed']<1020}
                seeds=set(first)&set(alternate)&set(control_a)&set(control_b)
                values={s:(alternate[s]-control_b[s])-(first[s]-control_a[s]) for s in seeds}
                robustness.append(dict(policy=policy,group=group,metric='chain_change_in_group_minus_G0_completion',required_pairs=20,A_first20_valid=len(first),B_valid=len(alternate),**paired(values,{s:0 for s in values})))
    write('chain_robustness_paired.csv',robustness)
    pressure=[];boundaries=[]
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        for group in ['G0','G1','G2','G3']:
            rates_by_alpha=[]
            for tenth in range(21):
                k=('S','A',policy,group,tenth/10);rs=[r for r in by.get(k,[]) if r['seed']<1020];n=len(rs);wins=sum(r['complete'] for r in rs);lo,hi=wilson(wins,n)
                p=wins/n if n else None;ready=n>=20;rates_by_alpha.append((tenth/10,p,ready))
                pressure.append({**labels(k),'valid_routes':n,'required':20,'complete_routes':wins,'completion_rate':p,'wilson_low':lo,'wilson_high':hi,'cell_complete':ready})
            complete=all(z[2] for z in rates_by_alpha);boundary=None;maximum=None
            if complete:
                passing=[a for a,p,ready in rates_by_alpha if p>=.9];maximum=max(passing) if passing else None
                if rates_by_alpha[0][1]>=.9:
                    for a,p,ready in rates_by_alpha:
                        if p<.9:break
                        boundary=a
            zero_failed=rates_by_alpha[0][2] and rates_by_alpha[0][1]<.9
            boundaries.append(dict(policy=policy,group=group,all_21_cells_complete=complete,continuous_boundary_determined=complete or zero_failed,continuous_boundary=boundary,boundary_is_lower_bound=complete and boundary==2,any_passing_maximum=maximum,any_passing_maximum_determined=complete,interpretation='empty: complete 20-seed alpha0 cell below90%; full scan continues for maximum-anywhere' if zero_failed else 'tested' if complete else '证据不足：扫描未完成'))
    # Equal-run, observed-window summaries. A stopped route contributes no future windows.

            for w in read(s['path']+'.windows.csv'):
                wk=ks+(int(w['window']),w['scope'],w['item'],w['facility'])
                buckets[wk].append(w)
    windows=[];paired_windows=[]
    skip={'seq','run_id','track','chain','policy','group','alpha','seed','stage','step','sim_seconds','window','scope','item','facility','journal_summary_seq'}
    for wk,ws in buckets.items():
        k=wk[:5];row={**labels(k),'stage':wk[5],'window':wk[6],'scope':wk[7],'item':wk[8],'facility':wk[9],'observed_runs':len(ws)}
        for col in ws[0]:
            if col not in skip:row[col+'_mean']=mean([numeric(w[col]) for w in ws])
        windows.append(row)
        if wk[3]!='G0' and wk[4]==0 and wk[7] in ['window','item']:
            base=buckets.get(wk[:3]+('G0',wk[4])+wk[5:],[])
            if base:
                selected=['supply','full_demand','flow_gap','net_shortage_core','due_unpaid_end','rebuild_paid','repair_material_paid'] if wk[7]=='item' else ['empty_turret_seconds','threat_turret_seconds','power_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds','repair_effective_hp','repair_energy','rebuild_equivalent','expand_seconds','defense_seconds','rebuild_seconds']
                if wk[7]!='item' or wk[8] in ['copper','graphite','silicon']:
                    for metric in selected:
                        a={int(z['seed']):numeric(z[metric]) for z in base};b={int(z['seed']):numeric(z[metric]) for z in ws};ids=sorted(s for s in a.keys()&b.keys() if a[s] is not None and b[s] is not None)
                        am=mean([a[s] for s in ids]);bm=mean([b[s] for s in ids]);paired_windows.append({**labels(k),'stage':wk[5],'window':wk[6],'scope':wk[7],'item':wk[8],'metric':metric,'paired_seeds':len(ids),'G0_paired_mean':am,'group_paired_mean':bm,'G0_minus_group_mean':am-bm if ids else None,'change_vs_G0':bm/am-1 if ids and am!=0 else None})
    window_sensitivity=[]
    rates_metrics={'supply','full_demand','flow_gap','net_shortage_core','rebuild_paid','repair_material_paid','empty_turret_seconds','threat_turret_seconds','power_loss_seconds','blocked_seconds','repair_effective_hp','repair_energy','rebuild_equivalent','expand_seconds','defense_seconds','rebuild_seconds'}
    for original in paired_windows:

        for scope in ['both_full_300_seconds','per_observed_second']:

            a={};b={};metric=original['metric']
            for seed in base.keys()&treatment.keys():
                x=base[seed];y=treatment[seed];dx=float(x['duration_seconds']);dy=float(y['duration_seconds'])
                if scope=='both_full_300_seconds' and (abs(dx-300)>1e-6 or abs(dy-300)>1e-6):continue
                if min(dx,dy)<=0:continue

    write('paired_window_exposure_sensitivity.csv',window_sensitivity)
    lookup={(z['track'],z['chain'],z['policy'],z['group'],z['alpha'],z['stage'],z['window'],z['scope'],z['item'],z['facility']):z for z in windows}
    for r in windows:
        if r['group']=='G0':continue
        bk=(r['track'],r['chain'],r['policy'],'G0',r['alpha'],r['stage'],r['window'],r['scope'],r['item'],r['facility']);base=lookup.get(bk)
        if base:

    factors=[]
    comparisons=[('single_'+p,'G0','I_only_'+p) for p in 'MTGSP']+[('remove_'+p,'I_without_'+p,'G1') for p in 'MTGSP']+[('joint_SP','G0','I_SP'),('extended_I','G1','G1X'),('extended_ID','G3','G3X'),('pure_H','G0','G2H'),('pure_C','G0','G2C')]
    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
        for contrast,a,b in comparisons:
            ar=by.get(('S','A',policy,a,0.0),[]);br=by.get(('S','A',policy,b,0.0),[])
            # Completion gain is group B minus group A; duration benefit is A minus B.
            factors.append(dict(policy=policy,contrast=contrast,reference=a,treatment=b,metric='route_completion_gain',**paired({r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in br},{r['seed']:float(r['complete']) for r in ar})))
            for stage in 'ABC':

                    av={r['seed']:numeric(s['summary'].get(metric)) for r,s in stages.get(('S','A',policy,a,0.0,stage),[])};bv={r['seed']:numeric(s['summary'].get(metric)) for r,s in stages.get(('S','A',policy,b,0.0,stage),[])}
                    factors.append(dict(policy=policy,contrast=contrast,reference=a,treatment=b,stage=stage,metric=metric,**paired(av,bv)))
    interactions=[]
    # Paired factorial interactions on final observable metrics, including full-route completion.

        for name,gs in [('H_C',['G0','G2H','G2C','G2']),('S_P',['G0','I_only_S','I_only_P','I_SP']),('I_D',['G0','G1','G2','G3'])]:
            dictionaries=[{r['seed']:r for r in by.get(('S','A',policy,g,0.0),[])} for g in gs]
            seeds=set.intersection(*(set(d) for d in dictionaries))
            values={seed:float(dictionaries[3][seed]['complete'])-float(dictionaries[1][seed]['complete'])-float(dictionaries[2][seed]['complete'])+float(dictionaries[0][seed]['complete']) for seed in seeds}
            interactions.append(dict(policy=policy,interaction=name,metric='route_completion',groups='|'.join(gs),**paired(values,{s:0 for s in values})))
            for stage in 'ABC':
                for metric in ['rmct_seconds','rebuild_seconds','empty_turret_seconds']:
                    ds=[{r['seed']:numeric(s['summary'].get(metric)) for r,s in stages.get(('S','A',policy,g,0.0,stage),[])} for g in gs]
                    seeds=set.intersection(*(set(d) for d in ds));vals={s:ds[3][s]-ds[1][s]-ds[2][s]+ds[0][s] for s in seeds if all(d[s] is not None for d in ds)}
                    interactions.append(dict(policy=policy,interaction=name,metric=metric,stage=stage,groups='|'.join(gs),**paired(vals,{s:0 for s in vals})))

    for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:

            if a and b and a['rmct_seconds_mean'] not in [None,0] and b['rmct_seconds_mean'] is not None:value=1-b['rmct_seconds_mean']/a['rmct_seconds_mean']
            eta.append(dict(policy=policy,stage=stage,eta=value,G0_rmct_runs=a['rmct_contributing_runs'] if a else 0,G1_rmct_runs=b['rmct_contributing_runs'] if b else 0,interpretation='不可计算：无批次或尚无到达数据' if value is None else 'observed-stage mean; consult paired/censor sensitivity'))
    write('route_completion.csv',rates);write('stage_summary_statistics.csv',stage_rows);write('tier_rmct.csv',tier_rows);write('paired_stage_differences.csv',paired_rows);write('milestones.csv',milestone_rows);write('paired_milestone_advances_minutes.csv',advances);write('operations.csv',operations);write('window_summary_statistics.csv',windows);write('paired_window_differences.csv',paired_windows);write('pressure.csv',pressure);write('pressure_boundaries.csv',boundaries);write('factorial_interactions.csv',interactions);write('factor_effects.csv',factors);write('industrial_eta.csv',eta)
    write('invalid_routes.csv',[dict(run_id=r['run_id'],seed=r['seed'],group=r['group'],policy=r['policy'],reason=json.dumps([s for s in r['stages'] if not s['accepted']],ensure_ascii=False)) for r in invalid])
    # Three deliverable tables, each preserving event provenance and original run IDs.
    for suffix,name in [('batches.csv','批次日志.csv'),('windows.csv','5分钟窗口日志.csv'),('stages.csv','阶段汇总日志.csv')]:
        dest=OUT/name;writer=None

                        enriched={'source_artifact':s['path']+'.'+suffix,'source_run_id':row['run_id'],'source_chain':row['chain'],'reused_prefix':bool(s.get('reused_from')),**row};enriched['run_id']=r['run_id'];enriched['chain']=r['chain']
                        if writer is None:writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(enriched));writer.writeheader()
                        writer.writerow(enriched)

    c_files=list((ROOT/'calibration').glob('*/route.json'))
    c_routes=[json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in c_files]
    s_handled=len(routes)+len(invalid)==4500
    c_handled=len(c_routes)==40
    finished=s_handled and c_handled
````

````java
  Team.sharded.core().requestSpawn(bot);

  }
  event("start",mapName+" seed="+seed+" inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  event("configuration","group="+EvaluationParameters.group+" alpha="+EvaluationParameters.alpha+" tick_substreams="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed")+" core_copper_bus="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus"));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".initial.msav"));
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.audit")){

     randomAudit.println(tick+" "+Thread.currentThread().getName()+" "+seed0+":"+seed1+" "+caller);randomAudit.flush();
    }

   }};
  }

  AuditRecorder recorder=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.recorder") && formalRecorder==null?new AuditRecorder(out,()->tick):null;
  if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.afterInitialization();

   if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.beforeStep();

    z=(z^(z>>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;z=(z^(z>>>27))*0x94d049bb133111ebL;
    Mathf.rand.setSeed(z^(z>>>31));
   }
   posted.run();Time.updateGlobal();pathfinder.evaluationStep();controlPath.evaluationStep();
   long randBefore=Mathf.rand.seed0;act();long randAfterAct=Mathf.rand.seed0;
   asyncCore.begin();logic.update();asyncCore.end();if(recorder!=null)recorder.step();if(formalRecorder!=null)formalRecorder.step();
   if(probe!=null){
    long uh=1,bh=1,ph=1;
    for(Unit uu:Groups.unit){uh=uh*31+uu.id;uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.y);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.health);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.y);}
    for(Bullet bb:Groups.bullet){ph=ph*31+bb.id;ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.x);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.y);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.damage);}
    for(Building bb:Groups.build){
     bh=bh*31+bb.id;bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.health);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.efficiency);bh=bh*31+(bb.enabled?1:0);
     if(bb.items!=null)for(var it:content.items())bh=bh*31+bb.items.get(it);
     for(Building pp:bb.proximity)bh=bh*31+pp.pos();
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){bh=bh*31+tb.totalAmmo;bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(tb.reloadCounter);}
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db){bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(db.progress);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(db.warmup);}
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.distribution.Conveyor.ConveyorBuild cv){for(int ci=0;ci<cv.len;ci++){bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(cv.xs[ci]);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(cv.ys[ci]);}}
    }

   }

    log.flush();System.out.println("t="+tick/60+" wave="+state.wave+" order="+index+" enemies="+state.enemies);
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter || b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || b.block==Blocks.graphitePress))event("factory",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" items="+b.items+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" power="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status));
    float ammo=0;int turrets=0;String drills="";
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){ammo+=tb.totalAmmo;turrets++;}
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db)drills+=db.tileX()+":"+db.tileY()+"="+db.dominantItem+"/"+db.dominantItems+" eff="+db.efficiency+" items="+db.items+" ";
    }

    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.arc || b.block==Blocks.mender || b.block==Blocks.battery))event("power_detail",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" status="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status)+" stored="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getBatteryStored())+" needed="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerNeeded())+" produced="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerProduced()));
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux && core!=null && eu.within(core,300))event("threat_detail",eu.type.name+" id="+eu.id+" health="+eu.health+" shield="+eu.shield+" x="+eu.x+" y="+eu.y);

   }
   if(!ended && initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size<=initialEnemyCores-1){ended=true;won=true;event("first_enemy_core","initial="+initialEnemyCores+" remaining="+Team.crux.cores().size);}
   if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){ended=true;won=false;}
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources)throw new IllegalStateException("cheat enabled");
  }
````
