 }
 static void importCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryIn");if(path==null)return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(String row:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).size())){
   String[] fields=row.split(",");Item item=content.item(fields[0]);int amount=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);int beforeSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]),afterSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
   if(amount<0 || beforeSource-afterSource!=amount || Integer.parseInt(fields[4])!=seed || !fields[5].equals(EvaluationParameters.group))throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid inheritance receipt");
   int before=core.items.get(item),accepted=Math.min(amount,Math.max(0,core.storageCapacity-before));core.items.add(item,accepted);
   event("carry_in","item="+item.name+" exported="+amount+" before="+before+" accepted="+accepted+" overflow="+(amount-accepted)+" after="+core.items.get(item));
  }
 }
 static void exportCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryOut");if(path==null || !won || Team.sharded.core()==null)return;
  int[] caps=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0").equals("0")?new int[]{1000,1000,500,500,500,200}:new int[]{1500,1500,800,800,800,300};
  Item[] items={Items.copper,Items.lead,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.titanium,Items.metaglass};var core=Team.sharded.core();
  try(PrintWriter carry=new PrintWriter(path)){carry.println("item,amount,source_before,source_after,seed,group");
   for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++){Item item=items[i];int before=core.items.get(item),amount=Math.min(before,caps[i]);core.items.remove(item,amount);carry.println(item.name+","+amount+","+before+","+core.items.get(item)+","+seed+","+EvaluationParameters.group);event("carry_out","item="+item.name+" before="+before+" amount="+amount+" after="+core.items.get(item));}
  }
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){
   bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && c.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)==0){
    Building sink=null;for(Building bb:Groups.build)if(bb.team==Team.sharded && bb!=c && bb.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)>0 && (sink==null || bb.dst2(u)<sink.dst2(u)))sink=bb;
    if(sink!=null){move(sink.x,sink.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(sink,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,sink);}
    else{event("discard","item="+u.item().name+" amount="+u.stack.amount+" reason=no_accepting_storage");InputHandler.dropItem(bot,0);}
   }
   return u.stack.amount==0;
  }
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static int ammoPriority(mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){
  if(tb.block==Blocks.scatter)return Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,tb.x,tb.y,400,eu->eu.isFlying())!=null?3:0;
  return tb.block==Blocks.salvo?2:1;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead())return;
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  if(!state.rules.attackMode && state.wave>=30 && tick-lastWaveTick>=180*60){
   Unit remaining=null;for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==state.rules.waveTeam && !eu.dead && eu.isAdded() && (remaining==null || eu.dst2(c)<remaining.dst2(c)))remaining=eu;
   if(remaining!=null){u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(remaining.x,remaining.y,u.range()-8);u.aim(remaining);u.lookAt(remaining);u.controlWeapons(true,true);return;}
  }
  if(AttackSupport.control())return;
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  {
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite") || (commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count());
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && ((b.block==Blocks.duo && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.manualDuo")) || b.block==Blocks.scatter || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus") && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.duo?6:16)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || ammoPriority(tb)>ammoPriority(ammoTarget) || (ammoPriority(tb)==ammoPriority(ammoTarget) && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.scatter?Items.lead:ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper || ammoItem==Items.lead)mine(ammoItem);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty()){
     Object configuration;
     if(o.config.startsWith("point:")){String[] point=o.config.split(":");configuration=new Point2(Integer.parseInt(point[1]),Integer.parseInt(point[2]));}
     else configuration=content.item(o.config);
     if(!configuration.equals(t.build.config()))t.build.configureAny(configuration);
    }
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill || o.block==Blocks.salvo || o.block==Blocks.arc)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);EvaluationTrace.order(u.id,o.x,o.y,o.block);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }

  for(String line:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).size())){
   String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Order o=new Order();o.block=content.getByName(ContentType.block,c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];orders.add(o);
  }

   long randBefore=Mathf.rand.seed0;act();long randAfterAct=Mathf.rand.seed0;
   asyncCore.begin();logic.update();asyncCore.end();
   if(probe!=null){

 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);return u.stack.amount==0;}
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead()){if(tick%120==0)c.requestSpawn(bot);return;}
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  if(!urgent){
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count();
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.duo || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.salvo?16:6)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || (tb.block==Blocks.salvo && ammoTarget.block!=Blocks.salvo) || (tb.block==ammoTarget.block && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper)mine(Items.copper);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }

   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty() && t.build.config()!=content.item(o.config))t.build.configureAny(content.item(o.config));
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }

 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());

 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);return u.stack.amount==0;}
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;

 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}

  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;

  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty() && t.build.config()!=content.item(o.config))t.build.configureAny(content.item(o.config));
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
}

  }
  event("start",mapName+" seed="+seed+" inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  event("configuration","group="+EvaluationParameters.group+" alpha="+EvaluationParameters.alpha+" tick_substreams="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed")+" core_copper_bus="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus"));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".initial.msav"));
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.audit")){

    z=(z^(z>>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;z=(z^(z>>>27))*0x94d049bb133111ebL;

   if(probe!=null){

    for(Unit uu:Groups.unit){uh=uh*31+uu.id;uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.y);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.health);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.y);}
    for(Bullet bb:Groups.bullet){ph=ph*31+bb.id;ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.x);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.y);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.damage);}
    for(Building bb:Groups.build){
     bh=bh*31+bb.id;bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.health);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.efficiency);bh=bh*31+(bb.enabled?1:0);

 }
 static void importCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryIn");if(path==null)return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(String row:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).size())){
   String[] fields=row.split(",");Item item=content.item(fields[0]);int amount=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);int beforeSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]),afterSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
   if(amount<0 || beforeSource-afterSource!=amount || Integer.parseInt(fields[4])!=seed || !fields[5].equals(EvaluationParameters.group))throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid inheritance receipt");
   int before=core.items.get(item),accepted=Math.min(amount,Math.max(0,core.storageCapacity-before));core.items.add(item,accepted);
   event("carry_in","item="+item.name+" exported="+amount+" before="+before+" accepted="+accepted+" overflow="+(amount-accepted)+" after="+core.items.get(item));
  }
 }
 static void exportCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryOut");if(path==null || !won || Team.sharded.core()==null)return;
  int[] caps=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0").equals("0")?new int[]{1000,1000,500,500,500,200}:new int[]{1500,1500,800,800,800,300};
  Item[] items={Items.copper,Items.lead,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.titanium,Items.metaglass};var core=Team.sharded.core();
  try(PrintWriter carry=new PrintWriter(path)){carry.println("item,amount,source_before,source_after,seed,group");
   for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++){Item item=items[i];int before=core.items.get(item),amount=Math.min(before,caps[i]);core.items.remove(item,amount);carry.println(item.name+","+amount+","+before+","+core.items.get(item)+","+seed+","+EvaluationParameters.group);event("carry_out","item="+item.name+" before="+before+" amount="+amount+" after="+core.items.get(item));}
  }
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){
   bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && c.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)==0){
    Building sink=null;for(Building bb:Groups.build)if(bb.team==Team.sharded && bb!=c && bb.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)>0 && (sink==null || bb.dst2(u)<sink.dst2(u)))sink=bb;
    if(sink!=null){move(sink.x,sink.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(sink,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,sink);}
    else{event("discard","item="+u.item().name+" amount="+u.stack.amount+" reason=no_accepting_storage");InputHandler.dropItem(bot,0);}
   }
   return u.stack.amount==0;
  }
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static int ammoPriority(mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){
  if(tb.block==Blocks.scatter)return Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,tb.x,tb.y,400,eu->eu.isFlying())!=null?3:0;
  return tb.block==Blocks.salvo?2:1;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead())return;
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  if(!state.rules.attackMode && state.wave>=30 && tick-lastWaveTick>=180*60){
   Unit remaining=null;for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==state.rules.waveTeam && !eu.dead && eu.isAdded() && (remaining==null || eu.dst2(c)<remaining.dst2(c)))remaining=eu;
   if(remaining!=null){u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(remaining.x,remaining.y,u.range()-8);u.aim(remaining);u.lookAt(remaining);u.controlWeapons(true,true);return;}
  }
  if(AttackSupport.control())return;
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  {
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite") || (commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count());
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && ((b.block==Blocks.duo && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.manualDuo")) || b.block==Blocks.scatter || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus") && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.duo?6:16)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || ammoPriority(tb)>ammoPriority(ammoTarget) || (ammoPriority(tb)==ammoPriority(ammoTarget) && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.scatter?Items.lead:ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper || ammoItem==Items.lead)mine(ammoItem);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty()){
     Object configuration;
     if(o.config.startsWith("point:")){String[] point=o.config.split(":");configuration=new Point2(Integer.parseInt(point[1]),Integer.parseInt(point[2]));}
     else configuration=content.item(o.config);
     if(!configuration.equals(t.build.config()))t.build.configureAny(configuration);
    }
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill || o.block==Blocks.salvo || o.block==Blocks.arc)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
}

 FormalRecorder(String path,IntSupplier clock)throws Exception{
  this.clock=clock;policy=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.policy","balanced");chain=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.chain","A");track=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.track","S");seed=Pilot.seed;
  int ordinal=Integer.parseInt(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0"));stage="ABC".substring(ordinal,ordinal+1);
  runId=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.runId",policy+"-"+chain+"-"+EvaluationParameters.group+"-a"+EvaluationParameters.alpha+"-s"+seed);
  initialEnemyCores=Team.crux.cores().size;
  journal=new PrintWriter(path+".events.csv");batchOut=new PrintWriter(path+".batches.csv");windowOut=new PrintWriter(path+".windows.csv");stageOut=new PrintWriter(path+".stages.csv");validation=new PrintWriter(path+".validity.json");
  journal.println("seq,run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds,event,detail");
  sleepField=Building.class.getDeclaredField("sleeping");sleepField.setAccessible(true);consumePowerField=Building.class.getDeclaredField("shouldConsumePower");consumePowerField.setAccessible(true);
  for(Tile tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.build!=null)register(tile.build);

  Events.on(BlockBuildEndEvent.class,e->{if(!closed && !e.breaking){if(e.tile.build!=null)register(e.tile.build);if(e.team==Team.sharded){Debt d=debts.remove(e.tile.pos());if(d!=null && Arrays.stream(d.remaining).sum()!=0)invalid("completed_order_has_unpaid_materials;site="+e.tile.pos());pendingEnemy.remove(e.tile.pos());emit("build_complete","site="+e.tile.pos()+";block="+e.tile.block().name);}}});
  Events.on(BlockDestroyEvent.class,e->{if(closed)return;Building b=e.tile.build;if(b==null)return;buildings.remove(e.tile.pos());if(b.team==Team.sharded){
   destructionTotal++;if(lateStart>=0)lateDestroyed++;Team root=damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root;boolean enemy=root!=null && root!=Team.derelict && root!=Team.sharded;
   if(enemy){enemyDestructionTotal++;pendingEnemy.add(e.tile.pos());}

 int tick(){return initializing?0:terminalTick>=0?terminalTick:clock.getAsInt()+1;}

 void emit(String type,String detail){journal.println(++seq+","+fields()+","+tick()+","+(tick()/60.0)+","+type+","+detail.replace(',',';').replace('\n',' '));}
 void invalid(String why){valid=false;emit("invalid",why);}
 void register(Building b){if(b.team==Team.sharded || b.team==Team.crux){buildings.put(b.pos(),b);producerBuildings.put(b.id,b);}}
 static Block target(Building b){return b instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild c && c.current!=null?c.current:b.block;}
 static boolean repair(Block b){return b instanceof MendProjector || b instanceof RegenProjector || b instanceof RepairTurret || b instanceof RepairTower;}
 static boolean defense(Block b){return b instanceof BaseTurret || b instanceof Wall || b instanceof UnitFactory || b instanceof Reconstructor || repair(b);}
 String category(int pos,Block b){return pendingEnemy.contains(pos)?"rebuild":defense(b)?"defense":"expand";}
 void syncCores(){for(var core:Team.sharded.cores())if(!accounts.containsKey(core.items)){
  var a=new Account(core.pos(),core.items);accounts.put(core.items,a);for(int i=0;i<a.balance.length;i++)emit("stock_open","core="+a.core+";item="+content.item(i).name+";balance="+a.balance[i]);
 }}
 void opening(Window w){if(w.opened)return;w.opened=true;Set<ItemModule> seen=Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());for(var c:Team.sharded.cores())if(seen.add(c.items))for(int i=0;i<w.opening.length;i++)w.opening[i]+=c.items.get(i);}
 Window window(int index){return windows.computeIfAbsent(index,k->new Window());}
 Window point(){return window(tick()/18000);}
 void afterInitialization(){opening(window(0));emit("stage_open","enemy_cores="+initialEnemyCores+";wave_timer="+state.rules.waveTimer+";waves="+state.rules.waves);initializing=false;}
 long[] due(){long[] total=new long[content.items().size];for(Debt d:debts.values())for(int i=0;i<total.length;i++)total[i]+=d.remaining[i];return total;}
 void beforeStep(){
  if((clock.getAsInt()+1)%18000==0){opening(window((clock.getAsInt()+1)/18000));window(clock.getAsInt()/18000).dueAtEnd=due();}
  else opening(window(clock.getAsInt()/18000));
 }
 public void stock(ItemModule m,int item,int before,int after){Account a=accounts.get(m);if(a==null)return;if(a.balance[item]!=before)invalid("ledger_discontinuity;item="+item+";expected="+a.balance[item]+";before="+before);if(after<0)invalid("negative_inventory;item="+item);emit("stock","core="+a.core+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);a.balance[item]=after;}
 public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(team==Team.sharded){Window w=point();w.supply[item.id]+=amount;Building b=producerBuildings.get(producer);String name=b==null?"unit_mining":b.block.name;w.supplyByFacility.computeIfAbsent(name,k->new long[content.items().size])[item.id]+=amount;}}
 public void order(int actor,int x,int y,Block block){int pos=Point2.pack(x,y);if(debts.containsKey(pos))return;Debt d=new Debt();d.target=block;d.category=category(pos,block);d.remaining=new long[content.items().size];for(ItemStack stack:block.requirements)d.remaining[stack.item.id]=EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,block,stack.amount);debts.put(pos,d);emit("order_due","actor="+actor+";site="+pos+";block="+block.name+";category="+d.category+";materials="+Arrays.toString(d.remaining));}
 public void construction(Building site,Block target,Item item,int amount){if(site.team!=Team.sharded)return;Window w=point();w.construction[item.id]+=amount;String kind=operations.getOrDefault(site.pos(),category(site.pos(),target));if(kind.equals("rebuild"))w.rebuild[item.id]+=amount;Debt d=debts.get(site.pos());if(d==null)invalid("spend_without_released_order;site="+site.pos());else{d.remaining[item.id]-=amount;if(d.remaining[item.id]<0)invalid("order_overpaid;site="+site.pos()+";item="+item.id);}emit("construction_spend","site="+site.pos()+";block="+target.name+";item="+item.name+";amount="+amount+";category="+kind);}
 public void work(Unit builder,Building site,Block target){if(builder.team!=Team.sharded)return;String kind=operations.getOrDefault(site.pos(),category(site.pos(),target));int index=kind.equals("expand")?0:kind.equals("defense")?1:2;workCalls.computeIfAbsent(builder.id,k->new int[3])[index]++;}
 public void consumed(Building b,Item item,int amount){if(b.team==Team.sharded && repair(b.block))point().repairItems[item.id]+=amount;}
 public void healing(Building source,int target,float amount){if(source.team==Team.sharded)point().repairHP+=amount;}
 public void damageBegin(Building b,Team source){Team root=enemy(source)?source:damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().root==null?source:damageStack.peek().root;damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(b.id,source,root));}
 public void damageEnd(Building b){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=b.id){invalid("damage_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 public void powerUsage(Building b,float requested,float received){
  if(b.team!=Team.sharded || requested<=0)return;Window w=window((tick()-1)/18000);w.powerNeed+=requested;w.powerReceived+=received;double[] energy=w.energyByFacility.computeIfAbsent(b.block.name,k->new double[2]);energy[0]+=requested;energy[1]+=received;if(repair(b.block))w.repairEnergy+=received;
 }
 Team bulletCause(Bullet b){return b.team==Team.derelict?bulletOrigins.get(b.id):b.team;}
 public void fireCreated(Fire f){if(f!=null && (!fireOrigins.containsKey(f.id) || fireOrigins.get(f.id)==null))fireOrigins.put(f.id,damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root);}

 public void fireBegin(Fire f){Team cause=fireOrigins.get(f.id);damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(-2*f.id,cause,cause));}
 public void fireEnd(Fire f){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=-2*f.id){invalid("fire_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}

 public void bulletEnd(Bullet b){if(damageStack.isEmpty() || damageStack.peek().building!=-2*b.id-1){invalid("bullet_context_mismatch");damageStack.clear();}else damageStack.pop();}
 static boolean enemy(Team t){return t!=null && t!=Team.derelict && t!=Team.sharded;}
 public Object captureCause(Team direct){Team current=damageStack.isEmpty()?null:damageStack.peek().root;return enemy(direct)?direct:current!=null?current:direct;}
 public void causeBegin(Object token){Team cause=(Team)token;damageStack.push(new DamageFrame(Integer.MIN_VALUE,cause,cause));}

 public void waveBegin(int wave){Batch b=new Batch();b.ordinal=batches.size()+1;b.wave=wave;b.start=tick();batches.add(b);if(b.ordinal==26)lateStart=tick();emit("batch_begin","ordinal="+b.ordinal+";native_wave="+wave);b.spawnSeq=seq;}
 Batch currentBatch(){return batches.get(batches.size()-1);}
 public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup g,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){emit("spawn_plan","batch="+currentBatch().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";type="+g.type.name+";x="+x+";y="+y+";base="+base+";adjusted="+adjusted+";boss="+(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss));}
 public void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup g,Unit u){if(u.team!=Team.sharded){currentBatch().units.put(u.id,u);emit("batch_unit","batch="+currentBatch().ordinal+";group="+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+";id="+u.id+";type="+u.type.name);}}
 public void waveEnd(int wave){currentBatch().sealed=true;emit("batch_seal","ordinal="+currentBatch().ordinal+";actual="+currentBatch().units.size());currentBatch().sealSeq=seq;}
 void attack(int actor,int target,int units){Building b=world.build(target);if(initialEnemyCores>0 && b!=null && b.block instanceof CoreBlock && b.team!=Team.sharded && units>0)milestone("rts_attack");emit("rts_command","actor="+actor+";target="+target+";units="+units);}
 void milestone(String name){if(!milestones.containsKey(name)){milestones.put(name,tick());emit("milestone",name);}}

 final HashMap<Long,ArrayList<Unit>> enemyGrid=new HashMap<>();
 static long cellKey(int x,int y){return ((long)x<<32)^(y&0xffffffffL);}
 void indexEnemies(){enemyGrid.clear();for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team!=Team.sharded && u.team!=Team.derelict && !u.dead && u.isAdded())enemyGrid.computeIfAbsent(cellKey((int)Math.floor(u.x/128),(int)Math.floor(u.y/128)),k->new ArrayList<>()).add(u);}
 Ammo ammo(ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild b){
  ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo out=new Ammo();Turret.AmmoEntry chosen=b.ammo.size>0?b.ammo.peek():null;
  if(chosen!=null && chosen.amount<t.ammoPerShot)for(int i=0;i<b.ammo.size;i++)if(b.ammo.get(i).amount>=t.ammoPerShot){chosen=b.ammo.get(i);break;}
  if(chosen instanceof ItemTurret.ItemEntry entry){out.item=entry.item;out.type=entry.type();out.ready=entry.amount>=t.ammoPerShot && b.potentialEfficiency>0;}
  else{
   out.item=Items.copper;out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(Items.copper);
   if(out.type==null)for(Item item:content.items())if(t.ammoTypes.get(item)!=null){out.type=t.ammoTypes.get(item);break;}
  }
  return out;
 }
 boolean threat(Building b,Turret t,BulletType bullet){
  float range=t.range+(bullet==null?0:bullet.rangeChange);int minX=(int)Math.floor((b.x-range-80)/128),maxX=(int)Math.floor((b.x+range+80)/128),minY=(int)Math.floor((b.y-range-80)/128),maxY=(int)Math.floor((b.y+range+80)/128);
  for(int cx=minX;cx<=maxX;cx++)for(int cy=minY;cy<=maxY;cy++){
   ArrayList<Unit> bucket=enemyGrid.get(cellKey(cx,cy));if(bucket==null)continue;
   for(Unit u:bucket)if((u.isGrounded()?t.targetGround:t.targetAir) && t.unitFilter.get(u) && (bullet==null || bullet.targetMissiles || !(u instanceof TimedKillc)) && u.within(b,range+u.hitSize/2f))return true;
  }
  if(t.targetGround && t.targetBlocks && (bullet==null || bullet.targetBlocks))for(Building other:buildings.values())if(other.team!=Team.sharded && other.team!=Team.derelict && !other.dead && other.block.targetable && other.within(b,range))return true;
  return false;
 }
 void nominalRecipe(Building b,ItemStack[] recipe,double secondsPerCycle,Window w){if(secondsPerCycle>0)for(ItemStack stack:recipe)w.demand[stack.item.id]+=stack.amount/secondsPerCycle/60.0;}
 void facility(Building b,Window w)throws Exception{
  boolean isFacility=b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill;
  if(!isFacility)return;
  if(sleepField.getBoolean(b))w.sleeping+=1.0/60;
  boolean gate=false,blocked=false;
  double cycleTicks=0;ItemStack[] recipe=null;
  if(b instanceof GenericCrafter.GenericCrafterBuild crafter){
   GenericCrafter t=(GenericCrafter)b.block;boolean room=true;
   if(t.outputItems!=null)for(ItemStack output:t.outputItems)if(b.items.get(output.item)+output.amount>t.itemCapacity)room=false;
   if(t.outputLiquids!=null && !t.ignoreLiquidFullness){boolean allFull=true;for(LiquidStack output:t.outputLiquids){boolean full=b.liquids.get(output.liquid)>=t.liquidCapacity-0.001f;if(full && !t.dumpExtraLiquid)room=false;if(!full)allFull=false;}if(allFull)room=false;}
   blocked=b.enabled && !room;gate=b.enabled && room && b.productionValid();cycleTicks=t.craftTime*EvaluationParameters.cycle(b);
  }else if(b instanceof UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory){
   UnitFactory t=(UnitFactory)b.block;
   if(factory.currentPlan>=0 && factory.currentPlan<t.plans.size){var plan=t.plans.get(factory.currentPlan);boolean cap=mindustry.entities.Units.canCreate(b.team,plan.unit);blocked=b.enabled && (factory.payload!=null || !cap);gate=b.enabled && factory.payload==null && cap && b.team.activateUnitFactories();recipe=plan.requirements;cycleTicks=plan.time/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);}
  }else if(b instanceof Reconstructor.ReconstructorBuild reconstructor){
   Reconstructor t=(Reconstructor)b.block;gate=reconstructor.shouldConsume();blocked=b.enabled && reconstructor.payload!=null && !gate;cycleTicks=t.constructTime/state.rules.unitBuildSpeed(b.team);
  }else if(b instanceof Drill.DrillBuild drill){Drill t=(Drill)b.block;blocked=b.enabled && b.items.total()>=t.itemCapacity;gate=b.enabled && drill.dominantItem!=null && drill.dominantItems>0 && !blocked;}
  if(blocked)w.blocked+=1.0/60;
  if(!gate)return;
  w.wantSeconds+=1.0/60;
  boolean lacksItem=false,lacksLiquid=false;
  for(Consume consumer:b.block.nonOptionalConsumers){
   ItemStack[] ingredients=consumer instanceof ConsumeItems ci?ci.items:consumer instanceof ConsumeItemDynamic ci?ci.items.get(b):null;
   if(ingredients!=null){float multiplier=consumer.multiplier.get(b);for(ItemStack ingredient:ingredients){int required=Math.round(ingredient.amount*multiplier);if(b.items.get(ingredient.item)<required)lacksItem=true;if(recipe==null && cycleTicks>0)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=required*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;}}
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquid liquid && b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
   if(consumer instanceof ConsumeLiquids liquids)for(LiquidStack liquid:liquids.liquids)if(b.liquids.get(liquid.liquid)+1e-6<liquid.amount*b.timeScale())lacksLiquid=true;
  }
  if(recipe!=null && cycleTicks>0)for(ItemStack ingredient:recipe)w.demand[ingredient.item.id]+=ingredient.amount*b.timeScale()/cycleTicks;
  if(lacksItem)w.missingItems+=1.0/60;if(lacksLiquid)w.missingLiquid+=1.0/60;
  if(b.block.consPower!=null && !b.block.consPower.buffered)w.powerLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.power.status)))/60.0;
  if(b.efficiency<=1e-7)w.zeroEfficiency+=1.0/60;w.efficiencyLoss+=(1-Math.max(0,Math.min(1,b.efficiency)))/60.0;
 }
 void step()throws Exception{
  syncCores();for(var core:Team.sharded.cores()){Account a=accounts.get(core.items);for(int i=0;i<a.balance.length;i++)if(a.balance[i]!=core.items.get(i))invalid("missed_stock_mutation;core="+core.pos()+";item="+i);}
  if(TimeDeltaInvalid())invalid("non_fixed_delta_or_cheat");
  indexEnemies();Window w=window((tick()-1)/18000);int salvoReady=0,salvoThreat=0;
  Iterator<Building> iterator=buildings.values().iterator();
  while(iterator.hasNext()){
   Building b=iterator.next();if(b.tile.build!=b || b.dead){iterator.remove();continue;}if(b.team!=Team.sharded)continue;
   if(!Float.isFinite(b.efficiency))invalid("nonfinite_efficiency;site="+b.pos());
   if(b instanceof ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild turret){
    ItemTurret t=(ItemTurret)b.block;Ammo a=ammo(turret);boolean danger=b.enabled && threat(b,t,a.type);
    if(danger){w.threatSeconds+=1.0/60;if(!a.ready)w.emptySeconds+=1.0/60;
     if(a.type!=null){double cycles=t.reload+(!t.reloadWhileCharging?t.shoot.firstShotDelay:0);double shots=t.consumeAmmoOnce?1:t.shoot.shots;w.demand[a.item.id]+=shots*t.ammoPerShot/a.type.ammoMultiplier*a.type.reloadMultiplier*b.timeScale()/cycles;}
    }
    if(b.block==Blocks.salvo && b.enabled && a.ready){salvoReady++;if(danger)salvoThreat++;}
   }
   if(b.block instanceof GenericCrafter || b.block instanceof UnitFactory || b.block instanceof Reconstructor || b.block instanceof Drill){
    double a=w.wantSeconds,mi=w.missingItems,ml=w.missingLiquid,pl=w.powerLoss,ze=w.zeroEfficiency,el=w.efficiencyLoss,bl=w.blocked,sl=w.sleeping;
    facility(b,w);double[] metric=w.facilityMetrics.computeIfAbsent(b.block.name,k->new double[8]);metric[0]+=w.wantSeconds-a;metric[1]+=w.missingItems-mi;metric[2]+=w.missingLiquid-ml;metric[3]+=w.powerLoss-pl;metric[4]+=w.zeroEfficiency-ze;metric[5]+=w.efficiencyLoss-el;metric[6]+=w.blocked-bl;metric[7]+=w.sleeping-sl;
   }

  }
  if(salvoReady>=3){
   if(salvoStreak>=10800)threatRingSum-=threatRing[ringIndex];threatRing[ringIndex]=salvoThreat;threatRingSum+=salvoThreat;ringIndex=(ringIndex+1)%10800;salvoStreak++;
   if(salvoStreak>=10800){milestone("salvo_static");if(threatRingSum>=5400)milestone("salvo_combat");}
  }else{salvoStreak=ringIndex=threatRingSum=0;}
  if(initialEnemyCores>0){int count=0;double hp=0;for(Unit u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==Team.sharded && u!=Pilot.bot.unit() && !u.dead && u.isAdded() && AttackSupport.contains(u)){count++;hp+=u.health;}if(count>=8 && hp>=2000)milestone("army_formed");if(Team.crux.cores().size<initialEnemyCores)milestone("first_enemy_core");}
  for(int[] calls:workCalls.values()){int total=calls[0]+calls[1]+calls[2];if(total>0)for(int i=0;i<3;i++)w.operation[i]+=calls[i]/(double)total/60;}
  workCalls.clear();
  for(Batch b:batches)if(b.end<0){for(var e:b.units.entrySet())if(!b.terminated.contains(e.getKey()) && (e.getValue().dead || !e.getValue().isAdded())){b.terminated.add(e.getKey());emit("batch_unit_terminated","batch="+b.ordinal+";id="+e.getKey()+";dead="+e.getValue().dead);}if(b.sealed && b.terminated.size()==b.units.size()){b.end=tick();emit("batch_clear","ordinal="+b.ordinal);b.clearSeq=seq;}}
 }
 boolean TimeDeltaInvalid(){return Math.abs(arc.util.Time.delta-1f)>1e-7 || state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().fillItems;}

 static final String META="run_id,track,chain,policy,group,alpha,seed,stage,step,sim_seconds";

 Map<String,String> windowBase(int index,double end,double duration,String scope){Map<String,String> r=new HashMap<>();r.put("journal_summary_seq",String.valueOf(windowReference));r.put("scope",scope);r.put("window",String.valueOf(index));r.put("start_seconds",String.valueOf(index*300));r.put("end_seconds",String.valueOf(end));r.put("duration_seconds",String.valueOf(duration));return r;}

  }
  double[] t=totals();header(stageOut,"valid,won,terminal_reason,batch_count,cleared_batches,censored_batches,rmct_seconds,clear_fraction,core_lost,enemy_cores_initial,enemy_cores_remaining,buildings_destroyed,enemy_caused_destroyed,late_buildings_destroyed,salvo_static_seconds,salvo_combat_seconds,army_formed_seconds,rts_attack_seconds,first_enemy_core_seconds,late_lock_seconds,threat_turret_seconds,empty_turret_seconds,empty_fraction,want_facility_seconds,missing_item_seconds,missing_liquid_seconds,power_loss_seconds,zero_efficiency_seconds,efficiency_loss_seconds,blocked_seconds,sleep_seconds,repair_effective_hp,repair_energy,grid_requested_energy,grid_received_energy,grid_satisfaction,expand_seconds,defense_seconds,rebuild_seconds,aux_stage_under_60min,journal_end_seq");

/** Strategy search only. Native construction, mining and transfers; no formal inference from pilots. */
public class Pilot{
 static String mapName,layout,out; static int limit,seed,tick,index; static long seq;

 public static void main(String[] args){
  mapName=args.length>0?args[0]:"stainedMountains";
  layout=args.length>1?args[1]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/pilot-layout.csv";
  out=args.length>2?args[2]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/pilot-01.csv";
