````java
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){ammo+=tb.totalAmmo;turrets++;}
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db)drills+=db.tileX()+":"+db.tileY()+"="+db.dominantItem+"/"+db.dominantItems+" eff="+db.efficiency+" items="+db.items+" ";
    }
    event("defense","turrets="+turrets+" ammo="+ammo+" drills="+drills);
    java.util.TreeMap<String,Integer> counts=new java.util.TreeMap<>();
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux)counts.merge(eu.type.name,1,Integer::sum);
    event("enemy_types",counts.toString());
    if(core!=null && core.power!=null)event("core_power","produced="+core.power.graph.getPowerProduced()+" needed="+core.power.graph.getPowerNeeded()+" stored="+core.power.graph.getBatteryStored());
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.arc || b.block==Blocks.mender || b.block==Blocks.battery))event("power_detail",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" status="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status)+" stored="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getBatteryStored())+" needed="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerNeeded())+" produced="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.graph.getPowerProduced()));
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux && core!=null && eu.within(core,300))event("threat_detail",eu.type.name+" id="+eu.id+" health="+eu.health+" shield="+eu.shield+" x="+eu.x+" y="+eu.y);

   }
   if(!ended && initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size<=initialEnemyCores-1){ended=true;won=true;event("first_enemy_core","initial="+initialEnemyCores+" remaining="+Team.crux.cores().size);}
   if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){ended=true;won=false;}
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources)throw new IllegalStateException("cheat enabled");
  }
  event("end","won="+won+" ended="+ended+" wave="+state.wave+" built="+built+" failed="+failed+" index="+index);
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.tileX()>=35 && b.tileX()<=56 && b.tileY()>=65 && b.tileY()<=78)event("final_build",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" rotation="+b.rotation+" items="+b.items+(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb?" ammo="+tb.totalAmmo:""));
  exportCarry();
  if(recorder!=null)recorder.close();
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".final.msav"));log.close();if(probe!=null)probe.close();
  System.out.println("END won="+won+" wave="+state.wave+" sim_seconds="+tick/60f+" wall_seconds="+(System.nanoTime()-start)/1e9);
 }
 static void importCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryIn");if(path==null)return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();
  for(String row:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(path)).size())){
   String[] fields=row.split(",");Item item=content.item(fields[0]);int amount=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);int beforeSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]),afterSource=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);
   if(amount<0 || beforeSource-afterSource!=amount || Integer.parseInt(fields[4])!=seed || !fields[5].equals(EvaluationParameters.group))throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid inheritance receipt");
   int before=core.items.get(item),accepted=Math.min(amount,Math.max(0,core.storageCapacity-before));core.items.add(item,accepted);
   event("carry_in","item="+item.name+" exported="+amount+" before="+before+" accepted="+accepted+" overflow="+(amount-accepted)+" after="+core.items.get(item));
  }
 }
 static void exportCarry() throws Exception{
  String path=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.carryOut");if(path==null || !won || Team.sharded.core()==null)return;
  int[] caps=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.stageOrdinal","0").equals("0")?new int[]{1000,1000,500,500,500,200}:new int[]{1500,1500,800,800,800,300};
  Item[] items={Items.copper,Items.lead,Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.titanium,Items.metaglass};var core=Team.sharded.core();
  try(PrintWriter carry=new PrintWriter(path)){carry.println("item,amount,source_before,source_after,seed,group");
   for(int i=0;i<items.length;i++){Item item=items[i];int before=core.items.get(item),amount=Math.min(before,caps[i]);core.items.remove(item,amount);carry.println(item.name+","+amount+","+before+","+core.items.get(item)+","+seed+","+EvaluationParameters.group);event("carry_out","item="+item.name+" before="+before+" amount="+amount+" after="+core.items.get(item));}
  }
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){
   bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && c.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)==0){
    Building sink=null;for(Building bb:Groups.build)if(bb.team==Team.sharded && bb!=c && bb.acceptStack(u.item(),u.stack.amount,u)>0 && (sink==null || bb.dst2(u)<sink.dst2(u)))sink=bb;
    if(sink!=null){move(sink.x,sink.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(sink,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,sink);}
    else{event("discard","item="+u.item().name+" amount="+u.stack.amount+" reason=no_accepting_storage");InputHandler.dropItem(bot,0);}
   }
   return u.stack.amount==0;
  }
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static int ammoPriority(mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){
  if(tb.block==Blocks.scatter)return Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,tb.x,tb.y,400,eu->eu.isFlying())!=null?3:0;
  return tb.block==Blocks.salvo?2:1;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead())return;
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  if(AttackSupport.control())return;
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  {
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.earlyGraphite") || (commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count());
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && ((b.block==Blocks.duo && Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.manualDuo")) || b.block==Blocks.scatter || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.autoCopperBus") && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.duo?6:16)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || ammoPriority(tb)>ammoPriority(ammoTarget) || (ammoPriority(tb)==ammoPriority(ammoTarget) && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.scatter?Items.lead:ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper || ammoItem==Items.lead)mine(ammoItem);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty()){
     Object configuration;
     if(o.config.startsWith("point:")){String[] point=o.config.split(":");configuration=new Point2(Integer.parseInt(point[1]),Integer.parseInt(point[2]));}
     else configuration=content.item(o.config);
     if(!configuration.equals(t.build.config()))t.build.configureAny(configuration);
    }
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill || o.block==Blocks.salvo || o.block==Blocks.arc)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
}
````

````java
import java.io.*; import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Strategy search only. Native construction, mining and transfers; no formal inference from pilots. */
public class Pilot{
 static String mapName,layout,out; static int limit,seed,tick,index; static long seq;
 static Player bot; static PrintWriter log; static ArrayList<Order> orders=new ArrayList<>();
 static int built,failed; static boolean won,ended; static final Vec2 movement=new Vec2();static float goalX,goalY,goalRadius;
 static class Order{Block block;int x,y,rotation;String config;boolean wasBuilt,critical;}
 static void event(String type,String detail){log.println(++seq+","+tick+","+type+","+detail.replace(',',';'));}
 public static void main(String[] args){
  mapName=args.length>0?args[0]:"stainedMountains";
  layout=args.length>1?args[1]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/pilot-layout.csv";
  out=args.length>2?args[2]:"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/pilot-01.csv";

 }
 static void run() throws Exception{
  Core.graphics=new MockGraphics(){@Override public float getDeltaTime(){return 1f/60f;}@Override public long getFrameId(){return tick;}};
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(out+".data"));
  headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(Vars.platform.getNet());Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();
  logicVars=new mindustry.logic.GlobalVars(){@Override public void update(){Player saved=Vars.player;Vars.player=null;try{super.update();}finally{Vars.player=saved;}}};
  content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();bases.load();
  log=new PrintWriter(out);log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");
  java.nio.file.Files.copy(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout),java.nio.file.Path.of(out+".layout.csv"));
  java.nio.file.Files.copy(java.nio.file.Path.of("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/src/Pilot.java"),java.nio.file.Path.of(out+".Pilot.java"));
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{won=e.winner==Team.sharded;ended=true;event("game_over",e.winner.name);});
  Events.on(WaveEvent.class,e->event("wave",String.valueOf(state.wave)));
  Events.on(BlockBuildEndEvent.class,e->{if(!e.breaking && e.team==Team.sharded){built++;event("constructed",e.tile.block().name+"@"+e.tile.x+":"+e.tile.y);}});
  Events.on(BlockDestroyEvent.class,e->{if(e.tile.team()==Team.sharded)event("destroyed",e.tile.block().name+"@"+e.tile.x+":"+e.tile.y);});
  Events.on(BuildDamageEvent.class,e->{if(e.build instanceof CoreBlock.CoreBuild)event("core_hit","source="+(e.source==null?"none":e.source.owner)+" health="+e.build.health);});
  logic.reset();Mathf.rand.setSeed(seed);world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/"+mapName));
  System.out.println("LOADED "+mapName+" actual="+state.map.name()+" width="+world.width()+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  ArrayList<Tile> remove=new ArrayList<>();
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.isCenter() && t.team()==Team.sharded && (t.block()==Blocks.duo || t.block()==Blocks.salvo))remove.add(t);
  for(Tile t:remove){event("protocol_remove",t.block().name+"@"+t.x+":"+t.y);t.remove();}
  state.rules.infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().cheat=false;Team.sharded.rules().fillItems=false;
  state.rules.unitCapVariable=false;state.rules.unitCap=mapName.equals("stainedMountains")?8:16;
  state.rules.buildCostMultiplier=1;
  if(!state.rules.attackMode)state.rules.winWave=30;
  Time.setDeltaProvider(()->1f);Time.setInternalTime(0);mindustry.logic.GlobalVars.rand.setSeed(seed);logic.play();
  System.out.println("PLAY core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  bot=Player.create();bot.name="evaluation-pilot";bot.team(Team.sharded);bot.add();Vars.player=bot;
  Team.sharded.core().requestSpawn(bot);
  net.host(40000+Math.floorMod(out.hashCode(),20000));
  if(!net.server() || !net.active())throw new IllegalStateException("Native server did not host");
  for(String line:java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).subList(1,java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(java.nio.file.Path.of(layout)).size())){
   String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Order o=new Order();o.block=content.getByName(ContentType.block,c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];orders.add(o);
  }
  event("start",mapName+" seed="+seed+" inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY());
  event("configuration","group="+EvaluationParameters.group+" alpha="+EvaluationParameters.alpha+" tick_substreams="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed"));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".initial.msav"));
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.audit")){
   PrintWriter randomAudit=new PrintWriter(out+".rng-audit.txt");Rand previous=Mathf.rand;
   Mathf.rand=new Rand(previous.seed0,previous.seed1){@Override public long nextLong(){
    if(tick>=14350 && tick<=14370){
     String caller="";for(StackTraceElement st:Thread.currentThread().getStackTrace())if(st.getClassName().startsWith("mindustry.") || st.getClassName().equals("arc.math.Mathf"))caller+=st.toString()+" <- ";
     randomAudit.println(tick+" "+Thread.currentThread().getName()+" "+seed0+":"+seed1+" "+caller);randomAudit.flush();
    }
    return super.nextLong();
   }};
  }
  TaskQueue posted=Reflect.get(HeadlessApplication.class,Core.app,"runnables");
  long start=System.nanoTime();PrintWriter probe=Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.diagnostic")?new PrintWriter(out+".probe.csv"):null;
  Object[] physicsWorlds=Reflect.get(mindustry.async.PhysicsProcess.class,unitPhysics,"physics");
  Rand[] physicalRandom=new Rand[4];for(int pi=0;pi<4;pi++)physicalRandom[pi]=Reflect.get(mindustry.async.PhysicsProcess.PhysicsWorld.class,physicsWorlds[pi],"rand");
  for(tick=0;tick<limit*60 && !ended;tick++){
   if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.stepSeed")){
    long z=seed ^ (0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L*(tick+1L)) ^ mapName.hashCode();
    z=(z^(z>>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;z=(z^(z>>>27))*0x94d049bb133111ebL;
    Mathf.rand.setSeed(z^(z>>>31));
   }
   posted.run();Time.updateGlobal();pathfinder.evaluationStep();controlPath.evaluationStep();
   long randBefore=Mathf.rand.seed0;act();long randAfterAct=Mathf.rand.seed0;
   asyncCore.begin();logic.update();asyncCore.end();
   if(probe!=null){
    long uh=1,bh=1,ph=1;
    for(Unit uu:Groups.unit){uh=uh*31+uu.id;uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.y);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.health);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.x);uh=uh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(uu.vel.y);}
    for(Bullet bb:Groups.bullet){ph=ph*31+bb.id;ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.x);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.y);ph=ph*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.damage);}
    for(Building bb:Groups.build){
     bh=bh*31+bb.id;bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.health);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(bb.efficiency);bh=bh*31+(bb.enabled?1:0);
     if(bb.items!=null)for(var it:content.items())bh=bh*31+bb.items.get(it);
     for(Building pp:bb.proximity)bh=bh*31+pp.pos();
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){bh=bh*31+tb.totalAmmo;bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(tb.reloadCounter);}
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db){bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(db.progress);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(db.warmup);}
     if(bb instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.distribution.Conveyor.ConveyorBuild cv){for(int ci=0;ci<cv.len;ci++){bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(cv.xs[ci]);bh=bh*31+Float.floatToIntBits(cv.ys[ci]);}}
    }
    String physical="";for(Rand rr:physicalRandom)physical+=","+rr.seed0+":"+rr.seed1;
    probe.println(tick+","+randBefore+","+randAfterAct+","+Mathf.rand.seed0+","+uh+","+bh+","+ph+","+goalX+":"+goalY+":"+goalRadius+physical);
   }
   if(tick%1800==0){
    var core=Team.sharded.core();
    event("sample","wave="+state.wave+" index="+index+" built="+built+" enemies="+state.enemies+" core="+(core==null?"none":core.health+" "+core.items)+" agent="+(bot.dead()?"dead":bot.unit().x+":"+bot.unit().y+" plan="+bot.unit().buildPlan()));
    log.flush();System.out.println("t="+tick/60+" wave="+state.wave+" order="+index+" enemies="+state.enemies);
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter || b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || b.block==Blocks.graphitePress))event("factory",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" items="+b.items+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" power="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status));
    float ammo=0;int turrets=0;String drills="";
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){ammo+=tb.totalAmmo;turrets++;}
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db)drills+=db.tileX()+":"+db.tileY()+"="+db.dominantItem+"/"+db.dominantItems+" eff="+db.efficiency+" items="+db.items+" ";
    }
    event("defense","turrets="+turrets+" ammo="+ammo+" drills="+drills);
    java.util.TreeMap<String,Integer> counts=new java.util.TreeMap<>();
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux)counts.merge(eu.type.name,1,Integer::sum);
    event("enemy_types",counts.toString());
   }
   if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){ended=true;won=false;}
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources)throw new IllegalStateException("cheat enabled");
  }
  event("end","won="+won+" ended="+ended+" wave="+state.wave+" built="+built+" failed="+failed+" index="+index);
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.tileX()>=35 && b.tileX()<=56 && b.tileY()>=65 && b.tileY()<=78)event("final_build",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" rotation="+b.rotation+" items="+b.items+(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb?" ammo="+tb.totalAmmo:""));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".final.msav"));log.close();if(probe!=null)probe.close();
  System.out.println("END won="+won+" wave="+state.wave+" sim_seconds="+tick/60f+" wall_seconds="+(System.nanoTime()-start)/1e9);
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);return u.stack.amount==0;}
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead()){if(tick%120==0)c.requestSpawn(bot);return;}
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  if(!urgent){
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count();
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.duo || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.salvo?16:6)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || (tb.block==Blocks.salvo && ammoTarget.block!=Blocks.salvo) || (tb.block==ammoTarget.block && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper)mine(Items.copper);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty() && t.build.config()!=content.item(o.config))t.build.configureAny(content.item(o.config));
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
````
````java
}

  ArrayList<Tile> remove=new ArrayList<>();

   if(tick%1800==0){
    var core=Team.sharded.core();
    event("sample","wave="+state.wave+" index="+index+" built="+built+" enemies="+state.enemies+" core="+(core==null?"none":core.health+" "+core.items)+" agent="+(bot.dead()?"dead":bot.unit().x+":"+bot.unit().y+" plan="+bot.unit().buildPlan()));
    log.flush();System.out.println("t="+tick/60+" wave="+state.wave+" order="+index+" enemies="+state.enemies);
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter || b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || b.block==Blocks.graphitePress))event("factory",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" items="+b.items+" efficiency="+b.efficiency+" power="+(b.power==null?-1:b.power.status));
    float ammo=0;int turrets=0;String drills="";
    for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded){
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb){ammo+=tb.totalAmmo;turrets++;}
     if(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db)drills+=db.tileX()+":"+db.tileY()+"="+db.dominantItem+"/"+db.dominantItems+" eff="+db.efficiency+" items="+db.items+" ";
    }
    event("defense","turrets="+turrets+" ammo="+ammo+" drills="+drills);
    java.util.TreeMap<String,Integer> counts=new java.util.TreeMap<>();
    for(Unit eu:Groups.unit)if(eu.team==Team.crux)counts.merge(eu.type.name,1,Integer::sum);
    event("enemy_types",counts.toString());
   }
   if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty()){ended=true;won=false;}
   if(state.rules.infiniteResources || Team.sharded.rules().cheat || Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources)throw new IllegalStateException("cheat enabled");
  }
  event("end","won="+won+" ended="+ended+" wave="+state.wave+" built="+built+" failed="+failed+" index="+index);
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.tileX()>=35 && b.tileX()<=56 && b.tileY()>=65 && b.tileY()<=78)event("final_build",b.block.name+"@"+b.tileX()+":"+b.tileY()+" rotation="+b.rotation+" items="+b.items+(b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb?" ammo="+tb.totalAmmo:""));
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(out+".final.msav"));log.close();if(probe!=null)probe.close();
  System.out.println("END won="+won+" wave="+state.wave+" sim_seconds="+tick/60f+" wall_seconds="+(System.nanoTime()-start)/1e9);
 }
 static void move(float x,float y,float radius){
  goalX=x;goalY=y;goalRadius=radius;
  Unit u=bot.unit();float dst=u.dst(x,y);
  if(dst>radius){movement.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(0.1f,(dst-radius)/8)));u.moveAt(movement);}
  else u.moveAt(movement.setZero());
 }
 static boolean deposit(){
  Unit u=bot.unit();var c=Team.sharded.core();if(u.stack.amount==0)return true;
  if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,c);return u.stack.amount==0;}
  move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);return false;
 }
 static void mine(Item item){
  Unit u=bot.unit();u.clearBuilding();
  if((u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=item) || u.stack.amount>=u.type.itemCapacity){u.mineTile=null;deposit();return;}
  Tile best=null;float cost=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
  for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.block()==Blocks.air && t.drop()==item && u.canMine(item)){
   float d=u.dst2(t);if(d<cost){cost=d;best=t;}
  }
  if(best==null){u.mineTile=null;return;}
  move(best.worldx(),best.worldy(),u.type.mineRange-4);
  u.mineTile=u.within(best,u.type.mineRange-2)?best:null;
 }
 static void act(){
  var c=Team.sharded.core();if(c==null)return;
  if(bot.dead()){if(tick%120==0)c.requestSpawn(bot);return;}
  Unit u=bot.unit();bot.set(u);u.updateBuilding=true;
  Unit enemy=Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,u.x,u.y,u.range(),x->true);
  if(enemy!=null){u.aim(enemy);u.lookAt(enemy);u.controlWeapons(true,true);}else u.controlWeapons(false,false);
  boolean urgent=false;
  for(Order repair:orders)if(repair.wasBuilt && (repair.critical || repair.block==Blocks.mender || repair.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || repair.block==Blocks.invertedSorter)){
   Tile rt=world.tile(repair.x,repair.y);
   if(rt.build==null || rt.block()!=repair.block || rt.team()!=Team.sharded){urgent=true;break;}
  }
  if(!urgent){
  // Native logistics priority: withdraw produced coal from paid drills, deliver to generators.
  Building fuelTarget=null,coalSource=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator && b.items.get(Items.coal)<3 && b.dst2(c)<250*250){
   if(fuelTarget==null || b.items.get(Items.coal)<fuelTarget.items.get(Items.coal))fuelTarget=b;
  }
  if(fuelTarget!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress) && b.items.get(Items.coal)>=5 && (coalSource==null || b.dst2(u)<coalSource.dst2(u)))coalSource=b;
   if(u.item()==Items.coal && u.stack.amount>0){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();move(fuelTarget.x,fuelTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(fuelTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,fuelTarget);}return;
   }
   if(coalSource!=null){
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}
    move(coalSource.x,coalSource.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(coalSource,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,coalSource,Items.coal,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;
   }
  }
  mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild ammoTarget=null;
  int salvosReady=0;boolean commissioned=true;
  for(Order order:orders){
   if(order.block==Blocks.salvo && order.wasBuilt)salvosReady++;
   if((order.block==Blocks.mender || order.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator) && !order.wasBuilt)commissioned=false;
  }
  boolean advancedAmmo=commissioned && salvosReady>=orders.stream().filter(o->o.block==Blocks.salvo).count();
  {
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.duo || (b.block==Blocks.salvo && !b.proximity.contains(nb->nb.block==Blocks.graphitePress))) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<(b.block==Blocks.salvo?16:6)){
    if(ammoTarget==null || (tb.block==Blocks.salvo && ammoTarget.block!=Blocks.salvo) || (tb.block==ammoTarget.block && tb.dst2(u)<ammoTarget.dst2(u)))ammoTarget=tb;
   }
  }
  ammoLogistics: if(ammoTarget!=null){
   Item ammoItem=ammoTarget.block==Blocks.salvo && advancedAmmo?Items.graphite:Items.copper;
   u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && u.item()!=ammoItem){deposit();return;}
   if(u.stack.amount==0){
    if(c.items.get(ammoItem)>0){move(c.x,c.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(c,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,c,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else if(ammoItem==Items.copper)mine(Items.copper);
    else{
     Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(ammoItem)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
     if(source!=null){move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,ammoItem,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
     else break ammoLogistics;
    }
    return;
   }
   move(ammoTarget.x,ammoTarget.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(ammoTarget,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,ammoTarget);}return;
  }
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild tb && tb.totalAmmo<4 && Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,b.x,b.y,300,eu->true)!=null){
   Building source=null;for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.block==Blocks.graphitePress && src.items.get(Items.graphite)>=3 && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
   if(u.item()==Items.graphite && u.stack.amount>0){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;move(b.x,b.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(b,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.transferInventory(bot,b);}return;}
   if(source!=null){u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,Items.graphite,u.type.itemCapacity);}return;}
  }
  }
  // First missing order, no adaptive layout changes. Rebuilding reuses the same order.
  Order current=null;
  for(int pass=0;pass<2 && current==null;pass++)for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);if(!o.wasBuilt)continue;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   boolean important=pass==0?(o.block==Blocks.mender || o.block==Blocks.combustionGenerator || o.block==Blocks.invertedSorter):o.critical;
   if(important && (t.build==null || t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)){current=o;index=i;break;}
  }
  if(current==null){
  for(int i=0;i<orders.size();i++){
   Order o=orders.get(i);Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
   if(t.build!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block){
    if(!o.config.isEmpty() && t.build.config()!=content.item(o.config))t.build.configureAny(content.item(o.config));
    o.wasBuilt=true;
    if(t.build instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.production.Drill.DrillBuild db && db.dominantItem==Items.coal)o.critical=true;
    if(o.block==Blocks.graphitePress || o.block==Blocks.pneumaticDrill)o.critical=true;
    continue;
   }
   current=o;index=i;break;
  }
  }
  if(current==null){index=orders.size();u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;mine(Items.copper);return;}
  Order o=current;Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);
  boolean started=t.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild;
  if(!started && !Build.validPlace(o.block,Team.sharded,o.x,o.y,o.rotation)){
   if(tick%300==0){event("placement_failed",o.block.name+"@"+o.x+":"+o.y+" existing="+t.block().name);failed++;}
   u.clearBuilding();u.mineTile=null;return;
  }
  Item missing=null;
  if(!started)for(ItemStack req:o.block.requirements)if(c.items.get(req.item)<EvaluationParameters.cost(Team.sharded,o.block,req.amount)){missing=req.item;break;}
  if(started){
   int[] remaining=Reflect.get(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild.class,t.build,"itemsLeft");
   if(remaining!=null)for(int ri=0;ri<remaining.length;ri++)if(c.items.get(o.block.requirements[ri].item)<remaining[ri]){missing=o.block.requirements[ri].item;break;}
  }
  if(missing!=null){
   if(u.stack.amount>0 && (u.item()==missing || u.stack.amount==u.type.itemCapacity)){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
   if(missing==Items.copper || missing==Items.lead)mine(missing);else{
    u.mineTile=null;u.clearBuilding();Building source=null;
    for(var src:Groups.build)if(src.team==Team.sharded && src.items!=null && src.items.get(missing)>=3 && src!=c && (source==null || src.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=src;
    if(source!=null){if(u.stack.amount>0){deposit();return;}move(source.x,source.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(u.within(source,itemTransferRange-4)){bot.set(u);InputHandler.requestItem(bot,source,missing,u.type.itemCapacity);}}
    else move(c.x,c.y,30);
   }
   return;
  }
  if(u.stack.amount>0){u.mineTile=null;if(!deposit())return;}
  u.mineTile=null;move(t.worldx(),t.worldy(),Math.min(40,u.type.buildRange-4));
  if(u.buildPlan()==null || u.buildPlan().x!=o.x || u.buildPlan().y!=o.y){u.clearBuilding();u.addBuild(new BuildPlan(o.x,o.y,o.rotation,o.block));}
 }
}
````

## run_calibration.py

从冻结合法入口复制独立档，执行40条原生实时C路线。

SHA-256：`24f424f9efd428d17417a6c072ba8bbe2b3c0d0082817f76208e28528f6b7d6a`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Formal native realtime C runner. Refuses to run before a frozen entry and acceptance exist."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,concurrent.futures,csv,hashlib,itertools,json,os,shutil,subprocess,threading,time
from verify_realtime import verify,verify_costs
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;F=ROOT/'frozen/C-v1';OUT=ROOT/'calibration'
JAVA='/workspace/toolchains/jdk-17.0.17+10/bin/java';LOCAL=threading.local();LOCK=threading.Lock();NUMBERS=itertools.count()
def atomic(path,data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);tmp=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp');tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');tmp.replace(path)
def manifest_check():
    manifest=json.loads((F/'manifest.json').read_text());acceptance=json.loads((ROOT/'results/C-frozen-acceptance.json').read_text())
    assert acceptance['passed'] and acceptance['freeze_id']==manifest['freeze_id']
    for name,digest in manifest['files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((F/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
    for name,digest in manifest['external_files'].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,name
    assert manifest['fps_cap']==30 and manifest['origin']=='ruinousShores'
    return manifest
def plan():
    return [dict(track='C',chain='A',policy=policy,group=group,alpha=0,seed=seed,run_id=f'C-A-{policy}-{group}-s{seed}') for seed in range(1000,1005) for policy in ['balanced','defensive'] for group in ['G0','G1','G2','G3']]
def run(job,manifest):
    if not hasattr(LOCAL,'number'):
        with LOCK:LOCAL.number=next(NUMBERS)
    base=OUT/job['run_id'];final=base/'route.json'
    if final.exists():return json.loads(final.read_text())
    for attempt in [1,2]:
        directory=base/f'attempt{attempt}';receipt=directory/'attempt-result.json'
        if receipt.exists():
            data=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
            if data['accepted']:atomic(final,data);return data
            continue
        if directory.exists():atomic(receipt,{**job,'attempt':attempt,'accepted':False,'valid':False,'technical_error':'Interrupted native route without accepted end record'});continue
        directory.mkdir(parents=True);profile=directory/'profile';output=directory/'run';output.mkdir();shutil.copytree(F/'entry-profile',profile)
        command=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g','-Dmindustry.eval.formalAccepted=true',f'-Dmindustry.eval.freezeId={manifest["freeze_id"]}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.cFreezeRoot={F}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.group={job["group"]}','-Dmindustry.eval.alpha=0','-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationFps=30',f'-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationOrigin={manifest["origin"]}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={48000+LOCAL.number}','-cp',f'{F}/classes:{F}/desktop.jar','RealtimeCampaign',str(profile),str(output),job['policy'],str(job['seed'])]
        atomic(directory/'invocation.json',dict(command=command,freeze_id=manifest['freeze_id'],entry_profile_files=manifest['entry_profile_files'],attempt=attempt))
        start=time.time()
        try:
            environment={**os.environ,'DISPLAY':':99','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE':'1','LP_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
            with (directory/'stdout.log').open('w') as log:code=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=environment,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=16*3600).returncode
            assert code==0,f'Native desktop exit {code}'
            native=json.loads((output/'route.json').read_text());assert native['formal_sample'] and native['freeze_id']==manifest['freeze_id'] and native['valid']
            stages=[]
            for letter in 'ABC':
                prefix=output/letter
                if not Path(str(prefix)+'.stages.csv').exists():continue
                check=verify(prefix)
                with Path(str(prefix)+'.stages.csv').open() as f:summary=next(csv.DictReader(f))
                stages.append(dict(stage=letter,path=str(prefix),summary=summary,artifact_check=check))
            assert len(stages)==native['stage_count']
            assert stages or native['reason']=='native_research_or_launch_gate_time_limit','No played calibration stage'
            costs=verify_costs(output/'campaign-costs.csv')
            data={**job,'attempt':attempt,'accepted':True,'valid':True,'complete':native['complete'],'native_route':native,'stages':stages,'costs':costs,'freeze_id':manifest['freeze_id'],'wall_seconds':time.time()-start,'output':str(output)}
            atomic(receipt,data);atomic(final,data);return data
        except Exception as error:
            atomic(receipt,{**job,'attempt':attempt,'accepted':False,'valid':False,'technical_error':repr(error),'wall_seconds':time.time()-start,'freeze_id':manifest['freeze_id']})
    data={**job,'accepted':False,'valid':False,'complete':False,'technical_error':'Same seed exhausted both technical attempts','freeze_id':manifest['freeze_id']};atomic(final,data);return data
def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=8);args=parser.parse_args();manifest=manifest_check();jobs=plan();assert len(jobs)==40
    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);atomic(OUT/'planned-cells.json',jobs);finished=valid=complete=0;start=time.time()
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as pool:
        futures={pool.submit(run,job,manifest):job for job in jobs}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            job=futures[future];result=future.result();finished+=1;valid+=result['valid'];complete+=result['complete']
            atomic(OUT/'progress.json',dict(freeze_id=manifest['freeze_id'],target=40,finished=finished,valid=valid,complete=complete,last=job['run_id'],wall_seconds=time.time()-start));print(f'{finished}/40 {job["run_id"]} valid={result["valid"]} complete={result["complete"]}',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

## run_formal.py

执行S预注册矩阵、同种子技术重试、保存阶段与路线结果。

SHA-256：`89f8ed1c7fb17c12aecbc2268ca2aa89175fab7f1c7ce2b03472e823e019e853`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Resumeable native S-route runner. No simulated measurements or replacement seeds."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse, concurrent.futures, csv, gzip, hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, threading, time
from verify_recorder import verify

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
FROZEN=ROOT/'frozen/S-v2'
OUT=ROOT/'formal'
JAVA='/workspace/toolchains/jdk-17.0.17+10/bin/java'
ASSETS='/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/core/assets'
LOCK=threading.Lock()
WORKERS=threading.local()
COUNTER=iter(range(32))

def atomic(path,obj):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    tmp=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp')
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');tmp.replace(path)

def manifest_check():
    m=json.loads((FROZEN/'manifest.json').read_text())
    for name,digest in m['files'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((FROZEN/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest, 'Frozen file changed: '+name
    for name in ['stainedMountains','windsweptIslands','fungalPass','overgrowth']:
        assert hashlib.sha256((Path(ASSETS)/'maps/serpulo'/(name+'.msav')).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['files']['maps/'+name+'.msav']
    return m['freeze_id']

def planned():
    cells=[]
    def add(experiment,chain,groups,n,alphas=(0,)):
        for seed in range(1000,1000+n):
            for policy in ['balanced','defensive']:
                for alpha in alphas:
                    for group in groups:
                        key=f'S-{chain}-{policy}-{group}-a{alpha:02d}-s{seed}'
                        cells.append(dict(experiment=experiment,track='S',chain=chain,policy=policy,group=group,alpha=alpha/10,seed=seed,run_id=key))
    add('main','A',['G0','G1','G2','G3'],30)
    add('decomposition','A',['G2H','G2C','G1X','G3X'],30)
    add('ablation','A',['I_only_'+k for k in 'MTGSP']+['I_without_'+k for k in 'MTGSP']+['I_SP'],30)
    add('pressure','A',['G0','G1','G2','G3'],20,range(21))
    add('robustness','B',['G0','G1','G2','G3'],20)
    assert len(cells)==4660
    jobs={}
    for c in cells:
        if c['run_id'] not in jobs:jobs[c['run_id']]={**c,'experiments':[]}
        jobs[c['run_id']]['experiments'].append(c['experiment'])
    return cells,list(jobs.values())

def compress(path):
    if not path.exists():return
    digest=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    with path.open('rb') as src,path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.gz').open('wb') as dst:
        with gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=dst,mtime=0) as z:shutil.copyfileobj(src,z)
    path.unlink()
    return digest

def one_stage(job,ordinal,previous,freeze_id):
    rid=job['run_id'];stage='ABC'[ordinal];base=OUT/rid
    base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if job['chain']=='A':maps=['stainedMountains','windsweptIslands','fungalPass'];layouts=['A','B','C']
    else:maps=['stainedMountains','fungalPass','overgrowth'];layouts=['A','C','overgrowth']
    for attempt in [1,2]:
        path=base/f'{stage}-attempt{attempt}.csv';result=Path(str(path)+'.result.json')
        if result.exists():
            data=json.loads(result.read_text())
            if data['accepted']:return data
            continue
        if path.exists():
            atomic(result,dict(accepted=False,technical_error='Interrupted stage has no accepted result',attempt=attempt,path=str(path)))
            continue
        carry=Path(str(path)+'.carry.csv')
        cmd=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g','-Dmindustry.eval.manualDuo=true','-Dmindustry.eval.earlyGraphite=true',
             '-Dmindustry.eval.formalRecorder=true','-Dmindustry.eval.formalAccepted=true',
             f'-Dmindustry.eval.freezeId={freeze_id}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourceRoot={FROZEN}/src',f'-Dmindustry.eval.sourcePath={FROZEN}/src/Pilot.java',
             f'-Dmindustry.eval.group={job["group"]}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.alpha={job["alpha"]:.1f}',
             f'-Dmindustry.eval.policy={job["policy"]}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.chain={job["chain"]}',
             f'-Dmindustry.eval.stageOrdinal={ordinal}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.runId={rid}',
             f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={44000+WORKERS.number}',f'-Dmindustry.eval.carryOut={carry}']
        if previous:cmd.append(f'-Dmindustry.eval.carryIn={previous["carry"]}')
        cmd+=['-cp',f'{FROZEN}/classes:{FROZEN}/server.jar','Pilot',maps[ordinal],str(FROZEN/'layouts'/f'{job["policy"]}-{layouts[ordinal]}.csv'),str(path),'5400',str(job['seed'])]
        start=time.time()
        atomic(Path(str(path)+'.invocation.json'),dict(command=cmd,cwd=ASSETS,freeze_id=freeze_id,attempt=attempt))
        try:
            with Path(str(path)+'.stdout.log').open('w') as log:
                process=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=ASSETS,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=3600)
            assert process.returncode==0,f'Native JVM exit {process.returncode}'
            check=verify(path)
            assert check['formal_sample'],'Run not admitted by recorder'
            with Path(str(path)+'.stages.csv').open() as f:summary=next(csv.DictReader(f))
            won=summary['won']=='true'
            if won:assert carry.exists(),'Won stage missing actual source debit receipt'
            data=dict(accepted=True,won=won,path=str(path),stage=stage,attempt=attempt,carry=str(carry) if won else None,summary=summary,wall_seconds=time.time()-start,freeze_id=freeze_id)
            data['uncompressed_sha256']={str(z.name):compress(z) for z in [path,Path(str(path)+'.events.csv')]}
            atomic(result,data)
            return data
        except Exception as e:
            atomic(result,dict(accepted=False,technical_error=str(e),attempt=attempt,path=str(path),wall_seconds=time.time()-start))
    return dict(accepted=False,technical_error='Same seed failed both technical attempts',stage=stage)

def route(job,freeze_id):
    if not hasattr(WORKERS,'number'):
        with LOCK:WORKERS.number=next(COUNTER)
    result=OUT/job['run_id']/'route.json'
    if result.exists():return json.loads(result.read_text())
    stages=[];previous=None
    for ordinal in range(3):
        s=one_stage(job,ordinal,previous,freeze_id);stages.append(s)
        if not s['accepted'] or not s['won']:break
        previous=s
    data={**job,'freeze_id':freeze_id,'valid':all(s['accepted'] for s in stages),'complete':len(stages)==3 and all(s.get('won',False) for s in stages),'reached_stages':len(stages),'stages':stages}
    atomic(result,data)
    return data

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('--workers',type=int,default=4);parser.add_argument('--experiment',choices=['all','main'],default='all');args=parser.parse_args()
    freeze_id=manifest_check()
    acceptance=json.loads((ROOT/'results/frozen-acceptance.json').read_text())
    assert acceptance['passed'] and acceptance['freeze_id']==freeze_id,'Frozen-source observer/repeat acceptance missing'
    cells,jobs=planned();OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    with (OUT/'planned_cells.csv').open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(cells[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(cells)
    if args.experiment=='main':jobs=[j for j in jobs if 'main' in j['experiments']]
    count=valid=complete=0;start=time.time()
    print(f'Starting {len(jobs)} unique routes, {len(cells)} requested S cells; freeze {freeze_id}',flush=True)
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=args.workers) as pool:
        futures={pool.submit(route,j,freeze_id):j for j in jobs}
        for future in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            job=futures[future]
            try:
                r=future.result();valid+=r['valid'];complete+=r['complete'];message=f'{job["run_id"]} valid={r["valid"]} complete={r["complete"]} reached={r["reached_stages"]}'
            except Exception as e:message=f'{job["run_id"]} RUNNER_ERROR {type(e).__name__}: {e}'
            count+=1
            atomic(OUT/'progress.json',dict(freeze_id=freeze_id,unique_routes_target=len(jobs),finished=count,valid=valid,complete=complete,wall_seconds=time.time()-start,last=message,remaining_tracks=['C','G']))
            print(f'{count}/{len(jobs)} {message}',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

SHA-256：`294bdd9271950e94e0695ab84a3d0a12d0446b7398f2c60ef21e9040aaf082c7`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Continue actual native prerequisite sectors, retaining the live parent's process tree."""
from pathlib import Path
import csv,hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,time
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;JAVA='/workspace/toolchains/jdk-17.0.17+10/bin/java'
CP=f'{ROOT}/native-campaign-v5-classes:{ROOT}/frozen/S-v2/classes:/workspace/Anuken-Mindustry/desktop/build/libs/Mindustry.jar'
PROFILE=ROOT/'campaign-preparation/recovery-from-frozenForest/profile'
STATE=ROOT/'results/C-preparation-pipeline.json'
ENV={**os.environ,'DISPLAY':':99','LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE':'1','LP_NUM_THREADS':'1'}
training=[]
def atomic(path,data):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);temporary=path.with_suffix(path.suffix+'.tmp');temporary.write_text(json.dumps(data,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');temporary.replace(path)
def live_profile():
    for directory in Path('/proc').iterdir():
        if not directory.name.isdigit():continue
        try:
            args=(directory/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0')
            if args and args[0].endswith(b'/java') and b'NativeCampaignStage' in args and str(PROFILE).encode() in args:return True
        except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError,PermissionError):pass
    return False
def wait_current(prefix):
    result=Path(str(prefix)+'.result.json');last=0
    while not result.exists() or live_profile():
        if time.time()-last>=30:
            last=time.time();atomic(STATE,dict(status='waiting_current_native_cratered',profile=str(PROFILE),formal_C_samples=0,last_observation=time.time()));print('Waiting on actual current Cratered preparation and native process exit',flush=True)
        if not live_profile() and not result.exists():raise RuntimeError('Current prerequisite process exited without a final result; recover a committed matched checkpoint before continuing')
        time.sleep(1)
    data=json.loads(result.read_text());assert data['captured'] and data['reason']=='native_captured_researched_and_stocked',data
    return data
def snapshot(name,result):
    destination=ROOT/'campaign-preparation/checkpoints'/('after-'+name)
    assert not destination.exists(),f'Never overwrite existing native checkpoint: {destination}'
    temporary=destination.with_name(destination.name+'.writing');temporary.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copy2(PROFILE/'settings.bin',temporary/'settings.bin');shutil.copytree(PROFILE/'saves',temporary/'saves',ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('*.png','*.spreview'))
    files={str(p.relative_to(temporary)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(temporary.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
    atomic(temporary/'manifest.json',dict(native_result=result,formal_sample=False,normal_native_save_and_settings_forceSave_before_exit=True,profile_files=files));temporary.replace(destination)
    atomic(ROOT/'results/C-profile-state.json',dict(active_profile=str(PROFILE),preparation_only=True,current_preparation_target=name,completed_native_prerequisite=name,checkpoint=str(destination),formal_C_samples=0,current_driver='NativeCampaignStage v5; native paid actions and verified paired snapshots'))
    return destination
def start_training(entry):
    for policy,port in [('balanced',47201),('defensive',47202)]:
        base=ROOT/'training/C-native-A'/policy;profile=base/'profile';assert not profile.exists();shutil.copytree(entry,profile)
        output=base/'run';output.mkdir();log=(ROOT/'logs'/f'C-training-A-{policy}.log').open('w')
        cp=f'{ROOT}/realtime-calibration-v6-classes:{CP}'
        command=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g','-Dmindustry.eval.formalAccepted=false','-Dmindustry.eval.group=G0','-Dmindustry.eval.alpha=0','-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationFps=30','-Dmindustry.eval.debugMap=stainedMountains','-Dmindustry.eval.debugNativeOrigin=biomassFacility',f'-Dmindustry.eval.debugLayout={ROOT}/frozen/S-v2/layouts/{policy}-A.csv','-Dmindustry.eval.calibrationLimit=5400',f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={port}','-cp',cp,'RealtimeCampaign',str(profile),str(output),policy,'0']
        atomic(base/'invocation.json',dict(command=command,formal_sample=False,entry_source=str(entry)));process=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT);training.append((policy,process,log,output));print('Started nonformal native A training',policy,'PID',process.pid,flush=True)
def play(target,origin,layout,port):
    prefix=ROOT/'campaign-preparation'/target/'attempt1';prefix.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True);assert not Path(str(prefix)+'.events.csv').exists()
    command=[JAVA,'-Xmx2g',f'-Dmindustry.eval.port={port}','-Dmindustry.eval.preparationLimit=14400','-cp',CP,'NativeCampaignStage',target,origin,str(ROOT/layout),str(PROFILE),str(prefix),'copper:3500,lead:2500,graphite:1000,silicon:2000,metaglass:500']
    atomic(Path(str(prefix)+'.invocation.json'),dict(command=command,formal_sample=False,actual_campaign_profile=str(PROFILE)))
    atomic(STATE,dict(status='native_prerequisite_running',target=target,profile=str(PROFILE),formal_C_samples=0))
    with (ROOT/'logs'/f'native-preparation-{target}-01.log').open('w') as log:
        code=subprocess.run(command,cwd=ROOT,env=ENV,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT).returncode
    assert code==0,(target,code);data=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.result.json').read_text());assert data['captured'] and data['reason']=='native_captured_researched_and_stocked',data
    return snapshot(target,data)
def main():
    current=ROOT/'campaign-preparation/crateredBattleground/attempt3';data=wait_current(current);snapshot('crateredBattleground',data)
    entry=play('biomassFacility','crateredBattleground','campaign-biomassFacility-v2-layout.csv',47092);start_training(entry)
    final=play('ruinousShores','biomassFacility','campaign-ruinousShores-v2-layout.csv',47093)
    results=[]
    from verify_realtime import verify,verify_costs
    for policy,process,log,output in training:
        code=process.wait();log.close();assert code==0,(policy,code)
        route=json.loads((output/'route.json').read_text());assert route['formal_sample'] is False and route['valid']
        checks=verify(output/'A');costs=verify_costs(output/'campaign-costs.csv');atomic(output/'artifact-check.json',dict(stage=checks,costs=costs))
        results.append(dict(policy=policy,route=route,artifact_checks=str(output/'artifact-check.json')))
    atomic(ROOT/'results/C-native-entry-and-training.json',dict(status='native_prerequisites_complete_training_recorded_freeze_pending',entry_checkpoint=str(final),training=results,formal_C_samples=0))
    atomic(STATE,dict(status='native_entry_ready_C_freeze_pending',entry_checkpoint=str(final),formal_C_samples=0));print('Native prerequisite entry and nonformal A training complete; C still not admitted',flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__':
    try:main()
    except Exception as error:
        atomic(STATE,dict(status='requires_diagnosis',error=repr(error),formal_C_samples=0));raise
````

````python
"""Nonformal Ruinous retry from the immutable earned Bio checkpoint; keeps failure evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib, json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time

ROOT = Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation')
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import run_native_prerequisites as p
from verify_realtime import verify, verify_costs

STATE = ROOT / 'results/runtime-C-preparation-recovery.json'


def state(**kwargs):
    p.atomic(STATE, dict(observed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                         daemon_managed=True, pid=os.getpid(),
                         recovers_child='C_preparation', superseded_exit_code=1,
                         formal_samples_added=0, **kwargs))


def main():
    state(alive=True, exit_code=None, completed=False)
    entry = ROOT / 'campaign-preparation/checkpoints/after-biomassFacility'
    manifest = json.loads((entry / 'manifest.json').read_text())
    assert manifest['native_result']['captured']
    for name, sha in manifest['profile_files'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((entry / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha
    p.PROFILE = ROOT / 'campaign-preparation/retry-ruinous-from-biomass/profile'
    assert not p.PROFILE.exists()
    shutil.copytree(entry, p.PROFILE)
    output = ROOT / 'campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/attempt2'
    assert not Path(str(output) + '.events.csv').exists()
    layout = ROOT / 'campaign-ruinousShores-v3-layout.csv'
    driver = ROOT / 'campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/driver-v3'
    files = {str(f.relative_to(driver)): hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
             for f in driver.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
    p.atomic(driver / 'manifest.json', dict(preparation_only=True, files=files,
                                          layout_sha256=hashlib.sha256(layout.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
    recovery_path = ROOT / 'results/C-preparation-continuations.json'
    recovery = json.loads(recovery_path.read_text())
    recovery['canonical_segments'].append(dict(sector='ruinousShores',
                                               artifact='campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/attempt2.events.csv',
                                               through_seq=None))
    recovery['active_continuation_profile'] = str(p.PROFILE)
    recovery['additional_excluded_histories'] = ['ruinousShores attempt1: genuine native defeat; retry starts from complete Bio checkpoint']
    p.atomic(recovery_path, recovery)
    command = [p.JAVA, '-Xmx2g', '-Dmindustry.eval.port=47093',
               '-Dmindustry.eval.preparationLimit=14400', '-cp', str(driver / 'classes') + ':' + p.CP,
               'NativeCampaignStage', 'ruinousShores', 'biomassFacility', str(layout),
               str(p.PROFILE), str(output),
               'copper:3500,lead:2500,graphite:1000,silicon:2000,metaglass:500']
    p.atomic(Path(str(output) + '.invocation.json'), dict(command=command, formal_sample=False,
             actual_campaign_profile=str(p.PROFILE), initial_checkpoint=str(entry),
             failed_attempt_preserved='campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/attempt1'))
    p.atomic(p.STATE, dict(status='native_prerequisite_running', target='ruinousShores', attempt=2,
                          profile=str(p.PROFILE), formal_C_samples=0))
    with (ROOT / 'logs/native-preparation-ruinousShores-02.log').open('w') as log:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=p.ENV, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        while process.poll() is None:
            state(alive=True, exit_code=None, completed=False, native_child_pid=process.pid)
            time.sleep(10)
        assert process.returncode == 0, process.returncode
    result = json.loads(Path(str(output) + '.result.json').read_text())
    assert result['captured'] and result['reason'] == 'native_captured_researched_and_stocked', result
    final = p.snapshot('ruinousShores', result)
    training = []
    for policy in ['balanced', 'defensive']:
        base = ROOT / 'training/C-native-A' / policy / 'run'
        route = json.loads((base / 'route.json').read_text())
        assert route['valid'] and route['formal_sample'] is False
        p.atomic(base / 'artifact-check.json', dict(stage=verify(base / 'A'),
                                                   costs=verify_costs(base / 'campaign-costs.csv')))
        training.append(dict(policy=policy, route=route, artifact_checks=str(base / 'artifact-check.json')))
    p.atomic(ROOT / 'results/C-native-entry-and-training.json', dict(
        status='native_prerequisites_complete_training_recorded_freeze_pending',
        entry_checkpoint=str(final), training=training, formal_C_samples=0,
        preparation_retry='results/C-ruinous-preparation-retry.json'))
    p.atomic(p.STATE, dict(status='native_entry_ready_C_freeze_pending', entry_checkpoint=str(final), formal_C_samples=0))
    state(alive=False, exit_code=0, completed=True, entry_checkpoint=str(final))
    print('Actual Ruinous retry completed; earned native entry and training checks ready', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        main()
    except Exception as error:
        state(alive=False, exit_code=1, completed=False, error=repr(error))
        p.atomic(p.STATE, dict(status='requires_diagnosis', error=repr(error), formal_C_samples=0))
        raise
````

## runtime-container/supervise.py

Daemon-owned batch supervision; never silently counts a dead process as progress.

SHA-256：`17b8abda3728d8875f71bdf27bdb16d8940ae39edd19b80b532e4fa2de8f2927`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Daemon-owned batch supervision; never silently counts a dead process as progress."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import json,os,subprocess,time
ROOT=Path('/workspace/mindustry-evaluation')
def write(path,data):
    temporary=path.with_suffix('.json.tmp');temporary.write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n');temporary.replace(path)
def main():
    assert json.loads((ROOT/'results/container-runtime-validation.json').read_text())['passed']
    programs=[('S',['python','run_formal.py','--workers','4'],'formal-runner-v2-container.log'),('C_preparation',['python','runtime-container/continue_campaign.py'],'native-prerequisite-container.log'),('finish',['python','finish_benchmark.py'],'finish-benchmark-container.log')]
    jobs=[]
    for name,command,filename in programs:
        log=(ROOT/'logs'/filename).open('w');process=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT);jobs.append((name,process,log))
    while True:
        status={name:dict(pid=process.pid,alive=process.poll() is None,exit_code=process.poll()) for name,process,_ in jobs}
        state=dict(observed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),container_hostname=Path('/etc/hostname').read_text().strip(),daemon_managed=True,children=status,requires_diagnosis=any(v['exit_code'] not in [None,0] for v in status.values()))
        for label,path in [('S_progress','formal/progress.json'),('C_progress','calibration/progress.json'),('C_preparation','results/C-preparation-pipeline.json')]:
            if (ROOT/path).exists():state[label]=json.loads((ROOT/path).read_text())
        write(ROOT/'results/runtime-supervisor-state.json',state)
        if all(not v['alive'] for v in status.values()):break
        time.sleep(10)
    for _,_,log in jobs:log.close()
if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

## runtime_quiescence.py

Resolve recorded controller failures only through explicit successful native recovery evidence.

SHA-256：`f7d261a5d68cd51a509b3a7af4a20fb97071ba118b90c8f7834c69f66e25b346`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Resolve recorded controller failures only through explicit successful native recovery evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import json

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent


def inspect():
    path = ROOT / 'results/runtime-supervisor-state.json'
    if not path.exists():
        return dict(quiescent=False, requires_diagnosis=True, active=[], errors=['Missing runtime supervisor evidence'])
    runtime = json.loads(path.read_text())
    active = [name for name, child in runtime['children'].items() if child['alive']]
    errors, recovered = [], []
    for name, child in runtime['children'].items():
        if child['exit_code'] in [None, 0]:
            continue
        recovery_path = ROOT / 'results/runtime-C-preparation-recovery.json'
        if name != 'C_preparation' or child['exit_code'] != 1 or not recovery_path.exists():
            errors.append(f'{name} exited {child["exit_code"]} without a recorded recovery')
            continue
        recovery = json.loads(recovery_path.read_text())
        assert recovery['recovers_child'] == name and recovery['superseded_exit_code'] == child['exit_code']
        if recovery['alive']:
            active.append('C_preparation_recovery')
        elif recovery['completed'] and recovery['exit_code'] == 0:
            entry = Path(recovery['entry_checkpoint'])
            native = json.loads((entry / 'manifest.json').read_text())['native_result']
            ready = json.loads((ROOT / 'results/C-native-entry-and-training.json').read_text())
            assert native['captured'] and native['reason'] == 'native_captured_researched_and_stocked'
            assert ready['entry_checkpoint'] == str(entry)
            recovered.append(dict(child=name, original_exit_code=child['exit_code'],
                                  successful_recovery=str(recovery_path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                                  original_failure_preserved=True))
        else:
            errors.append(f'{name} recovery failed or did not complete')
    return dict(quiescent=not active and not errors, requires_diagnosis=bool(errors),
                active=active, errors=errors, recovered_failures=recovered)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps(inspect(), indent=2))
````

Resolve two preparation-only pending orders sharing one tile, using legal native placement.

SHA-256：`33ffa099a7f99e5398db6c126d93c447af533720ed0052e868c841e445302fed`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.world.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Resolve two preparation-only pending orders sharing one tile, using legal native placement. */
public class CorrectPreparationOrderPositionAgent{
 public static void agentmain(String unused,Instrumentation ignored){Core.app.post(()->{
  if(headless || !state.isCampaign() || !"frozenForest".equals(Pilot.mapName))throw new IllegalStateException("Not prerequisite client");
  for(Pilot.Order order:Pilot.orders)if(order.block==Blocks.arc){
   Tile chosen=null;double best=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   for(Tile tile:world.tiles){boolean reserved=false;for(Pilot.Order other:Pilot.orders)if(other!=order && other.x==tile.x && other.y==tile.y){reserved=true;break;}
    if(!reserved && Build.validPlace(order.block,Team.sharded,tile.x,tile.y,0,false)){double d=tile.dst2(Team.sharded.core().tile);if(d<best){chosen=tile;best=d;}}
   }
   if(chosen==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No distinct native Arc site");
   order.x=chosen.x;order.y=chosen.y;order.wasBuilt=false;NativeCampaignStage.event("preparation_tutorial_order_relocated","block=arc;x="+order.x+";y="+order.y+";pending_battery_site_kept_distinct=true");
  }
 });}
}
````
