````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.sdl.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.util.*;
import mindustry.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.desktop.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.game.EventType.*;import mindustry.io.*;
import java.io.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Native SDL campaign readiness check, realtime. NOT a calibration sample. */
public class DesktopSmoke{
 static long started;static boolean launched,done;static PrintWriter log;
 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  String root="/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/desktop-smoke";new java.io.File(root).mkdirs();System.setProperty("mindustry.data.dir",root);System.setProperty("nodiscord","true");
  log=new PrintWriter(root+"/realtime.csv");log.println("wall_seconds,simulation_seconds,delta,campaign,sector,core_copper");
  Events.on(ClientLoadEvent.class,e->{Core.settings.put("backgroundpause",false);Core.settings.put("skipcoreanimation",true);Core.settings.put("fpscap",60);Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->{
   control.playSector(Planets.serpulo.getStartSector());
  }));});
  Events.on(SectorLaunchEvent.class,e->{started=System.nanoTime();launched=true;System.out.println("NATIVE_CAMPAIGN_LAUNCH sector="+e.sector.id+" fixed="+Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.fixed"));});
  Events.run(Trigger.afterGameUpdate,()->{if(!launched || done)return;
   double sim=state.tick/60.0,wall=(System.nanoTime()-started)/1e9;
   if(((int)sim)%10==0){log.println(wall+","+sim+","+Time.delta+","+state.isCampaign()+","+state.rules.sector.id+","+(Team.sharded.core()==null?-1:Team.sharded.core().items.get(Items.copper)));log.flush();}
   if(sim>=60){done=true;try{SaveIO.write(new Fi(root+"/native-campaign-60s.msav"));log.close();System.out.println("DESKTOP_SMOKE_PASS sim="+sim+" wall="+wall+" campaign="+state.isCampaign());Core.app.exit();}catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}}
  });
  Version.init();Vars.loadLogger();
  new SdlApplication(new DesktopLauncher(new String[0]),new SdlConfig(){{title="Mindustry native campaign calibration readiness";width=640;height=480;disableAudio=true;vSyncEnabled=false;}});
 }
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;import java.nio.file.*;import mindustry.content.*;import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Add paid native build plans only to the captured nonformal prerequisite stage. */
public class ExtendPreparationLogisticsAgent{
 public static void agentmain(String file,Instrumentation ignored){Core.app.post(()->{try{
  if(headless || !state.isCampaign() || !NativeCampaignStage.ready || !NativeCampaignStage.captured || !"crateredBattleground".equals(Pilot.mapName))throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong captured preparation process");
  int changed=0;for(Pilot.Order order:Pilot.orders)if(order.block==Blocks.mechanicalDrill){int sand=0;boolean other=false;for(int dx=0;dx<2;dx++)for(int dy=0;dy<2;dy++){var drop=world.tile(order.x+dx,order.y+dy).drop();if(drop==Items.sand)sand++;else if(drop!=null)other=true;}if(sand>=2 && !other){order.block=Blocks.pneumaticDrill;order.wasBuilt=false;order.critical=true;changed++;}}
  int added=0;var lines=java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(Path.of(file));for(String line:lines.subList(1,lines.size())){String[] fields=line.split(",",-1);Pilot.Order order=new Pilot.Order();order.block=content.block(fields[0]);order.x=Integer.parseInt(fields[1]);order.y=Integer.parseInt(fields[2]);order.rotation=Integer.parseInt(fields[3]);order.config=fields[4];Pilot.orders.add(order);added++;}
  NativeCampaignStage.researchGoals=new String[]{"pneumatic-drill","steam-generator","hail","mechanical-pump"};
  NativeCampaignStage.event("preparation_paid_logistics_extension","pneumatic_replacement_orders="+changed+";new_conveyor_orders="+added+";file="+file+";native_research_and_all_construction_materials_must_be_paid=true;formal_layouts_unchanged=true");
 }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}});}
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.headless.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;
import mindustry.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.io.*;import mindustry.net.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;
import java.io.*;import java.util.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Native generator-only survey. Choice uses map suitability, never benchmark group outcomes. */
public class GenerateSector{
 public static void main(String[] args){new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/generation-data"));headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(null);Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();bases.load();
  TreeMap<Integer,Integer> sizes=new TreeMap<>();for(Sector s:Planets.serpulo.sectors)sizes.merge(s.getSize(),1,Integer::sum);System.out.println("native_sector_sizes="+sizes);System.out.println("all_sectors="+Planets.serpulo.sectors.size);
  try(PrintWriter sizesCsv=new PrintWriter("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/native-sector-dimensions.csv")){sizesCsv.println("planet,sector,native_size,preset,enemy_base");for(Sector s:Planets.serpulo.sectors)sizesCsv.println("serpulo,"+s.id+","+s.getSize()+","+(s.preset==null?"":s.preset.name)+","+s.generateEnemyBase);}
  ArrayList<Sector> candidates=new ArrayList<>();
  for(Sector s:Planets.serpulo.sectors)if(s.preset==null && s.getSize()==192 && !s.generateEnemyBase)candidates.add(s);
  candidates.sort(Comparator.comparingInt(s->s.id));System.out.println("native_192_nonpreset_survival_candidates="+candidates.size());
  try(PrintWriter audit=new PrintWriter("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/generated-sector-survey.csv")){
   audit.println("sector,size,enemy_cores,core,copper,lead,coal,sand,titanium,selected");
   for(Sector s:candidates){logic.reset();Mathf.rand.setSeed(0);world.loadSector(s,new WorldParams(){{saveInfo=false;}});
    TreeMap<String,Integer> ore=new TreeMap<>();for(Tile t:world.tiles)if(t.drop()!=null && !t.solid())ore.merge(t.drop().name,1,Integer::sum);
    boolean suitable=Team.crux.cores().isEmpty() && Team.sharded.core()!=null && Team.sharded.core().block==Blocks.coreShard;
    for(String k:new String[]{"copper","lead","coal","sand","titanium"})suitable &= ore.getOrDefault(k,0)>=4;
    audit.println(s.id+","+s.getSize()+","+Team.crux.cores().size+","+(Team.sharded.core()==null?"none":Team.sharded.core().block.name)+","+ore.getOrDefault("copper",0)+","+ore.getOrDefault("lead",0)+","+ore.getOrDefault("coal",0)+","+ore.getOrDefault("sand",0)+","+ore.getOrDefault("titanium",0)+","+suitable);audit.flush();
    System.out.println("sector="+s.id+" core="+Team.sharded.core()+" resources="+ore+" suitable="+suitable);
    if(!suitable)continue;
    state.rules.sector=null;state.map.tags.put("name","generated192Sector"+s.id);SaveIO.write(new Fi("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/generated192Sector"+s.id+".msav"));
    try(PrintWriter w=new PrintWriter("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/tiles-generated192Sector"+s.id+".csv")){
     w.println("x,y,block,team,ore,solid,liquid");for(Tile t:world.tiles)w.println(t.x+","+t.y+","+t.block().name+","+t.team().id+","+(t.drop()==null?"":t.drop().name)+","+t.solid()+","+t.floor().isLiquid);
    }
    System.out.println("SELECTED sector="+s.id+" core="+Team.sharded.core().tileX()+":"+Team.sharded.core().tileY()+" native_win_wave="+state.rules.winWave+" spawns="+state.rules.spawns.size);break;
   }
  }
  System.exit(0);
 }catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});}
}
````

````java
import arc.Core;
import java.lang.instrument.Instrumentation;
import java.util.TreeMap;
import mindustry.content.Blocks;
import mindustry.game.Team;
import mindustry.gen.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Read-only health inspection of the named own nonformal preparation client. */
public class InspectNativePreparationHealth{
 public static void agentmain(String map,Instrumentation unused){Core.app.post(()->{
  if(headless || !state.isCampaign() || !NativeCampaignStage.ready || NativeCampaignStage.finished || !map.equals(Pilot.mapName) || Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.formalAccepted"))return;
  var core=Team.sharded.core();if(core==null)return;TreeMap<String,Integer> enemies=new TreeMap<>();int close=0,hails=0,missing=0;double hp=0;
  for(var o:Pilot.orders){var t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);if(t.block()!=o.block || t.team()!=Team.sharded)missing++;}
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.hail)hails++;
  for(var u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==state.rules.waveTeam && !u.dead){enemies.merge(u.type.name,1,Integer::sum);hp+=u.health;if(u.within(core,400))close++;}
  NativeCampaignStage.event("native_preparation_health_readonly","core_hp="+core.health+";core_max_hp="+core.maxHealth+";bot_dead="+Pilot.bot.dead()+";enemies="+enemies+";enemy_hp="+hp+";enemies_within400="+close+";hails_built="+hails+";missing_orders="+missing+";wave="+state.wave);
  for(var u:Groups.unit)if(u.team==state.rules.waveTeam && !u.dead)NativeCampaignStage.event("native_preparation_enemy_readonly","type="+u.type.name+";hp="+u.health+";x="+u.x+";y="+u.y+";core_distance="+u.dst(core));
 });}
}
````

````java
 });}
````

Map acceptance only. Does not claim to run a player or measure outcomes.

SHA-256：`cd7b38495936b1b2f76747ff60405a880147ec49aae8837ce619a317ef8c83e6`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;
import arc.backend.headless.*;
import arc.files.*;
import arc.util.*;
import mindustry.*;
import mindustry.core.*;
import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.mod.*;
import mindustry.net.*;
import mindustry.io.*;
import mindustry.content.*;
import mindustry.world.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Map acceptance only. Does not claim to run a player or measure outcomes. */
public class MapAudit {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final boolean sectorMode=args.length>0 && args[0].equals("sector");
        new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){
            public void init(){
                try {
                    Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/audit-data"));
                    headless=true;
                    loadLocales=false;
                    net=new Net(null);
                    tree=new FileTree();
                    Vars.loadSettings();
                    Vars.init();
                    content.createBaseContent();
                    content.init();
                    logic=new Logic();
                    netServer=new NetServer();
                    StringBuilder csv=new StringBuilder("map,width,height,player_core,player_core_count,enemy_cores,win_wave,attack_mode,wave_timer,player_turrets,copper_tiles,lead_tiles,coal_tiles,titanium_tiles,sand_tiles\n");
                    for(String name:new String[]{"stainedMountains","windsweptIslands","fungalPass","overgrowth"}){
                        logic.reset();
                        if(sectorMode){
                            var preset=(mindustry.type.SectorPreset)content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,name);
                            world.loadSector(preset.sector);
                        }else{
                            world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/"+name));
                        }
                        int[] counts=new int[5];
                        int turrets=0;
                        for(Tile t:world.tiles){
                            var item=t.drop();
                            if(item==Items.copper)counts[0]++;
                            if(item==Items.lead)counts[1]++;
                            if(item==Items.coal)counts[2]++;
                            if(item==Items.titanium)counts[3]++;
                            if(item==Items.sand)counts[4]++;
                            if(t.isCenter() && t.build!=null && t.build.team==Team.sharded && (t.block()==Blocks.duo || t.block()==Blocks.salvo)) {
                                turrets++;
                                System.out.println("PREPLACED "+name+" "+t.block().name+" "+t.x+" "+t.y);
                            }
                        }
                        csv.append(name).append(',').append(world.width()).append(',').append(world.height()).append(',')
                           .append(Team.sharded.core()==null?"none":Team.sharded.core().block.name).append(',')
                           .append(Team.sharded.cores().size).append(',').append(Team.crux.cores().size).append(',')
                           .append(state.rules.winWave).append(',').append(state.rules.attackMode).append(',')
````

冻结C版本、入口档、种子、类加载来源和帧率准入核对。

SHA-256：`415c75470d18d2fd2f4226bf3df0265c8d4c3d85f2b39909e8580fecdbaa1052`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.util.serialization.*;import java.nio.file.*;import java.security.*;import java.util.*;
/** Explicit admission guard; development and training remain nonformal by default. */
public class NativeCAdmission{
 static String sha(Path file)throws Exception{return HexFormat.of().formatHex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(Files.readAllBytes(file)));}
 static JsonValue json(Path file)throws Exception{return new JsonReader().parse(Files.readString(file));}
 static void verifyFiles(Path root,JsonValue files)throws Exception{
  if(files==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing frozen file map");
  for(JsonValue entry=files.child;entry!=null;entry=entry.next){Path file=root.resolve(entry.name).normalize();if(!file.startsWith(root.normalize()) || !Files.isRegularFile(file) || !sha(file).equals(entry.asString()))throw new IllegalStateException("Frozen C artifact mismatch: "+entry.name);}
 }
 public static String check(String profile,String policy,int seed,String debugMap,String origin)throws Exception{
  if(!Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.formalAccepted"))return null;
  if(debugMap!=null || seed<1000 || seed>1004 || !Set.of("balanced","defensive").contains(policy) || !Set.of("G0","G1","G2","G3").contains(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.group","G0")))throw new IllegalStateException("Not a preregistered C cell");
  String location=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.cFreezeRoot");if(location==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No frozen C root");Path root=Path.of(location).toAbsolutePath().normalize();JsonValue manifest=json(root.resolve("manifest.json"));String id=manifest.getString("freeze_id");
  if(!id.equals(System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.freezeId")) || !origin.equals(manifest.getString("origin")) || Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.calibrationFps",30)!=manifest.getInt("fps_cap"))throw new IllegalStateException("Frozen C protocol differs");
  JsonValue acceptance=json(Path.of("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/C-frozen-acceptance.json"));if(!acceptance.getBoolean("passed") || !id.equals(acceptance.getString("freeze_id")))throw new IllegalStateException("C acceptance missing");
  verifyFiles(root,manifest.get("files"));verifyFiles(Path.of(profile).toAbsolutePath().normalize(),manifest.get("entry_profile_files"));
  for(Class<?> type:new Class<?>[]{RealtimeCampaign.class,RealtimeRecorder.class,NativeCalibrationPolicy.class,Pilot.class,AttackSupport.class,NativeCampaignStage.class}){
   Path loaded=Path.of(type.getProtectionDomain().getCodeSource().getLocation().toURI()).toAbsolutePath().normalize();if(!loaded.equals(root.resolve("classes")))throw new IllegalStateException("C class outside frozen root: "+type.getName());
  }
  return id;
 }
}
````

## src/NativeCalibrationPolicy.java

同几何布局的合法科技前沿和一级兵种适配。

SHA-256：`4f27bec86a12d57f84abcc563c3d953bc6347e9c7a010ea27a5d7ec9486de9b3`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import java.util.*;import java.util.function.BiConsumer;import java.util.function.IntSupplier;
import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.input.*;import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.units.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Preregisterable native-campaign adapter: same geometry, legal research frontier and paid tier1 fallback. */
public class NativeCalibrationPolicy{
 final ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint;final BiConsumer<String,String> log;final IntSupplier clock;final HashSet<Integer> deferred=new HashSet<>();
 boolean tier1Activated,ownsCommandMode,capGateLogged;final ArrayList<Pilot.Order> lockedOrders=new ArrayList<>();
 NativeCalibrationPolicy(ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint,BiConsumer<String,String> log,IntSupplier clock){this.blueprint=blueprint;this.log=log;this.clock=clock;}
 boolean currentSectorGate(Block block){
  if(block.techNode==null || block.unlockedHost())return false;
  for(var objective:block.techNode.objectives)if(objective instanceof Objectives.SectorComplete s && s.preset.sector==state.rules.sector && !objective.complete())return true;
  return false;
 }
 void refresh(){
  ArrayList<Pilot.Order> legal=new ArrayList<>(),locked=new ArrayList<>();
  for(Pilot.Order o:blueprint){
   if(o.block==Blocks.additiveReconstructor && currentSectorGate(o.block)){if(deferred.add(o.x<<16|o.y))log.accept("native_technology_defer","block="+o.block.name+";site="+o.x+":"+o.y+";reason=current_sector_capture_required");continue;}
   (o.block.unlockedHost()?legal:locked).add(o);
  }
  Pilot.orders.clear();Pilot.orders.addAll(legal);lockedOrders.clear();lockedOrders.addAll(locked);
 }
 boolean installed(Pilot.Order o){Tile t=world.tile(o.x,o.y);return t!=null && t.team()==Team.sharded && t.block()==o.block;}
 void act()throws Exception{
  Pilot.tick=clock.getAsInt();if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;refresh();
  if(ownsCommandMode && state.rules.objectiveFlags.contains("unitsBuilt")){control.input.commandMode=false;ownsCommandMode=false;log.accept("native_command_mode_released","native_unitsBuilt_goal_completed=true");}
  // Native ammunition and fuel actions take priority while an enemy threatens the base.
  if(mindustry.entities.Units.closestEnemy(Team.sharded,Team.sharded.core().x,Team.sharded.core().y,500,u->true)!=null){
   for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && (b.block==Blocks.duo || b.block==Blocks.salvo || b.block==Blocks.scatter) && b instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.ItemTurret.ItemTurretBuild t && t.totalAmmo<4){Pilot.act();return;}
  }
  for(Pilot.Order o:Pilot.orders)if(o.block.unlockedHost() && !installed(o)){Pilot.act();return;}
  if(state.rules.attackMode && !Blocks.additiveReconstructor.unlockedHost() && produceLegalTier1()){AttackSupport.control();return;}
  // Fully affordable native technology has priority over saving for an unavailable earlier branch.
  ui.research.rebuildItems();
  for(Pilot.Order o:lockedOrders)if(!o.block.unlockedHost() && affordable(o.block)){NativeCampaignStage.research(o.block);return;}
  for(Pilot.Order o:lockedOrders)if(!o.block.unlockedHost()){NativeCampaignStage.research(o.block);return;}
  Pilot.act();
 }
 boolean affordable(mindustry.ctype.UnlockableContent c){
  if(c.unlockedHost())return true;var n=c.techNode;if(n==null)return false;
  if(n.parent!=null && !n.parent.content.unlockedHost())return affordable(n.parent.content);
  for(var objective:n.objectives)if(!objective.complete())return false;
  for(int i=0;i<n.requirements.length;i++)if(ui.research.items.get(n.requirements[i].item)<n.requirements[i].amount-n.finishedRequirements[i].amount)return false;
  return true;
 }
 boolean produceLegalTier1(){
  UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild factory=null;
  for(var b:Groups.build)if(b.team==Team.sharded && b.block==Blocks.groundFactory)factory=(UnitFactory.UnitFactoryBuild)b;
  if(factory==null || !UnitTypes.dagger.unlockedHost())return false;
  if(!capGateLogged && mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)*UnitTypes.dagger.health<2000){capGateLogged=true;log.accept("native_first_visit_technology_cap_gate","unit=dagger;native_per_type_cap="+mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)+";maximum_undamaged_hp="+(mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)*UnitTypes.dagger.health)+";required_hp=2000;reconstructor_and_nova_require_fungal_capture;no_cap_or_hp_override=true");}
  if(!tier1Activated){
   for(var item:new Item[]{Items.graphite,Items.silicon,Items.lead}){int required=item==Items.graphite?360:item==Items.silicon?450:200;if(Team.sharded.core().items.get(item)<required)return NativeCampaignStage.gather(item);}
   factory.configureAny(0);tier1Activated=true;control.input.commandMode=true;ownsCommandMode=true;
   log.accept("native_command_mode_entered","local_player_input=true;objective_flags_not_written=true");
   log.accept("native_tier1_factory_activated","site="+factory.pos()+";unit=dagger;unlocked_reconstructor=false;all_materials_native");
  }
  var unit=Pilot.bot.unit();unit.clearBuilding();unit.mineTile=null;
  for(var item:new Item[]{Items.silicon,Items.lead})if(factory.items.get(item)<20){
   if(unit.stack.amount>0 && unit.item()!=item){Pilot.deposit();return true;}
   if(unit.stack.amount==0){var core=Team.sharded.core();if(core.items.get(item)==0)return NativeCampaignStage.gather(item);Pilot.move(core.x,core.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(core,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.requestItem(Pilot.bot,core,item,unit.type.itemCapacity);return true;}
   Pilot.move(factory.x,factory.y,itemTransferRange-8);if(unit.within(factory,itemTransferRange-4))InputHandler.transferInventory(Pilot.bot,factory);return true;
  }
  return false;
 }
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.world.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Preparation only: inspect native goals and append paid Battery/Arc orders needed by Frozen Forest. */
public class NativeTutorialPreparationAgent{
 public static void agentmain(String action,Instrumentation ignored){Core.app.post(()->{
  if(headless || !state.isCampaign() || !"frozenForest".equals(Pilot.mapName))throw new IllegalStateException("Not the native prerequisite client");
  for(var objective:state.rules.objectives.all)NativeCampaignStage.event("native_objective_inspection",objective.getClass().getSimpleName()+";completed="+objective.isCompleted()+";qualified="+objective.qualified()+";description="+objective);
  if(!"add-required-native-builds".equals(action))return;
  for(Block block:new Block[]{Blocks.battery,Blocks.arc}){
   boolean present=false;for(var o:Pilot.orders)if(o.block==block)present=true;if(present)continue;
   var core=Team.sharded.core();Tile site=null;double distance=Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
   for(Tile tile:world.tiles)if(Build.validPlace(block,Team.sharded,tile.x,tile.y,0,false)){
    double d=tile.dst2(core.tile);if(d<distance){site=tile;distance=d;}
   }
   if(site==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No legal native tutorial construction site");
   Pilot.Order order=new Pilot.Order();order.block=block;order.x=site.x;order.y=site.y;order.rotation=0;order.config="";Pilot.orders.add(order);
   NativeCampaignStage.event("preparation_tutorial_order_added","block="+block.name+";x="+site.x+";y="+site.y+";native_research_and_construction_payment_required=true");
  }
 });}
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.headless.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.util.*;
import mindustry.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.ctype.*;import mindustry.game.*;
import mindustry.type.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import mindustry.net.*;import mindustry.input.*;import mindustry.world.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.*;
import mindustry.world.blocks.defense.turrets.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.production.*;import mindustry.world.blocks.distribution.*;
import mindustry.entities.bullet.*;import java.io.*;import java.lang.reflect.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;

/** Isolated acceptance actions on the native Overgrowth loadout, not a formal route. */
public class ParameterAcceptance{
 static PrintWriter out;static Player playerA,playerB;static int lastBuildSteps;
 static void row(String metric,String team,double value){out.println(metric+","+team+","+value);out.flush();}
 public static void main(String[] args){System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.fixed","true");
  new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{test(args[0]);System.exit(0);}catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});
 }
 static void test(String path)throws Exception{
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(path+".data"));headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(null);Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();
  content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();
  Mathf.rand.setSeed(0);world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/overgrowth"));
  java.util.ArrayList<Tile> remove=new java.util.ArrayList<>();for(Tile tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))remove.add(tile);for(Tile tile:remove)tile.remove();
  state.rules.waves=false;state.rules.canGameOver=false;state.rules.infiniteResources=false;
  for(Team team:new Team[]{Team.sharded,Team.crux}){team.rules().cheat=false;team.rules().infiniteResources=false;team.rules().fillItems=false;}
  Time.setDeltaProvider(()->1);Time.setInternalTime(0);logic.play();
  out=new PrintWriter(path);out.println("metric,team,value");
  playerA=spawn(Team.sharded);playerB=spawn(Team.crux);
  String researchBefore=researchSignature();
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.auditResearch"))for(Block block:new Block[]{Blocks.duo,Blocks.salvo})for(ItemStack cost:block.techNode.requirements)row(block.name+"_shared_research_"+cost.item.name+"_before","shared",cost.amount);
  int[] baseReq=java.util.Arrays.stream(Blocks.duo.requirements).mapToInt(st->st.amount).toArray();
  float baseBuildTime=Blocks.duo.buildTime;
  for(Player p:new Player[]{playerA,playerB}){
   String side=p.team()==Team.sharded?"player":"enemy";
   int before=p.team().core().items.get(Items.copper);
   Building b=build(p,Blocks.duo);
   row("duo_actual_copper_cost",side,before-p.team().core().items.get(Items.copper));row("duo_actual_construction_work_calls",side,lastBuildSteps);
   row("duo_shared_build_time",side,Blocks.duo.buildTime);
   Vars.player=p;p.set(p.unit());InputHandler.requestItem(p,p.team().core(),Items.copper,1);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,b);
   var tb=(Turret.TurretBuild)b;
   tb.update();
   Method shoot=Turret.TurretBuild.class.getDeclaredMethod("shoot",BulletType.class);shoot.setAccessible(true);
   var type=((ItemTurret)Blocks.duo).ammoTypes.get(Items.copper);shoot.invoke(tb,type);
   for(Bullet shot:Groups.bullet)if(shot.owner==b)row("duo_actual_bullet_damage",side,shot.damage);
   row("duo_shared_copper_damage",side,type.damage);
   Building drill=build(p,Blocks.mechanicalDrill);
   row("mechanical_copper_final_threshold",side,((Drill)Blocks.mechanicalDrill).getDrillTime(Items.copper)*EvaluationParameters.mining(drill));
   var db=(Drill.DrillBuild)drill;var mined=db.dominantItem;
   int stock=p.team().core().items.get(mined);final int[] nativeOutput={0};
   EvaluationTrace.sink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(producer==db.id && item==mined)nativeOutput[0]+=amount;}};
   for(int step=0;step<3600;step++){
    Time.update();db.update();
    if(db.items.get(mined)>0){Vars.player=p;p.set(p.unit());InputHandler.requestItem(p,db,mined,p.unit().type.itemCapacity);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,p.team().core());}
   }
   EvaluationTrace.sink=null;row("mechanical_actual_3600_tick_produced_"+mined.name,side,nativeOutput[0]);row("mechanical_actual_3600_tick_core_receipt_"+mined.name,side,p.team().core().items.get(mined)-stock);
   Building conveyor=build(p,Blocks.conveyor);
   InputHandler.requestItem(p,p.team().core(),Items.copper,1);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,conveyor);
   var cv=(Conveyor.ConveyorBuild)conveyor;
   if(cv.len!=1)throw new AssertionError("Native conveyor deposit failed: "+cv.len);
   float old=cv.ys[0];for(int step=0;step<5;step++){Time.update();cv.update();}
   row("conveyor_actual_displacement_5_ticks",side,cv.ys[0]-old);
   int[] salvoBefore={p.team().core().items.get(Items.copper),p.team().core().items.get(Items.graphite),p.team().core().items.get(Items.titanium)};
   Building salvo=build(p,Blocks.salvo);row("salvo_actual_construction_work_calls",side,lastBuildSteps);row("salvo_shared_build_time",side,Blocks.salvo.buildTime);
   row("salvo_actual_copper_cost",side,salvoBefore[0]-p.team().core().items.get(Items.copper));row("salvo_actual_graphite_cost",side,salvoBefore[1]-p.team().core().items.get(Items.graphite));row("salvo_actual_titanium_cost",side,salvoBefore[2]-p.team().core().items.get(Items.titanium));
   InputHandler.requestItem(p,p.team().core(),Items.copper,5);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,salvo);salvo.update();shoot.invoke(salvo,((ItemTurret)Blocks.salvo).ammoTypes.get(Items.copper));for(int step=0;step<30;step++)Time.update();int shots=0;
   for(Bullet shot:Groups.bullet)if(shot.owner==salvo){row("salvo_actual_copper_bullet_damage",side,shot.damage);shots++;}row("salvo_actual_four_shot_pattern_bullets",side,shots);
   for(Block target:new Block[]{Blocks.siliconSmelter,Blocks.graphitePress,Blocks.multiPress,Blocks.laserDrill}){
    Building factory=build(p,target);
    if(target.consPower!=null)row(target.name+"_actual_requested_power",side,target.consPower.requestedPower(factory));
    if(target instanceof GenericCrafter crafter)row(target.name+"_effective_cycle_structural",side,crafter.craftTime*EvaluationParameters.cycle(factory));
    if(target instanceof Drill d)row(target.name+"_titanium_final_threshold_structural",side,d.getDrillTime(Items.titanium)*EvaluationParameters.mining(factory));
   }
  }
  for(int i=0;i<baseReq.length;i++)if(baseReq[i]!=Blocks.duo.requirements[i].amount)throw new AssertionError("Shared requirement mutated");
  if(baseBuildTime!=Blocks.duo.buildTime)throw new AssertionError("Shared construction work mutated");
  if(!researchBefore.equals(researchSignature()))throw new AssertionError("Shared research requirements mutated by native construction");
  if(Boolean.getBoolean("mindustry.eval.auditResearch")){
   for(Block block:new Block[]{Blocks.duo,Blocks.salvo})for(ItemStack cost:block.techNode.requirements)row(block.name+"_shared_research_"+cost.item.name+"_after","shared",cost.amount);
   row("all_shared_tech_requirements_unchanged","shared",1);
  }
  out.close();System.out.println("Native cost, bullet and transport actions completed for "+EvaluationParameters.group);
 }
 static String researchSignature(){StringBuilder value=new StringBuilder();for(var node:TechTree.all){value.append(node.content.name).append(':');for(ItemStack stack:node.requirements)value.append(stack.item.name).append('=').append(stack.amount).append(';');value.append('\n');}return value.toString();}
 static Player spawn(Team t){Player p=Player.create();p.team(t);p.add();t.core().requestSpawn(p);Vars.player=p;return p;}
 static Building build(Player p,Block block){
  var core=p.team().core();Tile tile=null;
  outer:for(int radius=3;radius<23;radius++)for(int dx=-radius;dx<=radius;dx++)for(int dy=-radius;dy<=radius;dy++){
   Tile at=world.tile(core.tileX()+dx,core.tileY()+dy);
   if(at!=null && at.block()==Blocks.air && p.unit().within(at,p.unit().type.buildRange-4) && Build.validPlace(block,p.team(),at.x,at.y,0)) {tile=at;break outer;}
  }
  if(tile==null)throw new AssertionError("No legal paid placement for "+block+" "+p.team());
  Vars.player=p;
  Call.beginPlace(p.unit(),block,p.team(),tile.x,tile.y,0,null);
  if(!(tile.build instanceof ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild))throw new AssertionError("No construct entity");
  int steps=0;while(tile.block()!=block && steps++<100000){
   var cb=(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild)tile.build;
   cb.construct(p.unit(),core,p.unit().type.buildSpeed/cb.buildCost,null);Time.update();
  }
  if(tile.block()!=block)throw new AssertionError("Native inventory cannot fund fixture "+block);
  lastBuildSteps=steps;return tile.build;
 }
}
````

````java
    StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("parameter,object,base_value,proposed_value_not_applied\n");
    Drill m=(Drill)Blocks.mechanicalDrill,p=(Drill)Blocks.pneumaticDrill,l=(Drill)Blocks.laserDrill;
    row(s,"M","mechanical-copper",m.getDrillTime(Items.copper),0.8f);
    row(s,"M","mechanical-coal",m.getDrillTime(Items.coal),0.8f);
    row(s,"M","pneumatic-titanium",p.getDrillTime(Items.titanium),0.8f);
    row(s,"X","laser-base",l.drillTime,0.8f);
    row(s,"X","laser-titanium-final-threshold",l.getDrillTime(Items.titanium),0.8f);
    row(s,"X","laser-power",l.consPower.usage,1.2f);
    row(s,"T","conveyor",((Conveyor)Blocks.conveyor).speed,1.25f);
    row(s,"T","titanium-conveyor",((Conveyor)Blocks.titaniumConveyor).speed,1.25f);
    for(var b:new mindustry.world.Block[]{Blocks.graphitePress,Blocks.siliconSmelter,Blocks.multiPress}){
     row(s,"cycle",b.name,((GenericCrafter)b).craftTime,0.8f);
     if(b.consPower!=null)row(s,"power",b.name,b.consPower.usage,1.2f);
    }
    for(var b:new mindustry.world.Block[]{Blocks.duo,Blocks.salvo}){
     row(s,"H",b.name,((ItemTurret)b).ammoTypes.get(Items.copper).damage,1.2f);
     for(var req:b.requirements)row(s,"C",b.name+"-"+req.item.name,req.amount,1.2f);
    }
    java.nio.file.Files.writeString(java.nio.file.Path.of("/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/results/parameter-audit.csv"),s);
    System.out.print(s);System.exit(0);
   }catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}
  });
 }
 static void row(StringBuilder s,String p,String o,float v,float mult){s.append(p).append(',').append(o).append(',').append(v).append(',').append(v*mult).append('\n');}
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.gen.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;
import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Preparation-only diagnostics and native build-plan correction. Never attach to formal servers. */
public class PreparationControlAgent{
 public static void agentmain(String action,Instrumentation ignored){Core.app.post(()->{
  if(!state.isCampaign() || headless || !"groundZero".equals(Pilot.mapName))throw new IllegalStateException("Not the preparation client");
  for(var objective:state.rules.objectives.all)CampaignPreparation.event("native_objective_inspection",objective.getClass().getSimpleName()+";completed="+objective.isCompleted()+";qualified="+objective.qualified()+";description="+objective);
  CampaignPreparation.event("native_core_delivery_inspection","copper="+state.stats.coreItemCount.get(Items.copper)+";lead="+state.stats.coreItemCount.get(Items.lead));
  if("restore-core-conveyor".equals(action)){
   for(Pilot.Order order:Pilot.orders)if(order.x==129 && order.y==53){order.block=Blocks.conveyor;order.rotation=1;order.config="";order.wasBuilt=false;order.critical=true;}
   CampaignPreparation.event("preparation_policy_adjustment","replace inverted sorter129:53 with paid native conveyor; current copper diversion prevents tutorial core-delivery objective; no inventory or objective writes");
  }
 });}
}
````

````java
/** Native SDL realtime calibration route. Development until C training/entry/admission are frozen. */
public class RealtimeCampaign{

  var account=new SourceAccount(core);sourceAccounts.put(core.items,account);for(var item:content.items())note("transition_stock_open","generation="+account.generation+";sector="+account.sector+";core="+account.pos+";item="+item.name+";balance="+account.balances[item.id]);
 }}
 static final EvaluationTrace.Sink sourceSink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){public void stock(mindustry.world.modules.ItemModule module,int item,int before,int after){
  var account=sourceAccounts.get(module);if(account==null)return;if(account.balances[item]!=before || after<0)throw new IllegalStateException("Native transition stock discontinuity");account.balances[item]=after;
  note("transition_stock","generation="+account.generation+";sector="+account.sector+";core="+account.pos+";item="+content.item(item).name+";before="+before+";delta="+(after-before)+";after="+after);
 }};
 public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{
  profile=args[0];output=args[1];policy=args[2];seed=Integer.parseInt(args[3]);debugMap=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugMap");
  maps=debugMap==null?mapsA:new String[]{debugMap};originName=System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugNativeOrigin",System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.calibrationOrigin","ruinousShores"));limit=debugMap==null?5400:Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.calibrationLimit",60);

  admittedFreeze=NativeCAdmission.check(profile,policy,seed,debugMap,originName);
  new File(output).mkdirs();routeId="C-A-"+policy+"-"+EvaluationParameters.group+"-s"+seed;bootWall=System.nanoTime();
  routeLog=new PrintWriter(output+"/campaign-costs.csv"){@Override public void println(String line){if(!line.isEmpty() && Character.isDigit(line.charAt(0))){int at=line.indexOf(',');if(at>=0)line=line.substring(0,at)+","+routeId+","+(recorder==null?"source_":"")+stage()+","+(recorder==null?sourceFrame:recorder.frame)+line.substring(at);}super.println(line);}};
  routeLog.println("seq,run_id,stage,frame,native_tick_seconds,effective_route_seconds,event,detail");NativeCampaignStage.journal=routeLog;transitionFrames=new PrintWriter(output+"/transition.frames.csv");transitionFrames.println("stage,frame,effective_route_seconds,native_tick_seconds,wall_seconds,native_delta");
  Events.on(WorldLoadBeginEvent.class,e->Mathf.rand.setSeed(0));
  Events.on(ClientLoadEvent.class,e->{try{
   for(String option:new String[]{"backgroundpause","bloom","effects","drawlight","shadows","drawweather","animatedwater"})Core.settings.put(option,false);Core.settings.put("fpscap",Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.calibrationFps",30));Core.settings.put("skipcoreanimation",true);Core.settings.put("maxresources",true);
   NativeCampaignStage.spend=ui.research.view.getClass().getDeclaredMethod("spend",TechTree.TechNode.class);NativeCampaignStage.spend.setAccessible(true);

   control.setInput(new DesktopInput(){@Override public void update(){if(done || terminalPending || !state.isPlaying())return;try{
    Pilot.bot=Vars.player;if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;Pilot.bot.set(Pilot.bot.unit());
    if(recorder!=null){NativeCampaignStage.effective=(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds+recorder.now())*60;actor.act();}
    else if(sourceLoaded && !launchQueued)transition();
   }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}});
   Core.app.post(()->Core.app.post(()->{
    if(debugMap!=null && System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugNativeOrigin")==null)control.playSector(expected);
    else if(origin.hasBase())control.playSector(origin);
    else fail(new IllegalStateException("No actually prepared origin save "+originName));
   }));
  }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}});
  Events.on(WorldLoadEvent.class,e->{
   sourceSync();if(state.rules.sector==expected && !expected.hasBase())removePreplaced();
   Core.app.post(()->{if(done)return;if(state.rules.sector==expected){if(recorder==null)try{activate();}catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}else if(state.rules.sector==origin){sourceLoaded=true;sourceSync();Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.orders.clear();note("native_origin_loaded","origin="+originName+";source_items="+origin.items());}});
  });

  Events.on(SectorLaunchLoadoutEvent.class,e->{try{
   note("native_launch_loadout","source="+e.from.id+";destination="+e.sector.id+";schematic="+e.loadout.requirements()+";resources="+universe.getLaunchResources());
   int[] before=NativeCampaignStage.launchBalances.get(e.from);if(before==null)throw new IllegalStateException("Missing native source receipt opening");var after=e.from.items();var cost=e.loadout.requirements();var resources=universe.getLaunchResources();
   for(var item:content.items()){int paid=cost.get(item)+resources.get(item);if(before[item.id]-after.get(item)!=paid)throw new IllegalStateException("Native launch debit mismatch "+item);if(paid>0)note("native_launch_debit_receipt","source="+e.from.id+";item="+item.name+";before="+before[item.id]+";paid="+paid+";after="+after.get(item));}
  }catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}});
  Events.on(SectorCaptureEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null && e.sector==expected && recorder.initialEnemyCores==0)requestTerminal(true,"native_sector_capture");});
  Events.on(ResearchEvent.class,e->{if(routeLog!=null)note("native_research_unlocked",e.content.name);});
  Events.on(GameOverEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null)requestTerminal(e.winner==Team.sharded,e.winner==Team.sharded?"native_victory":"native_defeat");});
  Events.on(WaveEvent.class,e->{if(recorder!=null)Pilot.lastWaveTick=Pilot.tick;});
  Events.run(Trigger.beforeGameUpdate,()->{if(done)return;if(recorder!=null)recorder.beforePhysics();else if(sourceLoaded){advanceSource=true;sourceFrame++;float raw=Core.graphics.getDeltaTime()*60;sourceDelta=Float.isFinite(raw)?Mathf.clamp(raw,.0001f,maxDeltaClient):1;NativeCampaignStage.effective=effectiveNow()*60;}});
  Version.init();Vars.loadLogger();
  new SdlApplication(new DesktopLauncher(new String[0]){@Override public void update(){super.update();if(clientLoaded && !done)try{afterNativeFrame();}catch(Exception ex){fail(ex);}}},new SdlConfig(){{title="Mindustry realtime calibration "+routeId;width=480;height=360;disableAudio=true;vSyncEnabled=false;}});
 }
 static SectorPreset preset(String name){return content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,name);}
 static void removePreplaced(){ArrayList<Tile> removed=new ArrayList<>();for(var tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))removed.add(tile);for(var tile:removed){note("protocol_remove_without_refund",tile.block().name+"@"+tile.x+":"+tile.y);tile.remove();}}
 static void transition()throws Exception{
  if(Pilot.bot.dead())return;
  NativeCampaignStage.target=expected;NativeCampaignStage.targetName=expected.preset.name;NativeCampaignStage.origin=origin;NativeCampaignStage.originName=origin.preset.name;
  control.checkAutoUnlocks();
  if(!expected.preset.unlockedHost()){NativeCampaignStage.research(expected.preset);return;}
  var core=Team.sharded.core();if(core==null){finishRoute(false,"origin_core_lost");return;}
  if(core.items.get(Items.copper)<1000){NativeCampaignStage.gather(Items.copper);return;}
  if(core.items.get(Items.lead)<800){NativeCampaignStage.gather(Items.lead);return;}
  launchQueued=true;note("native_transition_launch","target="+expected.preset.name+";transition_effective_seconds="+transitionSeconds);NativeCampaignStage.launch();
 }
 static void activate()throws Exception{
  if(done || recorder!=null || state.rules.sector!=expected)return;
  routeCompletedSeconds+=transitionSeconds;transitionSeconds=0;advanceSource=false;sourceLoaded=false;launchQueued=false;terminalPending=false;
  if(!net.active())net.host(Integer.getInteger("mindustry.eval.port",47100));if(!net.server() || !net.active())throw new IllegalStateException("Native realtime server did not host");
  Pilot.tick=0;Pilot.index=0;Pilot.seq=0;Pilot.bot=Vars.player;Pilot.mapName=maps[index];Pilot.lastWaveTick=0;
  ArrayList<Pilot.Order> blueprint=new ArrayList<>();String file=debugMap==null?"/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/frozen/S-v2/layouts/"+policy+"-"+stage()+".csv":System.getProperty("mindustry.eval.debugLayout","/workspace/mindustry-evaluation/campaign-groundZero-v2-layout.csv");
  var lines=java.nio.file.Files.readAllLines(Path.of(file));for(String line:lines.subList(1,lines.size())){String[] c=line.split(",",-1);Pilot.Order o=new Pilot.Order();o.block=content.block(c[0]);o.x=Integer.parseInt(c[1]);o.y=Integer.parseInt(c[2]);o.rotation=Integer.parseInt(c[3]);o.config=c[4];blueprint.add(o);}
  String path=output+"/"+stage();java.nio.file.Files.copy(Path.of(file),Path.of(path+".layout.csv"));
  recorder=new RealtimeRecorder(path,routeId,stage(),policy,seed);mapAcceptance();actor=new NativeCalibrationPolicy(blueprint,(type,detail)->{if(recorder!=null)recorder.emit(type,detail);},()->(int)Math.floor(recorder.now()*60));actor.refresh();
  Pilot.log=new PrintWriter(path+".actor.csv"){@Override public void println(String line){super.println(line);if(!line.isEmpty() && Character.isDigit(line.charAt(0)) && recorder!=null){String[] parts=line.split(",",4);if(parts.length==4)recorder.actorEvent(parts[2],parts[3]);}}};Pilot.log.println("seq,tick,event,detail");
  Mathf.rand.setSeed(seed);mindustry.logic.GlobalVars.rand.setSeed(seed);
  state.rules.infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().infiniteResources=false;Team.sharded.rules().cheat=false;Team.sharded.rules().fillItems=false;
  SaveIO.write(new Fi(path+".initial.msav"));snapshotProfile(path+".initial-profile");
  note("native_stage_started","stage="+stage()+";map="+maps[index]+";native_core="+Team.sharded.core().block.name+";native_cap="+mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)+";initial_inventory="+Team.sharded.core().items);
  System.out.println("REALTIME_STAGE_STARTED "+stage()+" "+maps[index]+" seed="+seed+" headless="+headless+" nativeClock=true");
 }
 static void snapshotProfile(String destination)throws Exception{
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()!=null)control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();Path root=Path.of(profile),dest=Path.of(destination);java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(dest);
  for(String name:new String[]{"settings.bin","saves"}){Path selected=root.resolve(name);if(!java.nio.file.Files.exists(selected))throw new IllegalStateException("Missing native replay profile component "+name);
   try(var stream=java.nio.file.Files.walk(selected)){for(Path from:(Iterable<Path>)stream::iterator){Path to=dest.resolve(root.relativize(from));if(java.nio.file.Files.isDirectory(from))java.nio.file.Files.createDirectories(to);else java.nio.file.Files.copy(from,to);}}
  }
  note("native_replay_profile_snapshot","path="+destination+";contents=settings.bin_and_actual_sector_saves;free_state_injected=false");
 }
 static void mapAcceptance(){
  TreeMap<String,Integer> ore=new TreeMap<>();int preplaced=0;for(var tile:world.tiles){if(tile.drop()!=null)ore.merge(tile.drop().name,1,Integer::sum);if(tile.isCenter() && tile.team()==Team.sharded && (tile.block()==Blocks.duo || tile.block()==Blocks.salvo))preplaced++;}
  recorder.emit("native_map_acceptance","map="+maps[index]+";width="+world.width()+";height="+world.height()+";core="+Team.sharded.core().block.name+";unit_cap="+mindustry.entities.Units.getCap(Team.sharded)+";unit_cap_variable="+state.rules.unitCapVariable+";build_cost_multiplier="+state.rules.buildCostMultiplier+";enemy_cores="+Team.crux.cores().size+";win_wave="+state.rules.winWave+";minerals="+ore+";player_duo_salvo="+preplaced);
  if(debugMap!=null)return;int width=index==0?300:index==1?400:150,height=index==0?300:index==1?400:250,enemies=index==2?2:0;
  if(world.width()!=width || world.height()!=height || state.rules.attackMode!=(enemies>0) || Team.crux.cores().size!=enemies)recorder.invalid("native_map_dimensions_or_mode");
  if(preplaced!=0 || state.rules.buildCostMultiplier!=1 || state.rules.defaultTeam!=Team.sharded)recorder.invalid("native_map_team_cost_or_preplaced");
  for(String required:new String[]{"copper","lead","coal","sand"})if(ore.getOrDefault(required,0)==0)recorder.invalid("native_map_missing_mineral_"+required);
  if(index<2 && (state.rules.winWave!=30 || !state.rules.waves || ore.getOrDefault("titanium",0)==0))recorder.invalid("native_survival_wave_rules_or_titanium");
 }
 static void requestTerminal(boolean won,String reason){if(!terminalPending || !won){terminalPending=true;terminalWon=won;terminalReason=reason;}}
 static void afterNativeFrame()throws Exception{
  if(recorder==null){if(advanceSource){transitionSeconds+=Time.delta/60;advanceSource=false;transitionFrames.println(stage()+","+sourceFrame+","+(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds)+","+state.tick/60+","+(System.nanoTime()-bootWall)/1e9+","+Time.delta);}if(transitionSeconds>=5400)finishRoute(false,"native_research_or_launch_gate_time_limit");return;}
  if(recorder.inFrame)recorder.afterPhysics();NativeCampaignStage.effective=(routeCompletedSeconds+recorder.seconds)*60;
  if(Team.sharded.cores().isEmpty())requestTerminal(false,"core_lost");
  else if(recorder.initialEnemyCores>0 && Team.crux.cores().size<recorder.initialEnemyCores && !terminalPending)requestTerminal(true,"first_enemy_core");
  if(recorder.seconds>=limit && !terminalPending)requestTerminal(false,debugMap==null?"time_limit":"development_smoke_limit");
  if(recorder.frame>0 && recorder.frame%1800==0)System.out.println("REALTIME "+stage()+" sim="+recorder.seconds+" wall="+recorder.wall()+" wave="+state.wave+" valid="+recorder.valid);
  if(!terminalPending)return;
  String path=recorder.prefix;boolean won=terminalWon;String reason=terminalReason;boolean valid;
  recorder.finish(won,reason);valid=recorder.valid;SaveIO.write(new Fi(path+".final.msav"));if(Pilot.log!=null)Pilot.log.close();stagePaths.add(path);routeCompletedSeconds+=recorder.seconds;recorder=null;
  if(!valid){routeValid=false;finishRoute(false,"technical_invalid_native_stage");return;}
  if(!won || index+1==maps.length){finishRoute(won,reason);return;}
  sourceGeneration++;sourceFrame=0;sourceAccounts.clear();EvaluationTrace.sink=sourceSink;sourceSync();Pilot.orders.clear();origin=expected;originName=origin.preset.name;expected=preset(maps[++index]).sector;terminalPending=false;sourceLoaded=true;launchQueued=false;transitionSeconds=0;
 }
 static void finishRoute(boolean complete,String reason)throws Exception{
  if(done)return;done=true;note("native_route_end","complete="+complete+";reason="+reason+";total_effective_seconds="+(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds));
  if(control.saves.getCurrent()!=null)control.saves.getCurrent().save();Core.settings.forceSave();routeLog.close();transitionFrames.close();
  java.nio.file.Files.writeString(Path.of(output+"/route.json"),"{\"run_id\":\""+routeId+"\",\"track\":\"C\",\"policy\":\""+policy+"\",\"group\":\""+EvaluationParameters.group+"\",\"seed\":"+seed+",\"complete\":"+complete+",\"reason\":\""+reason+"\",\"effective_seconds\":"+(routeCompletedSeconds+transitionSeconds)+",\"wall_seconds\":"+(System.nanoTime()-bootWall)/1e9+",\"valid\":"+routeValid+",\"formal_sample\":"+(admittedFreeze!=null)+",\"freeze_id\":\""+(admittedFreeze==null?"":admittedFreeze)+"\",\"development_status\":\""+(admittedFreeze==null?"NOT_FROZEN_NOT_ADMITTED":"FROZEN_C_ADMITTED")+"\",\"stage_count\":"+stagePaths.size()+"}\n");
  System.out.println("REALTIME_ROUTE_END "+reason+" complete="+complete);Core.app.exit();
 }
 static void fail(Exception ex){ex.printStackTrace();routeValid=false;try{if(recorder!=null && !recorder.closed){recorder.invalid("technical_exception_"+ex.getClass().getSimpleName());recorder.finish(false,"technical_exception");stagePaths.add(recorder.prefix);routeCompletedSeconds+=recorder.seconds;recorder=null;}finishRoute(false,"technical_exception_"+ex.getClass().getSimpleName());}catch(Exception other){other.printStackTrace();Core.app.exit();}}
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.headless.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;import arc.math.geom.*;import arc.util.*;

import java.io.*;import java.util.*;import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Controlled native-component acceptance. Paid blocks, real native-drilled inputs, real generators. Not a formal battle. */
public class RecipeAcceptance{
 static PrintWriter out;static int tick;static Vec2 velocity=new Vec2();
 static void row(String name,Team team,double value){out.println(name+","+(team==Team.sharded?"player":"enemy")+","+value);out.flush();}
 public static void main(String[] args){System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.fixed","true");new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{test(args[0],Integer.parseInt(args[1]));System.exit(0);}catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});}
 static void test(String path,int port)throws Exception{
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(path+".data"));headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(Vars.platform.getNet());Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();Mathf.rand.setSeed(0);world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/overgrowth"));state.rules.waves=false;state.rules.canGameOver=false;state.rules.infiniteResources=false;
  for(Team t:new Team[]{Team.sharded,Team.crux}){t.rules().cheat=false;t.rules().infiniteResources=false;t.rules().fillItems=false;}
  Time.setDeltaProvider(()->1);Time.setInternalTime(0);logic.play();net.host(port);out=new PrintWriter(path);out.println("metric,team,value");
  for(Team t:new Team[]{Team.sharded,Team.crux}){
   Player p=ParameterAcceptance.spawn(t);p.name="recipe-fixture-"+t.name;Vars.player=p;p.set(p.unit());
   prepare(p,Items.coal,600);prepare(p,Items.sand,300);
   row("coal_inputs_from_real_inventory_before",t,t.core().items.get(Items.coal));row("sand_inputs_from_real_inventory_before",t,t.core().items.get(Items.sand));
   Building graphite=ParameterAcceptance.build(p,Blocks.graphitePress),silicon=ParameterAcceptance.build(p,Blocks.siliconSmelter);
   Building[] generators=new Building[3];for(int i=0;i<generators.length;i++)generators[i]=ParameterAcceptance.build(p,Blocks.combustionGenerator);
   for(int i=0;i<4;i++)ParameterAcceptance.build(p,Blocks.powerNode);
   measure(p,graphite,Items.graphite,3600,generators);
   measure(p,silicon,Items.silicon,3600,generators);
  }
  out.close();System.out.println("PASS actual paid/input/power recipe cycles "+EvaluationParameters.group);
 }
 static void prepare(Player p,Item item,int required){
  Unit u=p.unit();Vars.player=p;p.set(u);var core=p.team().core();int initial=core.items.get(item),loops=0;
  Drill.DrillBuild source=null;
  if(initial<required){
   for(Tile tile:world.tiles)if(tile.isCenter() && tile.build instanceof Drill.DrillBuild d && d.team==p.team() && d.block.consPower==null && d.dominantItem==item && u.within(d,itemTransferRange-4) && (source==null || d.dst2(u)<source.dst2(u)))source=d;
   if(source==null){
    Tile site=null;float best=Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
    for(Tile tile:world.tiles){
     if(!u.within(tile,Math.min(itemTransferRange-4,u.type.buildRange-4)) || !Build.validPlace(Blocks.mechanicalDrill,p.team(),tile.x,tile.y,0))continue;
     int desired=0;boolean other=false;
     for(int dx=0;dx<2;dx++)for(int dy=0;dy<2;dy++){Tile q=world.tile(tile.x+dx,tile.y+dy);Item drop=q==null?null:q.drop();if(drop==item)desired++;else if(drop!=null && drop!=Items.sand)other=true;}
     if(desired>0 && !other && tile.dst2(u)<best){site=tile;best=tile.dst2(u);}
    }
    if(site==null)throw new AssertionError("No paid/native drill source for "+item+" "+p.team());
    Call.beginPlace(u,Blocks.mechanicalDrill,p.team(),site.x,site.y,0,null);int steps=0;
    while(site.block()!=Blocks.mechanicalDrill && steps++<100000){var cb=(ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild)site.build;cb.construct(u,core,u.type.buildSpeed/cb.buildCost,null);Time.update();}
    if(!(site.build instanceof Drill.DrillBuild d) || d.dominantItem!=item)throw new AssertionError("Wrong native ore source");source=d;
   }
   while(core.items.get(item)<required && loops++<1000000){
    Time.update();tick++;state.updateId++;source.update();
    if(source.items.get(item)>0){if(u.stack.amount>0)InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);InputHandler.requestItem(p,source,item,u.type.itemCapacity);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);}
   }
  }
  if(core.items.get(item)<required)throw new AssertionError("Native extraction did not fund "+item+": "+core.items);
  row("native_drilled_"+item.name+"_core_gain",p.team(),core.items.get(item)-initial);row("native_drilled_"+item.name+"_ticks",p.team(),loops);
 }
 static void move(Unit u,float x,float y,float radius){float d=u.dst(x,y);if(d>radius)u.moveAt(velocity.set(x-u.x,y-u.y).setLength(Math.min(u.speed(),Math.max(.1f,(d-radius)/8))));else u.moveAt(velocity.setZero());}
 static void transfer(Player p,Building to,Item item,int desired){
  Unit u=p.unit();var core=p.team().core();Vars.player=p;p.set(u);
  if(!u.within(core,itemTransferRange-4) || !u.within(to,itemTransferRange-4))throw new AssertionError("Illegal transfer distance");
  if(u.stack.amount>0)InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);
  int amount=Math.min(u.type.itemCapacity,Math.min(Math.max(0,desired-to.items.get(item)),core.items.get(item)));
  if(amount>0){InputHandler.requestItem(p,core,item,amount);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,to);if(u.stack.amount>0)InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);}
 }
 static void measure(Player p,Building factory,Item output,int duration,Building[] generators){
  var core=p.team().core();int before=core.items.get(output),coalBefore=core.items.get(Items.coal),sandBefore=core.items.get(Items.sand);int powered=0,produced=0;final int[] nativeOutput={0},consumedCoal={0},consumedSand={0};final double[] energy={0,0};
  EvaluationTrace.sink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){public void produce(Team team,int producer,Item item,int amount){if(producer==factory.id && item==output)nativeOutput[0]+=amount;}public void consumed(Building b,Item item,int amount){if(b.id==factory.id){if(item==Items.coal)consumedCoal[0]+=amount;if(item==Items.sand)consumedSand[0]+=amount;}}public void powerUsage(Building b,float requested,float received){if(b.id==factory.id){energy[0]+=requested;energy[1]+=received;}}};
  for(int step=0;step<duration;step++){
   Time.update();tick++;state.updateId++;
   for(Building generator:generators){if(generator.items.get(Items.coal)<3)transfer(p,generator,Items.coal,10);generator.update();}
   if(factory.items.get(Items.coal)<3)transfer(p,factory,Items.coal,10);
   if(factory.block==Blocks.siliconSmelter && factory.items.get(Items.sand)<4)transfer(p,factory,Items.sand,10);
   Set<PowerGraph> seen=Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());for(Building generator:generators)if(seen.add(generator.power.graph))generator.power.graph.update();if(factory.power!=null && seen.add(factory.power.graph))factory.power.graph.update();
   factory.update();if(factory.power==null || factory.power.status>=.99999f)powered++;
   if(factory.items.get(output)>0){int current=factory.items.get(output);transferOutput(p,factory,output);produced+=current;}
  }
  transferOutput(p,factory,output);row(factory.block.name+"_actual_output_3600_ticks",p.team(),nativeOutput[0]);row(factory.block.name+"_core_receipt_3600_ticks",p.team(),core.items.get(output)-before);row(factory.block.name+"_buffered_output_outside_core",p.team(),nativeOutput[0]-(core.items.get(output)-before));row(factory.block.name+"_full_power_ticks",p.team(),powered);row(factory.block.name+"_coal_core_spent_including_generators",p.team(),coalBefore-core.items.get(Items.coal));row(factory.block.name+"_sand_core_spent",p.team(),sandBefore-core.items.get(Items.sand));
  if(powered!=duration)throw new AssertionError("Recipe power not held constant: "+powered+"/"+duration);
  row(factory.block.name+"_actual_recipe_coal_consumed",p.team(),consumedCoal[0]);row(factory.block.name+"_actual_recipe_sand_consumed",p.team(),consumedSand[0]);row(factory.block.name+"_actual_requested_energy",p.team(),energy[0]);row(factory.block.name+"_actual_received_energy",p.team(),energy[1]);
  boolean industrial=p.team()==Team.sharded && (EvaluationParameters.group.equals("G1") || EvaluationParameters.group.equals("G3") || EvaluationParameters.group.endsWith("X"));
  int expected=factory.block==Blocks.graphitePress?(industrial?50:40):(industrial?112:90);
  EvaluationTrace.sink=null;
  if(Math.abs(nativeOutput[0]-expected)>1)throw new AssertionError("Unexpected native recipe output "+factory.block.name+" "+nativeOutput[0]);
 }
 static void transferOutput(Player p,Building b,Item item){
  Unit u=p.unit();var core=p.team().core();Vars.player=p;p.set(u);if(u.stack.amount>0)InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);
  if(b.items.get(item)>0){InputHandler.requestItem(p,b,item,u.type.itemCapacity);InputHandler.transferInventory(p,core);}
 }
}
````

## src/ReloadNativePreparationAgent.java

SHA-256：`3ccad14a30e505dedb2b101a4c16ba62730a5dd699257bedfbf9e9dff8a77670`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import java.lang.instrument.*;import java.nio.file.*;import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Own prerequisite process only; changes its courier algorithm, never inventory or game rules. */
public class ReloadNativePreparationAgent{
 public static void agentmain(String path,Instrumentation instrumentation)throws Exception{
  if(!instrumentation.isRedefineClassesSupported())throw new IllegalStateException("No supported class reload");
  byte[] code=java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(Path.of(path));Core.app.post(()->{try{
   if(headless || !state.isCampaign() || !"crateredBattleground".equals(Pilot.mapName) || !NativeCampaignStage.ready)throw new IllegalStateException("Wrong preparation process");
   instrumentation.redefineClasses(new ClassDefinition(NativeCampaignStage.class,code));
   NativeCampaignStage.event("preparation_courier_algorithm_corrected","direct_mining_requires_an_actual_native_ore_tile;processed_outputs_use_real_factory_inputs;real_core_coal_can_fuel_connected_generators;no_material_or_rule_writes=true");
  }catch(Exception ex){throw new RuntimeException(ex);}});
 }
}
````

## src/ValidateNativeProfile.java

Zero played frames; reads an immutable profile and checks the selected active world against settings; offscreen balances legitimately evolve through native Universe.

SHA-256：`35107d08498a7a3bfb93f917b992d65a6dbc1219d5c464bb134ec2ac62b5a5e6`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.headless.*;import arc.files.*;import mindustry.*;import mindustry.core.*;import mindustry.content.*;import mindustry.game.*;import mindustry.game.EventType.*;import mindustry.io.*;import mindustry.net.*;import mindustry.type.*;
import java.nio.file.*;import java.util.*;import static mindustry.Vars.*;
/** Zero played frames; reads an immutable profile and checks the selected active world against settings; offscreen balances legitimately evolve through native Universe. */
public class ValidateNativeProfile{
 static int[] rawItems;static int worlds,rawPlayerConstructions;static ArrayList<String> errors=new ArrayList<>();
 public static void main(String[] args){new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{
  String profile=args[0],output=args[1],active=args[2];Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(output+".scratch"));headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(null);Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();bases.load();
  Settings source=new Settings();source.setDataDirectory(new Fi(profile));source.setJson(JsonIO.json);source.loadValues();
  Events.on(WorldLoadEvent.class,e->{rawItems=new int[content.items().size];var core=state.rules.defaultTeam.core();if(core==null){errors.add("raw world has no player core");return;}for(var item:content.items())rawItems[item.id]=core.items.get(item);rawPlayerConstructions=0;for(var building:mindustry.gen.Groups.build)if(building.team==state.rules.defaultTeam && building instanceof mindustry.world.blocks.ConstructBlock.ConstructBuild)rawPlayerConstructions++;});
  try(var files=java.nio.file.Files.list(Path.of(profile,"saves"))){for(Path file:files.filter(p->p.toString().endsWith(".msav") && !p.toString().contains("backup")).sorted().toList()){
   var meta=SaveIO.getMeta(new Fi(file.toString()));String name=meta.tags.get("sectorPreset","");if(!name.equals(active))continue;SectorPreset preset=content.getByName(mindustry.ctype.ContentType.sector,name);if(preset==null){errors.add("unknown sector "+name);continue;}var sector=preset.sector;
   SectorInfo saved=source.getJson(sector.planet.name+"-s-"+sector.id+"-info",SectorInfo.class,SectorInfo::new);
   if(!saved.hasCore || meta.wave!=saved.wave || meta.rules.waves!=saved.waves || meta.rules.attackMode!=saved.attack)errors.add(name+": raw world/settings wave or capture mismatch");
   rawItems=null;SaveIO.load(new Fi(file.toString()),world.makeSectorContext(sector));if(rawItems==null)throw new IllegalStateException("No raw world observation");
   for(var item:content.items())if(rawItems[item.id]!=saved.items.get(item))errors.add(name+": inventory mismatch "+item.name+" raw="+rawItems[item.id]+" settings="+saved.items.get(item));worlds++;
  }}
  if(worlds!=1)errors.add("Expected exactly one selected active-sector world");StringBuilder list=new StringBuilder();for(String error:errors){if(list.length()>0)list.append(',');list.append('"').append(error.replace('"','\'')).append('"');}
  String result="{\"passed\":"+errors.isEmpty()+",\"formal_sample\":false,\"played_frames\":0,\"native_worlds_checked\":"+worlds+",\"active_player_constructions\":"+rawPlayerConstructions+",\"errors\":["+list+"]}\n";java.nio.file.Files.writeString(Path.of(output),result);System.out.println(result);System.exit(errors.isEmpty()?0:1);
 }catch(Throwable error){error.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});}
}
````

````java
import arc.*;import arc.backend.headless.*;import arc.files.*;import arc.math.*;

/** Isolated native WaveSpawner count fixture, never a gameplay result. */
public class WavePressureAcceptance{
 public static void main(String[] args){System.setProperty("mindustry.eval.fixed","true");new HeadlessApplication(new ApplicationListener(){public void init(){try{test(args[0]);System.exit(0);}catch(Throwable t){t.printStackTrace();System.exit(1);}}});}
 static void test(String path)throws Exception{
  Core.settings.setDataDirectory(new Fi(path+".data"));headless=true;loadLocales=false;net=new Net(null);Vars.loadSettings();Vars.init();content.createBaseContent();content.init();logic=new Logic();netServer=new NetServer();
  Mathf.rand.setSeed(0);world.loadMap(maps.loadInternalMap("serpulo/stainedMountains"));
  int[] plans={0},actual={0},bossUnits={0};
  PrintWriter out=new PrintWriter(path);out.println("wave,group,type,x,y,native,adjusted,boss");
  EvaluationTrace.sink=new EvaluationTrace.Sink(){public void spawnPlan(SpawnGroup g,float x,float y,int base,int adjusted){
   int expected=base==0 || g.effect==StatusEffects.boss?base:Math.round(base*(1+EvaluationParameters.alpha));
   if(expected!=adjusted)throw new AssertionError("Count mismatch");plans[0]+=adjusted;
   out.println(state.wave+","+state.rules.spawns.indexOf(g,true)+","+g.type.name+","+x+","+y+","+base+","+adjusted+","+(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss));
  }public void spawnUnit(SpawnGroup g,Unit unit){actual[0]++;if(g.effect==StatusEffects.boss)bossUnits[0]++;}};
  for(int wave=1;wave<=31;wave++){state.wave=wave;spawner.spawnEnemies();}
  if(plans[0]!=actual[0])throw new AssertionError("Requested "+plans[0]+" actual "+actual[0]);
  for(int n:new int[]{0,1,2,7})if(EvaluationParameters.waveCount(n,true)!=n)throw new AssertionError("Boss changed");
  if(EvaluationParameters.waveCount(0,false)!=0)throw new AssertionError("Zero changed");
  EvaluationTrace.sink=null;out.close();System.out.println("PASS alpha="+EvaluationParameters.alpha+" native_requested="+plans[0]+" actual_spawned="+actual[0]+" boss_units="+bossUnits[0]);
 }
}
````

## summarize_preparation.py

Account the single earned C preparation history separately from formal route samples.

SHA-256：`05cb145aca3992fb1f429a48c8d18a5ae11144535d79cca56b5a75f424f6de8c`；同内容路径数：1。完整别名见CSV。

````python
"""Account the single earned C preparation history separately from formal route samples."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,hashlib,json,re

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'report'
HISTORY=[('groundZero','campaign-preparation/attempt2/groundZero-events.csv'),
         ('frozenForest','campaign-preparation/frozenForest/attempt1.events.csv'),
         ('crateredBattleground','campaign-preparation/crateredBattleground/attempt3.events.csv'),
         ('biomassFacility','campaign-preparation/biomassFacility/attempt1.events.csv'),
         ('ruinousShores','campaign-preparation/ruinousShores/attempt1.events.csv')]

def detail(value):return dict(part.split('=',1) for part in value.split(';') if '=' in part)
def module(value):return {k:int(v) for k,v in re.findall(r'([\w-]+):(\d+)',value)}
def itemseq(value):return {name.strip().lower().replace(' ','-'):int(amount) for name,amount in re.findall(r'([A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]*):\s*(\d+)',value)}
def write(name,rows,fields):
    with (OUT/name).open('w') as f:
        writer=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=fields);writer.writeheader();writer.writerows(rows)

def main():
    payments=[];construction=defaultdict(int);sources=[];completed=[];research_seen=set()
    history=[dict(sector=s,artifact=p,through_seq=None) for s,p in HISTORY]
    continuation=ROOT/'results/C-preparation-continuations.json'
    if continuation.exists():
        segments=json.loads(continuation.read_text())['canonical_segments'];replaced={s['sector'] for s in segments}
        history=[segment for original in history for segment in ([s for s in segments if s['sector']==original['sector']] if original['sector'] in replaced else [original])]
    for segment in history:
        sector,relative=segment['sector'],segment['artifact']
        path=ROOT/relative
        if not path.exists():continue
        with path.open() as f:events=list(csv.DictReader(f))
        cutoff=segment.get('through_seq')
        if cutoff is not None:events=[e for e in events if int(e['seq'])<=cutoff];assert events and int(events[-1]['seq'])==cutoff
        sources.append(dict(sector=sector,path=relative,through_seq=cutoff,sha256=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()))
        if any(e['event'] in ['preparation_end','native_preparation_end'] and 'captured' in e['detail'] and 'stocked' in e['detail'] for e in events) and sector not in completed:completed.append(sector)
        receipt_targets={detail(e['detail']).get('target') for e in events if e['event']=='native_research_source_receipt'}
        pending={};launch_schematic={};launch_resources={}
        for e in events:
            d=detail(e['detail']);kind=e['event']
            base=dict(sector=sector,journal_seq=e['seq'],effective_seconds=e['effective_sim_seconds'],artifact=relative)
            if kind=='native_launch_loadout':launch_schematic=itemseq(d['schematic']);launch_resources=itemseq(d['resources'])
            if kind=='construction_paid':construction[sector,d['item']]+=int(d['amount'])
            elif kind in ['native_launch_debit_receipt','native_research_source_receipt']:
                paid=int(d['paid']);consumed=paid if kind=='native_research_source_receipt' else launch_schematic.get(d['item'],0);carried=0 if kind=='native_research_source_receipt' else launch_resources.get(d['item'],0)
                assert paid==consumed+carried,'Native launch debit/carry split does not reconcile'
                payments.append(dict(**base,event=kind,target=d.get('target',sector),item=d['item'],paid=paid,consumed_cost=consumed,carried_resources=carried,source_sector=d.get('sector',d.get('origin','')),evidence='native source balance before/paid/after receipt; schematic consumption separated from transport'))
            elif kind=='native_research_payment':
                assert d['unlocked']=='true'
                before=module(d['before']);after=module(d['after'])
                for item in sorted(before.keys()|after.keys()):
                    amount=before.get(item,0)-after.get(item,0)
                    if amount:payments.append(dict(**base,event=kind,target=d['target'],item=item,paid=amount,consumed_cost=amount,carried_resources=0,source_sector='170',evidence='single-base native before/after inventory'))
                assert d['target'] not in research_seen;research_seen.add(d['target'])
            elif kind=='native_research_payment_begin':
                assert d['target'] not in research_seen,'Repeated research requires remaining-cost rather than total-cost accounting'
                pending[d['target']]=e
            elif kind=='native_research_payment_end':
                assert d['unlocked']=='true';start=pending.pop(d['target']);research_seen.add(d['target'])
                if d['target'] in receipt_targets:continue
                # The retained Frozen Forest v1 driver waits for the entire outstanding
                # cost before invoking native spend; no earlier partial payment exists.
                assert sector=='frozenForest','Unexpected missing source receipt in later driver'
                for display,amount in re.findall(r'([A-Za-z][A-Za-z -]*): (\d+)',detail(start['detail'])['required']):
                    item=display.lower().replace(' ','-')
                    payments.append(dict(**base,event='native_completed_research_total',target=d['target'],item=item,paid=int(amount),consumed_cost=int(amount),carried_resources=0,source_sector='unrecorded native multi-sector split',evidence='v1 full-affordability check and native unlocked callback; total requirement, no per-source receipt'))
    extra_exclusions=json.loads(continuation.read_text()).get('additional_excluded_histories',[]) if continuation.exists() else []
    totals=defaultdict(int);consumed_totals=defaultdict(int);carried_totals=defaultdict(int)
    for row in payments:
        key=row['event'],row['item'];totals[key]+=row['paid'];consumed_totals[key]+=row['consumed_cost'];carried_totals[key]+=row['carried_resources']
    write('C_preparation_payments.csv',payments,['sector','journal_seq','effective_seconds','artifact','event','target','item','paid','consumed_cost','carried_resources','source_sector','evidence'])
    write('C_preparation_construction.csv',[dict(sector=s,item=i,paid=n) for (s,i),n in sorted(construction.items())],['sector','item','paid'])
    summary=dict(formal_samples_added=0,one_common_history_not_40_observations=True,canonical_history=history,completed_prerequisites=completed,excluded_histories=['failed groundZero first attempt','crateredBattleground attempts1/2 with inconsistent interrupted world/settings pair','independent smoke/training profiles','interrupted preparation event tails after the committed recovery checkpoint']+extra_exclusions,sources=sources,payment_totals=[dict(event=e,item=i,source_debit=n,consumed_cost=consumed_totals[e,i],carried_resources=carried_totals[e,i]) for (e,i),n in sorted(totals.items())],launch_transport_not_counted_as_consumption=True,limitation='Frozen Forest v1 research has total full-affordability and native unlock evidence but no per-source split; all later research and formal routes retain actual source-debit receipts')
    (OUT/'C-preparation-costs.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(dict(canonical_sectors_completed=len(completed),payment_rows=len(payments),formal_samples_added=0)))

if __name__=='__main__':main()
````

````python
"""Equal-run resource/coverage summaries; endpoint debt is never summed over windows."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import defaultdict
import csv,json
from analyze_formal import mean,paired
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/'report'
ITEMS=['copper','graphite','silicon']
SUMS=['supply','full_demand','construction_paid','flow_gap','net_shortage_core','rebuild_paid','repair_material_paid']
def write(name,rows):
    if not rows:return
    with (OUT/name).open('w') as f:
        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(dict.fromkeys(k for row in rows for k in row)));w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
snapshot=json.loads((OUT/'analysis_manifest.json').read_text());items=[];coverage=[]
for filename in snapshot['valid_route_files']:
    route=json.loads(Path(filename).read_text())
    for stage in route['stages']:
        totals={i:dict.fromkeys(SUMS,0.) for i in ITEMS};endpoint={i:0. for i in ITEMS};maximum={i:0. for i in ITEMS}
        supplied=defaultdict(float);facilities=defaultdict(float)
        with open(stage['path']+'.windows.csv') as f:
            for row in csv.DictReader(f):
                if row['scope']=='item' and row['item'] in totals:
                    item=row['item']
                    for name in SUMS:totals[item][name]+=float(row[name])
                    endpoint[item]=float(row['due_unpaid_end']);maximum[item]=max(maximum[item],endpoint[item])
                elif row['scope']=='facility_supply':
                    supplied[row['item']]+=float(row['supply']);facilities[row['item'],row['facility']]+=float(row['supply'])
        base={k:route[k] for k in ['track','chain','policy','group','alpha','seed','run_id']};base['stage']=stage['stage'];base['observed_seconds']=float(stage['summary']['sim_seconds'])
        for item in ITEMS:
            totals[item].update(due_unpaid_stage_end=endpoint[item],due_unpaid_window_end_max=maximum[item])
            items.append({**base,'item':item,**totals[item]})
        for item,supply in supplied.items():
            direct=sum(value for (i,facility),value in facilities.items() if i==item and facility in ['mechanical-drill','pneumatic-drill','graphite-press','silicon-smelter'])
            extended=sum(value for (i,facility),value in facilities.items() if i==item and facility in ['laser-drill','multi-press'])
            coverage.append({**base,'item':item,'actual_total_production':supply,'direct_I_facility_production':direct,'X_facility_production':extended,'direct_I_share':direct/supply if supply else None,'X_share':extended/supply if supply else None,'definition':'Direct production facilities only; excludes transportation effects and core receipts'})
write('resource_totals_per_run.csv',items);write('production_coverage_per_run.csv',coverage)
names=['track','chain','policy','group','alpha','stage','item'];buckets=defaultdict(list);cover=defaultdict(list)
for row in items:buckets[tuple(row[k] for k in names)].append(row)
for row in coverage:cover[tuple(row[k] for k in names)].append(row)
summary=[];differences=[]
for key,rows in buckets.items():
    result={**dict(zip(names,key)),'observed_runs':len(rows),'observed_seconds_mean':mean([r['observed_seconds'] for r in rows]),'inventory_scope':'core only','gap_total_definition':'sum of positive five-minute window gaps; not a single whole-stage net gap'}
    for metric in SUMS+['due_unpaid_stage_end','due_unpaid_window_end_max']:result[metric+'_mean']=mean([r[metric] for r in rows])
    summary.append(result)
    if key[3]!='G0':
        base=buckets.get(key[:3]+('G0',)+key[4:],[])
        for metric in SUMS+['due_unpaid_stage_end']:
            a={r['seed']:r[metric] for r in base};b={r['seed']:r[metric] for r in rows}
            differences.append({**dict(zip(names,key)),'metric':metric,'direction':'G0 minus group; positive means smaller group value',**paired(a,b)})
coverage_summary=[]
for key,rows in cover.items():
    total=sum(r['actual_total_production'] for r in rows)
    coverage_summary.append({**dict(zip(names,key)),'observed_runs':len(rows),'production_contributing_runs':sum(r['actual_total_production']>0 for r in rows),'production_mean':mean([r['actual_total_production'] for r in rows]),'direct_I_share_equal_run_mean':mean([r['direct_I_share'] for r in rows]),'X_share_equal_run_mean':mean([r['X_share'] for r in rows]),'direct_I_share_pooled_production':sum(r['direct_I_facility_production'] for r in rows)/total if total else None,'X_share_pooled_production':sum(r['X_facility_production'] for r in rows)/total if total else None})
write('resource_stage_summary.csv',summary);write('paired_resource_stage_differences.csv',differences);write('production_coverage.csv',coverage_summary)
print(json.dumps(dict(snapshot_routes=len(snapshot['valid_route_files']),run_item_records=len(items),run_coverage_records=len(coverage),stage_resource_groups=len(summary))))
````
